These condensates form when particles enter a collective quantum state and begin behaving as a coordinated system rather than as separate individuals.
paras.zh: 几十年来，超固体仍然是一个理论概念。 2017 年，研究人员在超冷原子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中观察到了这一现象，最终得到了实验证实。当粒子进入集体量子态并开始表现为协调系统而不是单独的个体时，这些凝聚体就会形成。

paras.en: The catch was that producing these conditions generally required sophisticated equipment capable of cooling matter to temperatures extremely close to absolute zero, the lowest possible temperature.
paras.zh: 问题是，产生这些条件通常需要复杂的设备，能够将物质冷却到极其接近绝对零的温度，即可能的最低温度。

paras.en: Creating a Quantum Supersolid Using Light Instead of Cold Atoms
paras.zh: 使用光而不是冷原子创建量子超固体

paras.en: The international TopoLight consortium approached the challenge from a different direction. Instead of using ultracold atoms, the researchers worked with unusual hybrid particles called exciton polaritons.
paras.zh: 国际 TopoLight 联盟从不同的方向应对这一挑战。研究人员没有使用超冷原子，而是使用了称为激子极化激元的不寻常的混合粒子。

paras.en: These quasiparticles arise when light interacts so strongly with matter that the two become coupled inside a tiny optical chamber called a microcavity. The resulting particles display characteristics of both light and matter.
paras.zh: 当光与物质相互作用如此强烈，以致两者在称为微腔的微小光学室内耦合时，就会产生这些准粒子。产生的粒子显示出光和物质的特征。

paras.en: Exciton polaritons are extremely short-lived, typically surviving for only a few picoseconds. A picosecond is one trillionth of a second. Despite their brief existence, these particles can organize into a Bose-Einstein condensate and collectively exhibit the behavior of a quantum superfluid.
paras.zh: 激子极化激元的寿命极短，通常只能存活几皮秒。一皮秒是一万亿分之一秒。尽管存在时间很短，但这些粒子可以组织成玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体，并共同表现出量子超流体的行为。

paras.en: To create the necessary conditions, the team constructed an optical microcavity containing a specially engineered liquid crystal and covered it with an organic semiconductor. The arrangement allowed light and matter to interact strongly enough to produce the desired quantum effects without the need for extreme cooling.
paras.zh: 为了创造必要的条件，该团队构建了一个包含特殊设计的液晶的光学微腔，并用有机半导体覆盖它。这种布置允许光和物质发生足够强烈的相互作用，以产生所需的量子效应，而不需要极度冷却。

paras.en: "Our liquid-crystal microcavities can operate even at temperatures approaching 60°C," says Professor Wiktor Piecek from the Military University of Technology, whose group developed the liquid-crystal structures.
paras.zh: “我们的液晶微腔甚至可以在接近 60°C 的温度下工作，”军事科技大学的 Wiktor Piecek 教授说，他的团队开发了液晶结构。

paras.en: That temperature is approximately 140°F, far above the freezing conditions normally associated with experiments involving exotic quantum matter.
paras.zh: 该温度约为 140°F，远高于通常与涉及奇异量子物质的实验相关的冰点条件。

paras.en: Strange Patterns of Light Reveal a Supersolid
paras.zh: 奇怪的光图案揭示了超固体

paras.en: How can researchers determine whether a collection of particles has entered such an unusual state?
paras.zh: 研究人员如何确定一组粒子是否已进入如此不寻常的状态？

paras.en: In this experiment, the evidence appeared in the light emitted by the sample. When the system transitioned into the supersolid phase, researchers observed a series of regularly spaced bright fringes.
paras.zh: 在这个实验中，证据出现在样品发出的光中。当系统转变为超固体相时，研究人员观察到一系列规则间隔的明亮条纹。

paras.en: These patterns indicated that the particle condensate had spontaneously developed a repeating variation in its density. This type of spatial organization is a defining feature of crystalline structures and an important sign of supersolidity.
paras.zh: 这些图案表明颗粒凝聚物的密度自发地出现重复变化。这种类型的空间组织是晶体结构的定义特征，也是超固体的重要标志。

paras.en: But the researchers noticed another intriguing effect.
paras.zh: 但研究人员注意到了另一个有趣的效应。

paras.en: Each time a laser pulse excited the sample, the bright fringes appeared in a different position. Rather than following a single fixed arrangement, the quantum system repeatedly selected among several equally possible configurations.
paras.zh: 每次激光脉冲激发样品时，明亮的条纹就会出现在不同的位置。量子系统不是遵循单一的固定排列，而是在几种同等可能的配置中重复选择。

paras.en: "This is a textbook example of spontaneous symmetry breaking," explains Professor Guillaume Malpuech from Institut Pascal (CNRS). "Theory predicted that the supersolid could choose among several equivalent states, and that is exactly what we observed."
paras.zh: “这是自发对称破缺的教科书例子，”帕斯卡研究所（CNRS）的 Guillaume Malpuech 教授解释道。 “理论预测超固体可以在几种等效状态之间进行选择，这正是我们所观察到的。”

paras.en: Spontaneous symmetry breaking occurs when a system that could exist in several equivalent arrangements settles into one particular configuration. In this case, the effect became visible through the changing positions of the light patterns.
paras.zh: 当一个可能存在于几种等效排列中的系统陷入一种特定的配置时，就会发生自发对称性破缺。在这种情况下，通过改变光图案的位置，效果变得可见。

paras.en: The condensate also displayed another unusual characteristic called a persistent spin helix. This refers to a repeating variation in the polarization of the emitted light. Polarization describes the orientation of light's oscillating electric field.
paras.zh: 凝聚物还表现出另一种不寻常的特征，称为持续自旋螺旋。这是指发射光的偏振的重复变化。偏振描述了光振荡电场的方向。

paras.en: Together, these observations revealed two different forms of order occurring at the same time. One appeared in the intensity of the emitted light, while the other appeared in its polarization.
paras.zh: 这些观察结果共同揭示了同时发生的两种不同形式的秩序。一个表现为发射光的强度，而另一个表现为其偏振。

paras.en: A Difficult Experiment With Only Hours to Succeed
paras.zh: 一个艰难的实验，只有几个小时才能成功

paras.en: Achieving these results required overcoming an unexpected practical obstacle.
paras.zh: 实现这些成果需要克服意想不到的实际障碍。

paras.en: The organic semiconductor used in the device gradually reacted with the liquid crystal. As a result, the experimental samples had a limited useful lifetime, giving the scientists only a few hours to collect their measurements after assembly.
paras.zh: 器件中使用的有机半导体逐渐与液晶发生反应。因此，实验样品的使用寿命有限，科学家们在组装后只有几个小时来收集测量结果。

paras.en: This restriction made careful preparation essential. The researchers needed to determine exactly which measurements to perform and in what order before beginning each experimental run.
paras.zh: 这一限制使得仔细的准备工作变得至关重要。研究人员需要在开始每次实验之前准确确定要执行哪些测量以及按什么顺序进行。

paras.en: "We had to plan the entire sequence of experiments in advance," recalls Dr. Marcin Muszyński, the paper's first author, now a postdoctoral researcher at The City College of New York. "Repeating a measurement meant fabricating an entirely new sample."
paras.zh: “我们必须提前计划整个实验序列，”该论文的第一作者、现任纽约城市学院的博士后研究员 Marcin Muszyński 博士回忆道。 “重复测量意味着制造一个全新的样品。”

paras.en: The most important measurements took place at IBM Research Zurich. There, scientists deposited thin layers of the organic semiconductor onto specialized structures designed to manipulate light. These photonic structures had been manufactured at the Military University of Technology.
paras.zh: 最重要的测量是在 IBM 苏黎世研究院进行的。在那里，科学家们将有机半导体薄层沉积到旨在操纵光的特殊结构上。这些光子结构是在军事科技大学制造的。

paras.en: The semiconductor itself was not new to the researchers. IBM scientists had investigated its quantum properties for years, including its ability to support Bose-Einstein condensation.
paras.zh: 半导体本身对研究人员来说并不新鲜。 IBM 科学家多年来一直研究其量子特性，包括其支持玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚的能力。

paras.en: "We have studied the organic semiconductor MeLPPP (methyl-substituted ladder-type poly(paraphenylene) for many years and previously observed Bose-Einstein condensation in this material," says Thilo Stöferle from IBM Research. "This was the first time we combined it with a liquid-crystal microcavity."
paras.zh: IBM 研究中心的 Thilo Stöferle 表示：“我们对有机半导体 MeLPPP（甲基取代梯型聚对亚苯基）进行了多年研究，之前曾在这种材料中观察到玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚。这是我们第一次将其与液晶微腔结合起来。”

paras.en: Bringing these materials together ultimately made it possible to observe the unusual supersolid behavior at room temperature.
paras.zh: 将这些材料结合在一起最终使得在室温下观察不寻常的超固体行为成为可能。

paras.en: Why Room Temperature Quantum Matter Matters
paras.zh: 为什么室温量子物质很重要

paras.en: The significance of the discovery extends beyond demonstrating another unusual phenomenon predicted by quantum physics.
paras.zh: 这一发现的意义不仅仅在于证明量子物理学预测的另一种不寻常现象。

paras.en: Many experiments involving exotic quantum states depend on costly cryogenic systems designed to maintain temperatures close to absolute zero. These demanding conditions make research more complicated and can create substantial obstacles when scientists attempt to turn laboratory discoveries into useful technologies.
paras.zh: 许多涉及奇异量子态的实验都依赖于昂贵的低温系统，该系统旨在将温度保持在接近绝对零的水平。这些苛刻的条件使研究变得更加复杂，并且当科学家试图将实验室发现转化为有用的技术时，可能会造成巨大的障碍。

paras.en: The new results show that certain exotic quantum effects can instead be investigated in photonic devices that operate at ordinary temperatures.
paras.zh: 新结果表明，某些奇异的量子效应可以在常温下运行的光子器件中进行研究。

paras.en: This could create opportunities for future technologies that use light to process information. Potential applications include ultrafast photonic devices, specialized computing accelerators inspired by the way biological brains process information, and advanced optical sensors.
paras.zh: 这可能为未来使用光处理信息的技术创造机会。潜在的应用包括超快光子设备、受生物大脑处理信息方式启发的专用计算加速器以及先进的光学传感器。

paras.en: The computing approach, known as neuromorphic computing, seeks to imitate aspects of the brain's information processing to perform certain tasks more efficiently. Light-based systems could eventually provide new ways to accelerate these operations.
paras.zh: 这种计算方法被称为神经形态计算，旨在模仿大脑信息处理的各个方面，以更有效地执行某些任务。基于光的系统最终可以提供加速这些操作的新方法。

paras.en: The supersolid's exceptional sensitivity to light polarization may also prove useful for developing sensors capable of detecting extremely subtle optical changes.
paras.zh: 超固体对光偏振的卓越敏感性也可能有助于开发能够检测极其微妙的光学变化的传感器。

paras.en: These applications remain possibilities for future research, but the ability to generate the underlying quantum behavior without extreme cooling represents an important step toward making such technologies more practical.
paras.zh: 这些应用仍然是未来研究的可能性，但在不极端冷却的情况下生成底层量子行为的能力代表了使此类技术更加实用的重要一步。

paras.en: Electrically Controlled Quantum Matter Opens New Possibilities
paras.zh: 电控量子物质开辟了新的可能性

paras.en: One of the most promising features of the experiment is that the optical device can be adjusted using electricity.
paras.zh: 该实验最有前途的特点之一是光学装置可以用电来调节。

paras.en: The liquid crystal microcavities provide the first electrically tunable platform for studying supersolid exciton-polariton condensates. This means researchers can alter the optical properties of the system by applying an external voltage.
paras.zh: 液晶微腔为研究超固体激子-极化子凝聚态提供了第一个电可调平台。这意味着研究人员可以通过施加外部电压来改变系统的光学特性。

paras.en: Earlier experimental approaches did not offer this same degree of electrical control.
paras.zh: 早期的实验方法没有提供同样程度的电气控制。

paras.en: The ability to adjust the system dynamically gives physicists greater flexibility when investigating how quantum states emerge, interact, and respond to changing conditions.
paras.zh: 动态调整系统的能力为物理学家在研究量子态如何出现、相互作用和响应不断变化的条件时提供了更大的灵活性。

paras.en: It could also become valuable when designing practical quantum photonic devices, where precise control over the behavior of light and matter is essential.
paras.zh: 在设计实用的量子光子器件时，它也可能变得有价值，其中对光和物质行为的精确控制至关重要。

paras.en: By combining room-temperature operation with electrical tunability, the researchers have established a versatile platform for exploring quantum phenomena that previously required far more demanding experimental conditions.
paras.zh: 通过将室温操作与电可调谐性相结合，研究人员建立了一个多功能平台来探索量子现象，而这些现象以前需要更加苛刻的实验条件。

paras.en: About the University of Warsaw Faculty of Physics
paras.zh: 关于华沙大学物理学院

paras.en: The University of Warsaw has a long history of research and education in physics and astronomy. Both disciplines became part of the university in 1816, when they were included in the Faculty of Philosophy. The university subsequently established its Astronomical Observatory in 1825.
paras.zh: 华沙大学在物理学和天文学方面有着悠久的研究和教育历史。这两个学科于 1816 年成为大学的一部分，并并入哲学学院。该大学随后于 1825 年建立了天文台。

paras.en: Today, the Faculty of Physics includes the Institutes of Experimental Physics, Theoretical Physics, and Geophysics, along with the Department of Mathematical Methods in Physics.
paras.zh: 如今，物理学院包括实验物理研究所、理论物理研究所、地球物理学研究所以及物理数学方法系。

paras.en: Its research encompasses nearly every major area of modern physics, from the behavior of particles at quantum scales to the structure and evolution of the universe.
paras.zh: 它的研究几乎涵盖了现代物理学的每个主要领域，从量子尺度的粒子行为到宇宙的结构和演化。

paras.en: The faculty employs more than 250 academic teachers and serves approximately 1,350 students and more than 150 doctoral students.
paras.zh: 该学院拥有 250 多名学术教师，为大约 1,350 名学生和 150 多名博士生提供服务。

paras.en: According to Shanghai's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects, the University of Warsaw ranks among the world's top 150 institutions for physics education.
paras.zh: 根据上海全球学科排名，华沙大学物理教育跻身世界前150名。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Warsaw, Faculty of Physics. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由华沙大学物理学院提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: When your gut bacteria run out of fiber, they may start eating your gut lining

paras.en: When your gut bacteria run out of fiber, they may start eating your gut lining
paras.zh: 当您的肠道细菌耗尽纤维时，它们可能会开始吃掉您的肠道内壁

paras.en: - Scientists have discovered that gut bacteria can feed on the protective mucus lining your intestines, producing potentially harmful compounds, but fiber helps keep this activity in check. Overlooked proteins in plant foods also help shift gut bacteria toward producing beneficial substances, revealing a surprising new reason plant-based diets may be good for you.
paras.zh: - 科学家发现，肠道细菌可以以肠道内的保护性粘液为食，产生潜在有害的化合物，但纤维有助于控制这种活动。植物性食品中被忽视的蛋白质也有助于肠道细菌产生有益物质，揭示了植物性饮食可能对您有益的一个令人惊讶的新原因。

paras.en: Eating more plants is widely associated with better health, but scientists are still uncovering exactly why. New research suggests that fiber is only part of the story. Certain plant proteins that resist digestion may also play a surprisingly important role in shaping gut bacteria and determining whether they produce beneficial or potentially harmful substances.
paras.zh: 多吃植物与更好的健康有着广泛的联系，但科学家们仍在揭晓其中的确切原因。新的研究表明纤维只是故事的一部分。某些抗消化的植物蛋白也可能在塑造肠道细菌并决定它们是否产生有益或潜在有害物质方面发挥着令人惊讶的重要作用。

paras.en: Plant-based diets support digestive health, immune function, metabolism, and cardiovascular health. One reason is that they help maintain a diverse community of microorganisms in the intestines, collectively known as the gut microbiome. Many of these bacteria are beneficial, helping break down food components that the human digestive system cannot process on its own.
paras.zh: 植物性饮食支持消化健康、免疫功能、新陈代谢和心血管健康。原因之一是它们有助于维持肠道内多样化的微生物群落，统称为肠道微生物组。其中许多细菌都是有益的，有助于分解人体消化系统无法自行处理的食物成分。

paras.en: Fiber is particularly important because it provides food for gut microbes. Plants also contain phytochemicals, natural substances that often give fruits and vegetables their vibrant colors and help protect them from environmental threats. These compounds can also contribute to human health. Yet researchers have only begun to understand the complicated chemical interactions that occur when gut bacteria digest plant foods.
paras.zh: 纤维特别重要，因为它为肠道微生物提供食物。植物还含有植物化学物质，这些天然物质通常赋予水果和蔬菜鲜艳的色彩，并有助于保护它们免受环境威胁。这些化合物也有助于人类健康。然而，研究人员才刚刚开始了解肠道细菌消化植物性食物时发生的复杂化学相互作用。

paras.en: Two studies led by Jenna AbuSalim and Joshua Rabinowitz, director of the Princeton Branch of the Ludwig Institute for Cancer Research, provide important new insights. One, published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, shows how plant fiber and certain proteins influence gut bacteria to favor the production of beneficial compounds over potentially harmful ones. The other, published in Nature Metabolism in June, challenges the longstanding belief that many important chemical compounds circulating in the body originate exclusively from intestinal microbes.
paras.zh: 由路德维希癌症研究所普林斯顿分院所长 Jenna AbuSalim 和 Joshua Rabinowitz 领导的两项研究提供了重要的新见解。其中一篇发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上，展示了植物纤维和某些蛋白质如何影响肠道细菌，使其有利于有益化合物的产生，而不是潜在有害的化合物。另一篇发表于 6 月《自然代谢》杂志上，挑战了长期以来的观点，即体内循环的许多重要化合物完全源自肠道微生物。

paras.en: "There's growing interest across medical disciplines in manipulating the human microbiome or using its metabolic products themselves for therapy," said Rabinowitz. "Diet holds great promise for controlling the microbiome and its outputs. But to devise effective therapeutic interventions, we need to understand what aspects of the diet control which microbial outputs."
paras.zh: 拉比诺维茨说：“整个医学学科对操纵人类微生物组或利用其代谢产物本身进行治疗越来越感兴趣。” “饮食对于控制微生物组及其输出有着巨大的希望。但是为了设计有效的治疗干预措施，我们需要了解饮食的哪些方面控制着微生物的输出。”

paras.en: How Plant Foods Change the Chemicals Your Gut Produces
paras.zh: 植物性食物如何改变肠道产生的化学物质

paras.en: In the PNAS study, researchers examined a group of substances called phenol metabolites. Metabolites are chemicals formed when the body or microorganisms break down and process nutrients. Some are essential for normal biological functions, while others can contribute to health problems when they accumulate.
paras.zh: 在美国国家科学院院刊的研究中，研究人员检查了一组称为苯酚代谢物的物质。代谢物是身体或微生物分解和处理营养物质时形成的化学物质。有些对于正常的生物功能至关重要，而另一些则在积累时会导致健康问题。

paras.en: The phenol metabolites investigated by the team are produced when gut bacteria process two amino acids, tyrosine and phenylalanine. Amino acids are the building blocks of proteins, but the compounds they ultimately produce can have very different effects on health.
paras.zh: 研究小组研究的苯酚代谢物是肠道细菌处理酪氨酸和苯丙氨酸两种氨基酸时产生的。氨基酸是蛋白质的组成部分，但它们最终产生的化合物对健康有截然不同的影响。

paras.en: Two metabolites derived from phenylalanine, phenylpropionate and hippuric acid, are associated with healthy body weight and better gut health. In contrast, two compounds derived from tyrosine, p-cresol sulfate and phenol sulfate, have been linked to worse outcomes in cancer patients and harmful effects throughout the body in people with kidney disease.
paras.zh: 苯丙酸和马尿酸这两种源自苯丙氨酸的代谢物与健康体重和更好的肠道健康有关。相比之下，两种源自酪氨酸的化合物，即对甲酚硫酸盐和苯酚硫酸盐，与癌症患者的较差预后以及肾病患者的全身有害影响有关。

paras.en: The researchers wanted to understand whether different components of plant foods could influence which of these substances gut microbes produce.
paras.zh: 研究人员想了解植物性食品的不同成分是否会影响肠道微生物产生的这些物质。

paras.en: "Our studies showed that both the fiber and indigestible proteins from plants -- which we call 'proteins imitating fiber,' or Prif -- shift the balance of phenol metabolites from the harmful kind made from tyrosine to the healthful variety derived from phenylalanine," said AbuSalim.
paras.zh: AbuSalim 说：“我们的研究表明，植物中的纤维和难消化的蛋白质（我们称之为‘模拟纤维的蛋白质’或 Prif）都会改变苯酚代谢物的平衡，从由酪氨酸制成的有害物质转变为由苯丙氨酸制成的有益健康物质。”

paras.en: An Overlooked Plant Protein Works Alongside Fiber
paras.zh: 一种被忽视的植物蛋白与纤维一起发挥作用

paras.en: Although the health benefits of dietary fiber have been studied extensively, scientists have paid much less attention to plant proteins that pass through the digestive system without being fully broken down.
paras.zh: 尽管膳食纤维的健康益处已被广泛研究，但科学家们对通过消化系统而未完全分解的植物蛋白的关注要少得多。

paras.en: The researchers found that these indigestible proteins, which they call Prif, can reach the gut microbiome and serve as material for bacterial metabolism. In doing so, they influence which microbes thrive and which chemical compounds are produced.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，这些难消化的蛋白质（他们称之为 Prif）可以到达肠道微生物组，并作为细菌代谢的材料。在此过程中，它们会影响哪些微生物的繁殖以及哪些化学物质的产生。

paras.en: Importantly, these proteins do not work in isolation. They cooperate with plant fiber to change how gut bacteria process nutrients, shifting their activity toward the production of beneficial phenol metabolites.
paras.zh: 重要的是，这些蛋白质不能单独发挥作用。它们与植物纤维合作，改变肠道细菌处理营养物质的方式，将其活性转向产生有益的酚代谢物。

paras.en: This discovery suggests that the nutritional value of plant foods may depend on more than their familiar concentrations of fiber, vitamins, and minerals. The amount and type of protein that escapes digestion could also help determine how food influences the gut microbiome.
paras.zh: 这一发现表明，植物性食品的营养价值可能不仅仅取决于其熟悉的纤维、维生素和矿物质的浓度。逃逸消化的蛋白质的数量和类型也可以帮助确定食物如何影响肠道微生物组。

paras.en: When Gut Bacteria Run Low on Fiber, They May Feed on Your Gut's Protective Mucus
paras.zh: 当肠道细菌缺乏纤维时，它们可能会以肠道的保护性粘液为食

paras.en: One of the most intriguing findings concerns where gut bacteria obtain the raw materials used to produce harmful metabolites.
paras.zh: 最有趣的发现之一涉及肠道细菌从哪里获得用于生产有害代谢物的原材料。

paras.en: To investigate, the researchers labeled proteins with stable (non-radioactive) isotopes, allowing them to track exactly where the proteins traveled and how they were processed in the digestive systems of mice. This technique works by giving molecules a detectable chemical signature without making them radioactive.
paras.zh: 为了进行研究，研究人员用稳定（非放射性）同位素标记蛋白质，使他们能够准确追踪蛋白质的移动位置以及它们在小鼠消化系统中的加工方式。这项技术的工作原理是赋予分子可检测的化学特征，而不使它们具有放射性。

paras.en: The experiments revealed an important difference between the sources of beneficial and harmful phenols.
paras.zh: 实验揭示了有益酚和有害酚的来源之间的重要区别。

paras.en: The potentially harmful phenols came from gut bacteria breaking down proteins belonging to the host, including proteins found in the mucus layer that coats the intestines. This protective mucus helps separate intestinal microbes from the cells lining the gut and forms part of the body's natural defenses.
paras.zh: 潜在有害的酚类来自肠道细菌分解属于宿主的蛋白质，包括在覆盖肠道的粘液层中发现的蛋白质。这种保护性粘液有助于将肠道微生物与肠道内壁细胞分开，并形成人体自然防御的一部分。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the beneficial phenols were produced almost entirely from indigestible proteins supplied by food.
paras.zh: 与此同时，有益的酚类几乎完全是由食物提供的难消化蛋白质产生的。

paras.en: Fiber helped suppress the bacterial breakdown of the gut's protective mucus, reducing the production of harmful phenols. The indigestible plant proteins (Prif), in turn, supplied more dietary protein to gut bacteria, encouraging them to produce beneficial compounds instead.
paras.zh: 纤维有助于抑制肠道保护性粘液的细菌分解，减少有害酚类的产生。反过来，不可消化的植物蛋白（Prif）为肠道细菌提供了更多的膳食蛋白质，鼓励它们产生有益的化合物。

paras.en: Together, the findings reveal two complementary ways plant foods can influence intestinal chemistry. Fiber helps discourage bacteria from consuming proteins in the gut's protective mucus, while Prif provides an alternative source of nutrients that supports the production of healthier metabolites.
paras.zh: 总之，这些发现揭示了植物性食物影响肠道化学的两种互补方式。纤维有助于阻止细菌消耗肠道保护性粘液中的蛋白质，而 Prif 提供了另一种营养来源，支持更健康的代谢物的产生。

paras.en: "We think Prifs represent an emerging class of dietary nutrients that shape the composition of the gut microbiome and could have a far-reaching influence on metabolic health," said AbuSalim.
paras.zh: AbuSalim 说：“我们认为 Prifs 代表了一类新兴的膳食营养素，它可以塑造肠道微生物组的组成，并可能对代谢健康产生深远的影响。”

paras.en: The implications could eventually extend to nutrition labels and dietary recommendations.
paras.zh: 其影响最终可能会延伸到营养标签和饮食建议。

paras.en: "Food packaging may eventually list Prif right below fiber," said Rabinowitz.
paras.zh: “食品包装最终可能会将 Prif 列在纤维下方，”Rabinowitz 说。

paras.en: A Second Discovery Challenges What Scientists Thought About Gut Bacteria
paras.zh: 第二个发现挑战了科学家对肠道细菌的看法

paras.en: The companion study in Nature Metabolism addressed another important question: Are gut bacteria really responsible for producing all the metabolites traditionally attributed to them?
paras.zh: 《自然代谢》中的配套研究解决了另一个重要问题：肠道细菌真的负责产生传统上归因于它们的所有代谢物吗？

paras.en: Along with phenol metabolites, the researchers examined indole metabolites, which are formed from tryptophan, another amino acid found in dietary proteins.
paras.zh: 除了苯酚代谢物之外，研究人员还检测了由色氨酸（膳食蛋白质中发现的另一种氨基酸）形成的吲哚代谢物。

paras.en: These substances have attracted considerable scientific interest because they participate in biological processes linked to inflammation, immune activity, and disease. Researchers have investigated their involvement in inflammatory bowel disease, neurodegenerative disorders, and cancer. Some indole metabolites have also been found to influence the spread of cancer and the immune system's ability to attack tumors.
paras.zh: 这些物质引起了相当大的科学兴趣，因为它们参与与炎症、免疫活动和疾病相关的生物过程。研究人员调查了它们与炎症性肠病、神经退行性疾病和癌症的关系。还发现一些吲哚代谢物会影响癌症的扩散和免疫系统攻击肿瘤的能力。

paras.en: Scientists have generally assumed that gut bacteria are the source of these compounds. That belief has encouraged efforts to develop probiotics and dietary interventions that increase the production of potentially beneficial indole metabolites.
paras.zh: 科学家普遍认为肠道细菌是这些化合物的来源。这种信念鼓励人们努力开发益生菌和饮食干预措施，以增加潜在有益的吲哚代谢物的产生。

paras.en: However, this approach depends on an important assumption: that intestinal microbes are responsible for producing most or all of the compounds researchers want to influence.
paras.zh: 然而，这种方法取决于一个重要的假设：肠道微生物负责产生研究人员想要影响的大部分或全部化合物。

paras.en: If the body's own cells make substantial amounts of these metabolites, changing the microbiome may not be the most effective way to control their levels.
paras.zh: 如果人体自身细胞产生大量这些代谢物，改变微生物组可能不是控制其水平的最有效方法。

paras.en: Your Body Can Make Compounds Once Attributed to Gut Microbes
paras.zh: 您的身体可以产生曾经归因于肠道微生物的化合物

paras.en: To investigate, the research team used isotope tracing in mice, rats, and human cells to follow how different metabolites were produced.
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，研究小组在小鼠、大鼠和人类细胞中使用同位素示踪来追踪不同代谢物的产生方式。

paras.en: The results challenged conventional thinking. Mammalian cells were capable of generating numerous phenol and indole metabolites independently of intestinal bacteria.
paras.zh: 结果挑战了传统思维。哺乳动物细胞能够独立于肠道细菌产生大量苯酚和吲哚代谢物。

paras.en: Among these were indole-3-lactate and indole-3-acetate, two biologically important compounds previously considered products of microbial metabolism.
paras.zh: 其中包括吲哚-3-乳酸盐和吲哚-3-乙酸盐，这两种具有重要生物学意义的化合物以前被认为是微生物代谢的产物。

paras.en: The researchers also examined what happened when antibiotics disrupted the intestinal microbiome. If certain metabolites depended entirely on gut bacteria, their concentrations would be expected to decline sharply when those bacteria were depleted.
paras.zh: 研究人员还研究了抗生素破坏肠道微生物群时会发生什么。如果某些代谢物完全依赖于肠道细菌，那么当这些细菌耗尽时，它们的浓度预计会急剧下降。

paras.en: But many metabolites remained at substantial levels in the blood of antibiotic-treated mice. A similar pattern appeared in samples from patients receiving antibiotics, including people undergoing cancer treatment.
paras.zh: 但在接受抗生素治疗的小鼠血液中，许多代谢物仍保持在较高水平。接受抗生素治疗的患者（包括接受癌症治疗的患者）的样本中也出现了类似的模式。

paras.en: Other compounds behaved differently. Levels of indole-3-propionate and p-cresol sulfate, which are produced exclusively by microbes, declined following antibiotic treatment.
paras.zh: 其他化合物表现不同。抗生素治疗后，仅由微生物产生的吲哚-3-丙酸酯和对甲酚硫酸盐的水平下降。

paras.en: These results provided further evidence that some metabolites depend on intestinal bacteria, while others can also be manufactured by the body's own metabolic processes.
paras.zh: 这些结果进一步证明，一些代谢物依赖于肠道细菌，而另一些代谢物也可以通过人体自身的代谢过程产生。

paras.en: The distinction matters because it could change how researchers develop treatments intended to increase beneficial metabolites or reduce harmful ones.
paras.zh: 这种区别很重要，因为它可能会改变研究人员开发旨在增加有益代谢物或减少有害代谢物的治疗方法的方式。

paras.en: What These Discoveries Mean for Nutrition and Future Treatments
paras.zh: 这些发现对营养和未来治疗意味着什么

paras.en: Together, the two studies offer a more detailed understanding of how diet, gut microbes, and the body's own metabolism interact.
paras.zh: 这两项研究共同提供了对饮食、肠道微生物和人体自身新陈代谢如何相互作用的更详细的了解。

paras.en: The first identifies an overlooked category of plant proteins that works with fiber to influence bacterial activity, potentially helping shift the balance away from harmful metabolic products. The second demonstrates that the body itself can produce many compounds once believed to originate exclusively from gut bacteria.
paras.zh: 第一个发现是一类被忽视的植物蛋白，它们与纤维一起影响细菌活动，可能有助于改变有害代谢产物的平衡。第二个例子表明，身体本身可以产生许多曾经被认为完全来自肠道细菌的化合物。

paras.en: Both findings have implications for research into metabolic disease, digestive health, cancer, and other conditions involving the microbiome.
paras.zh: 这两项发现对代谢疾病、消化健康、癌症和其他涉及微生物组的疾病的研究都有影响。

paras.en: They also suggest that attempts to manipulate gut chemistry through diet, probiotics, or other therapies will need to account for both microbial activity and the body's own metabolic capabilities.
paras.zh: 他们还建议，尝试通过饮食、益生菌或其他疗法来控制肠道化学物质，需要考虑微生物活动和人体自身的代谢能力。

paras.en: Much of the experimental evidence comes from animals and laboratory studies, so additional research will be needed to determine how these mechanisms influence long-term health outcomes in people.
paras.zh: 大部分实验证据来自动物和实验室研究，因此需要进行额外的研究来确定这些机制如何影响人类的长期健康结果。

paras.en: Nevertheless, a better understanding of the relationship between different food components and microbial metabolism could eventually make dietary advice more precise and help researchers identify new therapeutic strategies.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，更好地了解不同食物成分和微生物代谢之间的关系最终可以使饮食建议更加精确，并帮助研究人员确定新的治疗策略。

paras.en: "Beyond that," said Rabinowitz, "a clearer picture of how different foods interact with the microbiome to modulate the production of bacterial metabolites will help sharpen the guidance nutritionists and doctors can give to people for disease prevention and therapy."
paras.zh: 拉比诺维茨说：“除此之外，更清楚地了解不同食物如何与微生物组相互作用以调节细菌代谢物的产生，将有助于加强营养学家和医生为人们提供疾病预防和治疗的指导。”

paras.en: These studies were funded by the Ludwig Institute for Cancer Research, the National Institutes of Health, the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases, the Princeton Alliance for Collaborative Research and Innovation, Princeton University.
paras.zh: 这些研究由路德维希癌症研究所、美国国立卫生研究院、美国国家糖尿病、消化和肾脏疾病研究所、普林斯顿大学合作研究与创新联盟资助。

paras.en: Aside from his post as Director of the Princeton Branch of the Ludwig Institute for Cancer Research, Joshua Rabinowitz is Professor in the Department of Chemistry & Lewis-Sigler Institute for Integrative Genomics and a member of the Rutgers Cancer Institute.
paras.zh: Joshua Rabinowitz 除了担任路德维希癌症研究所普林斯顿分院主任之外，还是化学系和刘易斯-西格勒综合基因组学研究所的教授，也是罗格斯癌症研究所的成员。

paras.en: Materials provided by Ludwig Institute for Cancer Research. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由路德维希癌症研究所提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: Common supplement could help fight psoriasis, scientists discover

paras.en: Common supplement could help fight psoriasis, scientists discover
paras.zh: 科学家发现普通补充剂可以帮助对抗牛皮癣

paras.en: - Scientists have discovered that pantethine, a readily available vitamin B5 derivative, can calm overactive immune cells and may help fight psoriasis. The supplement prevented psoriasis in mice and showed promising results in a small human trial, revealing an unexpected connection between cholesterol and autoimmune inflammation.
paras.zh: - 科学家发现泛硫乙胺是一种现成的维生素 B5 衍生物，可以镇静过度活跃的免疫细胞，并可能有助于对抗牛皮癣。该补充剂可预防小鼠牛皮癣，并在一项小型人体试验中显示出有希望的结果，揭示了胆固醇与自身免疫炎症之间的意外联系。

paras.en: A widely available nutritional supplement derived from vitamin B5 may offer a promising new approach to treating psoriasis, according to research from China. Scientists found that pantethine can calm immune cells involved in autoimmune inflammation, preventing psoriasis from developing in mice and improving symptoms in a small human clinical trial.
paras.zh: 根据中国的研究，一种广泛使用的源自维生素 B5 的营养补充剂可能为治疗牛皮癣提供一种有前景的新方法。科学家发现，泛硫乙胺可以镇静参与自身免疫性炎症的免疫细胞，防止小鼠患牛皮癣，并在一项小型人体临床试验中改善症状。

paras.en: The findings, published October 27 in the Journal of Experimental Medicine (JEM), reveal an unexpected connection between cholesterol production and the immune system. By interfering with this process, pantethine may help reduce the excessive immune activity responsible for psoriasis and potentially other autoimmune diseases.
paras.zh: 该研究结果于 10 月 27 日发表在《实验医学杂志》(JEM) 上，揭示了胆固醇产生与免疫系统之间存在意想不到的联系。通过干扰这一过程，泛硫乙胺可能有助于减少导致牛皮癣和其他潜在自身免疫性疾病的过度免疫活动。

paras.en: How Overactive Immune Cells Contribute to Psoriasis
paras.zh: 过度活跃的免疫细胞如何导致牛皮癣

paras.en: At the center of the discovery are dendritic cells, specialized immune cells that help organize the body's defenses. These cells act as coordinators, identifying potential threats and directing other immune cells to respond.
paras.zh: 这一发现的核心是树突状细胞，这是一种帮助组织身体防御的特殊免疫细胞。这些细胞充当协调员，识别潜在威胁并指导其他免疫细胞做出反应。

paras.en: Dendritic cells perform this role by capturing foreign substances called antigens and presenting them to T cells, which are immune cells that recognize specific threats. They also release chemical signals that recruit additional immune cells and trigger inflammation.
paras.zh: 树突状细胞通过捕获称为抗原的外来物质并将其呈递给 T 细胞（识别特定威胁的免疫细胞）来发挥这一作用。它们还释放化学信号，招募额外的免疫细胞并引发炎症。

paras.en: Although these activities are essential for fighting infections, problems can arise when dendritic cells become excessively active. Instead of helping protect the body, they can contribute to persistent inflammation and autoimmune diseases such as psoriasis.
paras.zh: 尽管这些活动对于抵抗感染至关重要，但当树突状细胞变得过度活跃时就会出现问题。它们不但不能帮助保护身体，反而会导致持续炎症和牛皮癣等自身免疫性疾病。

paras.en: "Emerging evidence highlights that metabolic pathways and their associated metabolites play vital roles in regulating immune cell function and autoimmune progression," says Wei-Na Zhang, a researcher at the State Key Laboratory of Biomedical Analysis in Beijing. "But therapeutic strategies targeting metabolism in inflammatory diseases remain underexplored."
paras.zh: 北京生物医学分析国家重点实验室研究员张伟娜表示：“新的证据表明，代谢途径及其相关代谢物在调节免疫细胞功能和自身免疫进展中发挥着至关重要的作用。” “但是针对炎症性疾病代谢的治疗策略仍未得到充分探索。”

paras.en: Zhang led the research alongside Qing Xia, Ai-Ling Li, and Tao Zhou, also from the State Key Laboratory of Biomedical Analysis, and Cheng-Xin Li from The First Medical Center of Chinese PLA General Hospital in Beijing.
paras.zh: 张与同样来自生物医学分析国家重点实验室的夏青、李爱玲和周涛以及中国人民解放军总医院第一医学中心的李成新一起领导了这项研究。

paras.en: Scientists Discover a Hidden Link Between Cholesterol and Psoriasis
paras.zh: 科学家发现胆固醇与牛皮癣之间的隐藏联系

paras.en: The researchers identified unusually high levels of enzymes called Vanins in dendritic cells from people with psoriasis and several other autoimmune diseases. These enzymes help regulate the processing of certain substances involved in cellular metabolism.
paras.zh: 研究人员在牛皮癣和其他几种自身免疫性疾病患者的树突状细胞中发现了异常高水平的酶，称为 Vanins。这些酶有助于调节参与细胞代谢的某些物质的加工。

paras.en: When the scientists reduced Vanin levels, dendritic cells became less active and were less capable of stimulating T cells. They also found that a drug designed to inhibit Vanins prevented psoriasis from developing in mice.
paras.zh: 当科学家降低 Vanin 水平时，树突状细胞的活性就会降低，刺激 T 细胞的能力也会减弱。他们还发现，一种旨在抑制 Vanins 的药物可以防止小鼠患牛皮癣。

paras.en: Further investigation revealed why these enzymes might play such an important role.
paras.zh: 进一步的研究揭示了为什么这些酶可能发挥如此重要的作用。

paras.en: Vanins convert pantethine into vitamin B5, an essential nutrient that cells need to produce energy. Pantethine is already sold as a nutritional supplement and is commonly used to help lower blood cholesterol because it can reduce cholesterol production.
paras.zh: Vanins 将泛硫乙胺转化为维生素 B5，这是细胞产生能量所需的必需营养素。泛硫乙胺已经作为营养补充剂出售，并且通常用于帮助降低血液胆固醇，因为它可以减少胆固醇的产生。

paras.en: This connection is particularly interesting because cholesterol does more than circulate in the bloodstream. It also influences how immune cells function. Previous research has shown that cholesterol can stimulate dendritic cell activity, while elevated blood cholesterol is a major risk factor for developing psoriasis.
paras.zh: 这种联系特别有趣，因为胆固醇不仅仅在血液中循环。它还影响免疫细胞的功能。先前的研究表明，胆固醇可以刺激树突状细胞活性，而血液胆固醇升高是患牛皮癣的主要危险因素。

paras.en: The team discovered that excessive Vanin activity reduces the amount of pantethine available inside dendritic cells. As pantethine levels fall, cholesterol production increases, causing these immune cells to become unusually active.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，过度的 Vanin 活性会减少树突状细胞内可用的泛硫乙胺的量。随着泛硫乙胺水平下降，胆固醇产生增加，导致这些免疫细胞变得异常活跃。

paras.en: Restoring pantethine levels interrupted this process. The supplement reduced cholesterol accumulation within dendritic cells and helped suppress the excessive immune activation associated with inflammation.
paras.zh: 恢复泛硫乙胺水平中断了这一过程。该补充剂减少了树突状细胞内的胆固醇积累，并有助于抑制与炎症相关的过度免疫激活。

paras.en: "We found that pantethine administration effectively alleviated psoriasis in mice, suggesting that insufficient pantethine levels may be the crucial contributor to hyperactivation of dendritic cells and autoimmune inflammation following the up-regulation of Vanins," Zhang says.
paras.zh: 张说：“我们发现，泛硫乙胺给药可有效缓解小鼠的牛皮癣，这表明泛硫乙胺水平不足可能是导致树突状细胞过度活化和 Vanins 上调后发生自身免疫炎症的关键因素。”

paras.en: Common Supplement Shows Promise in Human Psoriasis Trial
paras.zh: 普通补充剂在人体银屑病试验中显示出前景

paras.en: Encouraged by the laboratory and animal findings, the researchers investigated whether pantethine might also benefit people living with psoriasis.
paras.zh: 受到实验室和动物研究结果的鼓舞，研究人员调查了泛硫乙胺是否也可能使牛皮癣患者受益。

paras.en: They conducted a small clinical trial involving 24 patients with the condition. All participants received a topical ointment containing calcipotriene/betamethasone, a combination treatment used to control psoriasis symptoms. Calcipotriene is a vitamin D derivative that helps regulate skin cell growth, while betamethasone is a corticosteroid that reduces inflammation.
paras.zh: 他们进行了一项小型临床试验，涉及 24 名患有这种疾病的患者。所有参与者都接受了含有卡泊三烯/倍他米松的外用软膏，这是一种用于控制牛皮癣症状的联合治疗方法。卡泊三烯是一种维生素 D 衍生物，有助于调节皮肤细胞生长，而倍他米松是一种减少炎症的皮质类固醇。

paras.en: Half of the participants also took pantethine tablets, allowing researchers to examine whether adding the supplement improved the results of standard treatment.
paras.zh: 一半的参与者还服用泛硫乙胺片剂，使研究人员能够检查添加补充剂是否可以改善标准治疗的结果。

paras.en: After 12 weeks, the patients who received pantethine alongside their prescribed ointment showed greater improvement in psoriasis symptoms. The benefits were especially noticeable among participants who had high blood cholesterol levels before treatment.
paras.zh: 12 周后，接受泛硫乙胺和处方药膏治疗的患者银屑病症状有更大改善。对于治疗前血液胆固醇水平较高的参与者来说，这种好处尤其明显。

paras.en: These findings suggest that pantethine could potentially serve as an additional treatment for psoriasis, particularly in patients whose cholesterol metabolism may be contributing to inflammation.
paras.zh: 这些发现表明，泛硫乙胺有可能作为牛皮癣的额外治疗方法，特别是对于胆固醇代谢可能导致炎症的患者。

paras.en: However, the trial included only 24 people, and the researchers emphasize that larger studies are necessary to confirm the supplement's effectiveness. The human results also do not establish that the same biological mechanism observed in laboratory experiments is responsible for the improvement in patients.
paras.zh: 然而，该试验仅包括 24 人，研究人员强调，需要进行更大规模的研究来证实该补充剂的有效性。人体研究结果也未能证实实验室实验中观察到的相同生物学机制对患者的改善有影响。

paras.en: "Our investigator-initiated clinical trial demonstrated encouraging therapeutic efficacy of pantethine as an adjunctive therapy in psoriasis, but these findings should be interpreted as proof-of-concept for clinical feasibility rather than direct mechanistic validation," Zhang says. "Overall, our study uncovers the Vanin-pantethine-cholestrol axis as a key metabolic pathway governing dendritic cell activation and provides a foundation for therapeutic strategies targeting several dendritic cell-mediated autoimmune diseases."
paras.zh: “我们的研究者发起的临床试验证明了泛硫乙胺作为牛皮癣辅助疗法的治疗效果令人鼓舞，但这些发现应被解释为临床可行性的概念验证，而不是直接的机制验证，”张说。 “总的来说，我们的研究发现 Vanin-泛硫乙胺-胆固醇轴是控制树突状细胞激活的关键代谢途径，并为针对几种树突状细胞介导的自身免疫性疾病的治疗策略提供了基础。”

paras.en: Materials provided by Rockefeller University Press. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由洛克菲勒大学出版社提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

Vanin-pantethine metabolic axis shapes dendritic cell function and affects inflammatory disorder progression. Journal of Experimental Medicine, 2026; 223 (11) DOI: 10.1084/jem.20252558
paras.zh: - 曹爱萍、李俊成、王睿、王云英、吴楠、刘艳红、金志、刘佳玉、沉艳艳、郭跃、齐琪、王耀、王瑞波、谢博阳、颜春艳、韩秋英、黄绍一、吴胜明、王娜、潘新、李成新、周涛、李爱玲、夏青，张维娜。 Vanin-泛硫乙胺代谢轴塑造树突状细胞功能并影响炎症性疾病进展。实验医学杂志，2026； 223（11）DOI：10.1084/jem.20252558

articles.title: Are the James Webb Space Telescope's mysterious Little Red Dots actually tiny black holes left over from the Big Bang era?
articles.author: Robert Lea

paras.en: Ever since NASA's James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) started observing the early universe, it has been providing almost as many surprises as it has answers. One such surprise are the so-called Little Red Dots, cosmic objects that seemingly disappear completely before the universe is two billion years old.
paras.zh: 自从美国宇航局的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜 (JWST) 开始观测早期宇宙以来，它提供的惊喜几乎与它提供的答案一样多。其中一个令人惊奇的现象就是所谓的小红点，这是一种似乎在宇宙 20 亿岁之前就完全消失的宇宙物体。

paras.en: New research suggests that Little Red Dots may actually be connected primordial black holes, tiny black holes born not from dying stars but rather from fluctuations in the density of matter just after the Big Bang, in the earliest moments of cosmic history. Should they exist, primordial black holes would predate stars, galactic dust particles, and elements heavier than hydrogen and helium.
paras.zh: 新的研究表明，小红点实际上可能与原始黑洞有关，这些微小的黑洞不是由垂死的恒星产生的，而是由宇宙历史最早时刻大爆炸后物质密度的波动产生的。如果它们存在的话，太初黑洞将早于恒星、银河尘埃粒子以及比氢和氦重的元素。

paras.en: Now, researchers have used JWST data to test whether one particular Little Red Dot, known as blackAbell 2744-QSO1 (QSO1), could host a primordial black hole.
paras.zh: 现在，研究人员利用 JWST 数据来测试一个名为 blackAbell 2744-QSO1 (QSO1) 的特定小红点是否可能存在原始黑洞。

paras.en: "A black hole is an object born from the gravitational death of a star. Primordial black holes are a very different story," study team member Valerio De Luca, of the Department of Physics and Astronomy at Johns Hopkins University (JHU) in Maryland, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 马里兰州约翰·霍普金斯大学 (JHU) 物理与天文学系的研究小组成员瓦莱里奥·德·卢卡 (Valerio De Luca) 在一份声明中表示：“黑洞是恒星因引力死亡而诞生的物体。原始黑洞则完全不同。”

paras.en: "They come from the physics of the early universe that predates the first stars, when the universe was expanding exponentially in time and space. So the mechanisms for creating primordial black holes are different," De Luca added.
paras.zh: “它们来自早于第一颗恒星的早期宇宙的物理学，当时宇宙在时间和空间上呈指数级膨胀。因此，创造原始黑洞的机制是不同的，”德卢卡补充道。

paras.en: Little Red Dots could be the smoking gun of primordial black holes
paras.zh: 小红点可能是原始黑洞确凿的证据

paras.en: Though scientists have theorized about the existence of primordial black holes since they were first proposed by Stephen Hawking in the 1970s, no hard evidence has presented itself. One of the issues scientists have puzzled over is how to tell the difference between a primordial black hole and a "traditional" or astrophysical black hole formed from the supernova death and collapse of a massive star.
paras.zh: 尽管自从史蒂芬·霍金在 20 世纪 70 年代首次提出太初黑洞以来，科学家们已经对它们的存在进行了理论分析，但还没有提出确凿的证据。科学家们困惑的问题之一是如何区分原始黑洞和由超新星死亡和大质量恒星坍塌形成的“传统”或天体物理黑洞。

paras.en: "Little Red Dots could surround astrophysical black holes, and most probably many of them do, but they could also be primordial black holes, if primordial black holes exist," De Luca said. "So the question becomes, Which ones are primordial and how can we tell?"
paras.zh: 德卢卡说：“小红点可能围绕着天体物理黑洞，而且很可能有很多这样的黑洞，但如果原始黑洞存在的话，它们也可能是原始黑洞。” “所以问题就变成了，哪些是原始的，我们如何辨别？”

paras.en: De Luca and colleagues turned their attention to QS01, located around 13.1 billion light-years from Earth, which is seen as it was just 700 million years after the Big Bang. What makes this Little Red Dot stand out is the fact that it is almost entirely composed of hydrogen and helium. Because these were the universe's first elements, it could be more unspoiled and primordial than other Little Red Dots.
paras.zh: De Luca 和同事将注意力转向了 QS01，它距离地球约 131 亿光年，被认为是大爆炸后仅 7 亿年的时间。这个小红点之所以引人注目，是因为它几乎完全由氢和氦组成。因为它们是宇宙的最初元素，所以它可能比其他小红点更加未受破坏和原始。

paras.en: The team modeled how a Little Red Dot like QS01 could form from a primordial black hole. That was necessary because the circumstances under which this could happen would have to be very specific.
paras.zh: 该团队模拟了像 QS01 这样的小红点是如何从原始黑洞形成的。这是必要的，因为发生这种情况的情况必须非常具体。

paras.en: "There are constraints on primordial black holes from cosmological observations," said team member Loris Del Grosso, also of JHU's Department of Physics and Astronomy. "There can only be so many primordial black holes in the universe, for example, and there cannot be too many of them in a given cluster."
paras.zh: “宇宙学观测对原初黑洞存在限制，”团队成员洛里斯·德尔·格罗索（Loris Del Grosso）说，他也是约翰·霍普金斯大学物理与天文学系的成员。 “例如，宇宙中只能有这么多原始黑洞，而且在一个给定的星团中不可能有太多。”

paras.en: Considering three possible scenarios, the team found that the most likely situation is a smaller primordial black hole consuming surrounding gas and energy until it grew to be the size of QSO1.
paras.zh: 考虑到三种可能的情况，研究小组发现最有可能的情况是一个较小的原初黑洞消耗周围的气体和能量，直到它长到QSO1的大小。

paras.en: "The door was open on this theory — that Little Red Dots could be primordial black holes," Del Grosso said. "We've now cracked it open a little farther by showing some scenarios are more likely than others."
paras.zh: “这个理论的大门是敞开的——小红点可能是原始黑洞，”德尔格罗索说。 “我们现在已经进一步揭示了这一点，表明某些情况比其他情况更有可能发生。”

paras.en: Del Grosso and crew now intend to look at the other 100 or so Little Red Dots seen by the JWST to determine how many of them could have started life as primordial black holes.
paras.zh: 德尔格罗索和工作人员现在打算观察 JWST 观测到的另外 100 个左右的小红点，以确定其中有多少可能以原始黑洞的形式存在。

paras.en: Then scientists may finally have the evidence to say these long-theorized ancient black holes actually existed.
paras.zh: 那么科学家们可能最终有证据表明这些长期理论化的古代黑洞确实存在。

paras.en: "We don't have a clear understanding of what happens in the early universe right after the Big Bang," De Luca concluded. "If primordial black holes do exist, then something had to happen to make them in the first place, which would be a groundbreaking discovery in physics."
paras.zh: “我们对大爆炸后早期宇宙中发生的事情还没有清楚的了解，”德卢卡总结道。 “如果原始黑洞确实存在，那么首先必须发生一些事情才能形成它们，这将是物理学上的突破性发现。”

paras.en: The team's findings were published in June in the journal Physical Review Letters.
paras.zh: 该团队的研究结果发表在六月的《物理评论快报》杂志上。

paras.en: Robert Lea is a science journalist in the U.K. whose articles have been published in Physics World, New Scientist, Astronomy Magazine, All About Space, Newsweek and ZME Science. He also writes about science communication for Elsevier and the European Journal of Physics. Rob holds a bachelor of science degree in physics and astronomy from the U.K.’s Open University. Follow him on Twitter @sciencef1rst.
paras.zh: 罗伯特·李 (Robert Lea) 是一位英国科学记者，其文章发表在《物理世界》、《新科学家》、《天文学杂志》、《All About Space》、《新闻周刊》和《ZME Science》上。他还为爱思唯尔和《欧洲物理学杂志》撰写有关科学传播的文章。 Rob 拥有英国开放大学物理和天文学理学学士学位。在 Twitter 上关注他@sciencef1rst。

articles.title: Jupiter and Mars are set for a breathtaking close approach later this week: Here's how to see it
articles.author: Anthony Wood

paras.en: Jupiter and Mars will shine side by side in a spectacular close approach in the heart of the constellation Leo on Nov. 15. Here's what you need to know.
paras.zh: 11 月 15 日，木星和火星将在狮子座中心以壮观的近距离方式并肩闪耀。以下是您需要了解的内容。

paras.en: Mars and Jupiter reach their closest apparent separation in Earth's sky at 9:04 p.m. EST on Nov. 15 (0204 GMT on Nov. 16), according to astronomy website In-The-Sky. The planets will be below the horizon for U.S. stargazers at the moment of their closest approach, but observers can catch the pair rising above the eastern horizon around midnight local time, just a few hours later.
paras.zh: 晚上 9 点 04 分，火星和木星在地球天空中达到最接近的明显距离。据天文网站 In-The-Sky 报道，美国东部时间 11 月 15 日（格林尼治标准时间 11 月 16 日 0204）。当这两颗行星最接近时，美国天文观测者将位于地平线以下，但观察者可以在当地时间午夜左右，也就是几个小时后，看到这两颗行星从东方地平线上升起。

paras.en: Remember: You can discover the exact timings for the rising and setting of the planets above your local horizon using Time and Date's night sky tracker.
paras.zh: 请记住：您可以使用时间和日期的夜空跟踪器发现当地地平线上方行星升起和落下的确切时间。

paras.en: Jupiter will be the brightest of the pair, when it rises a little over 1 degree from the red light of Mars — roughly the width of your little finger held at arm's length against the night sky. The bright star Regulus will glow close at hand, forming the dot of the backward question mark formation of stars that represents the head of the great Lion in the constellation Leo.
paras.zh: 木星将是这对星中最亮的一个，届时它会比火星的红光升起略多于1度——大约是你在夜空中伸开手臂的小指的宽度。明亮的轩辕十四星将在近处发光，形成向后问号星阵的点，代表狮子座伟大狮子的头部。

paras.en: The Celestron StarSense Explorer LT114AZ is a great way to get a closer look at Jupiter, Mars and Saturn. Its 4.5-inch aperture and a high 1000mm focal length delivers good magnification out of the box, plus it's integrated with the StarSense smartphone app, which makes finding those planets so much easier. Check out our full review for more.
paras.zh: 星特朗 StarSense Explorer LT114AZ 是近距离观察木星、火星和土星的好方法。其 4.5 英寸光圈和 1000 毫米高焦距提供开箱即用的良好放大倍率，此外，它还与 StarSense 智能手机应用程序集成，使寻找这些行星变得更加容易。查看我们的完整评论了解更多信息。

paras.en: Mars and Jupiter will be close enough to share the field of view of a pair of 10x50 binoculars and will also make for a spectacular sight through the eyepiece of a telescope when viewed separately as they rise away from the horizon.
paras.zh: 火星和木星将非常接近，可以共享一副 10x50 双筒望远镜的视野，并且当它们从地平线升起时，通过望远镜的目镜单独观察时，也将形成壮观的景象。

paras.en: The gas giant's iconic Great Red Spot will rotate into view in the predawn hours of Nov. 16, and will be visible through a backyard telescope with an aperture of just 4 inches. Using a light green color filter will help increase the visibility of the vast storm, while an orange filter will help bring out detail in the gas giant's sweeping cloud belts.
paras.zh: 这颗气态巨行星的标志性大红斑将在 11 月 16 日黎明前旋转进入视野，通过后院口径仅为 4 英寸的望远镜即可看到。使用浅绿色滤光片将有助于提高巨大风暴的可见度，而橙色滤光片将有助于显示气态巨行星扫掠云带的细节。

paras.en: The two planets will appear to gradually drift apart over the coming weeks and won't appear as close again for another 2.5 years in July 2029, when the two planets appear close together in the constellation Virgo.
paras.zh: 这两颗行星将在未来几周内逐渐远离，并且在 2029 年 7 月的 2.5 年内不会再次出现，届时两颗行星将在处女座中靠得很近。

paras.en: Be sure to check out our guide to photographing the night sky, along with our picks of the best cameras and lenses for astrophotography if you're interested in following the dance of the planets for yourself.
paras.zh: 如果您有兴趣亲自跟随行星的舞蹈，请务必查看我们的夜空拍摄指南，以及我们精选的天文摄影最佳相机和镜头。

paras.en: Editor's Note: If you would like to share your astrophotography with Space.com's readers, then please send your photo(s), comments, and your name and location to spacephotos@space.com.
paras.zh: 编者注：如果您想与 Space.com 的读者分享您的天文摄影，请将您的照片、评论以及您的姓名和位置发送至 spacephotos@space.com。

paras.en: Anthony Wood joined Space.com in April 2025 after contributing articles to outlets including IGN, New Atlas and Gizmodo. He has a passion for the night sky, science, Hideo Kojima, and human space exploration, and can’t wait for the day when astronauts once again set foot on the moon.
paras.zh: 安东尼·伍德 (Anthony Wood) 向 IGN、New Atlas 和 Gizmodo 等媒体投稿后于 2025 年 4 月加入 Space.com。他热爱夜空、科学、小岛秀夫和人类太空探索，迫不及待地等待宇航员再次踏上月球的那一天。

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 9, 1967: NASA launches the Saturn V moon rocket for the first time on Apollo 4, but no astronauts were aboard
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 9, 1967, NASA launched the powerful new Saturn V rocket on its maiden voyage.
paras.zh: 1967 年 11 月 9 日，美国宇航局 (NASA) 发射了强大的新型土星五号火箭进行首次航行。

paras.en: The Saturn V moon rocket was 363 feet tall. That's taller than the Statue of Liberty! It was the biggest and most powerful rocket ever built at the time (though SpaceX's Starship megarocket has since surpassed it). NASA needed such a powerful rocket to launch astronauts to the moon. However, the first Saturn V launch didn't carry astronauts, because it was only a test flight.
paras.zh: 土星五号月球火箭高 363 英尺。这比自由女神像还高！它是当时有史以来最大、最强大的火箭（尽管 SpaceX 的星舰巨型火箭已经超越了它）。美国宇航局需要如此强大的火箭将宇航员送上月球。然而，第一次土星五号发射并没有搭载宇航员，因为这只是一次试飞。

paras.en: During the launch, the rocket created a loud shockwave that surprised nearby observers. The ground shook so hard that it rattled buildings miles away, and all the shaking caused a huge shower of dust and debris NASA's new launch center, the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
paras.zh: 在发射过程中，火箭产生了巨大的冲击波，令附近的观察者感到惊讶。地面震动如此剧烈，以至于数英里外的建筑物都发出嘎嘎声，所有的震动都在美国宇航局的新发射中心——佛罗里达州的肯尼迪航天中心引发了一场巨大的灰尘和碎片雨。

paras.en: The mission lasted 8 hours 36 minutes. The rocket carried an uncrewed command module that splashed down in the Pacific Ocean.
paras.zh: 任务持续了8小时36分钟。火箭携带的无人指挥舱坠入太平洋。

paras.en: The launch of Apollo 4 in November 1967 was a turning point for NASA on its path to landing astronauts on the moon.
paras.zh: 1967 年 11 月阿波罗 4 号的发射是 NASA 将宇航员送上月球的道路上的一个转折点。

paras.en: The space agency had bet the moon on its new Saturn V booster, a three-stage heavy-lift rocket designed to fly astronauts in a capsule (as well as their lander) to the moon and back. But the rocket had never been fully tested until the Apollo 4 launch.
paras.zh: 该航天局将月球押注于其新型土星五号助推器，这是一种三级重型火箭，旨在将宇航员乘坐太空舱（以及着陆器）运送到月球并返回。但直到阿波罗 4 号发射之前，火箭从未经过全面测试。

paras.en: NASA also needed a new launch site for its Apollo missions. So the agency built Launch Complex 39 at what is now called the Kennedy Space Center, a Florida spaceport that has become the home port for orbital human spaceflight in the United States. But in 1967, no rockets had ever flown from the site. Yet, everything went according to plan.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局还需要一个新的发射场来执行阿波罗任务。因此，该机构在现在称为肯尼迪航天中心的地方建造了 39 号发射场，这是佛罗里达州的一个航天发射场，现已成为美国轨道载人航天飞行的母港。但在 1967 年，还没有火箭从该地点升空。然而，一切都按计划进行。

paras.en: “It was really an expert launching all the way through from lifting off exactly on time to performance of every single stage,” rocket pioneer Wernher von Braun, director of NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama, said at the time.
paras.zh: 火箭先驱、美国宇航局位于阿拉巴马州亨茨维尔的马歇尔太空飞行中心主任沃纳·冯·布劳恩当时表示：“从准时升空到每个阶段的性能，这确实是一位专家级的发射。”

paras.en: The launch came as NASA was on its heels.
paras.zh: 此次发射正值美国宇航局紧随其后。

paras.en: Just months earlier, on Jan. 27, 1967, the space agency suffered a fatal tragedy when Apollo 1 astronauts Gus Grissom, Ed White and Roger Chaffee died on the launch pad after a fire broke out inside their Apollo command module during a ground test.
paras.zh: 就在几个月前，即 1967 年 1 月 27 日，美国宇航局遭遇了一场致命悲剧，阿波罗 1 号宇航员格斯·格里索姆 (Gus Grissom)、埃德·怀特 (Ed White) 和罗杰·查菲 (Roger Chaffee) 在地面测试期间阿波罗指挥舱内发生火灾，在发射台上丧生。

paras.en: “The maiden voyage of the Saturn V dramatically increased the confidence of people across the nation in the management of the largest research and development undertaking in which the western world has ever engaged,” George Mueller, NASA's then-Associate Administrator for Manned Space Flight, said at the time.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局当时的载人航天副局长乔治·穆勒（ George Mueller ）当时表示： “土星五号的首次航行极大地增强了全国人民对管理西方世界有史以来最大的研发工作的信心。”

paras.en: One year later, another Saturn V rocket launched the first astronauts to the moon with the Apollo 8 mission. All of the Apollo missions that followed also launched on Saturn V rockets.
paras.zh: 一年后，另一枚土星五号火箭通过阿波罗 8 号任务将第一批宇航员送上月球。随后的所有阿波罗任务也是通过土星五号火箭发射的。

paras.en: Just two years after its debut, the Saturn V rocket launched the Apollo 11 astronauts to the moon for the first crewed moon landing in July 1969.
paras.zh: 首次亮相仅两年后，土星五号火箭就在 1969 年 7 月将阿波罗 11 号宇航员送上月球，进行了首次载人登月。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: Building a ‘highway to the moon and back’ with Winnie Lai
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Mike Gruss speaks with Winnie Lai, CEO of Auriga Space.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 与 Auriga Space 首席执行官 Winnie Lai 进行了对话。

paras.en: They talk about how electromagnetic launch technology that “catapults” small launch vehicles could cut down on fuel costs. She describes a “paradigm shift” through new technology that could enable new operations in space through low-cost, targeted missions, and what that means for Golden Dome missile defense interceptors.
paras.zh: 他们讨论了“弹射”小型运载火箭的电磁发射技术如何降低燃料成本。她描述了新技术的“范式转变”，可以通过低成本、有针对性的任务实现太空新行动，以及这对金顶导弹防御拦截器意味着什么。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对喜欢谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

paras.en: Watch a new episode every Thursday on SpaceNews.com and on our YouTube, Spotify and Apple channels.
