paras.zh: 辩护律师援引陪审团的记录称，尽管有法官的指示，但坚持不懈的陪审员并未遵守合理怀疑的法律，沙利文应该对坚持不懈的人提出质疑，并可能将陪审员开除。

paras.en: But Sullivan said the notes did not indicate the holdout had announced he was refusing to follow the law, but instead suggested a disagreement among the jurors. Questioning the holdout in the midst of their deliberations would have as a result been "impermissibly coercive," Sullivan wrote.
paras.zh: 但沙利文表示，这些笔记并没有表明抵制者已经宣布他拒绝遵守法律，而是表明陪审员之间存在分歧。沙利文写道，在审议过程中对坚持不懈的人提出质疑将是“不允许的强制行为”。

paras.en: "Because the court concludes that there was a manifest necessity for a retrial based on the jury's deadlock, a retrial on the murder indictments does not violate Clancy's right not to be placed in double jeopardy," Sullivan wrote.
paras.zh: 沙利文写道：“由于法院根据陪审团的僵局得出结论，显然有必要进行重审，因此对谋杀起诉书进行重审并不侵犯克兰西不陷入双重危险的权利。”

paras.en: In a related decision, the judge declined to conduct a limited inquiry into the holdout, saying he saw no point in examining the juror under oath at this stage in the proceedings.
paras.zh: 在一项相关决定中，法官拒绝对抵制行为进行有限调查，称他认为在诉讼程序的现阶段没有必要对陪审员进行宣誓审查。

paras.en: Martin Weinberg, a lawyer for Clancy, said he anticipated the defence would pursue an appeal. A spokesperson for Plymouth County District Attorney Timothy Cruz did not respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 克兰西的律师马丁·温伯格表示，他预计辩方将提出上诉。普利茅斯县地方检察官蒂莫西·克鲁兹的发言人没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: No one at Clancy's initial trial disputed that she strangled daughter Cora, 5; son Dawson, 3; and 8-month-old son Callan with exercise bands on Jan. 24, 2023, in the basement of their home in the Boston suburb of Duxbury.
paras.zh: 在克兰西的初审中，没有人对她勒死 5 岁的女儿科拉这一事实提出异议。儿子道森，三岁； 2023 年 1 月 24 日，波士顿郊区达克斯伯里的家中地下室里，带着健身带的 8 个月大的儿子卡兰 (Callan)。

paras.en: She then cut herself with a knife and jumped from a second-storey window in an attempt to end her own life, leaving her paralyzed.
paras.zh: 随后，她用刀割伤了自己，并从二楼的窗户跳下，试图结束自己的生命，导致她瘫痪。

paras.en: Her lawyers have argued Clancy was in the throes of postpartum psychosis and should be found not guilty by reason of insanity, known in Massachusetts as lack of criminal responsibility.
paras.zh: 她的律师辩称，克兰西正处于产后精神病的痛苦之中，应该因精神错乱而被判无罪，在马萨诸塞州被称为缺乏刑事责任。

paras.en: Some of the jurors in televised interviews later said that, but for one holdout juror, they had been prepared to find Clancy not guilty by reason of insanity.
paras.zh: 一些陪审员在电视采访中表示，但对于一名坚持不懈的陪审员来说，他们已经准备好以精​​神错乱为由判定克兰西无罪。

paras.en: Such a verdict would have resulted in her commitment to a state psychiatric hospital, subject to regular court review. In Massachusetts, a conviction on first-degree murder charges carries a mandatory sentence of life in prison without parole.
paras.zh: 这样的判决将导致她被送往州立精神病院，并接受定期的法庭审查。在马萨诸塞州，一级谋杀罪一旦定罪，将被判处终身监禁，不得假释。

paras.en: If you or someone you know is struggling, here's where to look for help:
paras.zh: 如果您或您认识的人遇到困难，可以在此处寻求帮助：

paras.en: - Canada's Suicide Crisis Helpline: Call or text 988.
paras.zh: - 加拿大自杀危机求助热线：致电或发短信 988。

paras.en: - Provincial and territorial mental health support.
paras.zh: - 省和地区的心理健康支持。

paras.en: - Kids Help Phone: 1-800-668-6868. Text 686868. Live chat counselling on the website.
paras.zh: - 儿童帮助电话：1-800-668-6868。短信 686868。网站上的实时聊天咨询。

paras.en: - This guide from the Centre for Addiction and Mental Health outlines how to talk about suicide with someone you're worried about.
paras.zh: - 成瘾和心理健康中心的这份指南概述了如何与您担心的人谈论自杀问题。

articles.title: Tyler Robinson, man accused of shooting Charlie Kirk, to face trial in 2028

paras.en: Tyler Robinson, man accused of shooting Charlie Kirk, to face trial in 2028
paras.zh: 泰勒·罗宾逊 (Tyler Robinson)，被控枪杀查理·柯克 (Charlie Kirk)，将于 2028 年接受审判

paras.en: Utah judge sets trial date for June 2028
paras.zh: 犹他州法官将审判日期定为 2028 年 6 月

paras.en: A Utah judge on Monday set a June 2028 trial date for Tyler Robinson, the man accused of murdering prominent right-wing activist Charlie Kirk last year.
paras.zh: 周一，犹他州一名法官将泰勒·罗宾逊 (Tyler Robinson) 的审判日期定为 2028 年 6 月，泰勒·罗宾逊被指控去年谋杀了著名右翼活动人士查理·柯克 (Charlie Kirk)。

paras.en: Robinson, 23, has pleaded not guilty to seven counts, including aggravated murder, in the shooting of Kirk as the conservative held one of his trademark debates at Utah Valley University in Orem, Utah.
paras.zh: 23 岁的罗宾逊对枪杀柯克的七项罪名表示不认罪，其中包括严重谋杀，当时保守派在犹他州奥勒姆的犹他谷大学举行一场标志性辩论。

paras.en: Utah District Court Judge Tony Graf set jury selection for the trial for June 21, 2028, after Robinson's attorneys requested a late 2029 date to give them time to challenge Utah's request for the death penalty, gather additional evidence and seek a change of venue. Robinson's lawyers expect a six-to-seven-month trial.
paras.zh: 罗宾逊的律师要求推迟 2029 年的日期，以便让他们有时间质疑犹他州的死刑请求、收集更多证据并寻求变更审判地点，之后犹他州地方法院法官托尼·格拉夫 (Tony Graf) 将审判的陪审团选择定于 2028 年 6 月 21 日进行。罗宾逊的律师预计审判将持续六到七个月。

paras.en: Prosecutors had sought a date of January 31, 2028 to start what they expect to be a 17-week trial for the shooting death of Kirk, an ally of U.S. President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 检察官寻求在 2028 年 1 月 31 日开始对美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的盟友柯克枪杀案进行为期 17 周的审判。

paras.en: In a separate filing, Erika Kirk, Kirk's widow, requested the trial to start in 2027 to speed what she described as a painful legal process.
paras.zh: 柯克的遗孀埃里卡·柯克 (Erika Kirk) 在另一份文件中要求于 2027 年开始审判，以加快她所描述的痛苦的法律程序。

paras.en: Trump last month slammed Graf's handling of the case, saying the trial should start within a month and the judge was asking "questions that people already know the answer to."
paras.zh: 特朗普上个月猛烈抨击格拉夫对此案的处理方式，称审判应在一个月内开始，法官提出的问题是“人们已经知道答案的问题”。

paras.en: Charlie Kirk is seen in a file photo taken March 17, 2025, when he was speaking at a town hall in Oconomowoc, Wis. (Jeffrey Phelps/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 查理·柯克 (Charlie Kirk) 摄于 2025 年 3 月 17 日，当时他在威斯康星州奥科诺莫沃克的市政厅发表讲话。（杰弗里·菲尔普斯/美联社）

paras.en: Kirk was a polarizing figure in U.S. politics. He was admired by conservatives for mobilizing young voters around his Christian and right-wing views. Civil rights advocates criticized Kirk for rhetoric they called racist, anti-immigrant, transphobic and misogynist, citing his public remarks denigrating Black Americans, LGBTQ communities, Muslims and immigrants.
paras.zh: 柯克是美国政坛一个两极分化的人物。他因动员年轻选民支持他的基督教和右翼观点而受到保守派的钦佩。民权倡导者批评柯克的言论是种族主义、反移民、恐惧跨性别者和厌女症，并引用柯克公开言论诋毁美国黑人、LGBTQ 群体、穆斯林和移民。

paras.en: Prosecutors allege Robinson targeted Kirk for his opposition to same-sex marriage and transgender rights. Defence attorney Richard Novak has said in court that Kirk spoke "hatefully" about people who did not have traditional gender identities or were not heterosexual, but Robinson's defence say there was no evidence Robinson opposed those views.
paras.zh: 检察官指控罗宾逊因为柯克反对同性婚姻和变性人权利而针对柯克。辩护律师理查德·诺瓦克在法庭上表示，柯克“充满仇恨”地谈论那些没有传统性别认同或非异性恋的人，但罗宾逊的辩护人表示，没有证据表明罗宾逊反对这些观点。

articles.title: Fake news in Africa: In an age of disinformation, who decides what's true?

paras.en: Misinformation poses a threat to democracy worldwide: An exaggerated WhatsApp message, a manipulated TikTok video or an apparent breaking news alert on Facebook can all misguide people in Africa and beyond — particularly in the run-up to elections.
paras.zh: 错误信息对全球民主构成威胁：夸大的WhatsApp消息、操纵的TikTok视频或Facebook上明显的突发新闻警报都可能误导非洲及其他地区的人们，尤其是在选举前夕。

paras.en: As artificial intelligence is making it increasingly easy to manipulate images, voices and videos, more and more countries are trying to equip their populations with skills to identify and counter fake news.
paras.zh: 随着人工智能使操纵图像、声音和视频变得越来越容易，越来越多的国家正在尝试为其民众提供识别和反击假新闻的技能。

paras.en: But are these efforts really about raising awareness, or are certain governments using this fight to control public opinion, silence dissident voices and misguide the populace — from both within and outside of these respective nations?
paras.zh: 但这些努力真的是为了提高人们的认识吗？还是某些政府利用这场斗争来控制舆论、压制异见声音并误导民众——无论是国内还是国外？

paras.en: Civil society groups fill gaps left by governments
paras.zh: 民间社会团体填补政府留下的空白

paras.en: Journalism lecturer Dani Madrid-Morales at the University of Sheffield believes that African governments must significantly step up their efforts to combat sources of disinformation and misinformation.
paras.zh: 谢菲尔德大学新闻学讲师丹尼·马德里-莫拉莱斯认为，非洲各国政府必须加大力度打击虚假信息和错误信息的来源。

paras.en: He told DW that "there are very few countries — if any — that are actually doing a good job" to beat the influence of fake news.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声，“很少有国家——如果有的话——在打击假新闻的影响方面真正做得很好”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, he points out that there also are civil society initiatives in various African nations, which help inform people about the dangers of such false narratives.
paras.zh: 同时，他指出，非洲各国也有民间社会的倡议，帮助人们了解这种虚假叙述的危险。

paras.en: For instance in South Africa, organizations like Africa Check and Media Monitoring Africa work together to highlight the impact of fake news on elections. Similar coalitions also exist in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Senegal.
paras.zh: 例如，在南非，Africa Check 和 Media Monitoring Africa 等组织共同努力，强调假新闻对选举的影响。刚果民主共和国（DRC）和塞内加尔也存在类似的联盟。

paras.en: However, these initiative mostly focus on fighting disinformation during election periods; the rest of the time, they typically lack funding and sustained engagement with civil society to continue to make a change.
paras.zh: 然而，这些举措主要侧重于打击选举期间的虚假信息；在其余时间，他们通常缺乏资金和与民间社会的持续接触来继续做出改变。

paras.en: When African governments become part of the problem
paras.zh: 当非洲政府成为问题的一部分时

paras.en: There also are deliberate efforts by certain governments not to battle fake news; some let it happen while others engage in deliberately spreading this kind of disinformation.
paras.zh: 某些政府也刻意不与假新闻作斗争；有些人让它发生，而另一些人则故意传播这种虚假信息。

paras.en: Madrid-Morales distinguishes between three types of disinformation in this context: There are scams and similar schemes, which some governments, he says, fail to sufficiently fight, leaving people susceptible to financial losses and other problems.
paras.zh: 马德里-莫拉莱斯在这种情况下区分了三种类型的虚假信息：他说，有些政府未能充分打击诈骗和类似计划，导致人们容易遭受经济损失和其他问题。

paras.en: Secondly, he adds that there also are certain foreign influence operations trying to impact public opinion from outside a country and, in many instances, outside of the continent.
paras.zh: 其次，他补充说，还有某些外国影响力活动试图影响国外的公众舆论，在许多情况下，影响非洲大陆之外的公众舆论。

paras.en: Finally, there are political disinformation campaings which originate from within a country that are intended to deliberately derail impartial views, he explains.
paras.zh: 最后，他解释说，有些政治虚假信息运动源自一个国家内部，旨在故意破坏公正的观点。

paras.en: "Governments are particularly interested in the third category," says Madrid-Morales, adding that this is especially prevalent in the Sahel region.
paras.zh: 马德里-莫拉莱斯说：“各国政府对第三类特别感兴趣。”他补充说，这种情况在萨赫勒地区尤其普遍。

paras.en: He highlights how in nations like Burkina Faso and Mali, military governments have shut down media outlets, prosecuted journalists and expelled foreign correspondents in order to silence free speech.
paras.zh: 他强调了在布基纳法索和马里等国家，军政府如何关闭媒体机构、起诉记者并驱逐外国记者，以压制言论自由。

paras.en: In his view, these junta governments are primarily concerned with preventing negative or false information about themselves from circulating rather than actively recruiting followers.
paras.zh: 在他看来，这些军政府主要关心的是防止有关自己的负面或虚假信息传播，而不是积极招募追随者。

paras.en: Do outside forces shape public opinion in Africa?
paras.zh: 外部力量会影响非洲的舆论吗？

paras.en: Foreign powers meanwhile also appear to play a considerable role in shaping public opinion across the continent.
paras.zh: 与此同时，外国势力似乎也在塑造整个非洲大陆的舆论方面发挥着相当大的作用。

paras.en: Afrobarometer, a pan-African research network, examined the influence of international actors in terms of their influence across Africa — including those suspected of sharing fake news.
paras.zh: 泛非研究网络“非洲晴雨表”研究了国际行为者在整个非洲的影响力，其中包括那些涉嫌传播假新闻的人。

paras.en: The study found that over 60% of respondents viewed China's political and economic influence positively; this was followed by 52% for the United States.
paras.zh: 研究发现，超过60%的受访者对中国的政治和经济影响持积极态度；其次是美国，占 52%。

paras.en: Both countries have no past colonial history in Africa, although they are now competng for economic gains while focusing otherwise on furthering infrastructure projects — partly to maintain this largely benevolent perception towards them.
paras.zh: 这两个国家在非洲都没有殖民历史，尽管它们现在在争夺经济利益的同时，还专注于推进基础设施项目——部分是为了维持对它们的这种基本上是仁慈的看法。

paras.en: However, perceptions of other former colonial powers vary notably in some cases, depending mainly on factors such as the impact of past injustices: For example, in French-speaking countries, only 34% of respondents viewed France's ongoing influence positively.
paras.zh: 然而，在某些情况下，对其他前殖民国家的看法存在显着差异，主要取决于过去不公正现象的影响等因素：例如，在法语国家，只有 34% 的受访者对法国持续的影响持积极态度。

paras.en: Komi Amewonou from Afrobarometer told DW that such attitudes are not necessarily the outcome of targeted propaganda campaigns for or against certain nations outside the continent but rather the result of African governments letting negative perceptions simply run their course.
paras.zh: 《非洲晴雨表》的科米·阿梅沃努 (Komi Amewonou) 告诉德国之声，这种态度不一定是支持或反对非洲大陆以外某些国家的有针对性的宣传活动的结果，而是非洲各国政府任由负面看法自然发展的结果。

paras.en: The mixed role of media literacy initiatives
paras.zh: 媒体素养举措的混合作用

paras.en: In some countries, there are media development project trying to educate people and animate them to think for themselves and thus fight sources of fake news and disinformation.
paras.zh: 在一些国家，有一些媒体发展项目试图教育人们并激发他们独立思考，从而打击假新闻和虚假信息的来源。

paras.en: In Ghana, the NGO Penplusbytes runs the "Caravan of Hope" initiative — a project supported by the German development agency GIZ and by DW Akademie.
paras.zh: 在加纳，非政府组织 Penplusbytes 发起了“希望大篷车”倡议，该项目得到了德国发展机构 GIZ 和 DW Akademie 的支持。

paras.en: This mobile campaign brings media literacy training to rural communities through theater, role-playing exercises, public discussions and videos in local languages. The initiative has managed to reach 3,000 people in five districts to date.
paras.zh: 这项移动活动通过戏剧、角色扮演练习、公共讨论和当地语言视频为农村社区带来媒体素养培训。迄今为止，该倡议已成功惠及五个地区的 3,000 人。

paras.en: The campaign also involves trusted community figures, as studies show that locals most trust people they know personally — particularly traditional village leaders and community representatives.
paras.zh: 该活动还涉及值得信赖的社区人物，因为研究表明当地人最信任他们认识的人，尤其是传统的村庄领导和社区代表。

paras.en: Rebecca Avusu from Penplusbytes, who helped develop the project, told DW that "information must be verified before people believe it or pass it on. This is particularly important for those without smartphones or with limited formal education."
paras.zh: 帮助开发该项目的 Penplusbytes 的丽贝卡·阿武苏 (Rebecca Avusu) 告诉德国之声，“信息必须经过验证，然后人们才会相信或传播。这对于那些没有智能手机或受过有限正规教育的人来说尤其重要。”

paras.en: Initiatives in South Africa take a similar approach: The country is home to Africa Check — one of the continent's best-known fact-checking initiatives.
paras.zh: 南非的举措采取了类似的方法：该国是“非洲检查”的所在地，这是非洲大陆最著名的事实核查举措之一。

paras.en: The organization visits schools and teaches classes how to identify manipulated images, verify sources, and deal with misinformation circulating on WhatsApp groups.
paras.zh: 该组织访问学校并教授班级如何识别被篡改的图像、验证来源以及处理 WhatsApp 群组中传播的错误信息。

paras.en: However, Madrid-Morales says that there can be a downside to such media literacy programs as well; pointing to research conducted in South Africa, he highlights that while some young people do become more discerning consumers of information, others eventually lose trust in almost every source, resulting in a complete lack of knowledge about important developments.
paras.zh: 然而，马德里-莫拉莱斯表示，此类媒体素养计划也可能存在负面影响。他在谈到在南非进行的研究时强调，虽然一些年轻人确实成为了更有洞察力的信息消费者，但其他人最终对几乎所有来源都失去了信任，导致完全缺乏对重要发展的了解。

paras.en: In countries elsewhere in Africa, there's greater resistance against such media literacy initiaves — chiefly by their own governments.
paras.zh: 在非洲其他国家，此类媒体素养举措面临更大的阻力——主要是来自本国政府。

paras.en: In 2026, the International Media and Information Literacy Institute (IMILI) was opened in the Nigerian capital Abuja under the auspices of UNESCO, with a mission to promote research, training and international cooperation across media literacy initiatives.
paras.zh: 2026年，在联合国教科文组织的支持下，国际媒体和信息素养研究所（IMILI）在尼日利亚首都阿布贾成立，其使命是促进媒体素养倡议的研究、培训和国际合作。

paras.en: This came after the Nigerian government announced that it aimed to play a leading international role in Africa in the fight against fake news; however, civil rights groups say the state often blurs the line between genuinely battling disinformation and silencing public dissent in the country.
paras.zh: 此前，尼日利亚政府宣布其目标是在非洲打击假新闻方面发挥国际领导作用；然而，民权组织表示，国家经常模糊真正打击虚假信息和压制公众异议之间的界限。

paras.en: In Kenya, there are similar concerns: The Media Council of Kenya has been tasked with supporting journalists and boosting fact-checking initiatives.
paras.zh: 在肯尼亚，也存在类似的担忧：肯尼亚媒体委员会的任务是支持记者和推动事实核查举措。

paras.en: However, its scope of operations is limited, as the organization abides by the country's laws to remain in operation — in particular legislation supposedly designed to target the spreading of false information.
paras.zh: 然而，其业务范围有限，因为该组织必须遵守该国的法律才能继续运营——特别是旨在打击虚假信息传播的立法。

paras.en: Conversely, these laws have come under increased scrutiny, as they can also be abused to silence views against the government.
paras.zh: 相反，这些法律受到了越来越严格的审查，因为它们也可能被滥用来压制反对政府的观点。

paras.en: Madrid-Morales says that in such contexts, there need to be independent oversight bodies to ensure that people do not refrain from expressing themselves publicly for fear of reprisal.
paras.zh: 马德里-莫拉莱斯表示，在这种情况下，需要有独立的监督机构，以确保人们不会因为担心遭到报复而避免公开表达自己的意见。

paras.en: Mozambique: Fighting disinformation as a tool of control
paras.zh: 莫桑比克：打击虚假信息作为控制工具

paras.en: Meanwhile in Mozambique, the media institute MISA has also launched a series of media initiatives such as MISACheck. The program is designed to train young journalists and social activists in fact-checking techniques.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在莫桑比克，媒体机构MISA也推出了MISACheck等一系列媒体举措。该计划旨在培训年轻记者和社会活动家事实核查技术。

paras.en: Olivia Massango, the vice-president of MISA, says however that the efforts of such civil society groups may seem like a drop in the ocean; Massango is particularly critical of how state authorities deal with misinformation.
paras.zh: 然而，MISA 副主席奥利维亚·马桑戈 (Olivia Massango) 表示，此类民间社会团体的努力似乎只是沧海一粟；马桑戈对国家当局处理错误信息的方式尤其批评。

paras.en: "When something becomes inconvenient, the government ... invokes public interest, but ultimately often ends up protecting only what suits it," she told DW.
paras.zh: “当事情变得不方便时，政府......会援引公共利益，但最终往往只保护适合它的东西，”她告诉德国之声。

paras.en: "Combating disinformation must not mean criminalizing opinions, criticism or journalistic work," she warns.
paras.zh: “打击虚假信息绝不意味着将观点、批评或新闻工作定为犯罪，”她警告说。

paras.en: Guidance from Europe — with limited safeguards
paras.zh: 来自欧洲的指导——保障措施有限

paras.en: More and more African nations meanwhile are turning to Europe in hopes of adopting useful mechanisms to fight fake news.
paras.zh: 与此同时，越来越多的非洲国家转向欧洲，希望采取有用的机制来打击假新闻。

paras.en: Morocco and Senegal are among the examples where proposed disinformation legislation is widely inspired by EU standards. Madrid-Morales however stresses that while following strong EU legislation in the battle against disinformation can be a success, there also need to be independent oversight and enforcement mechanisms to make them work.
paras.zh: 摩洛哥和塞内加尔就是拟议的虚假信息立法广泛受到欧盟标准启发的例子。然而，马德里-莫拉莱斯强调，虽然在打击虚假信息的斗争中遵循强有力的欧盟立法可能会取得成功，但还需要独立的监督和执行机制才能使其发挥作用。

paras.en: In the cases of Senegal and Morocco, these are yet to be established, he explains, stressing that both nations have repeatedly had to deal with various forms of political instability influenced by fake news.
paras.zh: 他解释说，就塞内加尔和摩洛哥而言，这些尚未确定，并强调两国都多次不得不应对受假新闻影响的各种形式的政治不稳定。

paras.en: Rebecca Avusu says she is also concerned about such efforts maintaining loopholes to suit governments if and as needed: "We do not want laws designed to combat disinformation to become instruments for silencing people who question government decisions or express legitimate opinions," Avusu warns.
paras.zh: 丽贝卡·阿武苏 (Rebecca Avusu) 表示，她还担心此类努力会留下漏洞，以适应政府的需要：“我们不希望旨在打击虚假信息的法律成为压制那些质疑政府决策或表达合法意见的人的工具，”阿武苏警告说。

articles.title: India’s demonetization: 10 years on, promises remain unfulfilled

paras.en: On November 8, 2016, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced in a televised address to the nation that he was withdrawing all 500- and 1,000-rupee banknotes from circulation at midnight.
paras.zh: 2016 年 11 月 8 日，总理纳伦德拉·莫迪在向全国发表的电视讲话中宣布，他将于午夜停止流通所有 500 卢比和 1,000 卢比纸币。

paras.en: The surprise move invalidated 86.9% of the value of currency in circulation in a single stroke.
paras.zh: 这一出人意料的举动一下子使流通货币价值的86.9%失效。

paras.en: Modi asked Indians to make a "grand sacrifice for cleansing our country."
paras.zh: 莫迪要求印度人“为净化我们的国家做出巨大牺牲”。

paras.en: He promised that the hardship would help eliminate black money, corruption, counterfeit currency and terrorist financing. The exercise was presented as a major step towards a cleaner and more transparent economy.
paras.zh: 他承诺，这一困难将有助于消除黑钱、腐败、假币和恐怖主义融资。这项工作被认为是迈向更清洁、更透明的经济的重要一步。

paras.en: Millions of Indians rushed to banks to exchange their savings. Long queues formed outside banks and ATMs, with people waiting for hours, sometimes without knowing when they would get their money.
paras.zh: 数百万印度人涌向银行兑换储蓄。银行和自动取款机外排起了长队，人们等待了几个小时，有时甚至不知道什么时候才能拿到钱。

paras.en: Workers missed wages, small businesses struggled to pay employees and families found it difficult to buy everyday essentials. Reports of people dying during the cash crisis added to the distress.
paras.zh: 工人们拖欠工资，小企业难以支付员工工资，家庭发现很难购买日常必需品。有关现金危机期间有人死亡的报道加剧了人们的痛苦。

paras.en: "I still remember my domestic help's father," businessman Prakash Patra from Jaipur city told DW. "He panicked, collapsed, and passed away right there, standing in a long queue just trying to exchange his family's life savings. It wasn't just cash that was lost in those lines. It was human lives."
paras.zh: 来自斋浦尔市的商人普拉卡什·帕特拉（Prakash Patra）告诉德国之声：“我仍然记得我家佣的父亲。” “他惊慌失措，崩溃了，当场去世，排着长队，只是想兑换家人毕生的积蓄。在这些队伍中损失的不仅仅是现金。还有人的生命。”

paras.en: For India's most vulnerable, particularly rural women and people without bank accounts, the sudden cash shortage made savings difficult to access. Money set aside for family weddings, medical emergencies and basic survival was suddenly compromised.
paras.zh: 对于印度最弱势群体，特别是农村妇女和没有银行账户的人来说，突然的现金短缺使得储蓄变得困难。用于家庭婚礼、医疗紧急情况和基本生存的资金突然受到损害。

paras.en: Joe Athialy, executive director of the New Delhi-based Center for Financial Accountability, a financial watchdog, says the impact fell disproportionately on the poor and the informal economy.
paras.zh: 总部位于新德里的金融监管机构金融问责中心执行主任乔·阿蒂亚利表示，穷人和非正规经济受到的影响尤为严重。

paras.en: "Demonetization destroyed livelihoods, disrupted small businesses and pushed millions into deeper economic insecurity. The poor and those dependent on the informal sector bore the greatest cost," Athialy told DW.
paras.zh: 阿蒂亚利告诉德国之声：“废钞令破坏了生计，扰乱了小企业，并使数百万人陷入更深的经济不安全之中。穷人和依赖非正规部门的人承受着最大的损失。”

paras.en: Arun Kumar, former professor of economics at Jawaharlal Nehru University and author of "The Black Economy in India," shared a similar assessment. The government wrongly assumed that illicit wealth was primarily held in cash, he said.
paras.zh: 贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁大学前经济学教授、《印度的黑色经济》一书的作者阿伦·库马尔也有类似的评估。他说，政府错误地认为非法财富主要以现金形式持有。

paras.en: "And it penalized the cash-dependent informal sector while leaving the real engines of the black economy untouched," Kumar told DW.
paras.zh: 库马尔对德国之声表示：“它惩罚了依赖现金的非正规部门，但并未触及黑色经济的真正引擎。”

paras.en: The first major setback came in 2018, when the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) reported that 99.3% of the demonetized currency had returned to the banking system.
paras.zh: 第一次重大挫折发生在 2018 年，当时印度储备银行 (RBI) 报告称，99.3% 的非纸币已返回银行系统。

paras.en: Only a small fraction of the withdrawn money had failed to come back, undermining the expectation that large amounts of undeclared cash would be extinguished.
paras.zh: 只有一小部分提取的资金未能返还，这削弱了大量未申报现金将被消灭的预期。

paras.en: A decade later, there is little evidence that demonetization made a significant dent in black money or corruption. Economists have long pointed out that much illicit wealth in India is held in property, gold and other assets rather than cash.
paras.zh: 十年后，几乎没有证据表明废钞令对黑钱或腐败产生了重大影响。经济学家长期以来一直指出，印度的许多非法财富是房地产、黄金和其他资产，而不是现金。

paras.en: Some supporters of the policy argued that forcing cash into the banking system would help formalize the economy and widen the tax base. But the extent to which these changes could be attributed to the currency withdrawal remains contested.
paras.zh: 该政策的一些支持者认为，迫使现金进入银行系统将有助于经济正规化并扩大税基。但这些变化在多大程度上可以归因于货币撤回仍然存在争议。

paras.en: Lekha Chakraborty, a professor at the National Institute of Public Finance and Policy, said research after the exercise pointed to limited success in achieving its stated objectives.
paras.zh: 国家公共财政与政策研究所教授莱卡·查克拉博蒂 (Lekha Chakraborty) 表示，演习后的研究表明，在实现既定目标方面取得的成功有限。

paras.en: She draws on studies that examined both the immediate economic shock and its longer-term effects.
paras.zh: 她借鉴了对直接经济冲击及其长期影响进行检验的研究。

paras.en: "The research points to modest gains against demonetization's primary objectives, alongside temporary but real economic costs. The impact was particularly severe in the informal sector, where cash remains central to everyday transactions," Chakraborty told DW.
paras.zh: 查克拉博蒂告诉德国之声：“研究表明，废钞令的主要目标取得了适度的成果，同时也付出了暂时但实际的经济成本。这种影响在非正规部门尤其严重，因为现金仍然是日常交易的核心。”

paras.en: "The economic shock was real, even if much of it faded over time. But there is little to suggest that demonetization produced a lasting change in the way black wealth is generated or concealed."
paras.zh: “经济冲击是真实存在的，尽管其中大部分会随着时间的推移而消退。但几乎没有迹象表明废钞令对黑人财富的产生或隐藏方式产生了持久的改变。”

paras.en: Athialy argues that the policy was based on a flawed understanding of how illicit wealth is held in India.
paras.zh: 阿蒂亚利认为，该政策是基于对印度如何持有非法财富的错误理解。

paras.en: "Cash is only an insignificant part of the black economy. Much of India's unaccounted wealth is held in assets such as real estate and in tax havens, not currency," he said.
paras.zh: “现金只是黑色经济中微不足道的一部分。印度大部分下落不明的财富都存放在房地产和避税天堂等资产中，而不是货币，”他说。

paras.en: He also questions the absence of accountability for the disruption and its institutional consequences.
paras.zh: 他还质疑对破坏及其制度后果缺乏问责。

paras.en: "Nobody has been held accountable for the economic disruption or the undermining of institutions such as the RBI."
paras.zh: “没有人对经济混乱或印度储备银行等机构的破坏负责。”

paras.en: Digital payments have expanded rapidly since 2016. The Unified Payments Interface (UPI), launched in August that year, has become a major part of India's retail payment system today.
paras.zh: 自 2016 年以来，数字支付迅速扩张。当年 8 月推出的统一支付接口 (UPI) 已成为当今印度零售支付系统的主要组成部分。

paras.en: In 2025-26, UPI processed 241.6 billion transactions, worth 314.2 trillion rupees (approximately €2.95 trillion), according to the RBI.
paras.zh: 据印度储备银行称，2025-26 年，UPI 处理了 2416 亿笔交易，价值 314.2 万亿卢比（约合 2.95 万亿欧元）。

paras.en: Yet the growth of digital payments has not reduced the amount of physical currency in circulation.
paras.zh: 然而，数字支付的增长并没有减少流通中的实物货币数量。

paras.en: RBI data show that the value of banknotes in circulation stood at 43.15 trillion rupees (about €405 billion) on October 23, 2026, compared with 17.97 trillion rupees (€169 billion) in November 2016.
paras.zh: 印度央行数据显示，2026 年 10 月 23 日流通纸币价值为 43.15 万亿卢比（约合 4050 亿欧元），而 2016 年 11 月为 17.97 万亿卢比（约合 1690 亿欧元）。

paras.en: The figures show that Indians are increasingly using digital platforms for everyday payments, but cash remains firmly in circulation.
paras.zh: 数据显示，印度人越来越多地使用数字平台进行日常支付，但现金仍然稳定流通。

paras.en: Chakraborty cautions against attributing the growth of digital payments to demonetization. "Digital payments largely continued a trend that was already under way before the currency ban," she said.
paras.zh: 查克拉博蒂警告不要将数字支付的增长归因于非货币化。 “数字支付在很大程度上延续了货币禁令之前已经存在的趋势，”她说。

paras.en: A decade after the unprecedented move, the gap between the government's promises and what demonetization ultimately delivered remains central to its legacy.
paras.zh: 在这一史无前例的举措发生十年后，政府的承诺与废钞令最终带来的结果之间的差距仍然是其遗产的核心。

articles.title: Russia: Independent Novaya Gazeta shuts its Moscow newsroom

paras.en: The Novaya Gazeta newspaper closed its Moscow office on Monday, saying it was not able to continue reporting amid a campaign of state pressure in Russia.
paras.zh: 《新报》周一关闭了莫斯科办事处，称由于俄罗斯政府施压，该报无法继续报道。

paras.en: The investigative outlet, co-founded by late USSR chief Mikhail Gorbachev, had long been a thorn in the Kremlin's side. In recent years, it ran into increasing roadblocks amid its critical coverage of the Russian invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 这家由已故苏联领导人米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫（Mikhail Gorbachev）共同创立的调查机构长期以来一直是克里姆林宫的眼中钉。近年来，它在对俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的批评报道中遇到了越来越多的障碍。

paras.en: It was branded a "foreign agent," a Soviet-era term resuscitated by President Vladimir Putin's administration, with officials ordering it to vacate its Moscow offices.
paras.zh: 它被贴上了“外国特工”的标签，这是一个苏联时代的术语，弗拉基米尔·普京总统的政府重新启用了这个词，官员们命令它腾出莫斯科办事处。

paras.en: Russian banks were also forbidden from processing donations from readers and supporters. The paper had been heavily dependent on this income stream after moving wholly into online publishing, with the transition taking place shortly after the invasion of Ukraine. Russian authorities introduced new wartime censorship rules in the wake of the full-scale invasion.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯银行也被禁止处理读者和支持者的捐款。该报在完全转向在线出版后，一直严重依赖这一收入来源，而这一转变是在乌克兰入侵后不久发生的。全面入侵后，俄罗斯当局出台了新的战时审查规则。

paras.en: Nobel Prize winner Muratov calls for free speech
paras.zh: 诺贝尔奖获得者穆拉托夫呼吁言论自由

paras.en: 2021 Nobel Peace Prize-winning founding editor Dmitry Muratov issued an appeal for free speech in wartime Russia as journalists gathered in the Novaya Gazeta offices to witness its closure.
paras.zh: 2021 年诺贝尔和平奖得主、创始编辑德米特里·穆拉托夫 (Dmitry Muratov) 呼吁在战时俄罗斯实现言论自由，记者们聚集在《新报》办公室见证其关闭。

paras.en: "Those in our country who advocate for peace have been denied the right to read what they choose, as we see happening today," he said. "We are currently at a point where the section of the Russian constitution that guarantees political and civil rights has ceased to function."
paras.zh: 他说：“我们国家那些倡导和平的人被剥夺了阅读他们选择的内容的权利，正如我们今天所看到的那样。” “目前，俄罗斯宪法中保障政治和公民权利的部分已经停止运作。”

paras.en: Russia's government meanwhile sought to play down the significance of the closure, with Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov saying it was part of a "rotational process" in a fiercely competitive media landscape.
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯政府试图淡化关闭的重要性，克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，这是竞争激烈的媒体环境中“轮换过程”的一部分。

paras.en: Novaya Gazeta was a flagship for post-Soviet democratic Russia and the era of "glasnost" or openness, also launched by Mikhail Gorbachev. The reformist Soviet leader used some of the prize fund for his 1990 Nobel Peace Prize as seed money for the publication.
paras.zh: 《新报》是后苏联民主俄罗斯和“开放”时代的旗舰，也是由米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫发起的。这位改革派苏联领导人将 1990 年诺贝尔和平奖的部分奖金用作该出版物的种子资金。

paras.en: The paper has built a reputation for fearless reporting, which has also put it in the crosshairs of Russia's wealthy and powerful. Six of its journalists were murdered since the paper was launched in 1993.
paras.zh: 该报因无畏的报道而享有盛誉，这也使其成为俄罗斯富人和有权势人士的关注焦点。自 1993 年该报创刊以来，已有六名记者被谋杀。

paras.en: They included Anna Politkovskaya, who spent years investigating allegations of abuses by Russia's military during its campaigns in Chechnya. An early critic of Putin, she was found dead in her apartment bloc on the president's birthday in 2006.
paras.zh: 其中包括安娜·波利特科夫斯卡娅（Anna Politkovskaya），她花了数年时间调查俄罗斯军队在车臣战役期间滥用权力的指控。她是普京早期的批评者，2006 年总统生日那天，她被发现死在自己的公寓楼里。

paras.en: Images published in Russian media on Monday showed the paper's editor-in-chief, Sergei Sokolov, taking down photographs of Polikovskaya and other reporters murdered in what's thought to be retribution for their work.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯媒体周一发布的图片显示，该报主编谢尔盖·索科洛夫记下了波利科夫斯卡娅和其他记者被谋杀的照片，这被认为是对其工作的报复。

paras.en: Last month, when first announcing that the paper would close, Sokolov said the outlet had "been killed." The paper was shutting down after "the Russian authorities — the Russian special services — have forced the editorial team to end its work," he said.
paras.zh: 上个月，当索科洛夫首次宣布该报将关闭时，他表示该报已“被杀死”。他说，在“俄罗斯当局——俄罗斯特种部队——迫使编辑团队结束工作”后，该报被关闭。

paras.en: Will closure in Moscow mark a definitive end?
paras.zh: 莫斯科的关闭是否标志着最终的结束？

paras.en: Muratov called for a ceasefire in Ukraine and urged foreign observers to remember the strength of dissent that endured in Russia, even if it was being pushed underground by censorship laws and other repression or intimidation.
paras.zh: 穆拉托夫呼吁乌克兰停火，并敦促外国观察家记住俄罗斯境内持续存在的异议力量，即使这些异议正被审查法和其他镇压或恐吓推入地下。

paras.en: "We canot blame the citizens themselves for this," Muratov said, "especially the wonderful, truly remarkable younger generation."
paras.zh: 穆拉托夫说：“我们不能为此责怪公民本身，尤其是那些出色的、真正杰出的年轻一代。”

paras.en: "I urge you to distinguish between the Russian authorities and the Russian people," he added.
paras.zh: “我敦促你们区分俄罗斯当局和俄罗斯人民，”他补充道。

paras.en: Muratov also called for the release of around 4,000 people he termed political prisoners in Russia.
paras.zh: 穆拉托夫还呼吁释放大约 4,000 名被他称为俄罗斯政治犯的人。

paras.en: Novaya Gazeta's leadership has not made it entirely clear whether its closing down in Moscow marks a definitive end to the outlet's reporting, or whether they might perhaps seek to regroup and begin operating in some form from outisde Russia, as several other publications including DW have been forced to in recent years.
paras.zh: 《新报》领导层尚未完全明确其在莫斯科的关闭是否标志着该媒体报道的最终结束，或者是否可能寻求重组并开始以某种形式在俄罗斯境外开展业务，就像德国之声等其他几家出版物近年来被迫这样做的那样。

paras.en: One of its journalists, Irina Vorobyova, said that the paper's spirit would survive like a "good virus" and would "continue in everyone that was part of it."
paras.zh: 该报的一名记者伊琳娜·沃罗比奥娃(Irina Vorobyova)表示，该报的精神将像“良好的病毒”一样存活下来，并将“在每个参与其中的人身上继续存在”。

articles.title: Saudi Arabia reports new attack on key East-West pipeline

paras.en: Saudi Arabia’s critical East-West oil pipeline has suffered another attack, according to state media.
paras.zh: 据官方媒体报道，沙特阿拉伯重要的东西石油管道再次遭受袭击。

paras.en: An official at the Saudi Ministry of Energy said that the pipeline was targeted in the Medina region in the west of the country on Monday, causing a “limited fire” that was extinguished, the Saudi Press Agency reported.
paras.zh: 据沙特通讯社报道，沙特能源部一名官员表示，该管道周一袭击了该国西部麦地那地区，引发了“有限火灾”，但随后被扑灭。

paras.en: “No injuries or fatalities were reported, and pipeline operations were unaffected,” it said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“没有人员伤亡的报道，管道运营未受影响。”

paras.en: The report did not identify the party behind the attack, but fighting continues to intensify between Saudi Arabia and the Yemeni government coalition that it backs, and the Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen.
paras.zh: 该报告没有指明袭击背后的一方，但沙特阿拉伯与其支持的也门政府联盟以及伊朗支持的也门胡塞叛军之间的战斗继续加剧。

paras.en: The pipeline is essential for bypassing the Strait of Hormuz, which remains tightly constricted by the US-Israel war on Iran. It has come under attack several times as the war on Iran fuels a global energy crisis.
paras.zh: 该管道对于绕过霍尔木兹海峡至关重要，该海峡仍受到美以对伊朗战争的严格限制。由于对伊朗的战争加剧了全球能源危机，它多次受到攻击。

paras.en: The Houthis have also repeatedly targeted Saudi oil infrastructure, including refineries and storage facilities, with drones and missiles.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装还多次用无人机和导弹袭击沙特石油基础设施，包括炼油厂和储存设施。

paras.en: The 1,200km (745-mile) pipeline runs through the desert across the Arabian Peninsula. It was shut down for several days in September after drone attacks, which Saudi Arabia said were launched from Iraq.
paras.zh: 这条长 1,200 公里（745 英里）的管道穿过沙漠穿越阿拉伯半岛。 9月份，在无人机袭击后，该中心被关闭了几天，沙特阿拉伯称这次袭击是从伊拉克发起的。

paras.en: Since the conflict disrupted oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz, Riyadh has rerouted about 4 million barrels per day of crude via the East-West pipeline to Yanbu, equivalent to about 4 percent of global supply.
paras.zh: 由于冲突中断了霍尔木兹海峡的石油流动，利雅得每天通过东西方管道将约 400 万桶原油改道至延布，相当于全球供应量的 4% 左右。

articles.title: Hungarian police reportedly detain brother of ex-PM Viktor Orban

paras.en: Former Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban has accused the country’s new government of “political persecution” after the reported arrest of his younger brother.
paras.zh: 匈牙利前总理维克托·欧尔班在弟弟被捕的报道后指责该国新政府进行“政治迫害”。

paras.en: Hungarian police arrested Aron Orban on Monday on suspicion of people smuggling, among other offences, according to a press report shared by Prime Minister Peter Magyar. Viktor Orban’s staunch opposition to immigration defined his 16 years in power that ended in defeat at elections in April.
paras.zh: 根据总理彼得·马扎尔 (Peter Magyar) 分享的一份新闻报道，匈牙利警方周一逮捕了阿隆·欧尔班 (Aron Orban)，罪名是涉嫌人口走私等罪行。维克多·欧尔班 (Viktor Orban) 坚决反对移民，这奠定了他 16 年的执政生涯，但最终在 4 月份的选举中失败。

paras.en: News of the arrest was first reported by Kontroll, a news site owned by Magyar’s brother, Marton. Police carried out raids involving Aron Orban’s business associates but did not confirm whether he was among those detained, local media reported.
paras.zh: 逮捕的消息最先由 Magyar 的兄弟 Marton 拥有的新闻网站 Kontroll 报道。据当地媒体报道，警方对阿隆·欧尔班的商业伙伴进行了突击搜查，但没有确认他是否在被拘留者之列。

paras.en: Viktor Orban accused the government of arresting his brother as a way to “divert attention” from other issues.
paras.zh: 维克多·欧尔班指责政府逮捕他的兄弟是为了“转移人们对其他问题的注意力”。

paras.en: “I am the real target. My younger brother is simply being used to get to me,” he wrote on X.
paras.zh: “我才是真正的目标。我的弟弟只是被利用来对付我，”他在 X 上写道。

paras.en: Like other members of the Orban family, Aron built several successful businesses during his brother’s rule.
paras.zh: 与欧尔班家族的其他成员一样，阿伦在其兄弟统治期间建立了几家成功的企业。

paras.en: Last year, an investigation by news site Telex linked Aron Orban and his business associates to an alleged scheme involving visas for foreign guest workers.
paras.zh: 去年，新闻网站 Telex 进行的一项调查显示，阿隆·欧尔班 (Aron Orban) 及其商业伙伴涉嫌参与一项涉及外国客工签证的计划。

paras.en: Authorities said they had detained four people suspected of people smuggling.
paras.zh: 当局表示，他们已拘留了四名涉嫌走私人口的人。

paras.en: Pro-EU conservative Magyar won a landslide election victory in April, ending 16 years of Orban’s rule, after promising to investigate his predecessor’s alleged corruption and abuse of power while in office.
paras.zh: 亲欧盟的保守派马扎尔在四月份的选举中获得压倒性胜利，结束了欧尔班长达16年的统治，此前他承诺调查其前任在任期间涉嫌腐败和滥用权力的行为。

articles.title: Pope meets with clergy abuse survivors in Argentina

paras.en: Pope Leo XIV has met with five survivors of clerical sexual abuse on the second day of his historic visit to Argentina.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世在对阿根廷进行历史性访问的第二天会见了五名神职人员性虐待的幸存者。

paras.en: The private meetings in Buenos Aires on Monday were the first of several talks the pope is planning to hold with abuse survivors during his 12-day tour of Latin America, according to the Vatican.
paras.zh: 据梵蒂冈称，周一在布宜诺斯艾利斯举行的私人会议是教皇计划在为期 12 天的拉丁美洲之行期间与虐待幸存者举行的几次会谈中的第一次。

paras.en: “The Pope spoke individually with each of them, listened to their words and to the painful stories of their experiences, as well as to their proposals for strengthening paths towards healing within the Church,” the Vatican said in a statement.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈在一份声明中表示：“教宗与他们每个人单独交谈，聆听他们的话语和痛苦的经历，以及他们关于加强教会内部治愈之路的建议。”

paras.en: The closed-door meetings followed a historic open-air mass that drew an estimated 2.5 million people to Avenida del Libertador, a major boulevard in the capital, at the Monumento de los Espanoles. It was the country’s first papal liturgy in nearly 40 years.
paras.zh: 闭门会议之前，一场历史性的露天集会吸引了大约 250 万人来到首都解放者大道 (Avenida del Libertador)，这是位于西班牙纪念碑 (Monumento de los Espanoles) 的一条主干道。这是该国近 40 年来首次举行教皇礼拜仪式。

paras.en: The meetings with survivors respond to the pope’s desire to “express his closeness to those who have suffered”, build paths to healing and ensure the church is a safe and “spiritually healthy” place, the Holy See Press Office said in October.
paras.zh: 罗马教廷新闻办公室10月表示，与幸存者的会面回应了教皇“表达他对那些遭受苦难的人的亲近”的愿望，建立了治愈之路并确保教会是一个安全和“精神健康”的地方。

paras.en: Leo, the first pope born in the United States, has consistently met with survivors during foreign visits as part of a wider outreach aiming to repair global relations and restore the Catholic Church’s credibility. Lawsuits, widespread sexual abuse and cover-ups have sullied its reputation over the last three decades.
paras.zh: 利奥是第一位在美国出生的教皇，他在出访期间一直会见幸存者，作为旨在修复全球关系和恢复天主教会信誉的更广泛外展活动的一部分。过去三十年来，诉讼、广泛的性虐待和掩盖行为玷污了该公司的声誉。

paras.en: While clergy abuse cases are difficult to track globally, a 2021 independent inquiry found there were an estimated 216,000 victims of the French Catholic Church’s clergy alone between 1950 and 2020. Earlier research found more than 10,600 people were abused by Catholic priests in the US between 1950 and 2002, while Australia counted 6,875 victims of Catholic clergy, religious and lay church workers between 1980 and 2015, according to a 2019 German study.
paras.zh: 虽然神职人员虐待案件在全球范围内难以追踪，但 2021 年的一项独立调查发现，1950 年至 2020 年间，仅法国天主教会神职人员的受害者估计就有 216,000 人。早期研究发现，1950 年至 2002 年间，美国有超过 10,600 人受到天主教神父的虐待，而澳大利亚的统计数据显示，1950 年至 2002 年期间，有 6,875 名天主教神职人员、修会人员和世俗教会工作人员受害。根据 2019 年德国的一项研究，1980 年和 2015 年。

paras.en: During the meeting, which lasted more than an hour, Leo, 71, listened to victims’ testimonies and reiterated his pledge to strengthen safeguarding in the Catholic Church. Before being named pope, Leo served as president of the Pontifical Commission for Latin America.
paras.zh: 在持续一个多小时的会议中，71岁的利奥听取了受害者的证词，并重申了他加强天主教会保护的承诺。在被任命为教皇之前，利奥曾担任教皇拉丁美洲委员会主席。

paras.en: Argentina is the second stop on Leo’s three-country tour, which began in Uruguay and will wrap up in Peru.
paras.zh: 阿根廷是利奥三国之行的第二站，他的行程从乌拉圭开始，到秘鲁结束。

paras.en: His visit was the first by a pontiff since Pope John Paul II’s trip in 1987.
paras.zh: 这是自 1987 年教皇约翰·保罗二世访问以来，教皇的首次访问。

articles.title: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault
articles.author: Kate Bartlett

paras.en: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault
paras.zh: 英国喜剧演员拉塞尔·布兰德因强奸和性侵犯被判十年以上徒刑

paras.en: Russell Brand, the raunchy, irreverent British comedian who became a celebrity darling in the early 2000s, has been sentenced to over 10 years in prison after being found guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔·布兰德 (Russell Brand) 是一位粗俗、不敬的英国喜剧演员，在 2000 年代初成为名人宠儿，因一项强奸罪和三项性侵犯罪被判入狱 10 多年。

paras.en: "The total sentence is one of ten years, six months," said Judge Justice Bennathan on handing down the sentence at Southwark Crown Court in London on Monday.
paras.zh: “总刑期为十年零六个月，”法官本纳森周一在伦敦南华克刑事法院宣判刑罚时表示。

paras.en: Brand, 51, was a career chameleon who went from stand-up comic and MTV host to a political analyst esteemed by Britain's left, only to become a conspiracy theorist and Christian convert beloved by the U.S. right.
paras.zh: 51 岁的布兰德是一位职业变色龙，从单口喜剧演员和 MTV 主持人，到受英国左翼推崇的政治分析家，最后又成为受美国右翼喜爱的阴谋论者和基督教皈依者。

paras.en: But critics of Brand said there was always a clear thread of misogyny running through his comedy routines, and that his mistreatment of women had been an open secret for decades.
paras.zh: 但布兰德的批评者表示，他的喜剧套路中始终贯穿着明显的厌女症线索，而且几十年来他虐待女性的行为一直是公开的秘密。

paras.en: Over the past four weeks, six women testified against the comedian in court in London, in a trial that garnered massive media attention.
paras.zh: 在过去的四个星期里，六名女性在伦敦法庭上作证指控这位喜剧演员，这次审判引起了媒体的广泛关注。

paras.en: A jury found Brand guilty last week on four of the seven counts against him. He was found guilty of raping a woman he'd met at one of his shows in 2009 and of sexually assaulting three women — at a bar, a radio station and a TV studio — between 2004 and 2009.
paras.zh: 陪审团上周裁定布兰德七项罪名中的四项罪名成立。他被判犯有 2009 年在一场演出中强奸一名女子的罪名，以及 2004 年至 2009 年间在一家酒吧、一家广播电台和一家电视演播室对三名女性进行性侵犯的罪名。

paras.en: Brand denies all charges and said he never had non-consensual sex.
paras.zh: 布兰德否认所有指控，并表示他从未发生过未经同意的性行为。

paras.en: Before the judge handed down the sentence, four of the women who brought the case against Brand gave victim impact statements to the court. Three of the statements were read out by the prosecution, while one woman appeared in court behind a curtain to read her own.
paras.zh: 在法官宣判之前，四名对布兰德提起诉讼的女性向法庭提交了受害者影响陈述。其中三份陈述由检方宣读，而一名妇女则出现在法庭幕布后面宣读自己的陈述。

paras.en: None of the women have been publicly named and the trial was not televised.
paras.zh: 这些女性的名字都没有被公开，审判也没有电视转播。

paras.en: The prosecution read out an impact statement from the one complainant, who Brand was found guilty of anally raping at his home in 2009. In her statement she said: "It's something I carry with me every day and it often feels never-ending."
paras.zh: 控方宣读了一名申诉人的影响陈述，布兰德于 2009 年在家中强奸肛门，被判有罪。她在陈述中说：“这是我每天随身携带的东西，常常感觉永无休止。”

paras.en: "I doubt my ability to make good decisions and no longer trust my instinct in the way I did," her statement said, adding that because of Brand's fame she didn't think she'd be believed if she reported him.
paras.zh: 她在声明中说：“我怀疑自己做出正确决定的能力，不再像以前那样相信自己的直觉。”她补充说，由于布兰德的名气，她认为如果她举报他，别人不会相信她。

paras.en: Another complainant, who Brand was found guilty of sexually assaulting at a bar in 2004 when he grabbed her breasts, said the confusion of what she "should" or "could" do had stayed with her for over 20 years.
paras.zh: 另一位申诉人表示，布兰德 2004 年在酒吧抓住她的胸部，被判犯有性侵犯罪。她说，她“应该”或“可以”做什么的困惑已经困扰了她 20 多年。

paras.en: The complainant, who spoke in person from behind a curtain in the courtroom, said she felt "physically sick" seeing Brand in the press afterwards as his fame rose.
paras.zh: 申诉人在法庭的幕布后面亲自发言，她说，随着布兰德名气的上升，她在媒体上看到布兰德之后感到“身体不适”。

paras.en: Another of Brand's victims, who he was found guilty of sexually assaulting in 2005, said the assault had "a lasting impact on her life" and that over the years "hearing his voice on television or seeing his image has made me jump."
paras.zh: 布兰德的另一名受害者于 2005 年被判犯有性侵犯罪，她表示这次袭击“对她的生活产生了持久的影响”，多年来“在电视上听到他的声音或看到他的形象让我跳了起来”。

paras.en: A fourth woman, who Brand was found guilty of sexually assaulting when they worked together at a TV studio, said she was badly affected and afterwards felt her working environment was unsafe.
paras.zh: 第四名女性布兰德在一家电视演播室工作时被判犯有性侵犯罪，她说她受到了严重影响，后来觉得她的工作环境不安全。

paras.en: British media who were in the court for the sentencing said Brand, who had spent the weekend in prison, was in the suit he was convicted in on Thursday and sat holding a set of white rosary beads as the victim statements were read. Brand's wife Laura, who had supported him throughout the case, was in court, as was his father.
paras.zh: 出席法庭宣判的英国媒体称，布兰德在监狱里度过了周末，他在周四被定罪的诉讼中，在宣读受害者陈述时手握一串白色念珠。布兰德的妻子劳拉在整个案件中一直支持他，她和他的父亲都出庭了。

paras.en: After the victim statements, the defense and prosecution teams had the opportunity to make their last statements.
paras.zh: 受害人陈述后，辩方和检方团队有机会发表最后的陈述。

paras.en: The prosecution called for a long sentence, saying there were aggravating circumstances in the anal rape case, such as Brand removing a condom. The defence meanwhile said Brand was "a fundamentally different person" from who he was at the time of the crimes.
paras.zh: 检方要求判处长期徒刑，称肛奸案存在布兰德取出安全套等加重情节。与此同时，辩方表示布兰德与犯罪时的他“根本不同”。

paras.en: After considering the victim impact statements and those by the defence and prosecution, the judge handed down the sentence live on camera.
paras.zh: 在考虑了受害人的影响陈述以及辩方和检方的陈述后，法官在摄像机现场宣布了判决。

paras.en: In his remarks, he said Brand had become "a sexual predator" and paused "to pay tribute to the determination and bravery" of the women who'd come forward.
paras.zh: 他在讲话中表示，布兰德已经成为“性掠夺者”，并停下来“向挺身而出的女性的决心和勇敢致敬”。

paras.en: He then ordered Brand to be taken down to the cells.
paras.zh: 然后他命令将布兰德带到牢房。

articles.title: Thick smog shrouds New Delhi after Diwali firecrackers add to seasonal pollution
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Thick smog shrouds New Delhi after Diwali firecrackers add to seasonal pollution
paras.zh: 排灯节鞭炮加剧季节性污染后，浓烟笼罩新德里

paras.en: NEW DELHI — A thick blanket of smog shrouded India's capital Monday after firecrackers lit up the skies over New Delhi during Diwali celebrations, compounding dangerously high pollution levels and intensifying the seasonal air pollution crisis that grips the city every year.
paras.zh: 新德里——周一，在排灯节庆祝活动期间，新德里上空燃放鞭炮，浓重的烟雾笼罩着印度首都，加剧了危险的高污染水平，加剧了每年困扰这座城市的季节性空气污染危机。

paras.en: Despite restrictions on fireworks, residents in New Delhi celebrated the Hindu festival of lights with firecrackers on Sunday evening, releasing smoke and fine particulate matter into the atmosphere. The air quality index exceeded 350 in several parts of the capital on Monday morning, reaching the severe category and posing significant health risks.
paras.zh: 尽管烟花爆竹受到限制，新德里的居民仍在周日晚上用鞭炮庆祝印度教排灯节，向大气中释放烟雾和细颗粒物。周一上午，首都部分地区空气质量指数突破350，达到严重级别，存在重大健康风险。

paras.en: Monitoring stations across the city recorded similarly alarming levels, while visibility deteriorated as a gray haze blanketed streets and high-rise buildings.
paras.zh: 整个城市的监测站都记录了类似的惊人水平，而灰色雾霾笼罩着街道和高层建筑，能见度也恶化了。

paras.en: India's Supreme Court in October had sought to limit Diwali pollution by restricting conventional firecrackers and allowing only approved "green firecrackers" under specified conditions for three-hour windows on Saturday and Sunday. The crackers produce fewer emissions but are not pollution-free. They still release particulate matter and other pollutants, adding to the city's already hazardous air.
paras.zh: 印度最高法院10月曾试图限制排灯节污染，方法是限制传统鞭炮的燃放，并仅允许在特定条件下在周六和周日的三小时窗口内燃放经批准的“绿色鞭炮”。裂解装置产生的排放量较少，但并非没有污染。它们仍然释放颗粒物和其他污染物，加剧了城市本已有害的空气。

paras.en: Isyad, a New Delhi resident who uses one name, said the worsening smog was taking a toll on his health.
paras.zh: 新德里居民伊西亚德（Isyad）表示，日益恶化的雾霾正在损害他的健康。

paras.en: "Because of the pollution there is irritation in the throat and itching in the eyes," he said.
paras.zh: “由于污染，喉咙会发炎，眼睛也会发痒，”他说。

paras.en: New Delhi and its metropolitan region, home to more than 30 million people, regularly rank among the world's most polluted areas during winter. Pollution worsens as Diwali fireworks coincide with cooler weather and smoke from crop-residue fires in neighboring states of Punjab and Haryana.
paras.zh: 新德里及其拥有超过 3000 万人口的大都市地区在冬季经常跻身世界污染最严重的地区之列。由于排灯节烟花表演恰逢天气转凉，以及邻近的旁遮普邦和哈里亚纳邦农作物残渣火灾产生的烟雾，污染加剧。

paras.en: After harvesting rice, farmers often burn leftover stalks to clear their fields for the next planting season. The smoke drifts toward New Delhi, adding to pollution from vehicles, industries, construction dust and other local sources.
paras.zh: 收割水稻后，农民经常焚烧剩余的稻秆，以清理田地，为下一个种植季节做好准备。烟雾飘向新德里，加剧了车辆、工业、建筑灰尘和其他当地来源的污染。

paras.en: The problem becomes particularly acute in late October and November, when cooler temperatures, low wind speeds and stagnant atmospheric conditions prevent pollutants from dispersing. The result is a thick haze that can linger over the capital and surrounding areas for days.
paras.zh: 这个问题在十月底和十一月变得尤为严重，此时气温较低、风速较低且大气条件停滞，污染物无法扩散。其结果是浓浓的雾霾可能会在首都和周边地区持续数天。

paras.en: Authorities in New Delhi have implemented a set of measures to curb pollution, which include limits on construction activity and restrictions on diesel generators, while courts have sough restrictions on firecrackers. But the measures have not prevented the return of severe pollution each year.
paras.zh: 新德里当局实施了一系列遏制污染的措施，其中包括限制建筑活动和柴油发电机，而法院则对燃放鞭炮进行了严格限制。但这些措施并没有阻止严重污染每年卷土重来。

paras.en: Environmentalists say long-term solutions, such as cleaner energy and stricter controls on vehicle emissions, are needed to prevent the annual crisis.
paras.zh: 环保人士表示，需要采取长期解决方案，例如清洁能源和更严格地控​​制车辆排放，以防止每年的危机。

paras.en: Shweta Narayan, a public health expert at the Global Climate and Health Alliance, described the government's response so far as "knee-jerk" and "temporary."
paras.zh: 全球气候与健康联盟的公共卫生专家什韦塔·纳拉扬（Shweta Narayan）形容政府迄今为止的反应是“下意识的”和“暂时的”。

paras.en: "A lot of interventions happen only because the government is pressured or pushed in a corner to do something," she said.
paras.zh: “许多干预措施的发生只是因为政府受到压力或被逼到墙角做某事，”她说。

articles.title: France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks
articles.author: Jenna McLaughlin

paras.en: France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks
paras.zh: 法国指责伊朗在冰箱袭击中进行网络“破坏”

paras.en: France is accusing Iran of having launched a series of destructive cyberattacks against its critical infrastructure in October.
paras.zh: 法国指责伊朗十月份对其关键基础设施发动了一系列破坏性网络攻击。

paras.en: According to the French National Cybersecurity Agency, ANSSI, Iranian military hackers took over refrigeration controllers at around 700 different retail sites in France, from supermarkets to butcher shops, turning up the temperature in the middle of the night and spoiling millions of dollars' worth of food.
paras.zh: 据法国国家网络安全局 ANSSI 称，伊朗军事黑客接管了法国约 700 个不同零售场所（从超市到肉店）的制冷控制器，在半夜提高了温度，破坏了价值数百万美元的食物。

paras.en: They also targeted several small hydroelectric power plants, resulting in "moderate effects," wrote ANSSI in its press release.
paras.zh: ANSSI 在其新闻稿中写道，他们还针对几个小型水力发电厂，造成了“中等影响”。

paras.en: The hacking campaign was "unprecedented in both its scale and its level of aggression," said French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot. He said it "marks the first large-scale cyberattack aimed at sabotage on our national territory, and it constitutes a major attack on the nation's interests and the security of the French people."
paras.zh: 法国外交部长让-诺埃尔·巴罗表示，此次黑客攻击活动“无论是规模还是侵略程度都是前所未有的”。他表示，这“标志着首次针对我国领土进行破坏的大规模网络攻击，构成对国家利益和法国人民安全的重大攻击”。

paras.en: The Paris Prosecutor's Office has opened its own investigation into the Iranian cyber unit, Shahid Kaveh, which the French government is linking to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. "The Paris Public Prosecutor's Office is requesting the issuance of international arrest warrants," the office said in a statement.
paras.zh: 巴黎检察官办公室已对伊朗网络单位 Shahid Kaveh 展开调查，法国政府将其与伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队联系起来。 “巴黎检察官办公室正在请求签发国际逮捕令，”该办公室在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: A trend of attacks on refrigeration systems
paras.zh: 制冷系统攻击趋势

paras.en: The attacks on French industrial controllers are part of a larger trend. In 2026 alone, hackers have targeted refrigeration controllers from Europe to Israel and the United States.
paras.zh: 针对法国工业控制器的攻击是一个更大趋势的一部分。仅在 2026 年，黑客就瞄准了从欧洲到以色列和美国的制冷控制器。

paras.en: Grocery stores in European countries including Sweden and Ireland were hit in similar attacks last week.
paras.zh: 上周，包括瑞典和爱尔兰在内的欧洲国家的杂货店也遭受了类似的袭击。

paras.en: In a separate incident in France, employees at a major French blood bank had to act fast to save blood samples from heating up when their refrigeration system was hit last week, prompting international calls for the health sector to protect its lifesaving products from spoiling.
paras.zh: 在法国发生的另一起事件中，法国一家大型血库的员工上周制冷系统遭到袭击，不得不迅速采取行动，避免血样升温，这促使国际社会呼吁卫生部门保护其救生产品免遭变质。

paras.en: In Israel in the spring, suspected Iranian hackers going by the name of "Cyber Isnaad Front" claimed responsibility for sabotaging an industrial food processing plant, including infecting its corporate computers with malware, taking over office printers to print out threatening messages and hacking office cameras for use in a propaganda video released in early October. That video included a taunt in French referencing ongoing education-related protests, and came just before the attacks on French supermarket fridges. Cyber incident response firm Profero attributed the Israel attack to a wing of Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps.
paras.zh: 今年春天，在以色列，名为“Cyber​​ Isnaad Front”的疑似伊朗黑客声称对破坏一家工业食品加工厂负责，包括用恶意软件感染公司计算机、接管办公室打印机打印威胁信息，以及侵入办公室摄像头用于 10 月初发布的宣传视频。该视频中包含一段法语嘲讽内容，提及正在进行的与教育相关的抗议活动，视频发布时间就在法国超市冰箱遇袭之前。网络事件响应公司 Profero 将以色列的袭击归咎于伊朗革命卫队的一个分支。

paras.en: Over the summer, commissaries on U.S. military bases also went through something similar, when food spoiled after the temperature shot up inside refrigerators and freezers overnight.
paras.zh: 今年夏天，美国军事基地的小卖部也经历了类似的情况，冰箱和冰柜内的温度一夜之间飙升，食物变质。

paras.en: The French government is the first to formally assign blame for the wave of destructive attacks.
paras.zh: 法国政府是第一个正式对这波破坏性袭击负责的国家。

paras.en: They were able to identify the hackers through a series of digital clues, including digital infrastructure used by the hackers, connection to a propaganda outlet, and "traces" of the use of Farsi language in the attack, according to ANSSI.
paras.zh: ANSSI 表示，他们能够通过一系列数字线索识别黑客，包括黑客使用的数字基础设施、与宣传机构的连接以及攻击中使用波斯语的“痕迹”。

paras.en: While NPR and others have reported that U.S. officials suspect Iran may have been behind the attacks on U.S. military bases in August, the Pentagon has not made any official statement, even to conclude that the disruptions were in fact the result of a cyberattack.
paras.zh: 尽管 NPR 和其他机构报道称，美国官员怀疑伊朗可能是 8 月份美国军事基地袭击事件的幕后黑手，但五角大楼尚未发表任何官方声明，甚至没有得出结论称，这些破坏实际上是网络攻击造成的。

paras.en: "Consistent with our policy and to preserve the integrity of the process, the DOD [Office of Inspector General] Criminal Investigative Service does not discuss ongoing investigations," Mollie Halpern, a spokesperson for the Department of War Office of the Inspector General wrote in an email to NPR.
paras.zh: 战争部监察长办公室发言人莫莉·哈尔彭 (Mollie Halpern) 在给 NPR 的电子邮件中写道：“根据我们的政策并保持程序的完整性，国防部刑事调查局不会讨论正在进行的调查。”

paras.en: Attacks fit Iranian hackers' modus operandi
paras.zh: 攻击符合伊朗黑客的作案手法

paras.en: If Iranian hackers are behind the attacks across Europe, the U.S. and Israel, cybersecurity experts say that would fit with what they know about Iranian hackers' strategy and goals.
paras.zh: 网络安全专家表示，如果伊朗黑客是欧洲、美国和以色列袭击的幕后黑手，这将符合他们对伊朗黑客战略和目标的了解。

paras.en: "Iran's cyberattacks against refrigeration systems likely represents the IRGC attempting to reassert Iranian power abroad through both physically and psychologically disruptive operations," Alex Orleans, the head of threat intelligence at cybersecurity firm Sublime Security, told NPR. "Such activities continue to provide tangible and cost-effect results given how Iran's national resources remain tied down in the war."
paras.zh: 网络安全公司 Sublime Security 的威胁情报主管亚历克斯·奥尔良 (Alex Orleans) 告诉 NPR，“伊朗针对制冷系统的网络攻击可能代表着 IRGC 试图通过身体和心理上的破坏性行动，在海外重新确立伊朗的实力。” “鉴于伊朗的国家资源在战争中仍然受到束缚，此类活动继续提供切实且具有成本效益的成果。”

paras.en: "Also, Shahid Kaveh, the IRGC cyber unit that the French specifically attributed the disruptive attacks to, is repeating a pattern here," Orleans says. He referenced a series of cyberattacks on American water treatment plants in August, which most experts believe were linked to Iran, as precedent. The U.S. government has still not officially attributed those attacks.
paras.zh: 奥尔良说：“此外，法国人特别将破坏性攻击归咎于伊斯兰革命卫队网络部队沙希德·卡维（Shahid Kaveh），这里也重复了一种模式。”他引用了 8 月份针对美国水处理厂的一系列网络攻击作为先例，大多数专家认为这些攻击与伊朗有关。美国政府尚未正式归咎于这些袭击。

paras.en: "This unit has once again refined its tradecraft through attacks on Israeli targets before shifting their targeting to the same systems in the West," Orleans says.
paras.zh: 奥尔良说：“该部队通过攻击以色列目标，再次改进了其情报技术，然后将目标转移到西方的相同系统。”

paras.en: For those tracking Shahid Kaveh and the other Iranian cyber units that operate alongside it, these attacks fit squarely into their modus operandi.
paras.zh: 对于那些追踪沙希德·卡维（Shahid Kaveh）和与其并肩作战的其他伊朗网络单位的人来说，这些攻击完全符合他们的作案手法。

paras.en: "Shahid Kaveh group is an offensive cyber unit responsible for some of the greatest hits of Iranian offensive cyber [operations]," says Ari Ben Am, an adjunct fellow at the Foundation for the Defense of Democracies' Center on Cyber and Technology Innovation.
paras.zh: “沙希德·卡维组织是一个进攻性网络单位，负责伊朗进攻性网络[行动]中一些最严重的打击，”保卫民主基金会网络和技术创新中心的兼职研究员阿里·本·阿姆说。

paras.en: One group tied to Shahid Kaveh is the Cyber Av3ngers, he explains, which the U.S. government linked to cyberattacks on Israeli-made systems in U.S. water treatment facilities in the winter between 2023 and 2024. The French government also cited other cyberattacks carried out on behalf of the IRGC against French interests, including against the satirical French magazine Charlie Hebdo and another against digital kiosks used at the Paris Olympics in 2024.
paras.zh: 他解释说，与沙希德·卡维 (Shahid Kaveh) 相关的一个组织是“网络复仇者”(Cyber Av3ngers)，美国政府将其与 2023 年至 2024 年冬季对美国水处理设施中以色列制造的系统进行的网络攻击联系起来。法国政府还列举了代表 IRGC 针对法国利益实施的其他网络攻击，包括针对法国讽刺杂志《查理周刊》和另一起针对巴黎奥运会上使用的数字信息亭的网络攻击。 2024 年。

paras.en: Challenges in securing operational technology
paras.zh: 确保运营技术安全的挑战

paras.en: Cybersecurity experts say the attacks on refrigeration controllers have highlighted a yearslong difficulty with securing operational technology, the machines that control physical processes in the real world — from water pumps to cooling systems.
paras.zh: 网络安全专家表示，对制冷控制器的攻击凸显了多年来保护操作技术的困难，操作技术是控制现实世界中物理过程的机器——从水泵到冷却系统。

paras.en: These machines are often outdated and riddled with vulnerabilities, and are very difficult to patch because operators can't afford to shut them down and disrupt critical services including healthcare and transportation. Additionally, the machines are often left exposed to the open internet — often at least in part due to contractual requirements with vendors that want to maintain those systems remotely. That combination of factors makes it a complicated problem to solve.
paras.zh: 这些机器通常已经过时且漏洞百出，并且很难修补，因为运营商无法承担关闭它们并中断包括医疗保健和运输在内的关键服务的费用。此外，这些机器通常暴露在开放互联网上——通常至少部分是由于与想要远程维护这些系统的供应商的合同要求。这些因素的综合作用使其成为一个需要解决的复杂问题。

paras.en: Iran has yet to respond to the accusations. However, Monday's accusation by the French government may lead other affected countries to take action as well.
paras.zh: 伊朗尚未对这些指控做出回应。然而，法国政府周一的指控可能会导致其他受影响国家也采取行动。

paras.en: During Monday's G7 meeting in Paris, Secretary of State Marco Rubio was asked by journalists whether the U.S. shared information with the French to help with their attribution of the Iranian hacks. Rubio said he couldn't comment, but noted that the "French are quite capable."
paras.zh: 周一在巴黎举行的七国集团会议上，国务卿马可·卢比奥被记者问及美国是否与法国分享信息以帮助他们追查伊朗黑客攻击的原因。卢比奥表示他无法发表评论，但指出“法国人很有能力”。

paras.en: "What kind of sickos are these people?" he asked. "They attack refrigerators. France is not even involved in this, really," referring to the war between the U.S. and Iran, which began in February. "[These Iranians] do terrible things around the world … the news today doesn't surprise us," Rubio concluded.
paras.zh: “这些人都是什么病啊？”他问道。 “他们攻击冰箱。法国甚至没有参与这件事，真的，”指的是二月份开始的美国和伊朗之间的战争。 “[这些伊朗人]在世界各地做了可怕的事情......今天的消息并不让我们感到惊讶，”卢比奥总结道。

paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是尽可能长时间地避免信用卡利息，那么这张简单的卡是一个不错的选择。从购买账户开户和合格余额转账起，它提供令人难以置信的 0% 介绍年利率 21 个月（之后为 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率）。余额转账费用（5%；至少 5 美元）比某些卡要高，但如果您想要购买和余额转账时有同样长的年利率介绍，那么这张卡很难被击败。

paras.en: These cards are designed for people looking to pay off a large purchase or transfer a balance — so our ratings emphasize interest-free periods, fee structures, and how much time you really get to pay things down.
paras.zh: 这些卡是为那些希望还清大额购买或转移余额的人而设计的，因此我们的评级强调免息期、费用结构以及您真正还清贷款的时间。

paras.en: We don’t penalize cards for a lack of long-term rewards here – this category is all about interest savings, and our ratings reflect that.
paras.zh: 我们不会因为缺乏长期奖励而对信用卡进行处罚——这一类别主要是为了节省利息，我们的评级反映了这一点。

paras.en: We combine these factors with an evaluation of brand reputation and customer satisfaction to ensure you're getting the best high limit card recommendations. Our aim is to maintain a balanced best-of list featuring top-scoring high limit credit cards from reputable brands. 'Best for' category selections on this page are determined by our editors, and a single card may be recognized in multiple categories.
paras.zh: 我们将这些因素与品牌声誉和客户满意度评估相结合，以确保您获得最佳的高限额卡推荐。我们的目标是维持一个平衡的最佳列表，其中包括来自知名品牌的得分最高的高限额信用卡。此页面上的“最佳”类别选择由我们的编辑确定，单张卡片可能会在多个类别中被识别。

paras.en: Ordering within lists is influenced by advertiser compensation, including featured placements at the top of a given list, but our product recommendations are NEVER influenced by advertisers. Learn more about how Motley Fool Money rates credit cards.
paras.zh: 列表中的排序受到广告商补偿的影响，包括给定列表顶部的特色展示位置，但我们的产品推荐永远不会受到广告商的影响。详细了解 Motley Fool Money 如何对信用卡进行评级。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is best for people carrying high-interest debt or planning a large purchase they want to spread out over time.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡最适合背负高息债务或计划长期进行大额购买的人士。

paras.en: You get nearly two years of breathing room with no interest, which can save a lot of money while you pay things off.
paras.zh: 您将获得近两年的无息喘息空间，这可以在您还清债务的同时节省大量资金。

paras.en: If you're looking for cash back or travel rewards, this is not the card for you. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card has no rewards program and no welcome bonus. It loses most of its value the moment the intro period ends.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特点是，自开户购买和合格余额转账起 21 个月内，年利率为 0%。 （此后适用 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率。）

paras.en: That's one of the longest 0% APR periods you'll find anywhere -- which is why it earned Motley Fool Money's award for Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳整体信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，信用额度通常越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高利率。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。

paras.zh: 富国银行是 Motley Fool Money 的广告合作伙伴。乔尔·奥利里 (Joel O'Leary) 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 有披露政策。
