paras.zh: The Motley Fool 拥有 Visa 的股份并推荐该公司。

articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派系试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的形状而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰凉拌面，都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然充满活力的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答任何有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时间，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的奇妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通会比私家车多花一两个小时。

articles.title: Colorado mom who said daughter was secretly transitioned helps lead effort to ban boys in girls' sports

paras.en: A Colorado mother who said her daughter was secretly socially transitioned at school helped lead a grassroots campaign that delivered major midterm victories, including measures restricting boys from playing in girls' spots in the traditionally Democratic state.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州的一位母亲表示，她的女儿在学校秘密地进行了社会转型，她帮助领导了一场草根运动，取得了中期选举的重大胜利，其中包括限制男孩在传统民主党州参加女孩比赛的措施。

paras.en: Erin Lee, executive director and co-founder of Protect Kids Colorado, told Fox News Digital that the campaign's success was deeply personal, coming more than five years after an experience involving her daughter transformed her from a self-described left-leaning Democrat into a prominent parental rights advocate.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州保护儿童组织的执行董事兼联合创始人艾琳·李 (Erin Lee) 向福克斯新闻数字频道表示，该活动的成功很大程度上是针对个人的，五年多前，一次涉及她女儿的经历使她从一个自称的左倾民主党人变成了一位杰出的父母权利倡导者。

paras.en: "I co-founded Protect Kids Colorado because, five-and-a-half years ago, my 12-year-old daughter was secretly transitioned in her sixth-grade classroom," Lee said.
paras.zh: “我与他人共同创立了科罗拉多州保护儿童组织，因为五年半前，我 12 岁的女儿在六年级的教室里秘密变性，”李说。

paras.en: In 2023, Lee, her husband and another couple, who at the time had sixth-grade daughters attending Wellington Middle-High School (WMS), sued educators at the Poudre School District with the assistance of America First Policy Institute and Illumine Legal, according to a copy of the lawsuit.
paras.zh: 诉讼副本显示，2023 年，李、她的丈夫和另一对夫妇在美国第一政策研究所和 Illumine Legal 的协助下起诉了 Poudre 学区的教育工作者，当时他们的女儿正在惠灵顿中学 (WMS) 读六年级。

paras.en: Her group championed three ballot initiatives: Proposition 133, which increases penalties for child sex trafficking to life in prison without parole; Proposition 134, which would generally require students to compete on school sports teams corresponding to their biological sex; and Proposition 135, which would prohibit certain gender-transition surgeries for minors.
paras.zh: 她的团体支持三项投票倡议：133 号提案，将儿童性交易的处罚加重至终身监禁且不得假释； 134号提案，通常要求学生参加与其生理性别相对应的学校运动队的比赛； 135 号提案禁止对未成年人进行某些变性手术。

paras.en: Proposition 133 passed with approximately 62% support, while the other two measures, proposition 134, received roughly 52% and proposition 135 also received 52%.
paras.zh: 第 133 号提案以约 62% 的支持率获得通过，而另外两项措施，即第 134 号提案，获得了约 52% 的支持，第 135 号提案也获得了 52% 的支持。

paras.en: In the same election, Coloradans re-elected Democratic Sen. John Hickenlooper in a landslide with 60 percent of the vote.
paras.zh: 在同一次选举中，科罗拉多人以 60% 的选票以压倒性优势再次选举民主党参议员约翰·希肯卢珀 (John Hickenlooper)。

paras.en: Lee said that the results demonstrate opposition to certain transgender policies that extend beyond traditional partisan lines.
paras.zh: 李说，结果表明对某些超出传统党派界限的跨性别政策的反对。

paras.en: "Colorado broke ranks where they voted for Democrats," Lee said. "They also voted yes on these commonsense child protection measures."
paras.zh: “科罗拉多州打破了他们投票给民主党的立场，”李说。 “他们还对这些常识性的儿童保护措施投了赞成票。”

paras.en: "I think that really speaks volumes to the fact that gender ideology is not a winning issue," she added.
paras.zh: “我认为这确实说明了性别意识形态不是一个获胜问题的事实，”她补充道。

paras.en: Lee said the campaign relied on more than 3,300 petition circulators, over 1,900 notaries and support from more than 1,000 churches. She claimed opponents spent more than $5 million, outspending her organization by more than 20 to 1.
paras.zh: 李说，这场运动依靠了超过3,300名请愿传阅者、超过1,900名公证人和超过1,000个教会的支持。她声称反对者花费了超过 500 万美元，比她的组织花费了 20 比 1 以上。

paras.en: "This really was a movement of the people," Lee said.
paras.zh: “这确实是人民的运动，”李说。

paras.en: She also described the personal toll of her family's experience, alleging that school officials turned against her and her husband after they questioned their daughter's change in gender identity.
paras.zh: 她还描述了她家庭的经历对个人造成的影响，声称学校官员在质疑女儿性别认同的改变后对她和她的丈夫进行了反对。

paras.en: "We walked through a living nightmare," Lee said.
paras.zh: “我们经历了一场活生生的噩梦，”李说。

paras.en: "Prior to 2021, I was your typical left-leaning Democrat voting, politically disengaged, virtue-signaling mom," Lee said.
paras.zh: “在 2021 年之前，我是典型的左倾民主党选民，不参与政治，宣扬美德的妈妈，”李说。

paras.en: "And then it happened to us personally, and we were attacked by the school district when my daughter came home and declared she was suddenly a boy. We spoke up to the school and they vilified us. They sent in a well child check to check on our kids and assumed we weren't fit parents because we didn't instantly affirm. We were bullied with the suicide myth, ‘Would you rather have a living son or a dead daughter? You have to medicalize your child,’ and we're one of a few success stories," she said.
paras.zh: “然后这件事就发生在我们身上，当我女儿回家并宣布她突然变成男孩时，我们受到了学区的攻击。我们向学校举报，他们诽谤我们。他们寄来一份健康儿童检查来检查我们的孩子，并认为我们不适合父母，因为我们没有立即确认。我们被自杀神话欺负，‘你想要一个活着的儿子还是一个死去的女儿？你必须对你的孩子进行医疗’，我们是少数成功案例之一，”她说。

paras.en: Lee said her daughter one day moved on from the gender confusion, and asked her mom to become an advocate for others who might find themselves in a similar place.
paras.zh: 李说，有一天，她的女儿摆脱了性别困惑，并要求她的妈妈成为其他可能处于类似境地的人的倡导者。

paras.en: "It took almost a year to get her through this mentality," Lee said. "It included suicidal ideation and estrangement from people in our lives who didn't agree with us, not affirming her. She asked us to speak up to help other kids, and that's what launched me into sharing our story and it going viral, and really becoming this person that people could come to with their own stories of what they were going through, and I just learned how pervasive gender ideology is."
paras.zh: “她花了将近一年的时间才摆脱这种心态，”李说。 “这包括自杀念头，以及与生活中那些不同意我们观点、不肯定她的人的疏远。她要求我们大声疾呼，帮助其他孩子，这就是促使我分享我们的故事的原因，它迅速传播开来，并真正成为一个人们可以讲述自己所经历的故事的人，我刚刚了解到性别意识形态是多么普遍。”

paras.en: Her daughter’s request, according to Lee, helped launch the advocacy work that ultimately grew into Protect Kids Colorado's statewide campaign.
paras.zh: 据李说，她女儿的请求帮助启动了宣传工作，最终发展成为科罗拉多州保护儿童的全州运动。

paras.en: Lee said she sees the election results as evidence of a broader cultural shift.
paras.zh: 李说，她认为选举结果是更广泛的文化转变的证据。

paras.en: "Gender ideology is a house of cards," she said, arguing that the Colorado vote could inspire similar efforts elsewhere.
paras.zh: “性别意识形态是一座纸牌屋，”她说，并认为科罗拉多州的投票可能会激发其他地方的类似努力。

paras.en: "The voters have spoken," Lee said. "We've come a long way culturally for this to have passed."
paras.zh: “选民已经发声了，”李说。 “为了让这一切过去，我们在文化上已经走了很长一段路。”

paras.en: A spokesperson for Poudre School District told Fox News Digital in a statement that, "Poudre School District does not comment on individual students, consistent with federal student privacy law."
paras.zh: 普德尔学区的发言人在一份声明中告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，“普德尔学区不会对个别学生发表评论，这符合联邦学生隐私法。”

paras.en: The spokesperson added that "the claims in Lee v. Poudre School District R-1 were dismissed by the U.S. District Court for the District of Colorado. That dismissal was affirmed by the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit in April 2025. The plaintiffs subsequently petitioned the U.S. Supreme Court for review, and the Court denied that petition in October 2025. At no stage of this litigation was the district found liable."
paras.zh: 该发言人补充说，“Lee 诉 Poudre 学区 R-1 案中的诉讼请求被美国科罗拉多州地区法院驳回。美国第十巡回上诉法院于 2025 年 4 月维持了这一驳回。原告随后向美国最高法院请求复审，法院于 2025 年 10 月驳回了该请求。在本次诉讼的任何阶段，学区都没有被认定承担责任。”

paras.en: Fox News Digital reached out to LGBTQ advocacy organization One Colorado for comment, as well as Families Not Politics, an organization opposing the measures.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字媒体联系 LGBTQ 倡导组织 One Colorado 以及反对这些措施的组织 Families Not Politics 征求意见。

articles.title: Jeffries vows Democrats won’t ‘give a dime’ to Trump’s deportation efforts

paras.en: Rep. Hakeem Jeffries on Monday laid out an aggressive agenda for House Democrats as the party prepares to take control of the chamber following sweeping midterm election victories, declaring that Democrats will "not give a dime" toward funding the Trump administration's deportation efforts.
paras.zh: 众议员哈基姆·杰弗里斯周一为众议院民主党制定了一项积极的议程，该党正准备在中期选举中取得压倒性胜利后控制众议院，并宣称民主党将“不会为特朗普政府的驱逐工作提供一毛钱”。

paras.en: The House minority leader made the remarks during a press conference, one week before Democrats are set to vote on whether Jeffries should remain in his leadership position.
paras.zh: 这位众议院少数党领袖在新闻发布会上发表了上述言论，一周前民主党将就杰弗里斯是否应继续担任领导职务进行投票。

paras.en: "The American people clearly and decisively rejected MAGA extremism on Tuesday and voted for dramatic change," Jeffries said.
paras.zh: 杰弗里斯说：“周二，美国人民明确而果断地拒绝了 MAGA 极端主义，并投票支持重大变革。”

paras.en: "House Democrats have taken the position that we're not going to give a dime to the administration's violent mass deportation machine," he added.
paras.zh: “众议院民主党人的立场是，我们不会为政府的暴力大规模驱逐机器提供一毛钱，”他补充道。

paras.en: Jeffries also criticized the use of taxpayer dollars to support what he called "un-American" policies under President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 杰弗里斯还批评使用纳税人的钱来支持唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下的他所说的“非美国”政策。

paras.en: "Taxpayer dollars should be used to make life more affordable for the American people, not brutalize or kill American citizens, and violently target law-abiding immigrant communities and families, which is what has happened over the last two years," Jeffries said.
paras.zh: 杰弗里斯说：“纳税人的钱应该用来让美国人民的生活更容易负担，而不是残暴或杀害美国公民，并暴力针对守法的移民社区和家庭，这就是过去两年发生的事情。”

paras.en: He added that he hopes to secure one additional signature on a discharge petition that would bypass House leadership and force a floor vote on the American Dream and Promise Act, which would provide permanent legal status and a pathway to citizenship for Dreamers and recipients of Temporary Protected Status (TPS).
paras.zh: 他补充说，他希望在一份释放请愿书上获得一个额外的签名，该签名将绕过众议院领导层并强制对《美国梦与承诺法案》进行全体投票，该法案将为梦想家和临时保护身份（TPS）的获得者提供永久的法律地位和获得公民身份的途径。

paras.en: "Hopefully some of our colleagues on the other side of the aisle will be willing to do that work, perhaps beginning with one additional signature that we need to force a vote on the Dream and Promise Act from a Republican," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“希望我们另一边的一些同事愿意做这项工作，也许从一个额外的签名开始，我们需要迫使共和党人对《梦想与承诺法案》进行投票。”

paras.en: Among other priorities, Jeffries said Democrats want to pass legislation banning members of the House and Senate from trading stocks, an effort aimed at restoring public trust in government.
paras.zh: 杰弗里斯表示，除其他优先事项外，民主党希望通过立法，禁止众议院和参议院议员交易股票，此举旨在恢复公众对政府的信任。

paras.en: He also voiced support for an impeachment resolution against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over his handling of the war in Iran and alleged constitutional violations.
paras.zh: 他还表示支持针对国防部长皮特·赫格斯的弹劾决议，指控他处理伊朗战争和涉嫌违反宪法。

paras.en: "I'm a hard yes, as I've made clear, on the impeachment resolution. Pete Hegseth has abused his power, undermined America's national security, and he's the architect of the reckless and costly failed war of choice in Iran, which has skyrocketed gas prices on everyday Americans, made the country less safe," Jeffries said.
paras.zh: 杰弗里斯说：“正如我已经明确表示的那样，我对弹劾决议持强硬态度。皮特·赫格斯滥用权力，破坏了美国的国家安全，他是伊朗这场鲁莽且代价高昂、失败的选择战争的策划者，这场战争导致美国人的汽油价格飞涨，让这个国家变得不那么安全。”

paras.en: "Iran is stronger now than they were before," he argued.
paras.zh: “伊朗现在比以前更强大，”他辩称。

paras.en: As the Democratic caucus leadership vote approaches next Wednesday, reporters asked Jeffries whether he was concerned about progressive members who have criticized him for not taking a more aggressive approach during his tenure as leader.
paras.zh: 随着下周三民主党核心小组领导层投票的临近，记者问杰弗里斯是否担心进步派成员批评他在担任领导人期间没有采取更积极的做法。

paras.en: Jeffries said he plans to speak with every member of the caucus in an effort to retain his position.
paras.zh: 杰弗里斯表示，他计划与核心小组的每位成员进行交谈，以努力保住自己的职位。

paras.en: "I'm going to work hard to talk to every single member about what we've been able to do together over the last two years, and what the opportunities are for us to do together in the next two years," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我将努力与每一位成员谈论我们在过去两年中共同完成的工作，以及我们在未来两年中共同完成的工作机会。”

articles.title: Dana White takes questions at podium during White House briefing with Trump

paras.en: UFC CEO Dana White joined President Donald Trump at a White House press briefing on Monday, where Trump clarified that his recent suggestion to appoint the fight executive as his press secretary was merely a joke.
paras.zh: UFC首席执行官达纳·怀特(Dana White)周一与唐纳德·特朗普总统一起出席了白宫新闻发布会，特朗普在会上澄清说，他最近任命这位拳击主管担任新闻秘书的建议只是一个笑话。

paras.en: Trump made a surprise appearance at the briefing to address reports that he had reached out to White for the role following a difficult news cycle.
paras.zh: 特朗普出人意料地出现在新闻发布会上，回应了有关他在艰难的新闻周期后向怀特寻求这一职位的报道。

paras.en: "We were having a very bad press day, and I said: 'I don't know why I thought of his name. ' He's been my friend for a long time. I said: 'You know, I think I'm going to get Dana White to be my new press secretary,'" Trump told reporters. "I said it to a group of the press and that was it. I was sort of kidding, and then they wrote the story as though I wasn't kidding."
paras.zh: “我们的新闻发布会非常糟糕，我说：‘我不知道为什么会想到他的名字。’他是我很长时间的朋友了。我说：‘你知道，我想我会让达纳·怀特（Dana White）担任我的新新闻秘书，’”特朗普告诉记者。 “我对一群媒体说了这句话，就是这样。我有点开玩笑，然后他们写了这个故事，就好像我没有开玩笑一样。”

paras.en: White then took the podium to address reporters and shut down any rumors of entering government service.
paras.zh: 怀特随后走上讲台向记者发表讲话，并澄清了任何有关进入政府部门的谣言。

paras.en: "I have zero political aspirations," White said. "I was at a fight for Zuffa Boxing in London when he called me and told me that he had done this, and the last 24 hours of my life have been insane."
paras.zh: “我的政治愿望为零，”怀特说。 “我当时正在伦敦参加 Zuffa Boxing 的一场比赛，当时他打电话给我，告诉我他做到了这一点，我生命中的最后 24 小时简直太疯狂了。”

paras.en: When asked by a reporter to break down a hypothetical UFC cage match between Trump and former President Joe Biden, White praised Trump’s toughness while dismissing the match up.
paras.zh: 当记者要求分解特朗普和前总统乔·拜登之间假设的 UFC 笼式比赛时，怀特赞扬了特朗普的强硬，但对这场比赛不予理睬。

paras.en: "He's the toughest, most resilient human being that I've ever met in my entire life," White said of Trump. "Many times during the last eight or 10 years, I have told him: 'Why? Why do you keep doing this? ' But as tough and as resilient as I thought he was, after he got shot, he proved he is a one-of-one unique human being."
paras.zh: “他是我一生中见过的最坚强、最有韧性的人，”怀特谈到特朗普时说道。 “在过去的八年或十年里，我多次告诉他：‘为什么？你为什么继续这样做？’但尽管我认为他很坚强，但在他中枪后，他证明了自己是一个独一无二的独特的人。”

paras.en: Regarding the hypothetical fight, White added: "It would be very bad. Yeah, I think it would be very bad... I can't believe you actually have questions for me."
paras.zh: 关于假想的战斗，怀特补充道：“这将非常糟糕。是的，我认为这将非常糟糕......我不敢相信你真的有问题要问我。”

paras.en: White added that he never explicitly told Trump "no" regarding the position.
paras.zh: 怀特补充说，他从未明确对特朗普就这一立场说“不”。

paras.en: Before stepping away, the UFC chief was also asked what advice he would give Trump regarding a potential posthumous pardon for Pete Rose, the legendary baseball player who died in 2024.
paras.zh: 在离开之前，这位 UFC 主席还被问到，对于 2024 年去世的传奇棒球运动员皮特·罗斯可能的死后赦免，他会给特朗普什么建议。

paras.en: Rose was banned from MLB Hall of Fame eligibility due to betting on baseball games, including those involving his own team, the Cincinnati Reds. In 2025, MLB Commissioner Rob Manfred removed Rose and 16 other deceased people from the permanently ineligible list.
paras.zh: 罗斯因投注棒球比赛而被禁止进入美国职业棒球大联盟名人堂，其中包括那些涉及他自己球队辛辛那提红人队的比赛。 2025 年，美国职业棒球大联盟 (MLB) 专员罗布·曼弗雷德 (Rob Manfred) 将罗斯和其他 16 名死者从永久不符合资格的名单中删除。

paras.en: Trump reiterated during the briefing that he favors pardoning the hit king.
paras.zh: 特朗普在新闻发布会上重申，他赞成赦免这位袭击之王。

articles.title: Iran was behind cyber-attack on French supermarket freezers, Paris says
articles.author: Kim Willsher in Paris

paras.en: France has said Iran was responsible for a massive cyber-attack on supermarket freezers and chiller cabinets that was described by its foreign minister as being an act of “unprecedented scale and unprecedented aggression”.
paras.zh: 法国表示，伊朗对超市冰柜和冷藏柜发动大规模网络攻击，法国外交部长称这是一次“规模空前、侵略性空前”的行为。

paras.en: Jean-Noël Barrot said “Europe-wide sanctions” would be imposed against those responsible, adding that the attacks – which took control of digital thermostats to push temperatures up to above 50C – constituted “a major violation of the nation’s interests”.
paras.zh: Jean-Noël Barrot 表示，将对责任人实施“全欧洲制裁”，并补充说，这些攻击控制了数字恒温器，将温度推高至 50 摄氏度以上，构成了“对国家利益的重大侵犯”。

paras.en: At a press briefing during the G7 summit in Paris, he said: “Thanks to the remarkable efforts of government agencies, I am able to confirm that the Islamic Republic of Iran’s Revolutionary Guards are responsible for this attack.”
paras.zh: 他在巴黎七国集团峰会期间的新闻发布会上表示：“由于政府机构的出色努力，我能够确认伊朗伊斯兰共和国革命卫队对这次袭击负责。”

paras.en: He said the Iranian ambassador had been summoned “to protest in the strongest possible terms against this extremely serious act.”
paras.zh: 他说，伊朗大使已被传唤，“以最强烈的措辞抗议这一极其严重的行为”。

paras.en: Swathes of French supermarkets were hit in the cyber-attacks on 11 and 12 October. Some were forced to throw away entire inventories of perishable food.
paras.zh: 10 月 11 日至 12 日，法国大片超市遭受网络攻击。有些人被迫扔掉全部库存的易腐食品。

paras.en: Similar incidents have been reported since, including on supermarket fridges in other European countries last week and on a French blood bank.
paras.zh: 此后也发生过类似事件，包括上周在其他欧洲国家的超市冰箱和法国血库发生的事件。

paras.en: The Paris public prosecutor, Laure Beccuau, said on Monday that specialist investigators and government agencies had identified “a modus operandi” characteristic of the Iranian group Shahid Kaveh, a cyber warfare unit linked to the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC).
paras.zh: 巴黎检察官劳尔·贝库 (Laure Beccuau) 周一表示，专家调查人员和政府机构已经发现了伊朗组织 Shahid Kaveh 的“作案手法”特征，该组织是一个与伊斯兰革命卫队 (IRGC) 有联系的网络战部队。

paras.en: This included “the use of Farsi and IP addresses traced back to devices located in Iran”, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，这包括“使用波斯语和可追溯到位于伊朗的设备的 IP 地址”。

paras.en: Beccuau said her office had opened a investigation against the head of Shahid Kaveh, his deputies and “others who will be identified” on charges of “fraudulent attacks on an automated data processing system committed as part of an organised crime ring and of causing damage dangerous to persons”.
paras.zh: 贝库奥表示，她的办公室已对沙希德·卡维（Shahid Kaveh）的负责人、他的副手和“其他将被查明身份的人”展开调查，罪名是“对有组织犯罪团伙的自动数据处理系统进行欺诈性攻击，并对人员造成危险的损害”。

paras.en: She said the offences were “aggravated by the fact they were committed to serve a foreign power – in this case Iran”.
paras.zh: 她表示，这些罪行“由于他们致力于为外国势力——在本例中为伊朗——服务”而更加严重。

paras.en: Gérôme Billois, a partner at the cybersecurity and technology company Wavestone, said Shahid Kaveh had been active since 2020 and was known to have carried out cyber-attacks mostly on water distribution systems in the US.
paras.zh: 网络安全和技术公司 Wavestone 的合伙人 Gérôme Billois 表示，Shahid Kaveh 自 2020 年以来一直活跃，已知主要针对美国的供水系统进行网络攻击。

paras.en: “Two countries are known for this kind of attack: Iran and Russia. Given that recent cyber-attacks on supermarkets and the blood bank in France concerned freezers it is reasonable to think Iran is directly linked to both,” he said,
paras.zh: “有两个国家因此类攻击而闻名：伊朗和俄罗斯。鉴于最近对法国超市和血库的网络攻击涉及冰柜，有理由认为伊朗与这两个国家有直接联系，”他说，

paras.en: “For the moment they are attacking easy equipment but as a state group that has the means, the determination and the time, we should be prepared to see attacks on other systems like water or electricity.”
paras.zh: “目前他们正在攻击简单的设备，但作为一个有手段、决心和时间的国家组织，我们应该准备好看到对水或电力等其他系统的攻击。”

paras.en: During the attack last month, hackers remotely overrode the temperature setting on thousands of freezers, fridges and chiller cabinets in as many as 700 supermarkets and shops across France, pushing them from as low as -27C (-16.6F) to well over 50C (122F) in some cases.
paras.zh: 在上个月的攻击中，黑客远程覆盖了法国多达 700 家超市和商店的数千台冰柜、冰箱和冷藏柜的温度设置，在某些情况下将温度从低至 -27 摄氏度（-16.6 华氏度）提高到远超 50 摄氏度（122 华氏度）。

paras.en: Thousands of tons of food had to be dumped and in some stores the extreme temperature rise sparked fires, triggering sprinklers and water damage.
paras.zh: 数千吨食物不得不被倾倒，一些商店的极端气温上升引发火灾，引发洒水装置和水灾。

paras.en: Hackers last week accessed control systems at cold stores stocking blood products. The French blood service (EFS) said temperature and defrosting thresholds and been raised to “very high level” but that technicians had been alerted by alarm systems allowing them to disconnect the cold stores before the products were destroyed. It is not clear whether the two attacks are linked.
paras.zh: 黑客上周访问了储存血液制品的冷库的控制系统。法国血液服务中心（EFS）表示，温度和除霜阈值已提高到“非常高的水平”，但技术人员已收到警报系统的警报，允许他们在产品被销毁之前断开冷藏室的连接。目前尚不清楚这两次袭击是否有关联。

paras.en: The following day retailers in 11 European countries including the UK, Belgium, Estonia, Ireland, Finland, Luxembourg, the Netherlands and Sweden reported problems with refrigeration systems.
paras.zh: 第二天，英国、比利时、爱沙尼亚、爱尔兰、芬兰、卢森堡、荷兰和瑞典等 11 个欧洲国家的零售商报告了制冷系统存在问题。

paras.en: A regional branch of France’s Crédit Mutuel bank also reported losing more than €100m in a cyber-attack on Friday. The bank said it had recuperated some of the money.
paras.zh: 法国信用互助银行 (Crédit Mutuel) 的一个地区分行也报告称，在周五的网络攻击中损失超过 1 亿欧元。该银行表示已收回部分资金。

paras.en: The European Commission did not immediately comment on the French foreign minister’s statement. Kaja Kallas, the head of foreign affairs for the EU said: “We have the foreign affairs council next Monday, so we will have the opportunity to discuss this. These cyber incidents occurring in Europe, if attributed [to Iran], also call for a strong response on our part.”
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会没有立即对法国外长的声明发表评论。欧盟外交事务负责人卡贾·卡拉斯表示：“下周一我们将召开外交事务理事会，因此我们将有机会讨论此事。欧洲发生的这些网络事件，如果归咎于[伊朗]，也需要我们做出强有力的反应。”

paras.en: In a significant decision this year, the EU designated the IRGC a terrorist organisation, ending years of division over the issue. The designation became possible after France dropped its long-held opposition, having previously feared it would damage diplomatic channels and the interests of French nationals in Iran.
paras.zh: 在今年的一项重大决定中，欧盟将伊斯兰革命卫队指定为恐怖组织，结束了多年来在该问题上的分歧。法国放弃了长期以来的反对态度后，这一指定成为可能，此前法国担心这会损害外交渠道和法国国民在伊朗的利益。

articles.title: Witnesses recount struggle to save people buried in ‘horrifying’ Gaza landslide
articles.author: Seham Tantesh in Gaza and Jason Burke

paras.en: Witnesses have described the frantic struggle to save three members of a family buried by a landslide triggered by high winds and heavy rain in Gaza.
paras.zh: 目击者描述了为拯救加沙强风和大雨引发的山体滑坡而被掩埋的一家三口的疯狂斗争。

paras.en: A sand bank overlooking a camp for displaced families south of Deir al-Balah collapsed on Sunday, killing five people and crushing at least three tents.
paras.zh: 周日，代尔巴拉赫以南一座流离失所家庭营地附近的沙堆倒塌，造成五人死亡，至少三个帐篷被压毁。

paras.en: “It was a horrifying sight,” said Abdul Karim al-Sahhar, 30, originally from Izbat Beit Hanoun in northern Gaza. “We saw people buried beneath the sand and rocks. None of them was moving or making a sound. Even the tent had disappeared completely. There was no trace of it left.”
paras.zh: “这是一个可怕的景象，”30 岁的阿卜杜勒·卡里姆·萨哈尔 (Abdul Karim al-Sahhar) 说，他来自加沙北部的伊兹巴特拜特哈农 (Izbat Beit Hanoun)。 “我们看到有人埋在沙子和岩石下面。他们都没有动弹，也没有发出声音。就连帐篷也完全消失了。没有留下任何痕迹。”

paras.en: Among the casualties were an eight-year-old, a six-year-old and their mother.
paras.zh: 伤亡者包括一名八岁、一名六岁的孩子和他们的母亲。

paras.en: Sahhar, whose own shelter was badly damaged in the landslide, said the children’s father was outside the family tent and so survived. “One of his children had called him to come and eat with them,” he said. “He was a little late returning, and then the collapse happened.
paras.zh: 萨哈尔的住所在山体滑坡中遭到严重破坏，他说孩子们的父亲在家庭帐篷外面，因此幸存下来。 “他的一个孩子叫他来和他们一起吃饭，”他说。 “他回来的有点晚了，然后就发生了崩溃。

paras.en: “The father started shouting: ‘Save my children! Save my children!’ People came and started digging [but] there was a huge boulder on top of the victims. The young men had to break it into pieces so they could reach the people buried underneath.”
paras.zh: “父亲开始大喊：‘救救我的孩子们！救救我的孩子们！’人们赶来并开始挖掘，[但]受害者身上有一块巨大的巨石。年轻人必须把它打碎，这样他们才能找到埋在下面的人。”

paras.en: Abu Darbali, another witness, said the collapse of the embankment sounded like an explosion. “We found that three tents were covered completely after the mountain collapsed on top of them,” he told Reuters. “People were under the rubble and we couldn’t see them.”
paras.zh: 另一位目击者阿布·达尔巴利 (Abu Darbali) 表示，堤坝倒塌的声音就像爆炸一样。他告诉路透社：“我们发现，山体倒塌压在三顶帐篷上后，它们被完全覆盖。” “人们都在废墟下，我们看不到他们。”

paras.en: Video posted to social media showed people using hammers to break large rocks and others removing sand with shovels, using flashlights to search for those trapped underneath.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上发布的视频显示，人们用锤子敲碎大石头，其他人用铲子清除沙子，用手电筒寻找被困在下面的人。

paras.en: The UN said more than 26,000 households had reported damage to shelters or belongings after the weekend’s rainstorms.
paras.zh: 联合国表示，周末暴雨过后，超过 26,000 个家庭报告住所或财物受损。

paras.en: The vast majority of Gaza’s population of 2.3 million live in tent encampments or the ruins of bombed-out buildings, with reconstruction yet to begin after Israel’s relentless two-year military assault launched after the Hamas attacks on southern Israel in October 2023.
paras.zh: 加沙 230 万人口中的绝大多数居住在帐篷营地或被炸毁的建筑物废墟中，2023 年 10 月哈马斯袭击以色列南部后，以色列发动了为期两年的无情军事进攻，重建工作尚未开始。

paras.en: “The collapse [this weekend] was waiting to happen. [Gaza] is extremely overcrowded. People are just trying to find a place wherever,” said Toby Fricker, a spokesperson for Unicef, which has been working to prevent similar tragedies and improve drainage in camps for displaced people.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会发言人托比·弗里克（Toby Fricker）表示：“（本周末）崩溃即将发生。（加沙）极度拥挤。人们只是想在任何地方找到一个地方。”联合国儿童基金会一直致力于防止类似悲剧发生，并改善流离失所者营地的排水系统。

paras.en: In a statement, the Hamas-run government media office said about “70,000 tents sheltering tens of thousands of displaced people were flooded on the first day” of rains. It also noted the “collapse of dozens of cracked walls and roofs, which caused injuries”, some critical, in various areas of the tiny territory.
paras.zh: 哈马斯管理的政府媒体办公室在一份声明中表示，“在降雨的第一天”，大约“7万个为数万名流离失所者提供庇护的帐篷就被淹没了”。报告还指出，在这片狭小的领土的不同地区，“数十处破裂的墙壁和屋顶倒塌，造成人员受伤”，其中一些人伤势严重。

paras.en: A US-brokered ceasefire last year called for the eventual reconstruction of Gaza, but little progress has been made. Negotiators have failed to agree on terms for Hamas to disarm or for Israel to withdraw its troops, which control about two-thirds of the territory from which residents have been ordered to leave.
paras.zh: 去年在美国斡旋下达成的停火协议要求最终重建加沙，但进展甚微。谈判人员未能就哈马斯解除武装或以色列撤军的条款达成一致。以色列控制着约三分之二的领土，居民被勒令撤离。

paras.en: Israel says no reconstruction can happen before Hamas is disarmed.
paras.zh: 以色列表示，在哈马斯解除武装之前，重建不可能进行。

paras.en: Sahhar said he and his family were now homeless. “My tent and everything I own are now buried under the sand. My mattress, household utensils and all my belongings – everything was buried. I could not retrieve anything,” he said.
paras.zh: 萨哈尔说，他和他的家人现在无家可归。 “我的帐篷和我拥有的所有东西现在都被埋在沙子下。我的床垫、家庭用具和我所有的物品——一切都被埋了。我无法取回任何东西，”他说。

paras.en: Mustafa Qazzaat, a member of the Gaza City council, said Israel had not allowed prefabricated homes to shelter the displaced since the truce was announced, and only permitted the entry of limited numbers of tents.
paras.zh: 加沙市议会成员穆斯塔法·卡扎特表示，自宣布停战以来，以色列不允许使用预制房屋来安置流离失所者，只允许有限数量的帐篷进入。

paras.en: Many so-called “dual use” items remain restricted, such as metal tent poles. Humanitarian workers said they instead had used wooden poles fashioned from palettes used to transport food.
paras.zh: 许多所谓的“双重用途”物品仍然受到限制，例如金属帐篷杆。人道主义工作人员表示，他们改用用调色板制成的木杆来运输食物。

paras.en: Cogat, the Israeli defence ministry body that oversees aid to Gaza, said more than 91,000 tents and over 8,200 trucks containing tarpaulins, blankets and winter clothing had reached Gaza, as well as convoys carrying supplies of fuel and engine oil to power pumping facilities and other humanitarian installations.
paras.zh: 负责监督对加沙援助的以色列国防部机构 Cogat 表示，超过 91,000 个帐篷和超过 8,200 辆载有防水布、毯子和冬衣的卡车已抵达加沙，还有运输燃料和机油供应的车队，为抽水设施和其他人道主义设施提供动力。

paras.en: Earlier this year, an assessment compiled by shelter specialists in Gaza revealed that thousands of tents supplied by China, Egypt and Saudi Arabia to shelter displaced Palestinians offered only limited protection against rain and wind.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，加沙庇护所专家编制的一项评估显示，中国、埃及和沙特阿拉伯为流离失所的巴勒斯坦人提供的数千顶帐篷只能提供有限的防风雨保护。

articles.title: Cyber-attack on French supermarket freezers has geopolitical context
articles.author: Dan Milmo Global technology editor

paras.en: In 2023 a state-backed group interrupted TV streaming services in the United Arab Emirates to broadcast a deepfake report on the war in Gaza. In the same year, hackers affiliated with Iran displayed the slogan “down with Israel” on the screens of water-control equipment made by an Israeli firm.
paras.zh: 2023 年，一个国家支持的组织中断了阿拉伯联合酋长国的电视流媒体服务，播放有关加沙战争的深度伪造报道。同年，与伊朗有关的黑客在一家以色列公司制造的水控制设备的屏幕上显示了“打倒以色列”的口号。

paras.en: Now France has attributed an attack on supermarket fridges to hackers operating under the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, a key branch of Iran’s military establishment.
paras.zh: 现在，法国将对超市冰箱的攻击归咎于伊斯兰革命卫队下属的黑客，该部队是伊朗军事机构的一个重要分支。

paras.en: There was no message this time, but the disruption made headlines around the world. Some refrigerators had their temperature turned up so high they caught fire. In the hours after the hack, supermarket employees dumped piles of perished meat and melted ice-cream into rubbish containers.
paras.zh: 这次没有任何消息，但这次中断成为了世界各地的头条新闻。一些冰箱温度过高甚至起火。黑客攻击发生后的几个小时内，超市员工将成堆的腐烂肉类和融化的冰淇淋倒入垃圾箱。

paras.en: France’s foreign minister described it as an act of “unprecedented scale and unprecedented aggression” and promised “Europe-wide sanctions” would be imposed against those responsible.
paras.zh: 法国外交部长称这是“前所未有的规模和前所未有的侵略行为”，并承诺将对责任人实施“全欧洲制裁”。

paras.en: It follows attacks on industrial freezers at an Israeli food production plant in May and a wave of freezer malfunctions that spoiled food at US military bases in August that are now reportedly being treated as a suspected hack. Those attacks have not been officially attributed to Iran, but the French announcement is the first to implicate the state in this type of hack.
paras.zh: 此前，以色列一家食品生产工厂的工业冰柜于 5 月份遭到袭击，美国军事基地的食品于 8 月份发生了一波冰柜故障，导致食品变质，据报道，这些故障目前被视为可疑的黑客攻击。这些攻击尚未正式归咎于伊朗，但法国的声明是第一个暗示该国参与此类黑客攻击的声明。

paras.en: Rafe Pilling, a senior director at Sophos, a cybersecurity firm, said the relatively unsophisticated nature of the attack – hackers used default passwords to access fridge controls – was in line with Iranian capabilities. “The attacks themselves were not particularly complex,” he said.
paras.zh: 网络安全公司 Sophos 的高级总监拉夫·皮林 (Rafe Pilling) 表示，这次攻击的相对简单性——黑客使用默认密码访问冰箱控制——符合伊朗的能力。 “攻击本身并不是特别复杂，”他说。

paras.en: Pilling said there was now a presumption the French attacks and a wave of rogue defrosting hacks across Europe last week were linked.
paras.zh: 皮林表示，现在人们认为法国的袭击与上周欧洲各地的一波流氓解冻黑客活动有关。

paras.en: Hostile cyber operations against the west tend to come from a vexatious quartet of China, Russia, Iran and North Korea. All have different aims and characteristics: China has focused on industrial espionage and mass data gathering, Russia on disrupting enemy infrastructure and spreading disinformation, and North Korea on hacking crypto exchanges because it needs money. Iran, according to Pilling, wants to put a shot across the bow of its enemies.
paras.zh: 针对西方的敌对网络行动往往来自中国、俄罗斯、伊朗和朝鲜这四个无理取闹的国家。它们都有不同的目标和特点：中国专注于工业间谍活动和大规模数据收集，俄罗斯专注于破坏敌方基础设施和传播虚假信息，朝鲜则专注于黑客加密货币交易所，因为它需要资金。皮林表示，伊朗想要向敌人开一枪。

paras.en: “In general Iran uses cyber-attacks to project power internationally and to signal their political displeasure with regional and international adversaries,” Pilling said.
paras.zh: 皮林说：“总的来说，伊朗利用网络攻击在国际上投射力量，并表达他们对地区和国际对手的政治不满。”

paras.en: The fridge hacks came as the UK’s national cybersecurity centre warned the country is in the “foothills” of a new level of cyber threat – and should expect a “huge rise” in the volume of incidents. The main concern is AI, a technology now capable of highlighting previously unforeseen flaws in IT systems and helping attackers plan and carry out attacks.
paras.zh: 冰箱黑客事件发生之际，英国国家网络安全中心警告称，该国正处于新一轮网络威胁的“山麓”，预计事件数量将“大幅上升”。主要关注的是人工智能，这项技术现在能够突出 IT 系统中以前无法预见的缺陷，并帮助攻击者计划和实施攻击。

paras.en: However, the underlying context of the fridge attacks is not AI but geopolitics. After all, the refrigeration system vulnerabilities were relatively easy to find and exploit. But a combination of groundbreaking technology and tense global relations makes for an alarming landscape.
paras.zh: 然而，冰箱攻击的根本背景不是人工智能，而是地缘政治。毕竟，制冷系统的漏洞相对容易发现和利用。但突破性的技术和紧张的全球关系相结合，造成了令人震惊的局面。

articles.title: Republican congressman to force impeachment vote on Defence Secretary Hegseth

paras.en: A Republican congressman plans to force a vote in the House of Representatives this week to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, alleging he has violated the US Constitution.
paras.zh: 一名共和党国会议员计划本周在众议院强制投票弹劾国防部长皮特·赫格斯，指控他违反了美国宪法。

paras.en: "By engaging in hostilities in Iran for more than 90 days without congressional authorization, Secretary Hegseth is breaking the law and must be held accountable," Representative Thomas Massie said.
paras.zh: 众议员托马斯·马西表示：“赫格塞斯部长在未经国会授权的情况下在伊朗进行了超过 90 天的敌对行动，这违反了法律，必须承担责任。”

paras.en: The effort will likely fail, given Republicans will remain in power in Congress until January. But Massie says he wants to push President Donald Trump to fire Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process.
paras.zh: 鉴于共和党将在国会继续掌权直到明年一月，这一努力可能会失败。但马西表示，他希望在民主党启动自己的弹劾程序之前推动唐纳德·特朗普总统解雇赫格塞斯。

paras.en: Hegseth, who will hold a news conference on Tuesday about Massie's move, said he was not concerned.
paras.zh: 赫格斯将于周二就马西的举动举行新闻发布会，他表示他并不担心。

paras.en: Massie formally introduced the articles of impeachment in a resolution on the House floor on Monday afternoon.
paras.zh: 马西周一下午在众议院决议中正式提出了弹劾条款。

paras.en: "I'm doing this because it's the right thing to do," he told reporters after introducing the articles.
paras.zh: “我这样做是因为这是正确的做法，”他在介绍这些文章后告诉记者。

paras.en: When asked by reporters about the impending resolution earlier on Monday, Hegseth said: "We're not worried about that."
paras.zh: 周一早些时候，当记者问及即将出台的决议时，赫格斯表示：“我们对此并不担心。”

paras.en: He added he would hold a news conference Tuesday morning "on that very topic". Hegseth's last news conference was in May.
paras.zh: 他补充说，他将在周二上午“就这个话题”举行新闻发布会。赫格斯的最后一次新闻发布会是在五月份。

paras.en: Massie, who lost re-election earlier this year, has been critical of Trump and the war in Iran since it started nearly nine months ago. He is known for also pushing the administration to release federal files on the deceased sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候失去连任的马西自近九个月前开始以来一直对特朗普和伊朗战争持批评态度。他还因推动政府公布已故性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的联邦文件而闻名。

paras.en: The Kentucky congressman first introduced impeachment articles in September and has now brought them back in the wake of Republicans losing control of both the House and Senate in last week's midterm elections. He has said his push to rid the administration of Hegseth is meant to prevent a Democrat spectacle next year.
paras.zh: 这位肯塔基州国会议员于 9 月份首次提出弹劾条款，在共和党在上周的中期选举中失去众议院和参议院的控制权后，现在又重新提出了弹劾条款。他曾表示，他推动摆脱赫格塞斯政府的目的是为了防止明年出现民主党的大场面。

paras.en: "My effort to impeach Secretary Hegseth is a much gentler version of what's coming when the Democrats assume control of the House and Senate next year," Massie also said in a statement. "They will hold hearings and trials."
paras.zh: 马西还在一份声明中表示：“我弹劾赫格斯国务卿的努力，与民主党明年控制参众两院时的情况相比，是一个温和得多的版本。” “他们将举行听证会和审判。”

paras.en: "President Trump should replace Secretary Hegseth now while he can still get a replacement confirmed in the Senate," he also said.
paras.zh: 他还表示：“特朗普总统现在应该更换国务卿赫格塞斯，同时他仍然可以在参议院确认继任者。”

paras.en: Impeaching a cabinet secretary is rare. The impeachment must be approved by both chambers for the secretary to be removed from office. As with the presidential process, the House would first hold a vote on charges against Hegseth and the Senate then would conduct a trial to decide whether to acquit or convict.
paras.zh: 弹劾内阁秘书的情况很少见。弹劾必须得到参众两院的批准，国务卿才能被免职。与总统程序一样，众议院首先对赫格塞斯的指控进行投票，然后参议院进行审判，决定是否无罪或有罪。

paras.en: The House has voted to impeach only two cabinet members in US history, but the Senate did not convict either one.
paras.zh: 美国历史上众议院仅投票弹劾了两名内阁成员，但参议院并未对其中任何一人定罪。

paras.en: While impeachment has been "an incredibly rare process", it has become far more common since the House impeached President Bill Clinton in 1998, said Paul Gowder, a law professor at Northwestern University in Chicago. Trump was impeached by the House twice.
paras.zh: 芝加哥西北大学法学教授保罗·高德 (Paul Gowder) 表示，虽然弹劾是“极其罕见的过程”，但自 1998 年众议院弹劾总统比尔·克林顿以来，弹劾变得更加普遍。特朗普曾两次被众议院弹劾。

paras.en: "Impeachment has become much more common as the country has become more politically polarised," he said, predicting several more of Trump's cabinet members may face impeachment.
paras.zh: 他说：“随着国家政治两极分化加剧，弹劾变得更加普遍。”他预测特朗普的几名内阁成员可能会面临弹劾。

paras.en: Now Massie has introduced his resolution, Speaker of the House Mike Johnson must schedule a time to consider it within two days. Lawmakers could vote on the resolution directly, or vote to refer it to committee or to set it aside.
paras.zh: 现在马西已经提出了他的决议，众议院议长迈克·约翰逊必须在两天内安排时间进行考虑。立法者可以直接对该决议进行投票，也可以投票将其提交给委员会或将其搁置。

paras.en: Massie will likely have the support of House Democrats, with that party's leader, Hakeem Jeffries, saying on Sunday that he is a "hard yes" on impeachment, but may not be able to bring Republicans to his side.
paras.zh: 马西可能会得到众议院民主党人的支持，该党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯周日表示，他在弹劾问题上“强硬同意”，但可能无法让共和党人站在他一边。

paras.en: Massie told reporters he was not sure if the measure had sufficient backing to pass.
paras.zh: 马西告诉记者，他不确定这项措施是否有足够的支持来通过。

paras.en: Peter Loge, a professor of public affairs at George Washington University, told the BBC that the impeachment measure is "likely to pass the House because the Republican majority is so slim".
paras.zh: 乔治华盛顿大学公共事务教授彼得·洛格告诉英国广播公司，弹劾措施“很可能在众议院获得通过，因为共和党的多数席位太少了”。

paras.en: "And there are enough angry Republicans that more than enough Republicans are gonna simply not show up to vote," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充道：“愤怒的共和党人已经够多了，以至于有足够多的共和党人根本不会去投票。”

paras.en: Currently, there are 218 Republicans and 214 Democrats in the House.
paras.zh: 目前，众议院有218名共和党人和214名民主党人。

paras.en: The Senate requires a two-thirds vote to convict, a threshold that is hard to meet in the current congressional term. When the Democrats take over in January, they still will not have enough seats to convict Hegseth without Republican support.
paras.zh: 参议院需要三分之二的票数才能定罪，这一门槛在本届国会任期内很难达到。当民主党一月份上台时，如果没有共和党的支持，他们仍然没有足够的席位来对赫格塞斯定罪。

paras.en: In the articles, Massie also accused Hegseth of intimidating critics of the Trump administration, kidnapping foreign leaders and ignoring congressional War Powers resolutions.
paras.zh: 在文章中，马西还指责赫格斯恐吓特朗普政府的批评者、绑架外国领导人并无视国会的战争权力决议。

paras.en: The House has passed a War Powers resolution - a measure seeking to halt Trump from taking further military action in Iran - multiple times this year, with Massie's support. The Senate also passed a War Powers resolution over the summer.
paras.zh: 在马西的支持下，众议院今年多次通过了一项战争权力决议，该决议旨在阻止特朗普对伊朗采取进一步的军事行动。参议院还在今年夏天通过了一项战争权力决议。

paras.en: Gowder said that if Hegseth were to leave today, the current Republican-led Senate could be able to approve a replacement before the new term begins. The Democrats plan to "pick their battles", and would likely approve "somebody reasonable", he said.
paras.zh: 高德表示，如果赫格斯今天离开，现任共和党领导的参议院可能能够在新任期开始前批准继任者。他说，民主党计划“选择战斗”，并可能会批准“合理的人”。

paras.en: But the question is whether Trump would choose a "qualified candidate" who is "minimally acceptable to Democrats", he added.
paras.zh: 但问题是特朗普是否会选择一位“民主党最低限度可以接受”的“合格候选人”，他补充道。

paras.en: Loge said the chances that Hegseth would survive until the end of Trump's term are "pretty slim", but he expected Hegseth to be ousted instead of impeached.
paras.zh: Loge表示， Hegseth在特朗普任期结束前存活的机会“相当渺茫” ，但他预计Hegseth将被驱逐而不是弹劾。

paras.en: "Secretary Hegseth is a big personality, and I'm not sure I'd want to be a big personality that's drawing attention from President Trump these days," Loge said. "That's not a way to guarantee job security."
paras.zh: 洛格说：“赫格斯国务卿是一位大人物，我不确定我是否想成为一位最近引起特朗普总统注意的大人物。” “这不是保证工作保障的方法。”

articles.title: Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond

paras.en: The tech world has spent the day digesting the extraordinary news that Jensen Huang - the charismatic, leather-jacket wearing chief executive of the multi-trillion dollar firm Nvidia - is being investigated by his own company over an extramarital affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 科技界花了一整天的时间来消化这一令人震惊的消息：身着数万亿美元公司英伟达 (Nvidia) 的首席执行官、魅力超凡、身穿皮夹克的黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 因与一名被指控为中国间谍的女性发生婚外情而受到自己公司的调查。

paras.en: None of us had that on our bingo cards for 2026.
paras.zh: 我们中没有人在 2026 年的宾果卡上有这样的内容。

paras.en: Huang's alleged romantic affair with Alice Huang (no relation), the former CEO of a Singapore-based data centre company, has cast ripples far beyond his immediate family - undoubtedly on an emotional rollercoaster of their own - taking us to a crossroads at which technology, geopolitics and national security intersect.
paras.zh: 黄与一家新加坡数据中心公司前首席执行官 Alice Huang（无亲属关系）涉嫌恋情，其影响远远超出了他的直系亲属的范围，毫无疑问，他们的情绪就像坐过山车一样，将我们带到了技术、地缘政治和国家安全交叉的十字路口。

paras.en: In a nutshell, this is about the bitter rivalry between the US and China, as well as whether Jensen Huang has betrayed the US as well as his wife.
paras.zh: 简而言之，这是一个关于中美之间的激烈竞争，以及黄仁勋是否背叛了美国以及他的妻子的问题。

paras.en: The US is locked in a fierce race with China to develop the best AI models.
paras.zh: 美国正与中国展开激烈的竞争，以开发最好的人工智能模型。

paras.en: "Whoever wins AI, wins," as US President Donald Trump puts it. He thinks that the country with the more dominant AI technology will benefit the most from it and, ultimately, will be the most powerful in the world. He may well be right.
paras.zh: 正如美国总统唐纳德·特朗普所说，“谁赢得了人工智能，谁就获胜了”。他认为，人工智能技术占据主导地位的国家将从中受益最多，并最终成为世界上最强大的国家。他很可能是对的。

paras.en: Nvidia happens to make the best chips in the business for AI â so much so that it has been overwhelmed with demand.
paras.zh: 英伟达恰好生产了人工智能领域最好的芯片——以至于它已经被需求淹没了。

paras.en: It sets its prices accordingly: a single unit of the firm's latest kit for data centres starts at Â£37,000 ($50,000). A medium or large site might have hundreds of them.
paras.zh: 它相应地设定了价格：该公司最新的数据中心套件的单个单元起价为 37,000 英镑（50,000 美元）。一个中型或大型网站可能有数百个。

paras.en: The US administration initially slapped an export ban on Nvidia's more recent devices to prevent China from taking advantage of their superior capabilities. It has since softened the rules a little.
paras.zh: 美国政府最初对英伟达最新的设备实施了出口禁令，以阻止中国利用其优越的能力。此后，它稍微软化了规则。

paras.en: But there are suggestions that Alice Huang's company, Megaspeed, may have been involved in sneaking them into the country while she was in charge. Bloomberg reported that the firm bought billions of dollars worth of Nvidia tech in November 2025. Megaspeed denies that it was used illegitimately.
paras.zh: 但有迹象表明，Alice Huang 的公司 Megaspeed 可能在她负责期间参与了将他们偷偷带入该国的活动。彭博社报道称，该公司于 2025 年 11 月购买了价值数十亿美元的 Nvidia 技术。Megaspeed 否认其被非法使用。

paras.en: For his part, Jensen Huang has lobbied heavily for the export rules between the two countries to be relaxed, arguing against the weight of general opinion that the AI race doesn't matter and that it would be no bad thing for China to become dependent on US tech.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋则大力游说，要求放宽两国之间的出口规则，他反对普遍认为人工智能竞赛并不重要、中国依赖美国技术并不是坏事的观点。

paras.en: "President Trump wants American to win and President Xi wants China to win, and it's possible for both of them to do so," he told the BBC last year.
paras.zh: “特朗普总统希望美国获胜，习主席希望中国获胜，他们都有可能做到这一点，”他去年告诉英国广播公司。

paras.en: It think it's safe to assume that neither country sees it that way.
paras.zh: 它认为可以有把握地假设这两个国家都不这么看。

paras.en: The difficult questions Nvidia now has to try to answer include whether Alice gained special access to the firm's latest technology, either deliberately or not, via Jensen - and, if so, whether she shared it with Beijing or others.
paras.zh: 英伟达现在必须尝试回答的难题包括爱丽丝是否有意或无意地通过詹森获得了对该公司最新技术的特殊访问权，如果是这样，她是否与北京或其他人分享了该技术。

paras.en: We don't know when their affair began or ended, but there are numerous photos and videos of Jensen and Alice together at events. It is feasible that there were moments when they spent quite a lot of time together and Jensen has talked about always having an eye on his work.
paras.zh: 我们不知道他们的恋情何时开始或结束，但有大量詹森和爱丽丝在活动中在一起的照片和视频。有可能他们花了很多时间在一起，詹森谈到总是关注他的工作。

paras.en: China denies that she was engaged in espionage.
paras.zh: 中国否认她从事间谍活动。

paras.en: Interest in economic espionage is neither new nor unique to China. But many Western countries say that China does it on a grand scale, using a combination of technology tools and agents embedded in various organisations - including private companies.
paras.zh: 对经济间谍活动的兴趣对于中国来说既不新鲜也不独特。但许多西方国家表示，中国的做法规模宏大，结合了技术工具和嵌入各种组织（包括私营公司）的代理。

paras.en: China having access to significant enough numbers of Nvidia's chips to make use of them, or stripping them down and learning how to make its own versions, would infuriate the Trump administration, which is trying to keep its AI technology close to its chest.
paras.zh: 中国获得足够数量的英伟达芯片来使用它们，或者将它们剥离并学习如何制造自己的版本，都会激怒特朗普政府，后者正试图将其人工智能技术放在心上。

paras.en: Some models have even been withheld from the UK-based AI Safety Institute on the grounds that they are potentially too dangerous to be shared. The US does not want anyone having a headstart or misusing its innovations.
paras.zh: 一些模型甚至被英国人工智能安全研究所扣留，因为它们可能太危险而无法共享。美国不希望任何人抢占先机或滥用其创新成果。

paras.en: Another potential bombshell lies in the form of any national security information to which Jensen Huang may have been privy.
paras.zh: 另一个潜在的重磅炸弹是黄仁勋可能了解的任何国家安全信息。

paras.en: He is a man operating at the very top of the US elite - one of a handful of people who could probably walk into the White House unannounced and have tea with Trump. He has influence, he has access and he has powerful friends. It's quite possible that secrets were shared with him.
paras.zh: 他是美国精英中的最高层人物，也是极少数可能未经事先通知就走进白宫并与特朗普喝茶的人之一。他有影响力，有渠道，也有有权势的朋友。很有可能与他分享了秘密。

paras.en: Nvidia says there's no evidence so far that he passed anything on and the firm has launched an internal investigation. Huang says he will co-operate and wants to keep his job - though if nothing else, he has broken Nvidia's own code of conduct, which states that company members should not have relationships with clients.
paras.zh: 英伟达表示，到目前为止，没有证据表明他传递了任何信息，该公司已启动内部调查。黄说他会合作并希望保住自己的工作——尽管如果不出意外的话，他已经违反了英伟达自己的行为准则，该准则规定公司成员不应与客户建立关系。

paras.en: At present, he has the backing of both the Nvidia board and Trump, who described him as "honourable" and speculated that there must have been a reason for what had transpired. In other words, he's not throwing his tech boss buddy under the bus.
paras.zh: 目前，他得到了英伟达董事会和特朗普的支持，特朗普称他为“光荣的”，并推测所发生的事情一定是有原因的。换句话说，他并没有把他的技术老板伙伴扔到公共汽车下面。

paras.en: Nvidia's share price has fallen but has not tanked spectacularly, suggesting shareholders are not abandoning the company under his stewardship in their droves either.
paras.zh: 英伟达的股价有所下跌，但并未大幅下跌，这表明股东也没有大批放弃他管理下的公司。

paras.en: An AI industry with a weakened Nvidia would undoubtedly be a slower one.
paras.zh: 英伟达实力减弱的人工智能行业无疑会发展得更慢。

paras.en: And there isn't really a natural successor waiting in the wings to replace Jensen were he forced out.
paras.zh: 如果詹森被迫离开，并没有真正的自然接班人在等待接替他。

paras.en: Huang has run Nvidia for more than 30 years - to many, he is Nvidia. He has steered it through multiple crises and it was his decision for the firm to focus on AI before it was trendy.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋执掌 Nvidia 已超过 30 年——对很多人来说，他就是 Nvidia。他带领公司度过了多次危机，在人工智能流行之前，他决定让公司专注于人工智能。

paras.en: He is known to be a demanding boss who expects staff to work long hours and to high standards. There are stories about him calling all-staff meetings to tell off individuals who had made mistakes. He has said this was to prevent others making the same errors â but you can only imagine how it felt for those on the receiving end.
paras.zh: 众所周知，他是一位要求严格的老板，希望员工长时间工作并达到高标准。有传言称，他召开全体员工会议，责备犯过错误的人。他说这是为了防止其他人犯同样的错误——但你只能想象那些接收端的人的感受。

paras.en: While he awaits the conclusion of the investigation into his actions, Huang must hope that, despite not tolerating the mistakes of his colleagues in the past, they will be gracious about his own failings.
paras.zh: 在等待对其行为的调查得出结论的同时，黄必须希望，尽管他不容忍同事过去的错误，但他们会对他自己的失败有仁慈的态度。

paras.en: And he must also live with the irony that he was potentially caught out not by a sophisticated high-tech sting, but by the oldest trick in the book: a honey trap.
paras.zh: 而且他还必须忍受一个讽刺：他可能不是被复杂的高科技诱骗，而是被书中最古老的伎俩抓住了：美人计。

articles.title: Judge denies motion to dismiss Lindsay Clancy's murder case

paras.en: A Massachusetts judge has denied a motion to dismiss the murder case against Lindsay Clancy, the US woman accused of murdering her three children.
paras.zh: 马萨诸塞州一名法官驳回了一项驳回针对林赛·克兰西谋杀案的动议，林赛·克兰西是被指控谋杀其三个孩子的美国妇女。

paras.en: The judge's ruling follows her defence team's request to dismiss the case after the 12-person jury in her September trial failed to reach a veridict.
paras.zh: 法官做出这一裁决之前，她的辩护团队在 12 人陪审团在 9 ​​月份的审判中未能做出裁决后，要求驳回此案。

paras.en: The ruling clears the way for prosecutors to pursue the case. They could reduce the charges in a potential second trial or dismiss them altogether.
paras.zh: 该裁决为检察官追查此案扫清了道路。他们可以在可能的第二次审判中减少指控或完全驳回指控。

paras.en: Clancy has not denied killing her children in 2023, but her defence team argues she was suffering from severe postpartum psychosis at the time. Prosecutors say the killings were intentional.
paras.zh: 克兰西并未否认在 2023 年杀害了她的孩子，但她的辩护团队称她当时患有严重的产后精神病。检察官称，这些杀人事件是故意的。

paras.en: Clancy's defence team argued to dismiss the case against her due to double jeopardy - a legal standard that prevents a person from being tried for the same crime twice.
paras.zh: 克兰西的辩护团队以双重危险为由驳回对她的诉讼——这是一项法律标准，可以防止一个人因同一罪行两次受审。

paras.en: Her lawyers argued that Judge William Sullivan, who presided over the 26-day jury trial last summer, acted prematurely when he declared a mistrial on 4 September, saying that he should have sought a viable alternative.
paras.zh: 她的律师辩称，去年夏天主持了为期 26 天陪审团审判的威廉·沙利文法官在 9 月 4 日宣布审判无效时采取了过早的行动，并表示他应该寻求可行的替代方案。

paras.en: The five-week trial, its lead-up and aftermath gripped Americans, and put postpartum mental health issues such as psychosis in the spotlight.
paras.zh: 为期五周的试验及其前期和后续影响吸引了美国人，并使精神病等产后心理健康问题成为人们关注的焦点。

paras.en: In his ruling on Monday, Sullivan said that a retrial would not unconstitutionally subject Clancy to double jeopardy, according to court documents obtained by the BBC.
paras.zh: 根据英国广播公司获得的法庭文件，沙利文在周一的裁决中表示，重审不会违宪地使克兰西面临双重危险。

paras.en: "Although a mistrial may be expensive in both human and monetary costs, it is not to be avoided by intrusion into the jury's domain," he wrote.
paras.zh: 他写道：“尽管审判无效可能会造成高昂的人力和金钱成本，但侵入陪审团的管辖范围并不能避免这种情况。”

paras.en: The possibility that "an unreasonably stubborn or eccentric juror" could be seated is "an unavoidable risk of the jury system", he said.
paras.zh: 他说，“陪审员制度中不可避免的风险”是“一个不合理的顽固或古怪的陪审员”的可能性。

paras.en: "Because the court concludes that there was manifest necessity for a mistrial based on the jury's deadlock, a retrial on the murder indictments does not violate Clancy's right not to be placed in double jeopardy."
paras.zh: “由于法院根据陪审团的僵局得出结论，显然有必要进行误审，因此对谋杀起诉书进行重审并不侵犯克兰西不陷入双重危险的权利。”

paras.en: Sullivan also denied a defence motion to see records of the lone holdout juror in the case and to question the juror under oath.
paras.zh: 沙利文还拒绝了辩方提出的要求查看该案中唯一坚持不懈的陪审员记录并在宣誓下质询该陪审员的动议。

paras.en: He said the defence failed to demonstrate that the records are needed for Clancy's defence at any retrial, and that questioning the juror "would have been impermissibly coercive".
paras.zh: 他说辩方未能证明克兰西在任何重审中的辩护都需要这些记录，并且质疑陪审员“将是不允许的强制行为”。

paras.en: The judge scheduled a hearing for 16 November to discuss scheduling a potential second trial. He previously suggested it could begin in March.
paras.zh: 法官安排于 11 月 16 日举行听证会，讨论安排可能的二审。他此前建议可能从三月份开始。

paras.en: The BBC has contacted Clancy's lawyers for comment.
paras.zh: BBC 已联系克兰西的律师征求意见。

articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?

The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.

Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.

It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
- Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.

- Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
- Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.

It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?

The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants

Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil

Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.

High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.

Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities

Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions

In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.

Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery

Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
- Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
- Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
- Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.

To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.

articles.title: NHTSA to update tire safety standards, seeking public comment
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) plans to modernize its tire safety standards, calling it the first major overhaul in more than 20 years.
The goal is to encourage the adoption of new technologies, enhance driver safety, and lower automotive costs, a NHTSA press release states.

A rulemaking notice listed on the Federal Register states that NHTSA plans to form a Negotiated Rulemaking Advisory Committee for Tire Safety to “advise the Secretary [of Transportation] on tire safety matters through a negotiated rulemaking process.”
The updates focus on modernizing safety tests and evaluating new technologies.

“For tire testing, committee discussions would focus on the continued necessity and effectiveness of the tire strength test (plunger energy), the bead unseating resistance test, and the tire endurance test (chunking),” the notice states. “For other tire-related issues, the committee would evaluate broader regulatory topics, including the incorporation of non-pneumatic tires, modernization of tire markings, and a specific petition from the Tire and Rim Association (TRA) regarding the inclusion of Load Range F light truck tires in FMVSS No. 139.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: NHTSA says outdated tire strength, rim resistance, and endurance tests will be updated to align with current road conditions and modern tire technology.

“As American tire technology and vehicle design continue to evolve, our regulatory framework must keep pace,” said NHTSA Administrator Jonathan Morrison in the release. “By bringing key industry stakeholders and other technical safety experts to the same table, we can modernize outdated standards to boost safety and reduce costs for you and your family.”
NHTSA also plans to set safety rules for new designs like puncture-proof tires, modernize tire sidewall markings, and review truck and SUV weight limit guidelines.

“To accelerate updating federal tire standards, NHTSA is using a negotiated rulemaking — consulting experts early to streamline the process,” the release states. “U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy will appoint up to 18 stakeholders across tire manufacturers, automakers, safety organizations, research institutions, and engineering associations.”
NHTSA asks the public to comment on the committee scope and membership. It has also requested formal nominations of committee members.
According to the notice, the deadline to comment and apply for committee membership is Nov. 27.
Comments can be submitted at regulations.gov under Docket No. NHTSA-2026-1717. Membership applications should be emailed to [email protected].
NHTSA also plans to modernize its outdated vehicle lighting standards, saying it will update the “long overdue” Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard No. 108.
