articles.title: A little-known protein could be a major culprit in type 2 diabetes

paras.en: A little-known protein could be a major culprit in type 2 diabetes
paras.zh: 一种鲜为人知的蛋白质可能是 2 型糖尿病的罪魁祸首

paras.en: - Scientists have discovered that a buildup of a protein called Miro1 may be a hidden driver of insulin resistance in Type 2 diabetes, with preclinical experiments showing that removing it restores the musclesâ response to insulin. Exercise was also found to lower Miro1 levels in people with diabetes, revealing a potential new pathway for treating the disease.
paras.zh: - 科学家发现，一种名为 Miro1 的蛋白质的积累可能是 2 型糖尿病中胰岛素抵抗的隐藏驱动因素，临床前实验表明，去除它可以恢复肌肉对胰岛素的反应。研究还发现，运动可以降低糖尿病患者的 Miro1 水平，这揭示了治疗该疾病的潜在新途径。

paras.en: Researchers have identified a protein that may play an important role in Type 2 diabetes by interfering with the body's ability to respond to insulin. The discovery could provide a promising new target for treatments designed to improve blood sugar control.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现了一种蛋白质，它可能通过干扰人体对胰岛素的反应能力而在 2 型糖尿病中发挥重要作用。这一发现可能为旨在改善血糖控制的治疗提供一个有希望的新目标。

paras.en: The protein, known as Miro1, was found at higher levels in the skeletal muscles of people with Type 2 diabetes. In preclinical experiments, scientists discovered that removing Miro1 restored the muscles' response to insulin. They also found that exercise lowered Miro1 levels in people with the disease, offering new insight into how physical activity improves insulin sensitivity.
paras.zh: 这种名为 Miro1 的蛋白质在 2 型糖尿病患者的骨骼肌中含量较高。在临床前实验中，科学家发现去除 Miro1 可以恢复肌肉对胰岛素的反应。他们还发现，运动会降低患有这种疾病的人的 Miro1 水平，这为了解体力活动如何提高胰岛素敏感性提供了新的见解。

paras.en: The findings were published in Nature Communications and could help researchers better understand the biological processes behind insulin resistance, a central feature of Type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: 该研究结果发表在《自然通讯》杂志上，可以帮助研究人员更好地了解胰岛素抵抗（2 型糖尿病的一个核心特征）背后的生物过程。

paras.en: How a Hidden Muscle Protein Affects Insulin Resistance
paras.zh: 隐藏的肌肉蛋白如何影响胰岛素抵抗

paras.en: Miro1 (Mitochondrial Rho GTPase1) is located on the outer membrane of mitochondria, the tiny structures inside cells responsible for producing energy. Researchers believe that excessive amounts of this protein may interfere with how muscles respond to insulin, making it more difficult for the body to regulate blood sugar effectively.
paras.zh: Miro1（线粒体 Rho GTPase1）位于线粒体的外膜上，线粒体是细胞内负责产生能量的微小结构。研究人员认为，过量的这种蛋白质可能会干扰肌肉对胰岛素的反应，使身体更难以有效地调节血糖。

paras.en: To investigate this connection, the research team studied Miro1 in laboratory cells, preclinical models, and people living with Type 2 diabetes. By examining the protein across these different settings, they were able to explore its effects on muscle function and determine whether the findings could be relevant to human disease.
paras.zh: 为了研究这种联系，研究小组在实验室细胞、临床前模型和 2 型糖尿病患者中研究了 Miro1。通过在这些不同的环境中检查蛋白质，他们能够探索其对肌肉功能的影响，并确定这些发现是否与人类疾病相关。

paras.en: The results showed that Miro1 buildup impaired the muscles' response to insulin. When researchers removed the protein in preclinical models, insulin responsiveness returned, providing evidence that Miro1 contributes directly to this process.
paras.zh: 结果表明，Miro1 的积累损害了肌肉对胰岛素的反应。当研究人员在临床前模型中去除这种蛋白质时，胰岛素反应性又恢复了，这提供了 Miro1 直接参与这一过程的证据。

paras.en: Exercise Reduces a Protein Linked to Type 2 Diabetes
paras.zh: 运动可减少与 2 型糖尿病相关的蛋白质

paras.en: The researchers also investigated whether exercise could influence Miro1 levels in people with diabetes. In a randomized controlled trial involving participants with obesity and Type 2 diabetes, they compared the effects of aerobic exercise with those of standard medical care.
paras.zh: 研究人员还调查了运动是否会影响糖尿病患者的 Miro1 水平。在一项涉及肥胖和 2 型糖尿病参与者的随机对照试验中，他们比较了有氧运动与标准医疗护理的效果。

paras.en: People assigned to the exercise group experienced a decline in Miro1 levels in their muscles. These changes occurred alongside improvements in insulin sensitivity and the muscles' capacity to produce energy.
paras.zh: 分配到运动组的人肌肉中的 Miro1 水平下降。这些变化伴随着胰岛素敏感性和肌肉产生能量的能力的改善而发生。

paras.en: The findings suggest that reducing Miro1 may be one of the ways exercise helps the body respond more effectively to insulin. They also raise the possibility that treatments designed to target the protein could eventually provide additional benefits alongside physical activity.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，减少 Miro1 可能是运动帮助身体更有效地对胰岛素做出反应的方式之一。他们还提出了一种可能性，即针对该蛋白质的治疗最终可以在体育活动的同时提供额外的益处。

paras.en: "Insulin resistance in muscle is at the heart of Type 2 diabetes, and its molecular causes have remained frustratingly unclear. This study, the product of years of work, identifies Miro1 as a key part of the answer. By tracing Miro1 from cells to preclinical models to patients, we show that Miro1 accumulation impairs the muscle's response to insulin, that removing it causally restores that response in our models, and that exercise reverses its buildup in people. For the field, this is a new therapeutic target. For patients, it deepens our understanding of why exercise is so effective and opens a path toward treatments that could one day complement it," said Dr. John P. Kirwan, the study's senior author.
paras.zh: “肌肉中的胰岛素抵抗是 2 型糖尿病的核心，令人沮丧的是，其分子原因仍然不清楚。这项研究是多年工作的成果，将 Miro1 确定为答案的关键部分。通过追踪 Miro1 从细胞到临床前模型再到患者，我们发现 Miro1 积累会损害肌肉对胰岛素的反应，去除它会在我们的模型中恢复这种反应，而运动会逆转它在人体中的积累。对于患者来说，它加深了我们对运动为何如此有效的理解，并为有一天可以补充它的治疗开辟了道路，”该研究的资深作者 John P. Kirwan 博士说。

paras.en: A Promising New Direction for Diabetes Treatment
paras.zh: 糖尿病治疗的一个有前途的新方向

paras.en: Kirwan recently became executive director of the OU Health Harold Hamm Diabetes Center at the University of Oklahoma. He carried out the research while working at LSU's Pennington Biomedical Research Center and has since brought his internationally recognized translational research program to the University of Oklahoma.
paras.zh: Kirwan 最近成为俄克拉荷马大学 OU Health Harold Hamm 糖尿病中心的执行主任。他在路易斯安那州立大学彭宁顿生物医学研究中心工作期间进行了这项研究，此后将其国际认可的转化研究项目带到了俄克拉荷马大学。

paras.en: He also serves as Vice Provost for Diabetes Programs at the university and holds the Chickasaw Nation Endowed Chair in Diabetes Research.
paras.zh: 他还担任该大学负责糖尿病项目的副教务长，并担任契卡索国家糖尿病研究主席。

paras.en: The study's first author, Elizabeth Heintz, is a doctoral candidate who worked in the Integrated Physiology and Molecular Medicine Laboratory at Pennington Biomedical. Christopher Axelrod, the study's co-corresponding author, has also moved to the Harold Hamm Diabetes Center, joining Kirwan in continuing this line of research.
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者伊丽莎白·海因茨（Elizabeth Heintz）是一名博士生，曾在彭宁顿生物医学中心的综合生理学和分子医学实验室工作。该研究的共同通讯作者 Christopher Axelrod 也搬到了 Harold Hamm 糖尿病中心，与 Kirwan 一起继续这一领域的研究。

paras.en: Dr. Jennifer Rood, Interim Senior Vice Chancellor and Executive Director of Pennington Biomedical, emphasized the importance of connecting laboratory discoveries with research involving patients and broader populations.
paras.zh: Pennington Biomedical 临时高级副校长兼执行董事 Jennifer Rood 博士强调了将实验室发现与涉及患者和更广泛人群的研究联系起来的重要性。

paras.en: "This research exemplifies the breadth of scientific discovery at Pennington Biomedical, where research spans all levels, from basic science that reveals the biological mechanisms underlying disease to clinical studies and population-based research that informs public health," said Dr. Jennifer Rood, Interim Senior Vice Chancellor and Executive Director of Pennington Biomedical. "Dr. Kirwan and his team's findings on Miro1 demonstrate the value of this integrated approach, connecting fundamental discoveries about muscle function with insights into insulin resistance and the benefits of exercise in people with Type 2 diabetes. This work is advancing our understanding of diabetes and helping lay the foundation for future approaches to prevention and treatment."
paras.zh: 彭宁顿生物医学学院临时高级副校长兼执行董事 Jennifer Rood 博士表示：“这项研究体现了彭宁顿生物医学学院科学发现的广度，该研究涵盖各个层面，从揭示疾病潜在生物学机制的基础科学到为公共卫生提供信息的临床研究和基于人群的研究。” “Kirwan 博士和他的团队对 Miro1 的研究结果证明了这种综合方法的价值，它将有关肌肉功能的基本发现与对胰岛素抵抗的见解以及 2 型糖尿病患者运动的益处联系起来。这项工作正在增进我们对糖尿病的理解，并有助于为未来的预防和治疗方法奠定基础。”

paras.en: Could Targeting Miro1 Lead to New Diabetes Therapies?
paras.zh: 靶向 Miro1 能否带来新的糖尿病疗法？

paras.en: Although the results are encouraging, scientists still need to establish whether directly targeting Miro1 can produce safe and effective treatments for people with Type 2 diabetes. The restoration of insulin responsiveness was demonstrated in preclinical models, while the human trial showed that exercise reduced Miro1 levels alongside improvements in insulin sensitivity.
paras.zh: 尽管结果令人鼓舞，但科学家们仍需要确定直接靶向 Miro1 是否可以为 2 型糖尿病患者提供安全有效的治疗方法。临床前模型证明了胰岛素反应性的恢复，而人体试验表明，运动可降低 Miro1 水平，同时改善胰岛素敏感性。

paras.en: Kirwan plans to continue investigating these findings at the Harold Hamm Diabetes Center. His research will combine laboratory experiments with studies involving people to uncover more of the biological mechanisms responsible for diabetes and explore new strategies for preventing and treating the condition.
paras.zh: 柯万计划继续在哈罗德·哈姆糖尿病中心调查这些发现。他的研究将实验室实验与涉及人体的研究相结合，以揭示更多导致糖尿病的生物机制，并探索预防和治疗该疾病的新策略。

paras.en: "Type 2 diabetes is an affliction in Oklahoma and nationally," he said. "Ultimately, we are looking for cures, and we hope these recent findings could be part of the solution."
paras.zh: “2 型糖尿病是俄克拉荷马州乃至全国的一个难题，”他说。 “最终，我们正在寻找治疗方法，我们希望这些最近的发现能够成为解决方案的一部分。”

paras.en: The study received funding from the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases, the National Institute on Aging, the National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health, the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, and the National Institute of General Medical Sciences.
paras.zh: 该研究获得了国家糖尿病、消化和肾脏疾病研究所、国家老龄化研究所、国家补充和综合健康中心、国家心肺血液研究所和国家普通医学科学研究所的资助。

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 6, 1572: A German astronomer discovers the Tycho supernova with the naked eye, but everyone thought the cosmic explosion was a 'new star'
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 6, 1572, the German astronomer Wolfgang Schulër observed a supernova with his bare eyes. He spotted the exploding star in the constellation Cassiopeia. It was as bright as Venus and could even be seen during the day.
paras.zh: 1572 年 11 月 6 日，德国天文学家沃尔夫冈·舒勒 (Wolfgang Schulër) 肉眼观测到了一颗超新星。他在仙后座发现了这颗爆炸的恒星。它像金星一样明亮，甚至在白天也能看到。

paras.en: Astronomers were really confused, because it looked like a star just appeared out of nowhere. Schulër may have been the first to see it, but the Danish astronomer Tycho Brahe is widely credited for the discovery. Brahe studied it in detail and wrote a whole book about this so-called "new star." It then became known as "Tycho's Star."
paras.zh: 天文学家真的很困惑，因为它看起来就像一颗星星突然出现。舒勒可能是第一个发现它的人，但这一发现被广泛认为是丹麦天文学家第谷·布拉赫 (Tycho Brahe)。布拉赫详细研究了它，并写了一整本书关于这个所谓的“新星”。后来它被称为“第谷之星”。

paras.en: At the time, supernovas had not yet been discovered. Tycho's Star was finally classified as a supernova in the 1940s. Scientists now think it was a small star called a white dwarf that exploded thousands of years ago. Because Tycho's Star is 13,000 light-years from Earth, it took a while before anyone could see it.
paras.zh: 当时，超新星尚未被发现。第谷星最终在 20 世纪 40 年代被归类为超新星。科学家现在认为这是一颗称为白矮星的小恒星，在数千年前爆炸。因为第谷星距离地球 13,000 光年，所以过了一段时间才有人看到它。

paras.en: The Tycho supernova, known technically as SN 1572, is known today as a Type Ia supernova, which is a star explosion in a binary star system in which a white dwarf star draws material away from its partner, then explodes. But in 1572, the Tycho supernova appeared as something very different: a bright new star.
paras.zh: 第谷超新星，技术上称为 SN 1572，今天被称为 Ia 型超新星，这是双星系统中的恒星爆炸，其中一颗白矮星从其伙伴那里吸取物质，然后爆炸。但在 1572 年，第谷超新星以一种截然不同的姿态出现：一颗明亮的新星。

paras.en: While Schulër was first, other astronomers also observed the apparently new star in the sky. Tycho Brahe's numerous observations are the most well known, in no small part becuause he wrote a book all about them in "De Stella Nova" (Latin for "On The New Star." At the time, the prevailing theory among scientists was that the stars were unchanging, yet here was a new star -- a changed sky.
paras.zh: 虽然舒勒是第一个，但其他天文学家也观察到了天空中这颗明显的新星。第谷·布拉赫的众多观察结果最为人所熟知，这在很大程度上是因为他在《De Stella Nova》（拉丁语，意为“论新星”）中写了一本关于这些观察结果的书。当时，科学家们流行的理论是，恒星是不变的，但这里却出现了一颗新星——一片改变了的天空。

paras.en: "The 16th century exploding star, which appeared in the constellation Cassiopeia, was seen in daylight for about two weeks, and remained visible to the naked eye for 16 months," the University of California Berkeley wrote in 2004. "Brahe's meticulous record of the brightening and dimming of the supernova now allows astronomers to identify its 'light signature" as that of a Type Ia supernova."
paras.zh: 加州大学伯克利分校在 2004 年写道：“这颗出现在仙后座的 16 世纪爆炸恒星，在白天可见了大约两周，肉眼可见的时间长达 16 个月。布拉赫对超新星变亮和变暗的细致记录现在使天文学家能够将其‘光特征’识别为 Ia 型超新星。”

paras.en: "This was at the end of the Dark Ages in Europe, and these observations were an important piece of evidence that the heavens were not immutable," astronomer Alex Filippenko, who led a 2004 study on the origins of the Tycho supernova, said at the time.
paras.zh: 天文学家亚历克斯·菲利彭科 (Alex Filippenko) 领导了 2004 年第谷超新星起源研究，他当时表示：“当时正值欧洲黑暗时代末期，这些观测结果是证明天空并非一成不变的重要证据。”

paras.en: Today, astronomers are closely watching another star that might explode. Called T Corona Borealis, or the Blaze Star, the object is expected to be on the verge of exploding in a nova (a star explosion that is smaller than a supernova and may not destroy the star). is one of 11 known stars observed to have recurring nova explosions within gaps of 100 years or so.
paras.zh: 今天，天文学家正在密切关注另一颗可能爆炸的恒星。该物体被称为T Corona Borealis，或火焰星，预计将处于新星爆炸的边缘（比超新星更小的恒星爆炸，可能不会摧毁恒星）。是观测到在 100 年左右的时间间隔内反复发生新星爆炸的 11 颗已知恒星之一。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: SpaceX launches mystery mission for US Space Force in gorgeous sunset liftoff from California (video, photos)
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: SpaceX just launched a classified mission for the U.S. military.
paras.zh: SpaceX 刚刚为美国军方启动了一项机密任务。

paras.en: A Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from California's Vandenberg Space Force Base this evening (Nov. 6) at 7:48 p.m. EST (4:48 p.m. local California time; 0048 GMT on Nov. 7), rising into the sky as the sun sank toward the Pacific.
paras.zh: 今晚（11 月 6 日）晚上 7 点 48 分，一枚猎鹰 9 号火箭从加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地升空。美国东部时间（加利福尼亚州当地时间下午 4:48；格林尼治标准时间 11 月 7 日 0048），随着太阳落入太平洋而升入天空。

paras.en: The launch kicked off the USSF-432 mission for the U.S. Space Force, which we know little about. Neither SpaceX nor the Space Force told us much about USSF-432 beforehand, and we learned tonight; SpaceX cut its webcast off about 10 minutes into the flight, shortly after the Falcon 9's first stage came back to Earth for a landing.
paras.zh: 这次发射拉开了美国太空军 USSF-432 任务的序幕，对此我们知之甚少。 SpaceX 和太空部队事先都没有告诉我们太多有关 USSF-432 的信息，我们今晚才了解到；在猎鹰 9 号第一级返回地球着陆后不久，SpaceX 在飞行约 10 分钟后切断了网络直播。

paras.en: That touchdown occurred aboard the SpaceX droneship "Of Course I Still Love You," which was stationed downrange in the Pacific Ocean. It wrapped up the eighth flight for this particular booster, which is designated 1095.
paras.zh: 这次着陆发生在 SpaceX 无人机“当然我仍然爱你”上，该船驻扎在太平洋的下游。它完成了这个特殊助推器的第八次飞行，该助推器被指定为 1095。

paras.en: The Falcon 9's upper stage, meanwhile, continued carrying its mystery payload skyward. It could be headed to low Earth orbit, outside observers speculate.
paras.zh: 与此同时，猎鹰 9 号的上级继续将其神秘有效载荷升向天空。外部观察家推测，它可能会前往近地轨道。

paras.en: "It is possibly a batch of classified LEO satellites for the USSF's Space Based Sensing and Targeting (SBST) portfolio based on SpaceX's Starshield satellite bus, based on locations of rocket stage drop zones being exact fits with previous Starlink Group 15 launches," NextSpaceflight.com wrote in a mission description.
paras.zh: NextSpaceflight.com 在任务描述中写道：“这可能是 USSF 天基传感和瞄准 (SBST) 产品组合的一批机密 LEO 卫星，基于 SpaceX 的 Starshield 卫星总线，其火箭级降落区的位置与之前的 Starlink Group 15 发射完全吻合。”

paras.en: Starlink is SpaceX's LEO broadband megaconstellation, which consists of more than 11,000 active satellites. Starshield is a similar system designed to provide services to the U.S. military and its allies. Starshield satellites are believed to be based heavily on the Starlink spacecraft bus.
paras.zh: Starlink 是 SpaceX 的 LEO 宽带巨型星座，由 11,000 多颗活跃卫星组成。星盾是一个类似的系统，旨在为美国军方及其盟友提供服务。据信，星盾卫星主要基于星链航天器总线。

paras.en: USSF-432 was the 119th Falcon 9 launch of 2026, and the 14th national-security flight of the rocket so far this year. The vast majority of Falcon 9 missions in 2026 — more than 70% — have been devoted to building out the Starlink megaconstellation.
paras.zh: USSF-432 是猎鹰 9 号 2026 年第 119 次发射，也是今年迄今为止该火箭的第 14 次国家安全飞行。 2026 年猎鹰 9 号任务的绝大多数（超过 70%）都致力于建设星链巨型星座。

paras.en: SpaceX has also launched six other missions this year. Three were operational flights of the company's Falcon Heavy rocket, while the other three were test missions of its next-gen Starship vehicle. SpaceX plans to retire both the Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy shortly after the fully reusable Starship, the biggest and most powerful rocket ever built, is up and running.
paras.zh: SpaceX 今年还发射了其他六次任务。其中三架是该公司猎鹰重型火箭的运行飞行，另外三架是其下一代星舰飞行器的测试任务。 SpaceX 计划在完全可重复使用的星际飞船（有史以来最大、最强大的火箭）投入运行后不久，让猎鹰 9 号和猎鹰重型火箭退役。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: Scientists simulate an Earth without life to help hunt for aliens and inhabited worlds
articles.author: Keith Cooper

paras.en: A new computer simulation that depicts Earth, or a rocky planet in general, without life is the latest tool in the quest to discover whether or not we are alone in the universe.
paras.zh: 一种新的计算机模拟描绘了没有生命的地球或一般的岩石行星，这是探索我们是否在宇宙中孤独存在的最新工具。

paras.en: Life leaves its mark on a planet, particularly its atmosphere, in the form of a mixture of biochemically created gases. Some are obvious, while others can be produced by both biology and geology, meaning that distinguishing a planet that has life from one that does not, solely based on what gases we can detect in its atmosphere, can be difficult. The key is in knowing which atmospheric conditions can be explained without life.
paras.zh: 生命以生化产生的气体混合物的形式在行星上留下了痕迹，特别是在其大气层上。有些是显而易见的，而另一些则可以通过生物学和地质学产生，这意味着仅根据我们在其大气中检测到的气体来区分有生命的行星和没有生命的行星可能很困难。关键是要知道哪些大气条件可以在没有生命的情况下解释。

paras.en: To aid in distinguishing between habitable and inhabited planets, planetary scientist Samantha Gilbert-Janizek of the University of California, Riverside, developed a model that simulates the evolution of a rocky planet without life.
paras.zh: 为了帮助区分宜居行星和有人居住的行星，加州大学河滨分校的行星科学家萨曼莎·吉尔伯特·贾尼泽克开发了一个模型，模拟没有生命的岩石行星的演化。

paras.en: "The model can help us see how habitable but non-living planets might mimic living planets," Gilbert-Janizek, who was a PhD student at the University of Washington when the research was conducted, said in a statement.
paras.zh: “该模型可以帮助我们了解宜居但无生命的行星如何模仿生命行星，”进行这项研究时华盛顿大学的博士生吉尔伯特-贾尼泽克在一份声明中说。

paras.en: Gilbert-Janizek built upon a model previously developed by Washington’s Rory Barnes that simulated the core, mantle, and crust of a planet. This new model pushed the simulation two steps further by incorporating the surface and atmosphere of the planet as well.
paras.zh: 吉尔伯特-贾尼泽克建立在华盛顿的罗里·巴恩斯先前开发的模型的基础上，该模型模拟了行星的核心、地幔和地壳。这个新模型还结合了行星的表面和大气层，将模拟进一步推进了两步。

paras.en: In all, the model simulates 19 properties of a rocky planet that are not related to life, including the amount of heat a planet receives from its star, the exchange of heat and chemicals from the core to the surface, and the outflow of certain gases from the subsurface.
paras.zh: 总之，该模型模拟了岩石行星的 19 种与生命无关的属性，包括行星从恒星接收的热量、从核心到表面的热量和化学物质的交换，以及某些气体从地下的流出。

paras.en: Gilbert-Janizek’s starting point was to simulate the development of Earth had life never arisen here, therefore providing a baseline with which to compare to exoplanets. She ran the simulation from the birth of Earth 4.5 billion years ago to 500 million years into the future. The result was a lifeless world, but one that still had oceans and an atmosphere.
paras.zh: 吉尔伯特-贾尼泽克的出发点是模拟地球从未出现生命的情况下的发展，从而提供与系外行星进行比较的基线。她进行了从 45 亿年前地球诞生到未来 5 亿年的模拟。结果是一个没有生命的世界，但仍然有海洋和大气层。

paras.en: "When we interpret observations of an exoplanet’s atmosphere, this tool will help us determine the probability that what we observe indicates life on the surface," said Gilbert-Janizek.
paras.zh: 吉尔伯特-贾尼泽克说：“当我们解释对系外行星大气层的观测结果时，这个工具将帮助我们确定我们所观察到的表明表面存在生命的可能性。”

paras.en: What makes the simulation especially useful is its plug-and-play nature. Researchers can simply apply the bulk properties of whichever planet they are studying to the model, and then just let it run. If the result is a planet with an atmosphere that matches what is detected spectroscopically by the James Webb Space Telescope or, in the future, the various extremely large 30-meter-plus ground-based telescopes or NASA’s planned Habitable Worlds Observatory, then we know that planet probably does not have life as we know it.
paras.zh: 模拟特别有用的是它的即插即用特性。研究人员可以简单地将他们正在研究的行星的大量属性应用到模型中，然后让它运行。如果结果是一颗行星的大气层与詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜或未来各种超大型30米以上地面望远镜或美国宇航局计划的宜居世界天文台所检测到的光谱相匹配，那么我们就知道这颗行星可能不存在我们所知道的生命。

paras.en: However, if the simulated planet without life does not match what we observe on the real planet, then it becomes possible that life is present and altering the atmosphere.
paras.zh: 然而，如果没有生命的模拟行星与我们在真实行星上观察到的情况不符，那么就有可能存在生命并改变大气层。

paras.en: "Dr Gilbert-Janizek’s work represents an exciting step toward understanding where life can exist in the universe,” said Barnes. "After more than a decade of work by many scientists, Dr Gilbert-Janizek has finally completed a model of the Earth that simultaneously reproduces properties of Earth’s core, mantle, surface and atmosphere. That calibration gives us confidence that future simulations of exoplanets will be accurate."
paras.zh: 巴恩斯说：“吉尔伯特-贾尼泽克博士的工作代表着在了解宇宙中生命可能存在的位置方面迈出了令人兴奋的一步。” “经过许多科学家十多年的努力，吉尔伯特-贾尼泽克博士终于完成了一个地球模型，它同时再现了地核、地幔、表面和大气的特性。这种校准让我们相信，未来对系外行星的模拟将是准确的。”

paras.en: While any deviation from what is predicted by the model will not necessarily mean there is definitely life on a planet, it will help pick out those worlds that are worthy of follow-up studies by the next generation of telescopes.
paras.zh: 虽然与模型预测的任何偏差并不一定意味着行星上肯定存在生命，但它将有助于挑选出那些值得下一代望远镜进行后续研究的世界。

paras.en: Gilbert-Janizek’s model is described in a paper published in The Planetary Science Journal.
paras.zh: 吉尔伯特·雅尼泽克的模型在《行星科学杂志》上发表的一篇论文中进行了描述。

paras.en: Keith Cooper is a freelance science journalist and editor in the United Kingdom, and has a degree in physics and astrophysics from the University of Manchester. He's the author of "The Contact Paradox: Challenging Our Assumptions in the Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence" (Bloomsbury Sigma, 2020) and has written articles on astronomy, space, physics and astrobiology for a multitude of magazines and websites.
paras.zh: 基思·库珀 (Keith Cooper) 是英国自由科学记者和编辑，拥有曼彻斯特大学物理学和天体物理学学位。他是《接触悖论：在寻找外星智慧生命中挑战我们的假设》（Bloomsbury Sigma，2020 年）一书的作者，并为众多杂志和网站撰写了有关天文学、太空、物理学和天体生物学的文章。

articles.title: Ukrainian startup, GomSpace test satellite for future communications network
articles.author: Sandra Erwin

paras.en: WASHINGTON — A Ukrainian defense technology company and a Danish satellite manufacturer have begun operating an experimental communications satellite in orbit.
paras.zh: 华盛顿——一家乌克兰国防技术公司和一家丹麦卫星制造商已经开始在轨道上运行一颗实验通信卫星。

paras.en: Ukrainian startup Himera and Denmark’s GomSpace said Oct. 27 that their Obria Nano satellite, launched Oct. 1 aboard the SpaceX Transporter-18 rideshare mission, is undergoing tests. The companies plan to design a constellation that would provide communications coverage across Ukraine.
paras.zh: 乌克兰初创公司 Himera 和丹麦 GomSpace 于 10 月 27 日表示，他们的 Obria Nano 卫星于 10 月 1 日搭载 SpaceX Transporter-18 拼车任务发射，目前正在进行测试。两家公司计划设计一个星座，为整个乌克兰提供通信覆盖。

paras.en: The project is one of at least two European-backed initiatives aimed at giving Ukraine greater control over satellite communications, following disruptions this month to SpaceX’s Starlink and Starshield services that affected Ukrainian military operations.
paras.zh: 该项目是至少两项欧洲支持的举措之一，旨在让乌克兰更好地控制卫星通信，本月 SpaceX 的 Starlink 和 Starshield 服务中断，影响了乌克兰的军事行动。

paras.en: The announcement comes five days after Finnish satellite manufacturer Iceye and telecommunications equipment maker Nokia signed a letter of intent with Ukraine’s Defense Ministry to explore developing a sovereign broadband satellite communications network.
paras.zh: 五天前，芬兰卫星制造商 Iceye 和电信设备制造商诺基亚与乌克兰国防部签署了一份意向书，探讨开发主权宽带卫星通信网络。

paras.en: Ukraine has relied heavily on SpaceX’s satellite services for battlefield communications since Russia’s invasion in 2022. The services have become essential to military command networks, drone operations and communications in areas where terrestrial infrastructure has been destroyed or disrupted.
paras.zh: 自俄罗斯 2022 年入侵乌克兰以来，乌克兰一直严重依赖 SpaceX 的卫星服务进行战场通信。这些服务对于地面基础设施遭到破坏或中断的地区的军事指挥网络、无人机操作和通信至关重要。

paras.en: But restrictions imposed in mid-October limited satellite connectivity, interfering with Ukrainian drone operations, including efforts to intercept Russian attack drones.
paras.zh: 但十月中旬实施的限制限制了卫星连接，干扰了乌克兰无人机的行动，包括拦截俄罗斯攻击无人机的努力。

paras.en: Ukraine said Oct. 24 that Starlink and Starshield services had returned to normal operating speeds. The disruptions prompted a dispute over responsibility, with SpaceX chief executive Elon Musk and U.S. officials offering conflicting explanations about who had authorized the limits.
paras.zh: 乌克兰10月24日表示，星链和星盾服务已恢复正常运行速度。这些干扰引发了责任纠纷，SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克和美国官员对于谁授权了这些限制给出了相互矛盾的解释。

paras.en: Himera and GomSpace said the Obria Nano project is intended to establish a communications system under Ukrainian control, with plans eventually to manufacture satellites and ground terminals domestically.
paras.zh: Himera 和 GomSpace 表示，Obria Nano 项目旨在建立乌克兰控制下的通信系统，并计划最终在国内制造卫星和地面终端。

paras.en: “For us, this project is about more than launching a satellite. It is an opportunity to lay the foundation for an independent communications network for Ukraine,” said Misha Rudominski, Himera’s co-founder and chief executive.
paras.zh: Himera 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Misha Rudominski 表示：“对我们来说，这个项目不仅仅是发射一颗卫星。这是一个为乌克兰独立通信网络奠定基础的机会。”

paras.en: “We are starting by testing technologies in orbit, while our long-term goal is to develop capabilities that will strengthen the country’s strategic security and reduce dependence on external communications providers,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们首先在轨道上测试技术，而我们的长期目标是发展加强国家战略安全并减少对外部通信提供商的依赖的能力。”

paras.en: Himera, founded in 2022, develops secure tactical radio systems for military forces, including equipment designed to operate in environments affected by electronic warfare.
paras.zh: Himera 成立于 2022 年，为军队开发安全战术无线电系统，包括设计用于在受电子战影响的环境中运行的设备。

paras.en: GomSpace, headquartered in Aalborg, Denmark, manufactures small satellites, communications payloads and spacecraft subsystems.
paras.zh: GomSpace 总部位于丹麦奥尔堡，生产小型卫星、通信有效载荷和航天器子系统。

paras.en: The companies said Obria Nano is operating in orbit and undergoing testing that will inform the design of a constellation. They did not disclose the satellite’s specifications, communications capacity, project financing or the number of satellites envisioned for the network.
paras.zh: 两家公司表示，Obria Nano 正在轨道上运行并正在进行测试，这将为星座的设计提供信息。他们没有透露卫星的规格、通信能力、项目融资或网络中设想的卫星数量。

paras.en: Neither European initiative is expected to replace Starlink’s extensive global network. Smaller national constellations could provide dedicated communications for selected military operations while supplementing commercial services.
paras.zh: 预计这两项欧洲举措都不会取代星链广泛的全球网络。较小的国家星座可以为选定的军事行动提供专用通信，同时补充商业服务。

articles.title: Ozone Hole Reaches Its 2026 Maximum

paras.en: This story is an update to the Antarctic ozone hole feature in our World of Change series, which documents how Earth changes over months, seasons, and years.
paras.zh: 这个故事是我们的“变化​​世界”系列中南极臭氧空洞专题的更新，该系列记录了地球在数月、季节和年份中如何变化。

paras.en: The stratospheric ozone layer protects life on Earth by absorbing ultraviolet light, which damages DNA in plants and animals (including humans) and leads to sunburns and skin cancer. Prior to 1979, scientists had not observed atmospheric ozone concentrations below 220 Dobson Units. But in 1985, British Antarctic Survey scientists using ground-based measurements at Halley Research Station reported that Earth’s natural sunscreen was thinning dramatically over Antarctica each spring. NASA satellite instruments revealed the continental scale of this Antarctic ozone thinning, and it came to be known as the ozone hole.
paras.zh: 平流层臭氧层通过吸收紫外线来保护地球上的生命，紫外线会损害植物和动物（包括人类）的 DNA，并导致晒伤和皮肤癌。 1979 年之前，科学家尚未观察到大气臭氧浓度低于 220 多布森单位。但 1985 年，英国南极调查局的科学家利用哈雷研究站的地面测量报告称，每年春天，南极洲上空的地球天然防晒霜都会急剧变薄。美国宇航局卫星仪器揭示了南极臭氧稀薄的大陆范围，它被称为臭氧空洞。

paras.en: The data visualizations below shows the ozone hole each year from 1979 through 2026 (no data are available for 1995). The measurements were made from 1979-2004 by the TOMS (NASA’s Total Ozone Mapping Spectrometer) instruments on Nimbus-7 and several additional satellites; from 2005-2011 by the OMI (Ozone Monitoring Instrument) on the Aura satellite; from 2012-2025 by the OMPS (Ozone Mapping and Profiler Suite) on the Suomi NPP satellite; and in 2026 by the OMPS on the NOAA-20 satellite. Red and yellow areas indicate the ozone hole.
paras.zh: 下面的数据可视化显示了 1979 年至 2026 年每年的臭氧空洞情况（没有 1995 年的数据）。这些测量是在 1979 年至 2004 年期间由 Nimbus-7 和其他几颗卫星上的 TOMS（美国宇航局总臭氧测绘光谱仪）仪器进行的。 2005年至2011年由Aura卫星上的OMI（臭氧监测仪器）进行； 2012 年至 2025 年，由 Suomi NPP 卫星上的 OMPS（臭氧绘图和分析套件）进行；并于 2026 年由 OMPS 在 NOAA-20 卫星上进行。红色和黄色区域表示臭氧空洞。

paras.en: As the images show, the word hole isn’t literal; no place is empty of ozone. Scientists use the word hole as a metaphor for the area in which ozone concentrations drop below the historical threshold of 220 Dobson Units. Using this metaphor, they can describe the hole’s area and depth. These maps show the state of the ozone hole each year on the day of maximum depth—the day the lowest ozone concentrations were measured.
paras.zh: 如图所示，“洞”这个词并不是字面上的意思。没有一个地方是没有臭氧的。科学家们用洞这个词来比喻臭氧浓度低于 220 多布森单位的历史阈值的区域。使用这个比喻，他们可以描述洞的面积和深度。这些地图显示了每年最大深度当天（测量到的臭氧浓度最低的那一天）臭氧空洞的状态。

paras.en: The series begins in 1979. The maximum depth of the hole that year was 194 Dobson Units (DU)—not far below the previous historical low. For several years, the maximum depth stayed in the 190s, but then rapidly grew deeper: 173 DU in 1982, 154 in 1983, 124 in 1985. By 1991, a new threshold was passed, as the ozone concentration fell below 100 DU for the first time. Since then, concentrations below 100 DU have become more common. The deepest ozone hole occurred in 1994, when concentrations fell to just 73 DU on September 30.
paras.zh: 该系列始于 1979 年。当年的最大洞深度为 194 多布森单位 (DU)，与之前的历史低点相差不远。多年来，最大深度一直停留在 190 年代，但随后迅速加深：1982 年为 173 DU，1983 年为 154 DU，1985 年为 124 DU。到 1991 年，臭氧浓度首次降至 100 DU 以下，突破了新的阈值。从那时起，低于 100 DU 的浓度变得更加常见。最深的臭氧空洞发生于 1994 年，9 月 30 日浓度降至仅 73 DU。

paras.en: Records in depth and area have never occurred in the same year (the largest ozone hole occurred in 2006), but the long-term trend in both characteristics is consistent: from 1980 through the early 1990s, the hole rapidly grew in area and depth. In the early years of the 21st century, annual ozone holes roughly stabilized (see NASA Ozone Watch for annual averages). Year-to-year fluctuations in area and depth are caused by variations in stratospheric temperature and circulation. Colder conditions result in a larger area and lower ozone values in the core of the hole.
paras.zh: 深度和面积的记录从未发生在同一年（最大的臭氧空洞发生在2006年），但两个特征的长期趋势是一致的：从1980年到90年代初，空洞的面积和深度迅速增长。在 21 世纪初期，每年的臭氧空洞大致稳定（请参阅 NASA 臭氧观察的年平均值）。面积和深度的逐年波动是由平流层温度和环流的变化引起的。较冷的条件会导致洞中心面积更大，臭氧值更低。

paras.en: That was the case in 2026, when an unusually strong Antarctic polar vortex created ideal conditions for ozone depletion over a large area. Measured by its mean size from September 7 to October 13, which is peak ozone depletion season, the 2026 hole was the seventh largest in 48 years of monitoring. However, it was not as deep as other large holes on record. The map at the top of this page shows the hole on September 18, the day of its annual maximum area.
paras.zh: 2026 年的情况就是如此，当时异常强烈的南极极地涡旋为大面积臭氧消耗创造了理想的条件。根据9月7日至10月13日（臭氧消耗高峰季节）的平均大小来衡量，2026年的洞是48年来监测中的第七大洞。然而，它并不像有记录的其他大洞那么深。本页顶部的地图显示了 9 月 18 日的洞，当天是其年度面积最大的一天。

paras.en: The ozone hole opened the world’s eyes to the global effects of human activity on the atmosphere. Scientists learned that chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs)—long-lived chemicals that had been used in refrigerators and aerosol sprays since the 1930s—had a dark side. In the layer of the atmosphere closest to Earth (the troposphere), CFCs circulate for decades without degrading or reacting with other chemicals. When they reach the stratosphere, however, their behavior changes. In the upper stratosphere (beyond the protection of the ozone layer), ultraviolet light causes CFCs to break apart, releasing chlorine, a very reactive atom that repeatedly catalyzes ozone destruction.
paras.zh: 臭氧空洞让世界认识到人类活动对大气的全球影响。科学家们了解到，氯氟烃 (CFC) 这种长效化学物质自 20 世纪 30 年代以来一直用于冰箱和气溶胶喷雾剂，但也有其不好的一面。在最接近地球的大气层（对流层）中，氟氯化碳可以循环数十年，不会降解或与其他化学物质发生反应。然而，当他们到达平流层时，他们的行为就会发生变化。在平流层上层（臭氧层保护之外），紫外线导致氟氯化碳分解，释放出氯，这是一种非常活泼的原子，反复催化臭氧破坏。

paras.en: The global recognition of the destructive potential of CFCs led to the 1987 Montreal Protocol, a treaty phasing out the consumption and production of ozone-depleting chemicals. Scientists estimate that about 80 percent of the chlorine in the stratosphere today comes from human, not natural, sources. Human-produced bromine compounds, which are far less abundant but much more destructive to ozone, also contribute to the Antarctic ozone hole.
paras.zh: 全球对 CFC 破坏潜力的认识导致了 1987 年《蒙特利尔议定书》的签署，该协议逐步停止消耗和生产消耗臭氧层化学品。科学家估计，当今平流层中约 80% 的氯来自人类而非自然来源。人类产生的溴化合物虽然数量少得多，但对臭氧的破坏性却更大，也会造成南极臭氧层空洞。

paras.en: Models suggest that the concentration of chlorine and other ozone-depleting substances in the stratosphere will not return to pre-1980 levels until later in the 21st century. In 2018, scientists reported the first direct satellite evidence of ozone recovery, observing a 20 percent decrease in ozone depletion during the Antarctic winter months from 2005 to 2016. In 2019, abnormal weather patterns in the upper atmosphere over Antarctica dramatically limited ozone depletion, leading to the smallest hole since 1982—illustrating the impact of year-to-year variations in the meteorology of the Antarctic stratosphere. Scientists estimate that the Antarctic ozone layer will return to 1980 levels in the 2070s.
paras.zh: 模型表明，平流层中氯和其他消耗臭氧层物质的浓度要到 21 世纪后期才会恢复到 1980 年之前的水平。 2018年，科学家报告了臭氧恢复的第一个直接卫星证据，观察到2005年至2016年南极冬季的臭氧消耗减少了20%。2019年，南极上空高层大气的异常天气模式极大地限制了臭氧消耗，导致出现1982年以来最小的空洞——这说明了南极平流层气象逐年变化的影响。科学家估计，南极臭氧层将在2070年代恢复到1980年的水平。

paras.en: NASA Earth Observatory images by Lauren Dauphin, using data from NASA Ozone Watch.
paras.zh: NASA 地球观测站的图像由 Lauren Dauphin 使用 NASA 臭氧观察的数据拍摄。

articles.title: World News in Brief: Civilians killed in DR Congo, Ukrainians wrestle with return, Guterres calls out ‘normalisation’ of force

paras.en: World News in Brief: Civilians killed in DR Congo, Ukrainians wrestle with return, Guterres calls out ‘normalisation’ of force
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：刚果民主共和国平民被杀，乌克兰人努力回返，古特雷斯呼吁武力“正常化”

paras.en: At least 30 civilians were killed overnight on Thursday in Beni Territory, North Kivu in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to local sources cited by the UN aid coordination office (OCHA).
paras.zh: 联合国援助协调办公室 (OCHA) 援引当地消息人士称，刚果民主共和国北基伍省贝尼地区周四夜间至少有 30 名平民丧生。

paras.en: During the attack, attributed by local authorities to extremist rebel group the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) – according to news reports – homes were burnt and a health centre was destroyed, killing several patients.
paras.zh: 据新闻报道，地方当局将这次袭击归咎于极端反叛组织民主同盟军 (ADF)，袭击期间房屋被烧毁，一个医疗中心被摧毁，导致数名患者死亡。

paras.en: The insecurity has also disrupted the Ebola response. People who had been in contact with Ebola patients reportedly fled an observation centre, and response teams were forced to suspend operations, making it harder to track infections and contain the outbreak.
paras.zh: 不安全局势也扰乱了埃博拉应对工作。据报道，与埃博拉患者接触过的人逃离了观察中心，反应小组被迫暂停行动，这使得追踪感染和控制疫情变得更加困难。

paras.en: Authorities have reported more than 10,700 confirmed cases and over 5,200 deaths.
paras.zh: 当局已报告确诊病例超过 10,700 例，死亡人数超过 5,200 人。

paras.en: The UN called on all parties to protect civilians, respect international humanitarian law and ensure safe, unhindered access for humanitarian and health workers, warning that continued violence is costing lives and undermining efforts to contain the outbreak.
paras.zh: 联合国呼吁各方保护平民，尊重国际人道主义法，确保人道主义和卫生工作者安全、不受阻碍地进入，并警告说，持续的暴力正在造成生命损失，并破坏遏制疫情的努力。

paras.en: Asked about burial practices during the ongoing outbreak, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric told reporters in New York they were being addressed through community outreach.
paras.zh: 当被问及疫情持续爆发期间的埋葬做法时，联合国发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克 (Stéphane Dujarric) 在纽约告诉记者，这些问题正在通过社区外展得到解决。

paras.en: He noted that disinformation about the work of frontline health workers had led to attacks on staff.
paras.zh: 他指出，有关一线卫生工作者工作的虚假信息导致了对工作人员的袭击。

paras.en: He praised the courage of workers, “most of whom are Congolese”, who continue to battle the disease and save lives amid the fighting between armed groups which has roiled the region for decades.
paras.zh: 他赞扬了工人们的勇气，“其中大多数是刚果人”，他们在数十年来困扰该地区的武装团体之间的战斗中继续与疾病作斗争并拯救生命。

paras.en: Displaced Ukrainians return home but most do not say: IOM
paras.zh: 流离失所的乌克兰人返回家园，但大多数人没有说：国际移民组织

paras.en: Ukrainians displaced by the war continue to make frequent journeys back to their country without returning permanently, according to a new study published Friday.
paras.zh: 周五发表的一项新研究显示，因战争而流离失所的乌克兰人继续频繁返回自己的国家，但没有永久返回。

paras.en: Commissioned by the UN International Organization for Migration (IOM), the report found that nearly nine in 10 displaced Ukrainians crossing back from Poland planned to stay in their home country for no more than 30 days.
paras.zh: 受联合国国际移民组织 (IOM) 委托，这份报告发现，从波兰回国的流离失所的乌克兰人中，近十分之九计划在自己的祖国停留不超过 30 天。

paras.en: Respondents had spent almost three years abroad – on average – yet ties to home remain strong. More than three-quarters had crossed the border at least three times since being displaced.
paras.zh: 受访者平均在国外度过了近三年的时间，但与家乡的联系依然紧密。超过四分之三的人自流离失所以来至少跨越过边境三次。

paras.en: “For many Ukrainians, going home means seeing family, getting medical care or spending a few days in a place they have missed for years,” said Arthur Erken, IOM Regional Director for Europe and Central Asia.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织欧洲和中亚区域主任阿瑟·埃尔肯 (Arthur Erken) 表示：“对于许多乌克兰人来说，回家意味着见到家人、获得医疗护理或在他们多年来错过的地方度过几天。”

paras.en: But he added that “a visit is not the same as being able to stay. Many are still living between their home country and where they reside, making repeated journeys to hold on to the people and places that matter to them.”
paras.zh: 但他补充说，“访问并不等于能够留下来。许多人仍然生活在祖国和居住地之间，不断往返，以留住对他们重要的人和地方。”

paras.en: Most visits back to Ukraine were to reunite with family, with 85 per cent intending to return to their region of origin.
paras.zh: 大多数返回乌克兰的目的是与家人团聚，其中 85% 的人打算返回原籍地区。

paras.en: However, only eight per cent planned to remain in Ukraine for more than a month.
paras.zh: 然而，只有百分之八的人计划在乌克兰停留一个多月。

paras.en: Security concerns, damage to housing, limited income opportunities and healthcare needs, continue to hinder sustainable returns.
paras.zh: 安全问题、住房受损、收入机会有限和医疗保健需求继续阻碍可持续回报。

paras.en: Latest UN data indicates that about 5.9 million Ukrainians remain displaced abroad as refugees.
paras.zh: 联合国最新数据显示，仍有约 590 万乌克兰人在国外流离失所，成为难民。

paras.en: UN chief: Charter rules apply to all, with ‘no double standards’
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长：宪章规则适用于所有人，“不存在双重标准”

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres warned on Friday against the normalisation of force and the erosion of international law, in a speech at Spain’s University of Salamanca less than two months before his term ends.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯周五在西班牙萨拉曼卡大学发表讲话，警告不要武力正常化和国际法受到侵蚀，此时距离他的任期还有不到两个月。

paras.en: “The unlawful use of force is becoming normalised,” he said, after receiving an honorary doctorate. “Borders are being redrawn by force of arms. Too many States take an à la carte approach to international law.”
paras.zh: “非法使用武力正在变得常态化，”他在获得荣誉博士学位后说道。 “边界正在通过武力重新划定。太多国家对国际法采取点菜方式。”

paras.en: From Ukraine to Sudan, the Sahel and Gaza, civilians are the first to suffer, Mr. Guterres said, while “every crime that goes unpunished paves the way for the next.”
paras.zh: 古特雷斯表示，从乌克兰到苏丹、萨赫勒地区和加沙地带，平民首当其冲，而“每一次未受惩罚的犯罪行为都为下一次犯罪铺平了道路”。

paras.en: “The Charter lays down the same rule for everyone,” he said. “No exceptions. No double standards.”
paras.zh: “宪章为每个人制定了同样的规则，”他说。 “没有例外。没有双重标准。”

paras.en: He invoked Francisco de Vitoria, the theologian who taught at Salamanca in the 16th century and is seen as a forerunner of international law. His legacy endures, the UN chief said: “Power must be subject to the law.”
paras.zh: 他援引了 16 世纪在萨拉曼卡任教的神学家弗朗西斯科·德·维多利亚 (Francisco de Vitoria)，他被视为国际法的先驱。联合国秘书长表示，他的遗产永垂不朽：“权力必须服从法律。”

paras.en: Mr. Guterres called the lack of a permanent Security Council seat for Africa and for Latin America and the Caribbean “a historic injustice that we must rectify”. He also noted that military spending is breaking records while aid is plummeting.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生称非洲以及拉丁美洲和加勒比地区缺乏安理会常任理事国席位是“我们必须纠正的历史性不公正现象”。他还指出，军费开支正在打破记录，而援助却直线下降。

paras.en: “Terms of office come and go,” he said. “The struggle for peace, dignity and justice continues.”
paras.zh: “任期来来去去，”他说。 “争取和平、尊严和正义的斗争仍在继续。”

articles.title: Afghanistan faces deepening humanitarian crisis amid sweeping rights restrictions

paras.en: Afghanistan faces deepening humanitarian crisis amid sweeping rights restrictions
paras.zh: 阿富汗因全面的权利限制而面临日益加深的人道主义危机

paras.en: Afghanistan stands at a “difficult crossroad” more than five years after the Taliban returned to power, a senior UN official said on Friday. Relative stability and security are being undercut by a fragile economy, sweeping curbs on rights and acute humanitarian need.
paras.zh: 联合国高级官员周五表示，塔利班重新掌权五年多后，阿富汗正处于“艰难的十字路口”。脆弱的经济、全面的权利限制和迫切的人道主义需求正在削弱相对的稳定和安全。

paras.en: Bruno Lemarquis is the Deputy Special Representative of the Secretary-General for Afghanistan. He is also the UN’s Resident and Humanitarian Coordinator in the country.
paras.zh: 布鲁诺·勒马奎斯是负责阿富汗问题的秘书长副特别代表。他还是联合国驻该国的驻地和人道主义协调员。

paras.en: Women and girls continue to suffer from “severe and sweeping” restrictions on their freedoms, being deprived of many spaces to learn, work and participate in public life, Mr. Lemarquis stressed.
paras.zh: 勒马奎斯先生强调，妇女和女童的自由继续受到“严重和全面”的限制，被剥夺了许多学习、工作和参与公共生活的空间。

paras.en: In particular, the restriction of girls’ access to education represents “one of the world’s most sensitive…education challenges,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说，特别是，对女孩接受教育的限制代表了“世界上最敏感的……教育挑战之一”。

paras.en: Since 2021, over 2.6 million girls have been denied secondary education, and female university enrollment currently stands at zero.
paras.zh: 自 2021 年以来，超过 260 万女童无法接受中等教育，目前女性大学入学率为零。

paras.en: But higher education overall is in crisis: due to the country’s economic frailty, some families are also holding back from sending their boys to school.
paras.zh: 但高等教育总体上正处于危机之中：由于国家经济脆弱，一些家庭也不愿送孩子上学。

paras.en: When asked by a journalist how the Taliban justify their restrictions on women and girls, Mr. Lemarquis said their explanations are a mix of religious extremism and deep historical practices of control and discrimination.
paras.zh: 当记者问塔利班如何证明其对妇女和女孩的限制合理时，勒马奎斯表示，他们的解释是宗教极端主义和根深蒂固的历史控制和歧视做法的结合。

paras.en: Since September 2025, Afghan women staffers have also been banned from entering United Nations premises across the country, and the ban has not been lifted.
paras.zh: 自2025年9月起，阿富汗女工作人员也被禁止进入全国各地的联合国房地，且禁令至今仍未解除。

paras.en: The “massive” return of 6.7 million nationals to Afghanistan since 2020 is also placing additional strain on its already stretched services.
paras.zh: 自 2020 年以来，670 万国民“大规模”返回阿富汗，也给本已捉襟见肘的服务带来了额外的压力。

paras.en: Many were forcibly expelled from the neighbouring countries that were hosting them, with a large portion coming from Pakistan and Iran.
paras.zh: 许多人被强行驱逐出收容他们的邻国，其中很大一部分来自巴基斯坦和伊朗。

paras.en: Mr. Lemarquis said he had met many who had to return to Afghanistan despite never having lived there before. This included a 45-year-old father born abroad who had ended up back in his ancestral village along with his children.
paras.zh: 勒马奎斯表示，他遇到了许多不得不返回阿富汗的人，尽管他们以前从未在那里生活过。其中包括一位出生在国外的 45 岁父亲，他最终和孩子们一起回到了自己祖籍的村庄。

paras.en: He stressed that these returnees need legal documentation, protection and “jobs, jobs, jobs.”
paras.zh: 他强调，这些返回者需要法律文件、保护和“工作、工作、工作”。

paras.en: For decades, Afghanistan was the world’s biggest source of illicit opium, but its cultivation dropped dramatically following a 2022 Taliban ban.
paras.zh: 几十年来，阿富汗一直是世界上最大的非法鸦片来源地，但在 2022 年塔利班颁布禁令后，其种植面积急剧下降。

paras.en: Yet Mr. Lemarquis cited a recent UN report which found opium poppy production increasing by 330 per cent during 2025, with farmers finding ways of hiding their production from the Taliban.
paras.zh: 然而，勒马奎斯先生引用了联合国最近的一份报告，该报告发现，2025 年罂粟产量增加了 330%，而农民则想方设法向塔利班隐瞒自己的产量。

paras.en: For eradication to be effective, he said, there needs to be viable alternatives to making a living.
paras.zh: 他说，为了有效地根除这一疾病，需要有可行的谋生替代方案。

paras.en: “We cannot survive. And we don’t want to die,” some farmers told him, talking about how little income they would make without opium cultivation.
paras.zh: “我们无法生存。而且我们不想死，”一些农民告诉他，如果不种植鸦片，他们的收入将是多么少。

paras.en: Humanitarian needs in Afghanistan are expected to rise starkly in 2027 due to a combination of shocks – the mass influx of returnees, regional instability and the stronger-than-ever El Nino weather pattern together seriously threaten food security and access to services.
paras.zh: 由于一系列冲击，阿富汗的人道主义需求预计将在 2027 年急剧上升——大量回返者涌入、地区不稳定以及比以往任何时候都严重的厄尔尼诺天气模式，共同严重威胁粮食安全和服务的获取。

paras.en: Yet at the same time, humanitarian funding is being cut year-on-year. In 2023, the humanitarian response reached $2 billion, in 2025 it halved to $1 billion, and so far in 2026 it has only amounted to $570 million, roughly a quarter of 2023 levels.
paras.zh: 但与此同时，人道主义资金却逐年削减。 2023年，人道主义应急资金达到20亿美元，2025年减半至10亿美元，而2026年迄今为止仅达到5.7亿美元，大约是2023年水平的四分之一。

paras.en: 40 per cent of primary healthcare facilities are expected to close between 2025 and 2026 – corresponding to 700 health posts out of 1,900 across the country.
paras.zh: 预计 40% 的初级医疗机构将在 2025 年至 2026 年间关闭——相当于全国 1,900 个卫生站中的 700 个。

paras.en: The consequences are “very, very, very significant,” Mr. Lemarquis stressed, urging the international community not to turn its back of Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 勒马奎斯强调，其后果“非常、非常、非常严重”，并敦促国际社会不要背弃阿富汗。

paras.en: “And there is a saying in Afghanistan that is ‘What is happening in Afghanistan is not staying in Afghanistan,’” he said.
paras.zh: “阿富汗有句俗话，‘阿富汗发生的事情不能留在阿富汗’，”他说。

paras.en: “The consequences could go beyond the Afghanistan border, potentially affecting regional security, regional stability and migration pathways.”
paras.zh: “其后果可能超出阿富汗边境，可能影响地区安全、地区稳定和移民通道。”

articles.title: Beyond the broken glass: The human cost of the 1938 November Pogrom

paras.en: Beyond the broken glass: The human cost of the 1938 November Pogrom
paras.zh: 碎玻璃之外：1938 年 11 月大屠杀造成的人员伤亡

paras.en: On his way to school in Vienna on the morning of 10 November 1938, eight-year-old Arthur Schneier watched his synagogue burn while firefighters and police officers stood by “rejoicing”.
paras.zh: 1938 年 11 月 10 日早上，八岁的阿瑟·施奈尔 (Arthur Schneier) 在前往维也纳上学的路上，看着自己的犹太教堂被烧毁，而消防员和警察则站在一旁“欣喜若狂”。

paras.en: More than 87 years later, Rabbi Schneier told a UN panel in New York that the memory has never left him.
paras.zh: 87 年后，拉比·施奈尔 (Rabbi Schneier) 在纽约的一个联合国小组中表示，这段记忆从未离开过他。

paras.en: It shaped a lifelong conviction, he said in a video recording: an attack on a community’s house of worship strikes at the very heart of its faith. His message was one of mutual respect and acceptance, and a call for everyone to learn from the past.
paras.zh: 他在一段视频中说，这塑造了一个终生的信念：对社区礼拜堂的袭击触及其信仰的核心。他传达的信息是相互尊重和接受，并呼吁每个人从过去吸取教训。

paras.en: The panel was held this week ahead of the 88th anniversary of the Kristallnacht pogrom, when years of State-sponsored antisemitism erupted into orchestrated violence against Jewish communities across Germany, Austria and the Sudetenland.
paras.zh: 该小组于本周在水晶之夜大屠杀 88 周年纪念日之前举行，当时多年来国家支持的反犹太主义爆发为针对德国、奥地利和苏台德地区犹太社区的精心策划的暴力行为。

paras.en: Speakers set out to look past the familiar images of shattered shop windows to the fear, grief and loss lived by Jewish children, parents and neighbours.
paras.zh: 演讲者们开始透过破碎的商店橱窗的熟悉画面，看到犹太儿童、父母和邻居所经历的恐惧、悲伤和失落。

paras.en: On the night of 9–10 November 1938, synagogues were set alight, Jewish homes and businesses were ransacked and some 30,000 Jewish men were arrested and sent to concentration camps.
paras.zh: 1938 年 11 月 9 日至 10 日夜间，犹太教堂被纵火，犹太人的住宅和企业遭到洗劫，约 30,000 名犹太男子被捕并被送往集中营。

paras.en: It marked a turning point: Nazi persecution of Jews moved from discrimination and exclusion to open violence on the streets. Many tried to flee, only to find that other countries would not take them in.
paras.zh: 它标志着一个转折点：纳粹对犹太人的迫害从歧视和排斥转向街头公开暴力。许多人试图逃离，却发现其他国家不会接纳他们。

paras.en: The Nazis called it Kristallnacht – “crystal night”, or the night of broken glass. The name came from the shards that littered the streets, but it was a euphemism that played down the violence done to people.
paras.zh: 纳粹称其为“水晶之夜”（Kristallnacht），即碎玻璃之夜。这个名字来自于街道上散落的碎片，但它是一种委婉的说法，淡化了对人们的暴力行为。

paras.en: The photographs remain: Jewish men forced to march through their towns with their heads uncovered; neighbours looking on; synagogues desecrated; homes and businesses ransacked.
paras.zh: 照片仍然存在：犹太男人被迫不戴头巾穿过他们的城镇；邻居们在一旁观看；犹太教堂被亵渎；房屋和企业被洗劫一空。

paras.en: But what do these images really tell us about the people who lived through the pogrom? And what do they leave out?
paras.zh: 但这些图像真正告诉我们关于经历过大屠杀的人们的什么呢？他们遗漏了什么？

paras.en: The panel discussion, Understanding Past Realities of the Holocaust: Photography Versus Art, was organized at UN Headquarters by The Holocaust and the United Nations Outreach Programme and the Fritz Ascher Society for Persecuted, Ostracized and Banned Art, with the support of the Permanent Mission of Germany to the United Nations, in memory of the victims.
paras.zh: 题为“了解大屠杀过去的现实：摄影与艺术”的小组讨论会由大屠杀和联合国外展计划以及弗里茨·阿舍尔迫害、排斥和禁止艺术协会在联合国总部举办，并得到了德国常驻联合国代表团的支持，以纪念受害者。

paras.en: Speakers looked at historical photographs and at artworks by persecuted artists. They considered how visual records can reveal the reality of antisemitic violence, and how they can also hide it.
paras.zh: 演讲者们观看了历史照片和受迫害艺术家的艺术作品。他们考虑了视觉记录如何揭示反犹太暴力的现实，以及如何隐藏它。

paras.en: Holocaust historian Christoph Kreutzmüller urged the audience to treat photographs as primary sources to be examined critically, not as simple illustrations of history.
paras.zh: 大屠杀历史学家克里斯托夫·克罗伊茨米勒 (Christoph Kreutzmüller) 敦促观众将照片视为需要批判性审视的主要来源，而不是简单的历史插图。

paras.en: Who took the picture? Who was watching? Who was being photographed, and under what circumstances? And whose perspective has been preserved?
paras.zh: 谁拍的照片？谁在看？谁被拍照，在什么情况下被拍照？谁的观点得到了保留？

paras.en: In Germany within its 1937 borders alone, he noted, there were 2,416 violent incidents recorded against Jews during 1938. Yet statistics cannot convey the full human consequences.
paras.zh: 他指出，仅在 1937 年德国境内，1938 年就记录了 2,416 起针对犹太人的暴力事件。然而，统计数据无法反映对人类造成的全部后果。

paras.en: “We don't know the number of murders. We don't know the number of injured. We can't even measure the effects the violence had on all the people,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们不知道谋杀人数。我们不知道受伤人数。我们甚至无法衡量暴力对所有人的影响，”他说。

paras.en: Photographs, he argued, are a difficult source for another reason: many were taken by the perpetrators, or by those aligned with them, without the consent of the people being photographed.
paras.zh: 他认为，照片是一个困难的来源，还有另一个原因：许多照片是由肇事者或与他们结盟的人在未经被拍照者同意的情况下拍摄的。

paras.en: Mr. Kreutzmüller illustrated this with the story of a Jewish woman, Emily Freising, who was trying to leave her hometown in 1935.
paras.zh: Kreutzmüller 先生用一位犹太妇女 Emily Freising 的故事来说明这一点，她于 1935 年试图离开家乡。

paras.en: When someone attempted to photograph her, she raised something in front of her face to avoid being captured on camera. The photographer sent the image to the antisemitic newspaper Der Stürmer published in Nazi Germany from 20 April 1923 to 1 February 1945, complaining that she had refused to be photographed.
paras.zh: 当有人试图给她拍照时，她会举起一些东西挡住自己的脸，以避免被镜头捕捉到。摄影师将这张照片发送给纳粹德国于 1923 年 4 月 20 日至 1945 年 2 月 1 日期间出版的反犹太主义报纸《Der Stürmer》，抱怨她拒绝拍照。

paras.en: The episode exposes a disturbing imbalance: the person behind the camera had the power to record and circulate an image, while the person in front of it could be denied even the choice to be seen.
paras.zh: 这一集暴露了一种令人不安的不平衡：镜头后面的人有权记录和传播图像，而镜头前面的人甚至可能被剥夺被看到的选择权。

paras.en: Photography, in this context, was simply another instrument of persecution and humiliation.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，摄影只不过是另一种迫害和羞辱的工具。

paras.en: That dynamic is particularly visible in the photographs Mr. Kreutzmüller examined from Baden-Baden in Germany’s southwest, a town of around 30,000 people.
paras.zh: 这种动态在克罗伊茨穆勒先生在德国西南部巴登巴登（一个约有 30,000 人口的小镇）检查的照片中尤为明显。

paras.en: Jewish men who had been arrested by the police and Gestapo were brought out of police headquarters and forced to march through the streets. They were made to walk bareheaded, a deliberate humiliation in a society where men traditionally wore hats in public.
paras.zh: 被警察和盖世太保逮捕的犹太男子被带出警察总部，被迫上街游行。他们被迫光头走路，这在一个传统上男性在公共场合戴帽子的社会中是一种故意的羞辱。

paras.en: The photographs show the men watched by neighbours and passers-by. But, as Mr. Kreutzmüller pointed out, they also reveal other photographers. There was a “Brownshirt” (a member of the Nazi paramilitary wing) with a camera, another man photographing from the street, and a third wearing a Nazi badge.
paras.zh: 这些照片显示了邻居和路人注视着这些人。但是，正如克罗伊茨穆勒先生指出的那样，他们还揭露了其他摄影师。其中一名“褐衫军”（纳粹准军事组织成员）拿着相机，另一名男子在街上拍照，第三名则戴着纳粹徽章。

paras.en: Mr. Kreutzmüller asked the audience to consider what it all meant for an elderly Jewish man, perhaps 65 or 70, who might not have appeared in public without a hat for decades.
paras.zh: Kreutzmüller 先生请观众思考这对于一位可能 65 岁或 70 岁的犹太老人来说意味着什么，他可能几十年来都不会不戴帽子出现在公共场合。

paras.en: The camera did not simply witness the violence – it helped to extend it.
paras.zh: 摄像机不仅仅见证了暴力行为——它还帮助扩大了暴力行为。

paras.en: Even a photograph that records so much cannot tell the whole story. It cannot fully convey what the men felt as they were marched through town, what families feared behind closed doors, or what it meant to watch a home, a place of worship or a familiar life being taken away.
paras.zh: 即使一张照片记录了这么多，也无法讲述整个​​故事。它无法完全传达这些人被游行穿过城镇时的感受，家人关起门后的恐惧，或者看着一个家、一个礼拜场所或熟悉的生活被夺走意味着什么。

paras.en: Together, photographs and art offer a fuller account. One reveals the visible traces of persecution; the other helps recover what the camera could not capture. Both ask viewers to look carefully – not only at what is shown, but also at what has been left outside the frame.
paras.zh: 照片和艺术共同提供了更全面的描述。一是揭露迫害的明显痕迹；二是揭露迫害的痕迹。另一个帮助恢复相机无法捕获的内容。两者都要求观众仔细观察——不仅要注意所显示的内容，还要注意留在画面之外的内容。

paras.en: Art historian Rachel Perry discussed works by artists including Charlotte Salomon, whose visual narratives help reconstruct the private and emotional experience that photographs often fail to capture.
paras.zh: 艺术史学家雷切尔·佩里 (Rachel Perry) 讨论了夏洛特·所罗门 (Charlotte Salomon) 等艺术家的作品，他们的视觉叙事有助于重建照片常常无法捕捉到的私人和情感体验。

paras.en: When she started looking for artwork created by Jewish people during the Holocaust, she found absence, mainly because Jewish artists faced extreme conditions during the Nazi regime, including persecution, arrests, imprisonment, and the destruction of their work.
paras.zh: 当她开始寻找犹太人在大屠杀期间创作的艺术品时，她发现了缺失，主要是因为犹太艺术家在纳粹政权期间面临极端的条件，包括迫害、逮捕、监禁和作品被毁。

paras.en: They had little time, materials, or stability to create art.
paras.zh: 他们几乎没有时间、材料或稳定性来创作艺术。

paras.en: Charlotte Salomon was a German-Jewish artist best known for creating Life? or Theater? a series of autobiographical paintings documenting her life and experiences during the Holocaust before she was murdered at Auschwitz at age 26.
paras.zh: 夏洛特·所罗门是一位德国犹太艺术家，以创作《生活？》而闻名。或剧院？一系列自传体绘画记录了她在 26 岁时在奥斯威辛被谋杀之前在大屠杀期间的生活和经历。

paras.en: Ms. Perry described how Salomon's work follows the experience of German Jews as they tried to understand what was happening, sought information, considered where they might go and prepared to leave.
paras.zh: 佩里女士描述了所罗门的工作如何遵循德国犹太人的经历，因为他们试图了解正在发生的事情，寻求信息，考虑他们可能去哪里并准备离开。

paras.en: Her images capture the intimate moments of departure: a portrait received from a father, a suitcase being packed, family members saying goodbye at a station, and a woman looking out of a train window as it pulls away.
paras.zh: 她的照片捕捉到了出发时的亲密时刻：从父亲那里收到一张肖像，一个行李箱正在收拾好，家人在车站告别，以及一个女人在火车开动时向窗外看去。

paras.en: The historian drew a distinction between the visual record created by perpetrators and the work of artists who sought to bear witness. The photographs often show the aftermath, she explained, while art can convey the experience unfolding over time. In her words, “What the photograph cut out, someone drew.”
paras.zh: 这位历史学家对肇事者创造的视觉记录和寻求见证的艺术家的作品进行了区分。她解释说，这些照片通常会展示后果，而艺术可以传达随着时间的推移而展开的经历。用她的话来说，“照片剪下的东西，有人画出来了。”

articles.title: Madrid matadors and indestructible Mahomes - NFL Sunday Review

paras.en: Patrick Mahomes proves he is indestructible while Joe Burrow, Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins light up Madrid - NFL Sunday Review
paras.zh: 帕特里克·马霍姆斯证明了他是坚不可摧的，而乔·伯罗、贾马尔·蔡斯和蒂·希金斯点亮了马德里 - NFL 周日评论

paras.en: NFL Sunday Review - we reflect on Week Nine in the NFL as the Cincinnati Bengals stars dazzled in Madrid, Patrick Mahomes overcame an injury scare and Myles Garrett made an emphatic return from injury in his first big day for the Los Angeles Rams
paras.zh: NFL 周日回顾 - 我们回顾 NFL 第九周，辛辛那提猛虎队的明星们在马德里耀眼，帕特里克·马霍姆斯克服了伤病恐慌，迈尔斯·加勒特在他为洛杉矶公羊队的第一个重要日子中从伤病中强势回归

paras.en: Want to grow the NFL overseas? Send the stars. The superstars. The Joe Burrows'. The Ja'Marr Chases'. The Tee Higgins'. Let them flourish like superstars, and watch new host countries turn to disciples.
paras.zh: 想要在海外发展 NFL？送星星。超级巨星。乔·布罗斯的。贾马尔追逐战。希金斯的T恤。让他们像超级巨星一样蓬勃发展，并看着新的东道国成为门徒。

paras.en: Thousands of Spanish fans will have left the Bernabeu on Sunday with either a strengthened or a new-found connection to the Bengals, who delivered about as good a product as you are likely to see in an international game as they beat the Atlanta Falcons 34-17 on the league's return to Madrid.
paras.zh: 数以千计的西班牙球迷将于周日离开伯纳乌，与孟加拉虎队的联系要么加强，要么新发现，孟加拉虎队在联赛重返马德里时以 34-17 击败亚特兰大猎鹰队，他们的表现几乎是你在国际比赛中看到的一样出色。

paras.en: A winning product. A Super Bowl-contending product. The product of a three-headed monster capable of taking a sledgehammer to any defense in football, and one built to thrive amid the fiercest of slugfests.
paras.zh: 一个获胜的产品。超级碗竞争产品。这是一个三头怪物的产物，能够用大锤摧毁足球场上的任何防守，并且能够在最激烈的交锋中茁壮成长。

paras.en: Find yourself in a shoot-out with these Bengals and you are likely to come out second best. Particularly against this version of Burrow.
paras.zh: 如果你发现自己正在与这些猛虎队进行点球大战，那么你很可能会获得第二名。特别是针对这个版本的陋居。

paras.en: - Rodgers backs 16-game 'NFL International Week' after Paris
paras.zh: - 罗杰斯支持巴黎奥运会后举办 16 场“NFL 国际周”

paras.en: - Latest NFL fixtures, results and UK kick-off times
paras.zh: - 最新 NFL 赛程、赛果和英国开球时间

paras.en: - Get latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: There is a growing argument this version is flirting with the best version of Burrow in his NFL career as he seeks to fulfil his own rallying cry for Championship urgency this past offseason.
paras.zh: 越来越多的人认为，这个版本正在与伯罗在 NFL 职业生涯中最好的版本调情，因为他试图在过去的休赛期实现自己对冠军紧迫性的战斗口号。

paras.en: He was insistent "this is it" as far as Cincinnati's Super Bowl quest was concerned, long-tired of slow starts and injury setbacks that have hindered their mission to get back to the 'Big Dance', where they fell short against the Los Angeles Rams four years ago.
paras.zh: 就辛辛那提的超级碗追求而言，他坚持“就是这样”，长期以来，他厌倦了缓慢的开局和伤病挫折，这些阻碍了他们重返“盛大舞会”的使命，四年前他们在这场比赛中输给了洛杉矶公羊队。

paras.en: Burrow was near-flawless on European soil as he threw for 271 yards and three touchdowns while rushing for another himself, which he capped by imitating a Neymar celebration. Whether the Brazilian icon played for Real or not, the locals enjoyed it, so too his admiration for the city's museum scene this week.
paras.zh: 伯罗在欧洲的土地上表现得近乎完美，他传出 271 码并取得 3 次达阵，同时自己也冲向另一个达阵，并模仿内马尔的庆祝动作完成了这一目标。无论这位巴西偶像是否为皇马效力，当地人都很喜欢它，本周他也对这座城市的博物馆场景表示钦佩。

paras.en: "I always whisper in his ear to be legendary. That's who he is and that's what he does," Bengals defensive tackle Dexter Lawrence told Sky Sports NFL.
paras.zh: “我总是在他耳边低声说要成为传奇。他就是这样，他就是这么做的，”孟加拉虎防守截锋德克斯特·劳伦斯告诉天空体育 NFL。

paras.en: "He's the greatest. We keep calling him a killer - he goes out there with that look in his eye and does what he's supposed to do and puts point on the board."
paras.zh: “他是最伟大的。我们一直称他为杀手——他带着那种眼神走出去，做了他应该做的事情，并在董事会上提出了观点。”

paras.en: Head coach Zac Taylor admitted after the game the difficulty in resisting temptation to make every play a passing play such has been Burrow's dominance this season. As much was evident in his reply to Atlanta's opening touchdown when he launched deep to Chase for the 47-yard touchdown that would open the floodgates for Cincinnati's command.
paras.zh: 主教练扎克·泰勒赛后承认，很难抵制让每场比赛都成为传球的诱惑，这就是伯罗本赛季的统治地位。从他对亚特兰大开局达阵的回应中可以明显看出这一点，当时他向蔡斯纵深推进47码达阵，这为辛辛那提的指挥打开了闸门。

paras.en: "When I saw that first touchdown I was like 'uh oh', it was a snowball effect," said Higgins after the game.
paras.zh: “当我看到第一次达阵时，我就想‘哦哦’，这是滚雪球效应，”希金斯赛后说道。

paras.en: It represented their 19th touchdown connection of at least 40 yards to tie Joe Montana and Jerry Rice for the third-most by a quarterback-receiver duo since 1980, behind only Peyton Manning and Marvin Harrison (21) and Steve Young and Rice (20).
paras.zh: 这是他们第 19 次至少 40 码的达阵，与乔·蒙塔纳和杰里·赖斯并列自 1980 年以来第三多四分卫接球手组合，仅次于佩顿·曼宁和马文·哈里森（21 码）以及史蒂夫·杨和赖斯（20 码）。

paras.en: It is unfair. It is rude. It should be illegal to have a Chase-Higgins pairing at the disposal of a full-flow Burrow; together they are borderline unstoppable. There was a moment during Higgins' second touchdown of the game when both myself and a colleague pointed towards Chase, who had also wriggled free in the end zone to give Burrow a dream pick-your-poison scenario.
paras.zh: 这是不公平的。这是粗鲁的。让蔡斯-希金斯组合供全流布罗使用应该是非法的；他们在一起就势不可挡。在希金斯在比赛中第二次达阵时，有一刻我和一位同事都指向蔡斯，蔡斯也在达阵区自由蠕动，给伯罗一个梦幻般的选择你的毒药的场景。

paras.en: There are defensive coordinators across the NFL that might relate to Higgins' 'uh oh' sentiment upon a Burrow-Chase union. It tends to spell trouble, and there tends to be zero remedies.
paras.zh: NFL 中的一些防守协调员可能与希金斯对 Burrow-Chase 联盟的“呃哦”情绪有关。它往往会带来麻烦，而且补救措施往往为零。

paras.en: The celebration of choice on Chase's touchdown was a matador display as Higgins played the role of charging bull, much to the delight of the Bernabeu crowd. The game's chief protagonists were winning both on the football field but also in the realm of international fandom.
paras.zh: 蔡斯触地得分的庆祝动作是一场斗牛士表演，希金斯扮演了冲锋公牛的角色，这让伯纳乌球迷非常高兴。这场比赛的主要主角不仅在足球场上获胜，而且在国际球迷领域也取得了胜利。

paras.en: "The fans liked it, 'we did it and I heard them say 'Oleeee'," Higgins said.
paras.zh: “球迷们喜欢它，‘我们做到了，我听到他们说‘奥莉’，”希金斯说。

paras.en: There are plenty more 'Oles' to follow this season for an offensive trio playing at a different level to most in the league right now. Discussion surrounding the Bengals' Super Bowl aspirations has usually come back to question marks over their defense, which is why their offseason trade for Dexter Lawrence felt like a potential needle-moving moment.
paras.zh: 本赛季还有更多的“Oles”可以追随，这支进攻三人组的水平与目前联盟中的大多数球员不同。围绕孟虎队超级碗愿望的讨论通常会回到他们的防守问题上，这就是为什么他们在休赛期交易德克斯特·劳伦斯感觉像是一个潜在的激动人心的时刻。

paras.en: The reality, though, is that defensive improvement never really needed to be needle-moving or transformative, but instead a meaningful step forward. That is courtesy of a luxury to which few can attest in a trio of Burrow, Chase and Higgins.
paras.zh: 但现实是，防守的改进从来不需要真正的针锋相对或变革，而是有意义的进步。这是一种奢侈的礼貌，很少有人能在布罗、蔡斯和希金斯三人组中证明这一点。

paras.en: Higgins is automatic with one of the safest pairs of suction hands in football and the catch radius to defy any angle or the tightest of man coverage. Chase is a demon with the ball in his hands and a single high safeties worst nightmare come true. So long as that three-headed monster remains intact, the Bengals can challenge for the Super Bowl.
paras.zh: 希金斯是自动的，拥有足球界最安全的一对吸力手和接球半径，可以抵抗任何角度或最紧密的防守。蔡斯是一个手里有球的恶魔，一个高安全性最糟糕的噩梦成真了。只要那个三头怪物完好无损，孟加拉虎队就可以挑战超级碗。

paras.en: - Patrick Mahomes is seemingly indestructible. Robert Saleh - the now Tennessee Titans head coach - once said of the Kansas City Chiefs QB: "Don't be fooled by his little old man jog".
paras.zh: - 帕特里克·马霍姆斯看似坚不可摧。现任田纳西泰坦队主教练罗伯特·萨利赫曾经这样评价堪萨斯城酋长队四分卫：“不要被他的小老头慢跑所愚弄”。

paras.en: - The three-time Super Bowl winner played through a high ankle sprain in leading KC back from a double-digit deficit to beat the Philadelphia Eagles to one of those titles, while he also overcame turf toe to reach another Super Bowl (which they would lose to Tom Brady's Tampa Bay Buccaneers).
paras.zh: - 这位三届超级碗冠军在脚踝高位扭伤的情况下带领 KC 从两位数落后的局面中逆转，击败费城老鹰队夺得其中一个冠军，同时他还克服了草皮脚趾问题，再次进入超级碗（最终输给了汤姆·布雷迪的坦帕湾海盗队）。

paras.en: - When it looks like this man might be done, he is not. And that was very much the case again on Sunday when Mahomes' throwing arm appeared to be badly injured on a strip-sack by the New York Jets' David Bailey just before half-time - the Chiefs only leading 14-12 at the time.
paras.zh: - 当这个人看起来可能已经完蛋时，他却没有。周日的情况也是如此，半场结束前，马霍姆斯的投球手臂似乎被纽约喷气机队的大卫·贝利 (David Bailey) 擒杀而严重受伤，当时酋长队仅以 14-12 领先。

paras.en: - There were some hugely concerned faces on the sideline, none more so than the man himself, as well as tight end buddy Travis Kelce. But, incredibly, after a bit of treatment, No 15 was ready to go again, leading his team on a second-half tear to secure a comfortable 23-point victory in the end.
paras.zh: - 场边有一些非常担忧的面孔，其中最重要的是那个人本人，还有近端锋好友特拉维斯·凯尔斯。但令人难以置信的是，经过一番治疗后，15 号球员已经准备好再次出发，带领球队在下半场大放异彩，最终以 23 分轻松获胜。

paras.en: - The New York Giants are seemingly eyeing a trade for Indianapolis Colts running back Jonathan Taylor, with Big Blue head coach John Harbaugh saying "those conversations are taking place".
paras.zh: - 纽约巨人队似乎正在考虑交易印第安纳波利斯小马队跑卫乔纳森·泰勒，蓝色巨人队主教练约翰·哈博表示“这些对话正在进行中”。

paras.en: - Fox Sports reported on Sunday morning that the Giants had already offered the Colts second and fifth-round draft picks for Taylor, which has not yet got the deal done.
paras.zh: - 福克斯体育周日上午报道称，巨人队已经向小马队提供了泰勒的第二轮和第五轮选秀权，但该交易尚未完成。

paras.en: - But the Giants, currently in the driver's seat in the NFC East, are keen to get a deal done with Cam Skattebo (hamstring) missing Sunday's win over the Philadelphia Eagles, Tyrone Tracy Jr (hamstring) on injured reserve and Devin Singletary returning only 31 yards on 21 carries in Philly.
paras.zh: - 但目前在 NFC 东区占据主导地位的巨人队渴望与 Cam Skattebo（腿筋）达成交易，因为 Cam Skattebo（腿筋）缺席了周日战胜费城老鹰队的比赛，Tyrone Tracy Jr（腿筋）因受伤而处于预备队，而 Devin Singletary 在费城的 21 次冲球中仅返回 31 码。

paras.en: - Taylor, meanwhile, acknowledged he might have played his last game in Indy. "This place helped shape me into the man I am today, so I'm very grateful," Taylor said after their home loss to the Dallas Cowboys. "If it is [my last game], I'm very grateful for the city of Indianapolis."
paras.zh: - 与此同时，泰勒承认他可能已经在印地打了最后一场比赛。 “这个地方帮助我成为了今天的我，所以我非常感激，”泰勒在主场输给达拉斯牛仔队后说道。 “如果这是[我的最后一场比赛]，我非常感谢印第安纳波利斯市。”

paras.en: - The trade deadline is on Tuesday November 10.
paras.zh: - 交易截止日期为 11 月 10 日星期二。

paras.en: The Bengals do not need to trade for Jonathan Taylor. 'Need' is a strong word, and there are two sides to the equation when it comes to a potential move for a star running back. Cincinnati want the ball in the hands of their quarterback as much as humanly possible - would it be right and would it be wise to add a centre-piece running back to a scheme that is not only built but functions on shot-gun aerial bombardment?
paras.zh: 孟加拉虎队不需要交易乔纳森·泰勒。 “需要”是一个很强烈的词，当谈到明星跑卫的潜在转会时，有两个方面的因素。辛辛那提队希望球尽可能多地掌握在他们的四分卫手中——在一个不仅是建立起来的、而且在霰弹枪空中轰炸中发挥作用的方案中添加一名中锋跑卫是正确的还是明智的？

paras.en: The other side is the Thanos 'final Infinity Stone' notion to pairing Taylor with Burrow, Chase and Higgins, which becomes every bit the Avengers of NFL offenses and the kind capable of steamrolling its way to a Super Bowl appearance. Taylor is a field-flipper and an immediate difference-maker - but how different do you really want this offense to look?
paras.zh: 另一面是灭霸的“最终无限宝石”概念，将泰勒与伯罗、蔡斯和希金斯配对，这完全成为了 NFL 进攻中的复仇者联盟，并且能够一路碾压进入超级碗。泰勒是一名投篮手，也是一个立竿见影的创造者——但你真的希望这次进攻看起来有多大不同呢？

paras.en: Chase Brown barely gets a sniff in comparison to other backs around the league; when the Bengals did call on his number in Madrid he helped pave the way for Higgins' second touchdown catch. Sure, it would be box office. But to say the Bengals need him would be a disservice to just how good their prized trio are.
paras.zh: 与联盟其他后卫相比，蔡斯·布朗几乎没有受到任何关注。当猛虎队在马德里拨通他的电话号码时，他帮助希金斯第二次达阵接球铺平了道路。当然，这将是票房。但如果说孟加拉虎队需要他，那对他们珍贵的三人组的优秀程度来说是一种伤害。

paras.en: Myles Garrett: A warm welcome back to the Rams for Mr Myles Garrett. Los Angeles' 20-13 road win over the Washington Commanders has them over .500 for the first time in a season which they were expected to dominate - in large part due to their blockbuster offseason addition of the two-time NFL Defensive Player of the Year, who has been missing due to injury since their season opener.
paras.zh: 迈尔斯·加勒特：热烈欢迎迈尔斯·加勒特先生回到公羊队。洛杉矶队以 20-13 客场战胜华盛顿指挥官队，这让他们在本赛季中首次超过 0.500 分，他们原本有望占据统治地位，这在很大程度上是因为他们休赛期引进了两届 NFL 年度最佳防守球员，后者自赛季揭幕战以来就因伤缺席。

paras.en: But he is back, and with a vengeance, as he returned three sacks against the Commanders, the first of which being a forced fumble. Finally paired with three-time DPOY Aaron Donald on the defensive line, the Rams having won three straight, maybe a Super Bowl run could still be on the cards?
paras.zh: 但他又回来了，而且是复仇般的回归，他对指挥官们完成了三次擒杀，其中第一次是一次被迫掉球。最后在防守线上与三届最佳防守球员亚伦·唐纳德搭档，公羊队取得了三连胜，也许还有机会冲击超级碗？

paras.en: Christian Watson and Matthew Golden: The Green Bay Packers are explosive on offense! And the great beneficiaries of Jordan Love continuing to air it out - and coach Matt LaFleur laying the table for him to do so - are receivers Christian Watson and Matthew Golden.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂安·沃森和马修·戈尔登：绿湾包装工队的进攻极具爆发力！乔丹·洛夫继续传球的最大受益者——教练马特·拉弗勒尔为他这样做做好了准备——是接球手克里斯蒂安·沃森和马修·戈尔登。

paras.en: Watson came down with 171 yards and a score off seven catches, while Golden 164 off 10 grabs and too found the end zone - career highs for both - as Green Bay put up 45 points on a Pats defense that practically carried them through the playoffs and to the Super Bowl last season. Don't sleep on the Packers.
paras.zh: 沃森 (Watson) 取得 171 码，7 次接球得分，而戈尔登 (Golden) 10 次接球 164 码，也找到了达阵区——两人的职业生涯新高——绿湾队在爱国者队的防守下拿下 45 分，几乎带领他们进入了季后赛并进入了上赛季的超级碗。不要睡在包装工队身上。

paras.en: The Chargers gonna keep Chargering. If you thought it could not get any worse for head coach Jim Harbaugh, OC Mike McDaniel, QB Justin Herbert and the still-winless Chargers, you would be wrong!
paras.zh: 闪电队将继续充电。如果你认为主教练吉姆·哈博、OC 迈克·麦克丹尼尔、四分卫贾斯汀·赫伯特和仍未获胜的闪电队的情况不会变得更糟，那你就错了！

paras.en: This Los Angeles offense stinks! Do not let a couple of fourth-quarter, garbage-time touchdowns fool you. The Chargers were trailing 38-9 prior, notching three field goals to go with four punts, an interception, turnover on downs and fumble from their other offensive series.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶的进攻太臭了！不要让第四节垃圾时间的几次达阵愚弄了你。闪电队此前以 38-9 落后，在其他进攻系列赛中投进 3 个球，并有 4 次弃踢、1 次拦截、失误和掉球。

paras.en: They are now 0-8 on a truly dismal season.
paras.zh: 他们现在战绩为0胜8负，这是一个真正惨淡的赛季。

paras.en: Dan Quinn: In a Washington Commanders season defined by late offensive blunders or clock mismanagement, their head coach might well have dropped the ball once more to potentially signal curtains for him in the country's capital.
paras.zh: 丹·奎因：在华盛顿指挥官队的赛季中，由于进攻失误或时钟管理不善，他们的主教练很可能再次丢球，这可能预示着他在首都的落幕。

paras.en: Down seven, on the final play of their loss to the Los Angeles Rams - set up just beyond their opponents' 30-yard line - the Commanders opted to go for a short pass followed by a couple of lame attempts at laterals, rather than take a shot at the end zone.
paras.zh: 落后七分，在输给洛杉矶公羊队的最后一场比赛中——比赛地点就在对手的 30 码线外——指挥官们选择短传，随后进行了几次横向的蹩脚尝试，而不是在达阵区射门。

paras.en: After the game, Quinn admitted he was "not happy with the execution of that play".
paras.zh: 赛后，奎因承认他“对那场比赛的执行并不满意”。

paras.en: Well, file it alongside Jayden Daniels' sack in the dying seconds of overtime as their Week Five game against the New York Giants ended in a tie, as well as Quinn seeming to forget what down it was a week later in the loss to the San Francisco 49ers.
paras.zh: 好吧，将其与杰登·丹尼尔斯在加时赛最后几秒的擒杀一起归档，第五周对阵纽约巨人队的比赛以平局结束，而奎因似乎忘记了一周后输给旧金山 49 人队时的情况。

paras.en: Player of the Weekend - Arvell Reese, LB, New York Giants
paras.zh: 周末最佳球员 - Arvell Reese，LB，纽约巨人队

paras.en: The Philadelphia Eagles are there to be preyed on at the moment, and the New York Giants willingly obliged. Linebacker Arvell Reese in particular feasted to bolster his Defensive Rookie of the Year campaign, logging three sacks, 12 tackles, three tackles for loss, a forced fumble, four pressures and three quarterback hits to torment Eagles back-up quarterback Joe Milton in a 19-11 victory. His 2.29 seconds to sack marked the fastest time in the NFL this season, according to Next Gen Stats. The Giants have a superstar stalwart on their hands.
paras.zh: 费城老鹰队目前正在等待被猎杀，纽约巨人队也乐意效仿。线卫阿维尔·里斯（Arvell Reese）尤其为自己的年度最佳防守新秀助威，他完成了 3 次擒杀、12 次铲断、3 次丢球铲断、1 次强行掉球、4 次施压和 3 次四分卫安打，折磨老鹰队替补四分卫乔·米尔顿 (Joe Milton)，帮助球队以 19-11 获胜。根据 Next Gen Stats 的数据，他的擒杀时间为 2.29 秒，这是本赛季 NFL 最快的时间。巨人队手上有一位超级巨星。

paras.en: Sean Payton's Denver Broncos only know how to win close games. In fact, Sunday's 26-21 victory over the Carolina Panthers means they have now won 16 straight one-score games.
paras.zh: 肖恩·佩顿的丹佛野马队只知道如何赢得势均力敌的比赛。事实上，周日以 26-21 战胜卡罗莱纳黑豹队意味着他们现在已经连续 16 场以一分的比分获胜。

paras.en: The Broncos survived late when Nik Bonitto strip-sacked Bryce Young and recovered the loose fumble with 1.24 remaining, before Bo Nix clinched the win with a quarterback sneak on third down.
paras.zh: 野马队在比赛最后时刻幸存下来，尼克·博尼托 (Nik Bonitto) 解雇了布莱斯·杨 (Bryce Young)，并在还剩 1.24 秒时追回了失球，随后​​博·尼克斯 (Bo Nix) 在第三次落后时凭借四分卫偷袭锁定了胜利。

paras.en: It was what has become typical late Broncos drama. Denver had trailed by one point entering the fourth quarter, meaning it would become their fifth victory of the year after trailing in the fourth. For a large part of the game Young had been sizzling, only to be hit by Broncos defiance.
paras.zh: 这已经成为野马队晚期的典型戏剧。丹佛进入第四节时落后一分，这意味着这将是他们在第四节落后后今年的第五场胜利。在比赛的大部分时间里，杨一直表现得很火爆，结果却遭到了野马队的反抗。
