articles.title: Baumgardner outclasses Turhan to win lightweight world title

paras.en: Alycia Baumgardner outclasses Elif Nur Turhan to become two-weight world champion, winning IBF lightweight title
paras.zh: 阿莉西亚·鲍姆加德纳 (Alycia Baumgardner) 击败埃利夫·努尔·图尔汗 (Elif Nur Turhan) 成为两量级世界冠军，赢得 IBF 轻量级冠军

paras.en: Alycia Baumgardner dominated Elif Tur Nurhan to win the IBF world lightweight title; her war of words with British rival Caroline Dubois continued after the fight; Baumgardner is now a two-weight world champion after beating a hard puncher who had never lost before
paras.zh: 阿莉西亚·鲍姆加德纳 (Alycia Baumgardner) 力压埃利夫·图尔·努尔汉 (Elif Tur Nurhan) 夺得 IBF 轻量级世界冠军；比赛结束后，她与英国竞争对手卡罗琳·杜波依斯的口水战仍在继续。鲍姆加德纳击败了一位以前从未输过的重拳手，现在成为了两重量级世界冠军

paras.en: Alycia Baumgardner, an undisputed world champion at super-featherweight, moved up to lightweight to capture the IBF world title when she shut out Elif Tur Nurhan in Texas.
paras.zh: 阿莉西亚·鲍姆加德纳 (Alycia Baumgardner) 是无可争议的超羽量级世界冠军，在德克萨斯州击败艾利夫·图尔·努尔汉 (Elif Tur Nurhan) 后，她晋升到轻量级，夺得了 IBF 世界冠军。

paras.en: Baumgardner won a unanimous decision after 10 rounds as she overcame Nurhan at College Park Center in Arlington.
paras.zh: 鲍姆加德纳在阿灵顿大学公园中心击败努尔汉，经过 10 轮比赛一致判定获胜。

paras.en: The American won 100-90 on all three cards, beating a hard puncher who had never lost before.
paras.zh: 美国人三张牌都以100-90获胜，击败了一位从未输过的重拳手。

paras.en: Baumgardner hurt Turhan at times, shaking her up in the third and seventh rounds.
paras.zh: 鲍姆加德纳有时会伤害图尔汗，在第三轮和第七轮中让她摇晃。

paras.en: She poured in punches, with Nurhan feeling the weight of those attacks in the ninth round. Nurhan went the distance but, despite her punch power, could not threaten Baumgardner.
paras.zh: 她猛烈地出拳，努尔汗在第九回合中感受到了这些攻击的重量。努尔汉打出了很远的距离，但尽管她的拳力强劲，但无法威胁到鲍姆加德纳。

paras.en: Now the IBF champion, Baumgardner looks to be on a collision course with Caroline Dubois, who fights Stephanie Han for the WBA, WBC and WBO 135lb titles on February 20, live on Sky Sports.
paras.zh: 现在已是 IBF 冠军的鲍姆加德纳看起来将与卡罗琳·杜波依斯展开对决，卡罗琳·杜波依斯将于 2 月 20 日在天空体育直播中与斯蒂芬妮·汉争夺 WBA、WBC 和 WBO 135 磅冠军头衔。

paras.en: Baumgardner and Dubois have clashed before and the Briton was ringside in Texas. Their war of words continued after the American's latest win. "Are we going to fight?" Dubois demanded.
paras.zh: 鲍姆加德纳和杜波依斯之前曾发生过冲突，英国人当时就在德克萨斯州的场边。在美国人最近获胜后，他们的口水战仍在继续。 “我们要打架吗？”杜波依斯问道。

paras.en: "You've got a champ right there in front of you," Baumgardner warned.
paras.zh: “冠军就在你面前，”鲍姆加德纳警告说。

paras.en: Ramla Ali took a contentious split-decision victory over Mikiah Kreps to win the WBO and IBF super-bantamweight titles.
paras.zh: 拉姆拉·阿里（Ramla Ali）以争议性的分歧判定战胜了米基亚·克雷普斯（Mikiah Kreps），赢得了 WBO 和 IBF 超轻量级冠军。

paras.en: Ali started sharply and knocked Kreps down with a right hook right on the chin in the third round. From then on, though, Kreps maintained real pressure on Ali and the two finished trading punches before the final bell.
paras.zh: 阿里起步迅速，在第三回合中用一记右勾拳打倒了克雷普斯的下巴。不过，从那时起，克雷普斯继续对阿里施加真正的压力，两人在终场钟声前完成了对打。

paras.en: Kreps won widely, 98-91, for one judge but Ali took it 96-93 and 97-92 on the other two cards.
paras.zh: 克雷普斯在一名裁判中以 98-91 获胜，但阿里在另外两张牌上以 96-93 和 97-92 获胜。

paras.en: It was an emotional victory for Ali, whose family had to flee Somalia when she was a child and settled in London. She dedicated the victory to the memory of her father who passed away earlier this year.
paras.zh: 对于阿里来说，这是一次情感上的胜利，当她还是个孩子的时候，她的家人不得不逃离索马里并定居在伦敦。她将这场胜利献给了今年早些时候去世的父亲。

paras.en: Skye Nicolson defended the WBC super-bantamweight title, beating Japan's Miyo Yoshida, winning a unanimous decision on a dominant display.
paras.zh: 斯凯·尼科尔森击败日本选手吉田美代，以压倒性的优势赢得了一致判定，卫冕了WBC超轻量级拳王头衔。

paras.en: Nicolson took the victory 100-90, 99-91 and 98-92.

Unbeaten prospect Albina Moldazhanova knocked out former European champion Kirstie Bavington, subjecting her to heavy punishment before landing a right hook in the fourth round to finish it inside the distance. Moldazhanova has a 100 per cent knockout ratio after six pro fights.
paras.zh: 不败的新星阿尔比娜·莫尔达扎诺娃（Albina Moldazzanova）淘汰了前欧洲冠军基尔斯蒂·巴文顿（Kirstie Bavington），她受到了严厉的惩罚，然后在第四轮中右勾拳将球打入远距离。摩尔达扎诺娃在六场职业比赛后拥有 100% 的击倒率。

paras.en: Watch Caroline Dubois vs Stephanie Han on February 20, live on Sky Sports.
paras.zh: 观看 2 月 20 日天空体育直播的 Caroline Dubois 对阵 Stephanie Han 的比赛。

articles.title: Gauff survives Pegula test to win all-American thriller at WTA Finals

paras.en: WTA Finals: Coco Gauff defeats Jessica Pegula in thriller at Indian Wells as Linda Noskova beats Marta Kostyuk
paras.zh: WTA 决赛：可可·高芙 (Coco Gauff) 在印第安维尔斯 (Indian Wells) 惊悚片中击败杰西卡·佩古拉 (Jessica Pegula)，琳达·诺斯科娃 (Linda Noskova) 击败玛塔·科斯图克 (Marta Kostyuk)

paras.en: Coco Gauff overcomes Jessica Pegula with a dominant third-set display to open her WTA Finals campaign with victory as Linda Noskova beats Marta Kostyuk; you can watch the WTA Finals from Indian Wells this week on Sky Sports Tennis
paras.zh: 可可·高芙 (Coco Gauff) 在第三盘中凭借统治力的表现战胜了杰西卡·佩古拉 (Jessica Pegula)，琳达·诺斯科娃 (Linda Noskova) 击败了玛尔塔·科斯特尤克 (Marta Kostyuk)，以胜利开启了她的 WTA 总决赛征程；您可以在天空体育网球频道观看本周印第安维尔斯举行的 WTA 总决赛

paras.en: Coco Gauff shredded her shoes but stayed one step ahead of Jessica Pegula to defeat her compatriot 6-4 6-7 (5-7) 6-2 on the opening day of the WTA Finals at Indian Wells, while Czech Linda Noskova got the better of Marta Kostyuk 6-2 6-4.
paras.zh: 在印第安维尔斯举行的 WTA 总决赛首日，可可·高芙 (Coco Gauff) 撕碎了鞋子，但仍领先杰西卡·佩古拉 (Jessica Pegula) 一步，以 6-4 6-7 (5-7) 6-2 击败了同胞，而捷克琳达·诺斯科娃 (Linda Noskova) 以 6-2 6-4 击败了玛塔·科斯特尤克 (Marta Kostyuk)。

paras.en: Gauff had beaten Pegula three months ago in Cincinnati and had the right formula once again, as the 2024 winner showed superb versatility in a round-robin clash between the top two Americans in the season-ending championship.
paras.zh: 高夫三个月前在辛辛那提击败了佩古拉，并再次拥有了正确的公式，这位 2024 年冠军在季末锦标赛中美国排名前两名的循环赛中展现了出色的多才多艺。

paras.en: World No 4 Gauff took the opener and recovered from 5-1 down in the second to come within a point of winning in straight sets.
paras.zh: 世界排名第四的高夫率先拿下首盘，并在第二局从1-5落后的情况下追平比分，直落两盘获胜。

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract on NOW📱
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播现在📱

paras.en: But it was Pegula's turn to dig in from 5-6, saving a match point and then playing a terrific tie-break to extend the contest at Indian Wells.
paras.zh: 但5-6轮到佩古拉发力，挽救一个赛点，然后打出精彩的抢七，将印第安维尔斯的比赛延长。

paras.en: Gauff took charge of the match in the third set, breaking to lead 3-0 before earning her sixth win against Pegula after two hours and 39 minutes.
paras.zh: 高夫在第三盘中掌控了比赛，以3-0领先，并在耗时2小时39分钟后第六次战胜佩古拉。

paras.en: Pegula would probably have been grateful to get the tennis under way after her viral and awkward 'hot mic' moment when disparaging comments she made about fellow player Mirra Andreeva to her coach during a training session were picked up on a livestream.
paras.zh: 佩古拉可能会很感激能够让网球比赛重新开始，因为她在训练课上向教练发表的对队友米拉·安德烈娃的贬低言论在直播中被拍到，当时她的“热麦克风”瞬间被疯传，尴尬的“热麦克风”时刻也开始了。

paras.en: That prompted a grovelling apology from the WTA, which admitted it had not told players the microphones were on, and damage control behind the scenes from Pegula.
paras.zh: 这促使 WTA 卑躬屈膝地道歉，并承认自己没有告诉球员麦克风已经打开，而佩古拉则在幕后进行了损害控制。

paras.en: The world No 5 had compared Andreeva's mentality unfavourably with Gauff's in her indiscreet comments, and the two-time Grand Slam champion set about showing her competitive grit, clawing her way back with five games in a row, including saving three set points.
paras.zh: 世界排名第五的安德烈耶娃在不检点的评论中将安德烈耶娃的心态与高夫进行了不利的比较，这位两届大满贯冠军开始展现出她的竞争勇气，连续五场比赛扳回一城，其中包括挽救三个盘点。

paras.en: Sometime doubles partners Gauff and Pegula had shared their 10 previous meetings, while this was the fourth year in a row they were meeting at the WTA Finals.
paras.zh: 有时双打搭档高夫和佩古拉曾有过10次交锋，而这是他们连续第四年在WTA年终总决赛上交锋。

paras.en: "Honestly, I was having a lot of fun today. I took a little break, it was my first match in a month," said Gauff, who was last in action at the China Open in early October.
paras.zh: “说实话，我今天玩得很开心。我休息了一会儿，这是我一个月来的第一场比赛，”高夫说，他最后一次参加中国公开赛是在十月初。

paras.en: "To play a tournament like this with no preparation is something I've never done in my career. I'm just really happy to get through today. It was a tough match."
paras.zh: “在没有任何准备的情况下参加这样的比赛是我职业生涯中从未做过的事情。我真的很高兴今天能够通过。这是一场艰难的比赛。”

paras.en: The 22-year-old said she had to be aggressive to deal with Pegula's game.
paras.zh: 这位 22 岁的球员表示，她必须积极进攻才能应对佩古拉的比赛。

paras.en: "I also had to run a lot," she added. "My shoes are pretty torn up now. Some of my shoes are like somewhere on the court there, so I'm going to have to change shoes tomorrow."
paras.zh: “我还必须经常跑步，”她补充道。 “我的鞋子现在已经破烂了。我的一些鞋子就像球场上的某个地方一样，所以我明天必须换鞋。”

paras.en: Earlier, Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova marked her debut by beating alternate Marta Kostyuk 6-2 6-4 in her opening round-robin game.
paras.zh: 此前，温网冠军琳达·诺斯科娃在首场循环赛中以 6-2 6-4 击败替补选手玛塔·科斯特尤克，完成了自己的首秀。

paras.en: Kostyuk is standing in for No 1 seed Elena Rybakina after the Kazakh withdrew a day before the tournament citing a medical issue, and got off to an understandably slow start, as Noskova broke her serve at the second time of asking before winning four of the next five games in a dominant first-set performance.
paras.zh: 科斯秋克将接替一号种子埃琳娜·雷巴基娜，哈萨克人在比赛前一天因健康问题退赛，开局缓慢是可以理解的，诺斯科娃在第二次发球时破发，随后在首盘占据统治地位的表现中赢得了接下来五场比赛中的四场。

paras.en: Kostyuk made a stronger start in the second set, wining her first two games on serve, but a Noskova break put the No 8 seed ahead 4-2, and her Ukranian opponent's missed opportunity to break back at 4-3 down proved costly, with the Czech winning her next two service games and securing the straight-sets victory.
paras.zh: 科斯特尤克在第二盘中取得了强势，赢得了前两场发球局，但诺斯科娃的破发让八号种子以4-2领先，而她的乌克兰对手在4-3落后的情况下错失了破发机会，代价高昂，捷克人赢得了接下来的两个发球局并确保了直落两盘的胜利。

paras.en: "My main focus was myself," Noskova told Sky Sports. "Marta is a very difficult opponent, because she never gives up, but I felt like I had the match under control the whole time.
paras.zh: “我主要关注的是我自己，”诺斯科娃告诉天空体育。 “玛塔是一个非常难对付的对手，因为她从不放弃，但我感觉比赛一直在我的掌控之中。

paras.en: "I've played against Marta a few times now, so I know that I have to be as aggressive as possible against Marta. She is very fast, plays a lot of great volleys and tricky points. Against her, it's very tough to get that last point over the net."
paras.zh: “我已经和玛塔交手过几次了，所以我知道我必须尽可能地对玛塔表现出侵略性。她速度非常快，打出了很多精彩的截击和棘手的得分。对阵她，要在网前获得最后一分是非常困难的。”

articles.title: U.S. Marine dies in Japan during training, military says
articles.author: Adela Suliman

paras.en: A U.S. Marine has died in Japan following a “training incident,” the military said in a statement Wednesday.
paras.zh: 军方周三在一份声明中表示，一名美国海军陆战队员在日本发生“训练事件”后死亡。

paras.en: The unnamed Marine was undertaking training at Camp Schwab in Okinawa, Japan’s southernmost prefecture, the statement said. The area is home to a large U.S. military presence and bases that serve as a regional hub in the Indo-Pacific.
paras.zh: 声明称，这名未透露姓名的海军陆战队员正在日本最南端冲绳县的施瓦布军营接受训练。该地区拥有大量美国军事存在和基地，是印度-太平洋地区的区域中心。

paras.en: The Marine, who was with the 3rd Marine Division, died Tuesday and will not be named until 24 hours after the individual’s family has been notified, the 3rd Marine Division said in a statement Wednesday.
paras.zh: 海军陆战队第三师周三在一份声明中表示，这名海军陆战队士兵于周二去世，在通知其家人 24 小时后，他的姓名才会被公布。

paras.en: “It is with heavy hearts that 3rd Marine Division announces the death of a Marine following a training incident at Camp Schwab, Okinawa, Japan, on Nov. 3, 2026,” the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“海军陆战队第三师怀着沉重的心情宣布一名海军陆战队员在 2026 年 11 月 3 日日本冲绳施瓦布军营发生训练事件后死亡。”

paras.en: “The circumstances surrounding the incident remain under investigation,” it added. “We express our deepest condolences to the family and loved ones of our Marine.”
paras.zh: “事件相关情况仍在调查中，”它补充道。 “我们向我们海军陆战队的家人和亲人表示最深切的哀悼。”

paras.en: Okinawa was under U.S. occupation following World War II until it was handed back to Japan in 1972. Today, the U.S. population on the island is nearly 80,000, with nearly 30,000 being active-duty troops from all four branches of the armed forces, though the Marines make up the bulk of the forces.
paras.zh: 冲绳岛在第二次世界大战后一直处于美国占领之下，直到 1972 年被交还给日本。如今，岛上的美国人口接近 80,000 人，其中近 30,000 人是来自武装部队所有四个军种的现役军人，不过海军陆战队占了部队的主体。

paras.en: Separately, Secretary of State Marco Rubio last month pledged to cooperate with Japanese authorities investigating allegations that a U.S. Marine murdered a woman in Okinawa. The case sparked widespread protests and led to a U.S. military curfew and mandatory training in standards and discipline.
paras.zh: 另外，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥上个月承诺与日本当局合作，调查一名美国海军陆战队员在冲绳谋杀一名妇女的指控。此案引发了广泛的抗议，并导致美国实行军事宵禁以及强制标准和纪律培训。

paras.en: Lt. Gen. Benjamin Watson, commander of the III Marine Expeditionary Force, said at the time that serving on the Japanese island “comes with responsibility.”
paras.zh: 美国海军陆战队第三远征军司令本杰明·沃森中将当时表示，在日本岛上服役“伴随着责任”。

articles.title: Wave of bomb threats against European airliners triggers diversions and tarmac searches
articles.author: Matteo Moschella

paras.en: LONDON — A wave of bomb threats against passenger airliners caused chaos in the skies and airports of Europe on Thursday, the latest of such incidents this week that have prompted emergency landings and security sweeps on runways.
paras.zh: 伦敦——周四，针对客机的一波炸弹威胁在欧洲天空和机场造成混乱，这是本周发生的最新一起此类事件，引发了紧急着陆和跑道安全扫描。

paras.en: No explosives have so far been found, and it is not clear who or what is behind the security threats made against at least 14 airliners. But the threats have caused disruption to Europe’s airspace and some of its busiest airports.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，尚未发现爆炸物，也不清楚谁或什么是针对至少 14 架客机的安全威胁的幕后黑手。但这些威胁已经对欧洲领空和一些最繁忙的机场造成了干扰。

paras.en: The threats against two flights that landed in Rome came by email that cited opposition to “your feminist regime,” the airport confirmed to NBC News. Italy’s prime minister, Giorgia Meloni, is a woman who has conservative views.
paras.zh: 机场向 NBC 新闻证实，针对降落在罗马的两架航班的威胁是通过电子邮件发出的，其中提到反对“你们的女权主义政权”。 Italy’s prime minister, Giorgia Meloni, is a woman who has conservative views.

paras.en: One of the first reports involved Aer Lingus Flight EI402 from Dublin to Rome, which changed course near Paris and diverted to a French air force base, the airline said. There, all 151 passengers and six crewmembers were evacuated while a bomb squad inspected the aircraft, French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu’s office said in a statement.
paras.zh: 爱尔兰航空公司表示，首批报告之一涉及从都柏林飞往罗马的 EI402 航班，该航班在巴黎附近改变航线并改道飞往法国空军基地。法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努 (Sébastien Lecornu) 办公室在一份声明中表示，在拆弹小组检查飞机时，所有 151 名乘客和 6 名机组人员均已撤离。

paras.en: - Aer Lingus EI402 from Dublin to Rome — received bomb threat over France, made emergency landing at air base and inspected by bomb squad, according to airline and French officials.
paras.zh: - 据航空公司和法国官员称，从都柏林飞往罗马的爱尔兰航空 EI402 在法国上空收到炸弹威胁，紧急降落在空军基地并接受拆弹小组检查。

paras.en: - Finnair AY1761 from Helsinki, Finland, to Rome Fiumicino — escorted into Rome by Italian air force jets, bomb squad search found no explosives, airline said.
paras.zh: - 芬兰航空 AY1761 从芬兰赫尔辛基飞往罗马菲乌米奇诺 — 航空公司表示，在意大利空军喷气机的护送下飞往罗马，拆弹小组搜查后没有发现爆炸物。

paras.en: - Finnair AY1471 from Helsinki to Vienna — also received bomb threat, likewise no explosives found, according to airline.
paras.zh: - 据航空公司称，从赫尔辛基飞往维也纳的芬兰航空 AY1471 航班也收到炸弹威胁，同样没有发现爆炸物。

paras.en: - LOT Polish Airlines LO235 from Warsaw, Poland, to Brussels — crew made midair checks after receiving threat, "additional screening" once in Brussels found no "suspicious items," airline said.
paras.zh: -从波兰华沙到布鲁塞尔的波兰航空公司LOT LO235 —机组人员在收到威胁后进行了空中检查，一旦在布鲁塞尔发现没有“可疑物品” ，航空公司表示。

paras.en: - LOT Polish Airlines LO331 from Warsaw to Paris — stopped while taxiing and directed to parking stand where searched, airline said. Passengers continued on trips after switching planes.
paras.zh: - 波兰航空公司表示，从华沙飞往巴黎的LO331航班在滑行时停下来，并被引导至接受搜查的停车位。乘客转机后继续旅行。

paras.en: - Ryanair FR3606 from Copenhagen, Denmark, to Sofia, Bulgaria, and Ryanair FR6410 from Madrid to Sofia — both landed normally following bomb threat, no explosives found, according to Bulgarian Transport Ministry.
paras.zh: - 保加利亚交通部表示，从丹麦哥本哈根飞往保加利亚索非亚的瑞安航空 FR3606 航班和从马德里飞往索非亚的瑞安航空 FR6410 航班均在炸弹威胁后正常着陆，未发现爆炸物。

paras.en: - Ryanair FR1730 from London Stansted to Sofia — also received a bomb threat and diverted to Plovdiv, Bulgaria, the Bulgarian Transport Ministry said.
paras.zh: 保加利亚交通部表示，从伦敦斯坦斯特德飞往索非亚的瑞安航空 FR1730 航班也收到炸弹威胁，并改道飞往保加利亚普罗夫迪夫。

paras.en: - Wizz Air WMT3064 from Milan to Bucharest — airport said it was notified of the bomb threat as flight was arriving, bomb squad found nothing.
paras.zh: - Wizz Air WMT3064 从米兰飞往布加勒斯特 — 机场表示，在航班抵达时接到炸弹威胁通知，拆弹小组什么也没发现。

paras.en: - Czech police say four unidentified flights headed for Prague also received threats.
paras.zh: - 捷克警方表示，四架飞往布拉格的不明航班也受到了威胁。

paras.en: From there, reports of threats in the skies over Europe arrived at a dizzying pace, triggering searches by cabin crews and then again by airport security crews on the ground.
paras.zh: 从那里开始，有关欧洲上空威胁的报告以令人眼花缭乱的速度传来，引发了机组人员的搜查，然后又引发了地面机场保安人员的搜查。

paras.en: Security operations were launched at airports in Prague; Copenhagen, Denmark; and Warsaw, Poland, where passengers saw the military and police sniffer dogs patrolling the tarmac.
paras.zh: 布拉格机场启动了安全行动；丹麦哥本哈根；波兰华沙，乘客看到军警嗅探犬在停机坪上巡逻。

paras.en: “It is too early to draw conclusions on whether the reported incidents are linked,” Apostolos Tzitzikostas, the European commissioner for sustainable transport and tourism, said at a news conference in Brussels.
paras.zh: 欧盟可持续交通和旅游业专员阿波斯托洛斯·齐齐科斯塔斯在布鲁塞尔举行的新闻发布会上表示：“现在就所报道的事件是否存在关联得出结论还为时过早。”

paras.en: British Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander appealed for calm, telling Sky News, “We have established processes for dealing with hoax and malicious threats, and that’s what these threats have been.”
paras.zh: 英国交通大臣海蒂·亚历山大呼吁保持冷静，她告诉天空新闻，“我们已经建立了处理恶作剧和恶意威胁的流程，而这些威胁就是这样的。”

paras.en: Italian air force jets escorted a Finnair flight from Helsinki to Rome’s Fiumicino Airport “following anonymous reports of a suspected bomb threat,” said a spokesperson for the city’s airport authority. Bomb disposal experts found nothing.
paras.zh: 罗马机场管理局发言人表示，“在收到疑似炸弹威胁的匿名报告后”，意大利空军喷气式飞机护送一架从赫尔辛基飞往罗马菲乌米奇诺机场的芬兰航空航班。拆弹专家什么也没发现。

paras.en: “Unfortunately, air traffic is sometimes subject to threats, as we have seen this week, when other airlines in Europe have also faced hoax bomb threats,” a Finnair spokesperson, Stiina Tuunanen, said in an email. “Threats are almost always unfounded.”
paras.zh: 芬兰航空发言人 Stiina Tuunanen 在一封电子邮件中表示：“不幸的是，空中交通有时会受到威胁，正如我们本周所看到的那样，欧洲其他航空公司也面临着恶作剧炸弹威胁。” “威胁几乎总是毫无根据的。”

paras.en: That was also the case for another Finnair flight from Helsinki to Vienna, whose threat was found to be baseless after it landed safely in the Austrian capital.
paras.zh: 芬兰航空另一架从赫尔辛基飞往维也纳的航班也是如此，该航班安全降落在奥地利首都后，人们发现该航班的威胁毫无根据。

paras.en: LOT Polish Airlines said two of its aircraft from Warsaw were targeted, one flying to Brussels and the other to Paris.
paras.zh: LOT波兰航空公司表示，其两架从华沙起飞的飞机成为目标，一架飞往布鲁塞尔，另一架飞往巴黎。

paras.en: Back on the ground in Warsaw, Polish resident Matthew Bojarsky, 28, was about to fly to Paris for a romantic trip with his American girlfriend, but he saw police, military and sniffer dogs on the tarmac, he told NBC News. Passengers were told that “safety protocols” meant their flight, LOT LO331, had to be aborted and moved to a later time.
paras.zh: 回到华沙后，28 岁的波兰居民马修·博贾斯基 (Matthew Bojarsky) 告诉 NBC 新闻，他正准备飞往巴黎与美国女友进行一次浪漫旅行，但他在停机坪上看到了警察、军队和嗅探犬。乘客被告知，“安全协议”意味着他们的 LOT LO331 航班必须中止并改期。

paras.en: Elsewhere, three Ryanair flights were interrupted as they headed to the Bulgarian capital, Sofia. Two flights, from Copenhagen and Milan, landed at their destination, while a third, from London, was diverted to the city of Plovdiv, the Bulgarian Transport Ministry said in an email.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，瑞安航空的三架航班在飞往保加利亚首都索非亚的途中被中断。保加利亚交通部在一封电子邮件中表示，来自哥本哈根和米兰的两架航班降落在目的地，而来自伦敦的第三架航班则改道飞往普罗夫迪夫市。

paras.en: Ryanair did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 瑞安航空没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: Romania’s intelligence agency said a KLM flight to Tel Aviv with a layover in Bucharest had received a bomb threat.
paras.zh: 罗马尼亚情报机构表示，荷航一架飞往特拉维夫并在布加勒斯特中途停留的航班收到炸弹威胁。

paras.en: And Spanish police said three emailed threats came in within 20 minutes involving two Air Europa departures from Madrid to Paris and four inbound Iberia flights from Rome and Milan. Several aircraft were halted or returned to their stands in Madrid, and passengers disembarked as the aircraft were inspected.
paras.zh: 西班牙警方表示，20 分钟内收到了三封电子邮件威胁，涉及两架从马德里飞往巴黎的欧洲航空公司航班以及四架从罗马和米兰出发的伊比利亚航空公司航班。多架飞机被拦截或返回马德里的停机位，乘客在飞机接受检查时下机。

paras.en: In the Czech Republic, meanwhile, police said they had received threats about improvised explosive devices being placed on four planes heading to the country’s capital, Prague.
paras.zh: 与此同时，捷克共和国警方表示，他们收到了有关在飞往该国首都布拉格的四架飞机上放置简易爆炸装置的威胁。

paras.en: In this instance, it appeared that at least some of the threats were sent by email, so “clearly there must be a process whereby airlines distinguish more credible threats from obvious hoaxes,” said Peter Neumann, a professor of security studies at Kings College London.
paras.zh: 伦敦国王学院安全研究教授彼得·诺伊曼表示，在这种情况下，至少有一些威胁是通过电子邮件发送的，因此“显然，航空公司必须有一个流程来区分更可信的威胁和明显的恶作剧”。

paras.en: Thursday’s incidents follow days of airline bomb threats that have forced multiple flights to divert and an airport in Poland to close briefly. No explosive devices were found in the earlier incidents, according to authorities in various countries.
paras.zh: 周四的事件发生之前，几天来航空炸弹威胁迫使多个航班改道，波兰的一个机场短暂关闭。据各国当局称，在之前的事件中没有发现爆炸装置。

paras.en: On Tuesday, a security operation was also launched at the Greek island port of Syros after a bomb threat to an Israel-bound cruise ship. Authorities said an unknown person claimed an explosive device had been attached to the hull of the Panama-flagged Crown Iris, which was due to sail to Haifa.
paras.zh: 周二，一艘开往以色列的游轮受到炸弹威胁后，希腊锡罗斯岛港口也启动了安全行动。当局表示，一名身份不明的人声称，悬挂巴拿马国旗的“皇冠鸢尾”号船体上安装了爆炸装置，该船原定驶往海法。

paras.en: Authorities have not indicated who could have been behind the incidents, and there were no claims of responsibility.
paras.zh: 当局没有表明谁是这些事件的幕后黑手，也没有人声称对此负责。

articles.title: Greene's ex-teammate says he abandoned Giants with Cats move

paras.en: Thu, 3 Sept, 8:10 pm, Final score, Dockers 40, Hawks 72
paras.zh: 9 月 3 日星期四，晚上 8:10，最终比分，码头工人 40，老鹰 72

paras.en: Toby Greene accused by ex-teammate of abandoning GWS Giants to join Geelong
paras.zh: 托比·格林被前队友指控放弃GWS巨人队加盟吉朗

paras.en: GWS defender Joe Fonti says former captain Toby Greene abandoned them by joining Geelong as a free agent.
paras.zh: GWS后卫乔·丰蒂表示，前队长托比·格林以自由球员身份加盟吉朗，抛弃了他们。

paras.en: Greene is one of a number of veteran players to have departed the Giants this summer, with Lachie Whitfield, Jesse Hogan, Jake Stringer and Kieren Briggs also gone.
paras.zh: 格林是今年夏天离开巨人队的众多老将之一，其他球员还有拉奇·惠特菲尔德、杰西·霍根、杰克·斯金格和基伦·布里格斯。

paras.en: The Giants are yet to nominate their next club captain after Greene's departure, with Tom Green and Connor Idun considered contenders for the role.
paras.zh: 格林离开后，巨人队尚未提名下一任队长，汤姆·格林和康纳·伊登被认为是这一职位的竞争者。

articles.title: Premier accepts big pay rise after initially saying it was 'out of step'
articles.author: Jano Gibson

paras.en: Last year, Tasmanian Premier Jeremy Rockliff fought against a 22 per cent pay rise for parliamentarians and capped his own increase at 3 per cent.
paras.zh: 去年，塔斯马尼亚州州长杰里米·罗克利夫(Jeremy Rockliff)反对议员加薪22%，并将自己的加薪上限限制在3%。

paras.en: But he has now confirmed that he and all other parliamentarians are receiving the full amount the Industrial Commission said they were entitled to after a seven-year pay freeze.
paras.zh: 但他现在证实，他和所有其他议员正在收到工业委员会所说的在七年冻结工资后他们有权获得的全额金额。

paras.en: A health union has described the government's latest pay offer for nurses as unfair when compared with the increases given to parliamentarians.
paras.zh: 一个健康工会表示，与议员的加薪相比，政府对护士的最新加薪提议是不公平的。

paras.en: All Tasmanian parliamentarians are now receiving the full 22 per cent pay rise they are entitled to, including the premier, who previously said it was "out of step with community expectations".
paras.zh: 所有塔斯马尼亚议员现在都获得了他们应得的22%的全额加薪，其中包括州长，他此前表示这“与社区期望不符”。

paras.en: In June last year, the Tasmanian Industrial Commission determined that parliamentarians should get a 22 per cent pay rise after a seven-year pay freeze.
paras.zh: 去年6月，塔斯马尼亚工业委员会决定，议员在七年冻结工资后应加薪22%。

paras.en: At the time, Jeremy Rockliff said on social media: "This is not on, and we will not be accepting it."
paras.zh: 当时，杰里米·罗克利夫在社交媒体上表示：“这不可行，我们不会接受。”

paras.en: The Liberals then moved a motion in parliament to disallow the increase, but Labor and eight independents rejected it in the upper house in September last year.
paras.zh: 自由党随后在议会提出一项动议，禁止加息，但去年 9 月工党和八名独立议员在上议院否决了这一动议。

paras.en: In response, Mr Rockliff said he would accept only a 3 per cent pay rise for himself.
paras.zh: 作为回应，罗克利夫表示，他自己只接受 3% 的加薪。

paras.en: "I will personally be knocking it back," he said on social media in September last year.
paras.zh: 去年九月，他在社交媒体上表示：“我个人会予以反击。”

paras.en: "3 per cent, the same as what is being offered to our public workers, is fair and reasonable."
paras.zh: “3%，与我们向公职人员提供的相同，是公平合理的。”

paras.en: Several other Liberals also declared they would only take a 3 per cent rise, while most other parliamentarians accepted the full amount.
paras.zh: 其他几位自由党人士也宣布他们只会接受 3% 的加薪，而大多数其他议员则接受全额加薪。

paras.en: But today, Mr Rockliff said he and all other parliamentarians were now on the rate recommended by the commission.
paras.zh: 但今天，罗克利夫先生表示，他和所有其他议员现在都采用了委员会建议的利率。

paras.en: "Tasmanians rightly did not expect one of the first actions of the new parliament was to be voting on a pay rise for MPs," he said in a statement.
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中说：“塔斯马尼亚人正确地没有想到新议会的首要行动之一就是对议员加薪进行投票。”

paras.en: "It was certainly not my focus and not the community's expectation.
paras.zh: “这当然不是我关注的焦点，也不是社区的期望。

paras.en: "We tried to stop the pay rise. However, Labor voted for it.
paras.zh: “我们试图阻止加薪。然而，工党投了赞成票。

paras.en: "I did accept much less than recommended by the Industrial Commission for over a year.
paras.zh: “一年多来，我接受的金额确实比工业委员会建议的要少得多。

paras.en: "Now, as I understand it, all parliamentarians have been brought into line with the Industrial Commission's determination."
paras.zh: “现在，据我了解，所有议员都已同意工业委员会的决定。”

paras.en: It means Mr Rockliff is now receiving $369,000 a year, a rise of almost $68,000 compared to what he was being paid before the commission's determination last year.
paras.zh: 这意味着罗克利夫先生现在每年领取 369,000 美元，比委员会去年做出决定之前的薪酬增加了近 68,000 美元。

paras.en: Ministers currently receive $291,597, while MPs get a base rate of $171,527, which is still the lowest rate in the country.
paras.zh: 部长目前的收入为291,597澳元，而国会议员的基本工资为171,527澳元，这仍然是该国最低的工资。

paras.en: But the decision by Mr Rockliff and others to accept the higher rate comes at a time when the government is planning to slash 1,700 state servant roles by 2030 to rein in spending.
paras.zh: 但罗克利夫和其他人决定接受更高的税率之际，政府正计划到 2030 年削减 1,700 名公务员职位以控制支出。

paras.en: A health union has also questioned the fairness of offering nurses pay rises of 3 per cent, 2.75 per cent and 2.5 per cent over the next three years.
paras.zh: 卫生工会还质疑未来三年护士加薪 3%、2.75% 和 2.5% 的公平性。

paras.en: "[Treasurer] Eric Abetz last year took a 22.36 per cent pay rise," HACSU secretary Robbie Moore told a rally outside parliament on Saturday, triggering boos from the crowd.
paras.zh: HACSU 秘书罗比·摩尔 (Robbie Moore) 周六在议会外的一次集会上表示：“[财务主管]埃里克·阿贝茨 (Eric Abetz) 去年加薪了 22.36%”，引发了人群的嘘声。

paras.en: "Now you compare that to the offer that we've got for nurses … and literally going as low as 2.5 per cent, that's a pay cut [compared with inflation]."
paras.zh: “现在你将其与我们为护士提供的报价进行比较……实际上低至 2.5%，这就是[与通货膨胀相比]的减薪。”

paras.en: In a statement, Mr Abetz, a former federal minister, explained why he had decided to take the 22 per cent pay rise.
paras.zh: 前联邦部长阿贝茨在一份声明中解释了他决定加薪 22% 的原因。

paras.en: "After our effort to disallow the pay rise was rejected by Labor and certain crossbench members, I, along with others, accepted the will of the parliament," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在我们禁止加薪的努力被工党和某些中立议员拒绝后，我和其他人一起接受了议会的意愿。”

paras.en: "To seek to personalise this matter conveniently ignores that by serving in state parliament I forego my Commonwealth entitlement, which I have done for the past two years.
paras.zh: “试图将此事个人化，很容易忽视了我在州议会任职而放弃了我在过去两年中所做的英联邦权利。

paras.en: "Most people acknowledge my commitment to state service is not based on the pay."
paras.zh: “大多数人承认我对国家服务的承诺并不是基于报酬。”

paras.en: Health Minister Bridget Archer also confirmed she was now on the higher rate.
paras.zh: 卫生部长布里奇特·阿彻也证实她现在的发病率更高。

paras.en: "I did not initially accept a 22 per cent pay rise. I accepted a 3 per cent pay rise for a year," Ms Archer said.
paras.zh: “我最初并没有接受 22% 的加薪。我接受了一年 3% 的加薪，”Archer 女士说。

paras.en: "I have subsequently accepted the base rate of salary as every parliamentarian has."
paras.zh: “我随后接受了每位议员的基本工资。”

paras.en: Ms Archer said the government was continuing to negotiate in "good faith" with health unions about the wage offer.
paras.zh: 阿彻女士表示，政府正在继续与卫生工会就工资提议进行“善意”谈判。

paras.en: "We continue to be at the table," she said.
paras.zh: “我们继续坐在谈判桌上，”她说。

paras.en: "I think those discussions have been constructive.
paras.zh: “我认为这些讨论是建设性的。

paras.en: "And we look forward to delivering a fair and affordable pay rise for our nurses as soon as we possibly can."
paras.zh: “我们期待尽快为我们的护士提供公平且负担得起的加薪。”

articles.title: 'High-priority': Overseer of QLD demerits system implores government to act
articles.author: Tom Hartley

paras.en: The man who oversaw the rollout of Queensland's licensing and registration system in the 1990s says the government is staring at a "cybersecurity flaw" in the wake of revelations about demerit points being traded for cash.
paras.zh: 20世纪90年代负责昆士兰州许可和注册系统推出的负责人表示，在扣分兑换现金的事件被曝光后，政府正在关注一个“网络安全缺陷”。

paras.en: The 7.30 investigation revealed widespread trading on black markets after a 27-year-old woman was charged with fraud. It's alleged she had accumulated 1,150 demerit points and more than $600,000 in fines.
paras.zh: 7.30 的调查显示，一名 27 岁女性被指控欺诈后，黑市交易广泛存在。据称，她已累计被扣 1,150 分，并被处以超过 60 万美元的罚款。

paras.en: Peter Grant is a veteran of the state's public service and oversaw its most complex IT systems as chief information officer; he says risks have changed dramatically since then.
paras.zh: Peter Grant 是该州公共服务领域的资深人士，作为首席信息官负责监督该州最复杂的 IT 系统。他说，从那时起，风险发生了巨大变化。

paras.en: "During the 90s, there was no social media. They didn't have to defend against this," Mr Grant told 7.30.
paras.zh: “在 90 年代，没有社交媒体。他们不需要对此进行防御，”格兰特先生告诉 7.30。

paras.en: "[But] if you've got people who are manipulating your business processes to actually do fraudulent behaviour, you have a cybersecurity breach."
paras.zh: “[但是]如果有人操纵你的业务流程来实施欺诈行为，那么你就存在网络安全漏洞。”

paras.en: Mr Grant characterises the manipulation as a "cybersecurity breach" because, he says, it compromises the integrity of a government business process.
paras.zh: 格兰特先生将这种操纵行为描述为“网络安全漏洞”，因为他说，这损害了政府业务流程的完整性。

paras.en: "These people are visible in the system over a long period of time — what we have here are people who are gaming the system, and they've created a cyber breach," Mr Grant said.
paras.zh: 格兰特先生说：“这些人在系统中长期存在——我们这里的人是在玩弄系统，他们制造了网络漏洞。”

paras.en: "The Queensland government has got to demonstrate that people can't get away with fraud and I would have thought that would have been a high-priority initiative.
paras.zh: “昆士兰州政府必须证明人们无法逃脱欺诈行为，我本认为这将是一项高度优先的举措。

paras.en: "For the integrity of the system, this would start to get to the top of the list for me."
paras.zh: “为了系统的完整性，这对我来说将开始成为首要任务。”

paras.en: Dr Katie Williams, a former KPMG partner and senior lecturer in business information systems at the University of Queensland's Business School, says she would expect to see the government review its systems around control gaps and pain points.
paras.zh: 前毕马威合伙人、昆士兰大学商学院商业信息系统高级讲师凯蒂·威廉姆斯博士表示，她希望看到政府围绕控制差距和痛点审查其系统。

paras.en: "A system that is set up correctly in the first place and regularly monitored and capable of tweaking makes it harder for fraud to remain undetected," Dr Williams said.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯博士说：“一个从一开始就正确设置、定期监控并能够进行调整的系统，将使欺诈行为更难被发现。”

paras.en: "Based on what we're seeing in other parts of Australia, there's an opportunity to perhaps consider, at a really detailed level, the enabling legislation."
paras.zh: “根据我们在澳大利亚其他地区看到的情况，也许有机会在非常详细的层面上考虑授权立法。”

paras.en: 7.30 was told police have raised the detection issue with the agencies responsible for administering the system — Queensland's Revenue Office and Department of Transport and Main Roads — and remain frustrated by inaction.
paras.zh: 7.30 获悉，警方已向负责管理该系统的机构（昆士兰州税务局以及交通和主要道路部）提出了检测问题，但仍对不作为感到沮丧。

paras.en: When asked by 7.30 government agencies described their processes for detecting fraud as robust.
paras.zh: 当 7.30 政府机构询问时，他们描述了他们检测欺诈的流程是稳健的。

paras.en: On Monday afternoon the Queensland Treasurer's Office told 7.30 in a statement: "New measures have already been implemented and ... we will continue to strengthen the system we inherited from the former government, if needed, to stamp out fraud."
paras.zh: 周一下午，昆士兰州财政部长办公室在一份声明中告诉《7.30》：“新措施已经实施，并且……如果需要，我们将继续加强从前政府继承的制度，以杜绝欺诈行为。”

paras.en: The statement said those measures were implemented in late 2025 as part of a new fines and integrity framework.
paras.zh: 声明称，这些措施作为新罚款和诚信框架的一部分于 2025 年底实施。

paras.en: Queensland Premier David Crisafulli told 7.30: "I think [the] loophole has been closed" but said if there are other loopholes "then of course we will look at it".
paras.zh: 昆士兰州州长 David Crisafulli 告诉 7.30：“我认为漏洞已经被堵住”，但表示如果还有其他漏洞“那么我们当然会考虑”。

paras.en: A consequence of the 'cash for demerit points' schemes is that authorities have not been able to confirm how many drivers may have escaped licence suspensions through fraudulent demerit point transfers.
paras.zh: “扣分现金”计划的一个后果是，当局无法确认有多少司机可能通过欺诈性扣分转移逃脱了驾照吊销。

paras.en: Revelations from the investigation have caused concerns for police, road safety and motorist advocacy groups, including RACQ.
paras.zh: 调查结果引起了警方、道路安全和包括 RACQ 在内的驾车者权益团体的担忧。

paras.en: "We don't know the size of the problem, but we should know the size of the problem in Queensland, and that is the key thing here," said Michael Kane, RACQ's executive manager of public policy.
paras.zh: RACQ 公共政策执行经理 Michael Kane 表示：“我们不知道问题的严重程度，但我们应该知道昆士兰州问题的严重程度，这是这里的关键。”

paras.en: "There's no point having stronger laws to make our roads safer if people simply can find a way around the consequences.
paras.zh: “如果人们能够找到解决后果的方法，那么制定更强有力的法律来使我们的道路更安全就没有意义。

paras.en: "It needs to be addressed, and there needs to be some urgency to it."
paras.zh: “这个问题需要得到解决，而且需要有一定的紧迫性。”

paras.en: In New South Wales, similar abuses prompted a dedicated taskforce and proposed legislative changes supported by both major parties.
paras.zh: 在新南威尔士州，类似的侵权行为促使成立了一个专门的工作组，并提议进行立法改革，并得到了两个主要政党的支持。

paras.en: Launched in 2024, the Demerit Point Integrity Taskforce uncovered "extraordinary examples of misconduct", NSW opposition roads spokesman Mark Coure told parliament, including people accumulating hundreds — and in some cases more than 1,000 — demerit points while continuing to drive.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州反对派道路发言人马克·库尔 (Mark Coure) 告诉议会，自 2024 年成立的扣分诚信工作组发现了“非常规不当行为的例子”，其中包括有人在继续开车时累积了数百分（有时甚至超过 1,000 分）的扣分。

paras.en: "If dangerous drivers are able to manipulate the system, avoid licence suspensions and continue offending with zero consequences, then the purpose of the demerit point scheme is fundamentally undermined," Mr Coure said.
paras.zh: 库尔表示：“如果危险司机能够操纵系统，避免驾照被吊销，并继续违法且后果为零，那么扣分计划的目的就会从根本上被破坏。”

paras.en: The taskforce resulted in proposed reforms that would require passport details and the country of issue when an overseas licence holder is nominated as the responsible driver and introduce new offences relating to false disputes and fraudulent nominations.
paras.zh: 该工作组提出了改革建议，要求在海外驾照持有者被提名为责任司机时提供护照详细信息和签发国家/地区，并引入与虚假争议和欺诈性提名相关的新犯罪行为。

paras.en: NSW Minister for Roads, Jenny Aitchison, said the proposed legislation would crack down on international licences being nominated for fines.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州道路部长珍妮·艾奇森 (Jenny Aitchison) 表示，拟议的立法将严厉打击对国际驾照进行罚款的行为。

paras.en: "Revenue NSW systems are being integrated with Australian Border Force data to verify if a nominated overseas driver was actually in the country when an offence occurred," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“新南威尔士州税务局系统正在与澳大利亚边防部队的数据进行整合，以核实犯罪发生时指定的海外司机是否确实在该国。”

paras.en: "The bill forces an individual who nominates an overseas driver for a demerit-carrying offence to provide the nominee's passport number and country of origin."
paras.zh: “该法案迫使提名海外司机犯过过错的个人提供被提名人的护照号码和原籍国。”

paras.en: A spokesperson from Transport for NSW said its taskforce saw the licences of 50 repeat offenders suspended, and resulted in 190 vehicle registrations being cancelled.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州交通局发言人表示，其工作组已吊销 50 名屡犯者的驾照，并导致 190 辆车辆的登记被取消。

paras.en: The department told 7.30 that its proposed reforms are "designed to support a fair, consistent, and safety-focused licensing system in NSW".
paras.zh: 该部门告诉 7.30，其拟议的改革“旨在支持新南威尔士州建立公平、一致且注重安全的许可制度”。

paras.en: But while those changes are being deliberated, it hasn't stopped other schemes from establishing.
paras.zh: 但尽管这些改变正在酝酿之中，但这并没有阻止其他计划的制定。

paras.en: Among the purported services 7.30 uncovered was a website bearing a striking resemblance to the official Service NSW portal. Its contact button redirected 7.30 to WhatsApp.
paras.zh: 在 7.30 发现的所谓服务中，有一个网站与新南威尔士州服务局官方门户网站极为相似。其联系按钮将 7.30 重定向至 WhatsApp。

paras.en: In messages, the person claiming to be offering the service said they had "certain access to live dummy accounts" registered under Service NSW, and knew "how to get it accepted straight away and keep it all automated."
paras.zh: 在消息中，自称提供这项服务的人表示，他们对在新南威尔士州服务局注册的“实时虚拟账户有一定的访问权限”，并且知道“如何立即接受并保持一切自动化”。

paras.en: When asked how much a $434 fine and 3 points would cost to wipe, the person said, "ill [sic] do it for $500 total if sorting it today … I just need penalty notice number, date of offence and full name it's in and it will take 3 minutes … you only pay after you can see it's sorted."
paras.zh: 当被问及 434 美元的罚款和 3 分的擦除费用是多少时，该人士表示，“如果今天对它进行分类，我[原文如此]总共需要 500 美元……我只需要罚款通知号码、违规日期和其中的全名，这将需要 3 分钟……只有在看到它被分类后才需要付费。”

paras.en: NSW Police said it is aware of "reports concerning websites and online services claiming to facilitate the removal of demerit points in exchange for payment".
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州警方表示，他们注意到“有关网站和在线服务声称可以通过付费来消除记分”的报告。

paras.en: "The NSW Police Force does not comment on specific investigations; however, any information alleging criminal conduct is assessed and investigated where appropriate."
paras.zh: “新南威尔士州警察局不会对具体调查发表评论；但是，任何指控犯罪行为的信息都会在适当的情况下进行评估和调查。”

paras.en: "Demerit point fraud is a serious offence that undermines the integrity of the licensing system and road safety."
paras.zh: “扣分欺诈是一种严重的违法行为，破坏了许可制度的完整性和道路安全。”

paras.en: RACQ says Queensland authorities need to "get much tougher" and consider policy intervention, legislation intervention, and police action.
paras.zh: RACQ 表示，昆士兰当局需要“变得更加强硬”，并考虑政策干预、立法干预和警方行动。

paras.en: Mr Kane told 7.30 the government needs to demonstrate that it understood the problem and was addressing it.
paras.zh: 凯恩先生告诉 7.30 政府需要证明它理解这个问题并正在解决它。

paras.en: Griffith cybersecurity expert Dr David Tuffley says a taskforce could determine the number of people actively exploiting the state’s loopholes.
paras.zh: 格里菲斯网络安全专家戴维·塔夫利博士表示，一个工作组可以确定积极利用该州漏洞的人数。

paras.en: "That's going to take some courage from the government, to basically take a deep breath and run the query and just see how bad it is," he told 7.30.
paras.zh: “这需要政府拿出一些勇气，深吸一口气，进行查询，看看情况有多糟糕，”他告诉 7.30。

paras.en: "I'd be very surprised if it didn't amount to many thousands."
paras.zh: “如果数量没有达到数千，我会感到非常惊讶。”

paras.en: Mr Crisafulli acknowledged the infringement and demerits scheme is "an important part of justice," but avoided answering if his government would commit to a review or taskforce.
paras.zh: 克里萨富利先生承认侵权和记过计划是“司法的重要组成部分”，但避免回答他的政府是否会承诺进行审查或成立特别工作组。

paras.en: "You will never make a system bulletproof, but you can make it better," he said.
paras.zh: “你永远无法让系统变得万无一失，但你可以让它变得更好，”他说。

paras.en: "We will continue to do all we can to make sure we have systems that are strong.
paras.zh: “我们将继续尽一切努力确保我们拥有强大的系统。

paras.en: "If people have done the wrong thing, then they should have to pay their dues."
paras.zh: “如果人们做了错事，那么他们就应该付出代价。”

paras.en: Watch 7.30, Mondays to Thursdays 7:30pm on ABC iview and ABC TV
paras.zh: 每周一至周四晚上 7:30 在 ABC iview 和 ABC TV 上观看 7.30

articles.title: Nvidia probes whether CEO Jensen Huang targeted by foreign intelligence as he admits affair

paras.en: Nvidia probes whether CEO Jensen Huang targeted by foreign intelligence as he admits affair
paras.zh: 英伟达调查首席执行官黄仁勋承认婚外情后是否成为外国情报目标

paras.en: New York Times reports Huang had relationship with woman who relayed info to Beijing
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》报道黄与向北京转发信息的女子有关系

paras.en: Nvidia said on Sunday it is probing whether CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a "foreign intelligence effort," after a media report alleged he had a close relationship with a Chinese businesswoman who passed information to Beijing.
paras.zh: 英伟达周日表示，正在调查首席执行官黄仁勋是否成为“外国情报活动”的目标，此前有媒体报道称他与一名向北京传递信息的中国女商人关系密切。

paras.en: Huang admitted in a message to employees that he had been unfaithful to his wife and took "full responsibility" for his actions, while Nvidia said the CEO was committed to continuing to lead the company without interruption.
paras.zh: 黄在发给员工的信息中承认，他对妻子不忠，并为自己的行为承担“全部责任”，而英伟达则表示，首席执行官致力于继续不间断地领导公司。

paras.en: The developments are likely to pressure the chipmaker's stock, which has already seen sharp declines recently amid worries about AI sustainability, and may also raise questions about Huang's future at the helm of the company he co-founded.
paras.zh: 这些事态发展可能会给这家芯片制造商的股价带来压力，由于对人工智能可持续性的担忧，该芯片制造商的股价最近已经大幅下跌，而且还可能引发人们对黄仁勋领导他共同创立的公司的未来产生疑问。

paras.en: The New York Times reported last month that Huang had a relationship with a former executive of a Singapore-based company whom U.S. authorities investigated and concluded was a Chinese intelligence asset.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》上个月报道称，黄与一家新加坡公司的前高管有关系，美国当局调查后得出结论，该公司是中国情报人员。

paras.en: "The Nvidia board is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort. A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation," the company said.
paras.zh: 该公司表示：“鉴于最近有报道称创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋已成为外国情报工作的目标，英伟达董事会正在启动一项独立调查。一个由独立董事组成的委员会将在外部独立顾问的协助下监督这项调查。”

paras.en: The multinational tech company said on Sunday that while its board has no reason to believe that either U.S. national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, its inquiry will examine all available information.
paras.zh: 这家跨国科技公司周日表示，虽然其董事会没有理由相信美国国家安全或英伟达的机密遭到泄露，但其调查将检查所有可用信息。

paras.en: The board has confidence in the CEO and his leadership team, Nvidia said, adding that Huang fully supports the review and has committed to co-operating with it.
paras.zh: 英伟达表示，董事会对首席执行官及其领导团队充满信心，并补充说，黄仁勋完全支持此次审查，并承诺与其合作。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Sunday he had not spoken to Huang about the allegations but called him a fine person.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周日表示，他没有与黄谈论这些指控，但称他是一个好人。

paras.en: "I hope everything's fine. He's done such an incredible job," Trump added.
paras.zh: “我希望一切都好。他做了如此令人难以置信的工作，”特朗普补充道。

paras.en: When asked if he believed he should have acted on intelligence when he was briefed about it, Trump said: "No, I don't think so. I think he's an honourable guy. I think he probably has an excuse for it. You have to hear it."
paras.zh: 当被问及在听取简报时是否认为自己应该根据情报采取行动时，特朗普说：“不，我不这么认为。我认为他是一个值得尊敬的人。我认为他可能有一个借口。你必须听到它。”

paras.en: Huang and U.S. President Donald Trump are shown in Washington on Oct. 8. (Julia Demaree Nikhinson/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 10 月 8 日，黄仁勋和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在华盛顿现身。（Julia Demaree Nikhinson/美联社）

paras.en: The New York Times had reported that Trump was briefed about the intelligence findings roughly a year ago and chose not to do anything with the information.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，特朗普大约一年前就收到了有关情报调查结果的简报，并选择不对这些信息采取任何行动。

paras.en: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio declined to comment on Huang when asked by reporters on Sunday evening.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥在周日晚上接受记者询问时拒绝对黄发表评论。

paras.en: China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
paras.zh: 中国外交部没有立即回应路透社的置评请求。

paras.en: Huang, who founded the company in 1993, said he was "committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America's national security."
paras.zh: 1993 年创立该公司的黄仁勋表示，他“致力于保护 Nvidia 并支持美国的国家安全”。

paras.en: The investigation adds to pressure on Nvidia at a time investors are already pulling back from uncertainty over the sustainability of the artificial intelligence market, in which the company is a leader.
paras.zh: 这项调查增加了英伟达面临的压力，而投资者已经从对该公司处于领先地位的人工智能市场可持续性的不确定性中撤退。

paras.en: The $4.5-trillion US chipmaker's shares have given up all of their gains this year amid a broader tech market rout triggered by worries over AI sustainability.
paras.zh: 由于对人工智能可持续性的担忧引发了更广泛的科技市场暴跌，这家市值 4.5 万亿美元的美国芯片制造商的股价已经回吐了今年的所有涨幅。

paras.en: "There is clearly risk that Jensen could be removed as CEO depending on the board investigation, and this will add risk to the stock as he is so important to the Nvidia story and strategy globally," said Dan Ives, partner and senior managing director at Yorkville Ives & Co.
paras.zh: Yorkville Ives & Co 合伙人兼高级董事总经理丹·艾夫斯 (Dan Ives) 表示：“根据董事会的调查，詹森显然存在被解除首席执行官职务的风险，这将增加股票的风险，因为他对英伟达的故事和全球战略非常重要。”

paras.en: "This is a black eye moment for Jensen and will spark multiple congressional inquiries at a minimum and will create an overhang on the stock," Ives said, adding that the news would also increase major scrutiny about selling chips to China.
paras.zh: 艾夫斯表示：“这对詹森来说是一个糟糕的时刻，至少会引发多项国会调查，并将对该股造成压力。”他补充说，这一消息还将加强对向中国出售芯片的严格审查。

paras.en: Huang admitted to having been unfaithful to his wife, saying, "My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry."
paras.zh: 黄承认对妻子不忠，他说：“我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的行为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”

paras.en: Addressing his colleagues, board, partners and shareholders, Huang said: "My responsibility is to serve you and be worthy of your trust. I have fallen short of that responsibility. I am fully committed to Nvidia and will work to earn back your confidence."
paras.zh: 黄向他的同事、董事会、合作伙伴和股东表示：“我的责任是为你们服务并值得你们的信任。我没有履行这一责任。我完全致力于英伟达，并将努力赢得你们的信任。”

paras.en: Huang delivers a speech at a company event in Berlin on Oct. 21. (Markus Schreiber/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 10 月 21 日，黄在柏林的一次公司活动上发表演讲。（Markus Schreiber/美联社）

paras.en: In late October, he told Bloomberg News that his relationship and interactions with the Chinese businesswoman were "completely normal and not unusual."
paras.zh: 十月底，他告诉彭博新闻社，他与这位中国女商人的关系和互动“完全正常，并不罕见”。

paras.en: Josh Gilbert, lead analyst at trading platform eToro, said Huang's fingerprints were on every part of the company's rise, so any doubt over his position would matter to shareholders.
paras.zh: 交易平台 eToro 首席分析师乔什·吉尔伯特 (Josh Gilbert) 表示，黄的足迹遍布公司崛起的方方面面，因此对他的地位的任何怀疑都会对股东产生影响。

paras.en: "While the investigation is likely to dent sentiment, it won't alter anything long term unless it leads to a change at the top, at which point it becomes a completely different ball game," Gilbert said.
paras.zh: 吉尔伯特说：“虽然调查可能会削弱人们的情绪，但从长远来看，它不会改变任何事情，除非它导致高层发生变化，而到那时，情况就变成了一场完全不同的比赛。”

paras.en: Top Republican lawmakers in the U.S. House of Representatives have already called on Huang to brief Congress this month about the New York Times report.
paras.zh: 美国众议院共和党高层议员已经呼吁黄本月向国会通报《纽约时报》的报道。

paras.en: The newspaper's story raises "significant national security concerns regarding [China's] access to sensitive U.S. technology and information," the Republican lawmakers said in a letter dated Nov. 4. "It is vital that Congress determines the extent to which U.S. national security has been placed at risk."
paras.zh: 共和党议员在 11 月 4 日的一封信中表示，该报的报道引发了“对（中国）获取美国敏感技术和信息的重大国家安全担忧”。“国会必须确定美国国家安全面临风险的程度，这一点至关重要。”

paras.en: U.S. export controls since 2022 have sought to restrict China's access to advanced Nvidia chips and the equipment needed to make them.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年以来，美国的出口管制一直试图限制中国获得先进的 Nvidia 芯片及其制造所需的设备。

articles.title: Trump insists he was 'only kidding' about wanting UFC's Dana White as press secretary

paras.en: Trump insists he was 'only kidding' about wanting UFC's Dana White as press secretary
paras.zh: 特朗普坚称他希望UFC的达纳怀特担任新闻秘书“只是开玩笑”

paras.en: U.S. president claims UFC boss 'loves the idea' but says it was not a serious one
paras.zh: 美国总统声称UFC老板“喜欢这个想法”，但表示这不是一个严肃的想法

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday said he was "only kidding" when he suggested UFC CEO Dana White could become his next White House press secretary, after a social media post a day earlier stirred speculation about recruiting his feisty ally and signalled a combative approach to dealing with Democrats as they prepare to take control of Congress.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周日表示，当他建议UFC首席执行官达纳·怀特(Dana White)成为他的下一任白宫新闻秘书时，他“只是在开玩笑”。一天前，社交媒体上的一篇帖子引发了有关招募他活跃盟友的猜测，并暗示在准备控制国会的民主党人面前将采取好斗的态度。

paras.en: Trump said White, a prominent supporter, "loves the idea" of taking the job but insisted he had not been serious about the prospect, describing the suggestion as "just a little fun."
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，怀特是一位著名的支持者，他“喜欢这个想法”接受这份工作，但坚称他对这一前景并不认真，称这个建议“只是有点有趣”。

paras.en: "I will tell you, I was only kidding," Trump told reporters, explaining that he had posted photographs of prominent UFC fighters as potential assistants to White as part of the joke.
paras.zh: 特朗普对记者说：“我告诉你，我只是在开玩笑。”他解释说，作为玩笑的一部分，他张贴了著名 UFC 选手作为怀特潜在助手的照片。

paras.en: In Saturday's post, Trump described White as a "violent Fighter and Warrior" and suggested he bring several current or former UFC champions to serve as assistants, saying they were needed to "defend us against the Lunatic Left."
paras.zh: 在周六的帖子中，特朗普将怀特描述为“暴力的斗士和战士”，并建议他带几位现任或前任UFC冠军担任助手，称他们需要“保卫我们免受疯狂左派的侵害”。

paras.en: Trump said White would visit him at the White House on Monday, but added that the meeting was planned for other reasons.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，怀特将于周一前往白宫拜访他，但他补充说，计划这次会面还有其他原因。

paras.en: White, who has led the Ultimate Fighting Championship for more than two decades, has been a close Trump ally and helped mobilize support for his 2024 presidential campaign.
paras.zh: 怀特领导终极格斗锦标赛二十多年，一直是特朗普的亲密盟友，并帮助动员了对他 2024 年总统竞选的支持。

paras.en: He has also appeared alongside Trump at several political events and helped bring UFC fights to the White House lawn this year.
paras.zh: 他还与特朗普一起出现在一些政治活动中，并帮助今年将 UFC 比赛带到了白宫草坪。

articles.title: 19-year-old golfer becomes youngest PGA Tour winner in 95 years

paras.en: 19-year-old Blades Brown becomes youngest PGA Tour winner in 95 years
paras.zh: 19岁刀锋布朗成为95年来最年轻的美巡赛冠军

paras.en: Birdies 2nd playoff hole to win World Wide Technology Championship in Mexico
paras.zh: 延长赛第二洞小鸟球赢得墨西哥世界技术锦标赛

paras.en: Blades Brown became the youngest PGA Tour winner in 95 years Sunday when the 19-year-old rallied from a seven-shot deficit with a 9-under 63 and beat Ben James with a birdie on the second playoff hole in the World Wide Technology Championship in Los Cabos, Mexico.
paras.zh: 周日，刀锋布朗成为 95 年来最年轻的 PGA 巡回赛冠军，这位 19 岁的选手在墨西哥洛斯卡沃斯举行的世界科技锦标赛上，以低于标准杆 9 杆的 63 杆，在延长赛第二洞抓到小鸟击败了本·詹姆斯，在落后 7 杆的情况下奋起直追。

paras.en: Brown became the youngest winner since Charles Kocsis won the Michigan Open in 1931 when he was 18, a tournament that was considered a regional event in the early years of the PGA.
paras.zh: 布朗成为自1931年查尔斯·科奇斯(Charles Kocsis)赢得密歇根公开赛以来最年轻的冠军，当时他18岁，这项赛事在PGA成立之初被认为是地区性赛事。

paras.en: James lost a four-shot lead going into the final round at El Cardonal at Diamante and then showed his moxie by smoking a 285-yard shot into 20 feet on the par-5 18th and making eagle to salvage a 70 and force the playoff.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯在迪亚曼特的埃尔卡多纳尔球场进入最后一轮时失去了四杆领先优势，然后在 18 号洞，五杆洞，一杆 285 码射入 20 英尺，打出老鹰，挽救了 70 杆，并进入延长赛，展现了他的勇气。

paras.en: But he missed an 8-foot putt on the second playoff hole, and Brown made his 3-footer.
paras.zh: 但他在延长赛第二洞错过了 8 英尺推杆，布朗推入了 3 英尺推杆。

paras.en: "I'm so obsessed with this game. It tests you in so many ways," said Brown, who graduated high school in January. "I love golf, all the stuff that goes into it and I can't wait for what's next."
paras.zh: “我对这款游戏非常着迷。它在很多方面考验你，”一月份高中毕业的布朗说。 “我热爱高尔夫，热爱其中的所有事物，我迫不及待地想知道接下来会发生什么。”

paras.en: For a sleepy FedEx Cup Fall event on the southern tip of Baja California, this was pure theater between two players from the next generation. James was the No. 1 player in the PGA Tour University ranking last season. Brown make a surprising choice to turn pro two years ago while a junior in high school.
paras.zh: 对于下加利福尼亚州南端一场沉睡的联邦快递杯秋季赛事来说，这是两位下一代球员之间的纯粹戏剧。詹姆斯是上赛季美巡赛大学排名第一的球员。两年前，当布朗还是一名高中三年级学生时，他做出了一个令人惊讶的选择转为职业球员。

paras.en: Brown was tested even more by going through two bags of golf balls on the range waiting to see if the two-shot lead he had over James would hold, and then going back out to the 18th to decide it.
paras.zh: 布朗受到了更多的考验，他在练习场检查了两袋高尔夫球，等待看看他对詹姆斯的两杆领先优势是否能保持，然后回到第 18 号洞来决定。

paras.en: On the first extra hole, their approach shots were side-by-side, separated by about 3 feet, and both narrowly missed eagle chances. They returned to the 18th tee and their drives were next to each other. Both came up just short of the green.
paras.zh: 在第一个加洞中，两人并排击球，相距约 3 英尺，都险些错过了老鹰的机会。他们回到 18 号发球台，两人的开球紧挨着。两人都离果岭不远。

paras.en: James nearly holed his pitch and saw it run out 8 feet. Brown, who had a similar pitch in regulation that he hit to 6 feet for a closing birdie, this time came up 3 feet short. James' birdie putt grazed the right edge, and Brown poured in the winner.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯差点将球打进洞，发现球向外延伸出 8 英尺。布朗在常规比赛中也有类似的投球距离，他在最后时刻击中了 6 英尺小鸟，但这次却短了 3 英尺。詹姆斯的小鸟推擦过右边缘，布朗打入制胜球。

paras.en: They have known each since their junior days and Brown figures this is the start.
paras.zh: 他们从大三的时候就认识了，布朗认为这就是开始。

paras.en: "I got him this time, but I'm sure we'll be battling it out for years to come," he said.
paras.zh: “这次我抓住了他，但我相信我们将在未来几年内继续战斗，”他说。

paras.en: With eight players separated by two shots on the back nine, Brown ran off three straight birdies to share the lead and then left the mistakes to everyone else. He hit a superb pitch for birdie on the final hole to post at 23-under 265.
paras.zh: 后九洞，八名球员的差距只有两杆，布朗连续抓到三只小鸟，分享领先优势，然后把错误留给了其他人。他在最后一个洞打出精彩的小鸟球，打出265杆，低于标准杆23杆。

paras.en: That put him one shot ahead of Michael Kim, who played with the Tennessee teen and made birdie from 12 feet for 64 right before Brown made his putt.
paras.zh: 这让他领先迈克尔·金一杆，后者与这位田纳西州青少年一起比赛，并在布朗推杆之前从 12 英尺处抓到小鸟，打出 64 杆。

paras.en: Brown earned his PGA Tour card for 2027 by finishing among the top 20 on the Korn Ferry Tour points list. Now he has a two-year exemption, which puts him in the elite Championship Series when the PGA Tour's new model begins in 2028.
paras.zh: 布朗在光辉国际巡回赛积分榜上跻身前 20 名，赢得了 2027 年美巡赛参赛卡。现在，他获得了两年的豁免权，这使他能够在美巡赛新模式于 2028 年开始时参加精英锦标赛系列赛。

paras.en: The victory also assures Brown of his first major next year at the PGA Championship.
paras.zh: 这场胜利也确保布朗在明年的 PGA 锦标赛上获得他的第一个大满贯赛冠军。

paras.en: It was another setback for James, who in 13 starts since turning pro has five finishes in the top five, and two runner-up finishes.
paras.zh: 这对詹姆斯来说是另一个挫折，自从成为职业球员以来，他在 13 场首发中，有 5 次进入前五名，两次获得亚军。

paras.en: Denny McCarthy, winless in nine years in 240 starts on the PGA Tour, made a 30-foot birdie putt on the 13th hole to take the lead. But he hit a pedestrian pitch to the par-5 14th and had to settle for par. With a wedge in hand from the 15th fairway, he came up some 40 feet short and three-putted for a bogey.
paras.zh: 丹尼·麦卡锡 (Denny McCarthy) 在 PGA 巡回赛 240 场比赛中连续 9 年未尝胜绩，在第 13 洞推入 30 英尺小鸟推，取得领先。但他在第 14 号洞，打到了五杆洞，打出了一个步行球，最终只得保标准杆。他在第 15 号球道上手握挖起杆，距离大约 40 英尺，三推吞下柏忌。

paras.en: McCarthy's tee shot on the 17th was right of the 18th tee box, he put his next shot off a dirt path into a hazard and made double bogey. He shot 69.
paras.zh: 麦卡锡在17号洞的开球位于18号洞发球台的右侧，他的下一杆从土路进入障碍区，吞下双柏忌。他打出69杆。

paras.en: Sudarshan Yellamaraju was the top Canadian, finishing tied for 12th at 17-under.
paras.zh: 苏达山·耶拉马拉朱 (Sudarshan Yellamaraju) 是加拿大顶尖选手，以低于标准杆 17 杆的成绩获得并列第 12 名。

articles.title: US asks China to uphold Busan trade deal commitments

paras.en: Top officials of United States President Donald Trump's administration have called on China to "fully and immediately" implement its commitments under a 2025 trade agreement between the two nations, including on rare earth and other critical minerals.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府的高级官员呼吁中国“立即全面”履行其在2025年两国贸易协定中的承诺，包括稀土和其他关键矿产的承诺。

paras.en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Trade Representative Jamieson Greer on Friday held a videoconference with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng on the trade and economic relationship between Washington and Beijing, a statement from Greer's office said.
paras.zh: 格里尔办公室的一份声明称，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特和贸易代表杰米森·格里尔周五与中国国务院副总理何立峰就华盛顿和北京之间的贸易和经济关系举行了视频会议。

paras.en: Greer "emphasized the critical importance of China taking concrete actions to fully implement its past commitments, particularly as they relate to agricultural purchases, rare earths, and other critical minerals.” it added.
paras.zh: 格里尔“强调中国采取具体行动全面履行其过去的承诺至关重要，特别是在农产品采购、稀土和其他关键矿产方面。”它补充道。

paras.en: The US officials were referring to an accord reached between the world's two largest economies in 2025 in a meeting between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping in South Korea's Busan, on the sidelines of an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit.
paras.zh: 美国官员指的是特朗普与中国国家主席习近平在亚太经济合作组织 (APEC) 峰会期间在韩国釜山举行的会晤中，世界最大的两个经济体于 2025 年达成的协议。

paras.en: The deal had been reached during a period that saw the two countries exchange tariff escalations prompted by Trump's wider tariffs policy, which particularly targeted China, among other countries.
paras.zh: 该协议是在特朗普更广泛的关税政策（特别针对中国等国家）促使两国关税升级的时期达成的。

paras.en: The accord capped US tariffs on Chinese goods — enforced during Trump's second stint as president — at about 20%.
paras.zh: 该协议将美国对中国商品征收的关税（在特朗普第二任总统期间实施）限制在 20% 左右。

paras.en: China agreed to buy 25 million metric tons of US soybeans for the next three years.
paras.zh: 中国同意未来三年购买2500万吨美国大豆。

paras.en: Beijing also said it would keep China's rare earth exports flowing, suspending new export curbs.
paras.zh: 北京还表示将保持中国稀土出口畅通，暂停新的出口限制。

paras.en: The minerals are critical for the technological industry, and the Trump administration has in the past complained that Beijing was not meeting its commitments regarding supply.
paras.zh: 这些矿物对科技行业至关重要，特朗普政府过去曾抱怨北京没有履行其供应承诺。

paras.en: "The Trump Administration will continue pursuing policies that benefit American workers, farmers, and businesses and strengthen our economic and national security,” Bessent wrote on X after the high-level call.
paras.zh: “特朗普政府将继续奉行有利于美国工人、农民和企业的政策，并加强我们的经济和国家安全，”贝森特在高层通话后在 X 上写道。

paras.en: China raises concern over US trade restrictions
paras.zh: 中国对美国贸易限制表示担忧

paras.en: He, who is Beijing's lead negotiator on trade ties with the US, during Friday's interaction expressed "serious concern" over recent US trade restrictions targeting his country, Chinese state news agency Xinhua reported.
paras.zh: 据中国官方通讯社新华社报道，作为北京与美国贸易关系的首席谈判代表，他在周五的互动中对美国最近针对中国的贸易限制表示“严重关切”。

paras.en: The report did not elaborate which measure the vice premier was referring to.
paras.zh: 该报告没有详细说明副总理指的是哪项措施。

paras.en: But both parties agreed to "continuously strengthen cooperation”and "properly manage differences" to promote a "stable" US-China trade relationship, Xinhua said.
paras.zh: 但新华社称，双方同意“不断加强合作”并“妥善管控分歧”，以促进“稳定”的美中贸易关系。

paras.en: The Busan trade deal at first covered only one year, but the US and China extended their trade pact until January 10 next year, as Trump hosted Xi at the White House in September.
paras.zh: 釜山贸易协定最初只持续一年，但随着特朗普9月在白宫接待习近平，美国和中国将贸易协定延长至明年1月10日。

paras.en: The two leaders are expected to meet again at the upcoming APEC forum in Shenzhen, China, slated from November 18 to 19.
paras.zh: 两国领导人预计将于 11 月 18 日至 19 日在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织论坛上再次会面。

paras.en: Meanwhile, in a separate development, China has confirmed for the first time that it is discussing a historic trilateral summit of Xi, Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the APEC gathering.
paras.zh: 与此同时，另一项进展是，中国首次确认正在亚太经合组织会议期间讨论习近平、特朗普和俄罗斯总统普京的历史性三边峰会。

paras.en: China "is in communication with relevant parties regarding a meeting between the three heads of state,” Mao Ning, a spokesperson for the Chinese Foreign Ministry, said at a media briefing in Beijing this week.
paras.zh: 中国外交部发言人毛宁本周在北京举行的媒体吹风会上表示，中方“正在就三位国家元首会晤事宜与有关方面进行沟通”。

articles.title: US: Giant pandas from China make public debut at Atlanta zoo

paras.en: Two giant pandas from China have made their first public appearance at a zoo in the US city of Atlanta as a queue of visitors lined up to see the bears.
paras.zh: 两只来自中国的大熊猫首次公开亮相美国亚特兰大市的一家动物园，游客们排队等候观赏它们。

paras.en: In a treat for them and their fans, Ping Ping and Fu Shuang — male and female, respectively — were seen munching on bamboo at Zoo Atlanta on Friday.
paras.zh: 周五，人们看到萍萍和傅爽（分别为雄性和雌性）在亚特兰大动物园咀嚼竹子，以招待他们和他们的粉丝。

paras.en: The six-year-old pandas arrived from China's Chengdu on September 27.
paras.zh: 这对六岁大熊猫于9月27日从中国成都抵达。

paras.en: The FedEx flight they traveled on was dubbed the "Panda Express."
paras.zh: 他们乘坐的联邦快递航班被称为“熊猫快递”。

paras.en: The panda duo had spent the last few weeks getting acclimated to their habitat.
paras.zh: 这对大熊猫在过去的几周里一直在适应它们的栖息地。

paras.en: Ping Ping and Fu Shuang have taken up residence in a panda enclosure at the zoo that had been vacant since 2024.
paras.zh: 萍萍和傅爽在动物园的熊猫围栏里安家落户，该围栏自 2024 年以来一直空置。

paras.en: A 25-year-long partnership that saw Atlanta host four pandas on loan since 1999 ended in the midst of strained US-China ties. Seven panda cubs that were born at the zoo during that period now live in Chengdu, China.
paras.zh: 亚特兰大自 1999 年起租借了四只大熊猫，这段长达 25 年的合作关系因中美关系紧张而结束。在此期间在动物园出生的七只大熊猫幼崽现在生活在中国成都。

paras.en: That arrangement has been renewed under a 10-year loan agreement following a Washington summit between US President Donald Trump and his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与中国国家主席习近平在华盛顿举行峰会后，根据一项十年期贷款协议续签了这一安排。

paras.en: China's ambassador to the US, Xie Feng, said at a press conference on Friday that the pandas' arrival "marks the renewal of a decade-long bond between China and Zoo Atlanta."
paras.zh: 中国驻美国大使谢锋在周五的新闻发布会上表示，大熊猫的到来“标志着中国与亚特兰大动物园之间长达十年的友谊的延续”。

paras.en: Raymond King, CEO of Zoo Atlanta, described pandas as "animals that have got a unique ability to inspire curiosity, instill passion, evoke joy, and unite people around the globe."
paras.zh: 亚特兰大动物园首席执行官雷蒙德·金 (Raymond King) 将大熊猫描述为“具有激发好奇心、灌输激情、唤起欢乐和团结世界各地人们的独特能力的动物。”

paras.en: "This extraordinary spirit of partnership helps create a future for a species that is truly beloved the world over," he said as the two adult pandas made their debut.
paras.zh: 在两只成年大熊猫首次亮相时，他说道：“这种非凡的合作精神有助于为全世界真正喜爱的物种创造未来。”

paras.en: China has a history of leasing the iconic pandas to other countries in a bid to build diplomatic ties, dubbed "panda diplomacy."
paras.zh: 中国有向其他国家出租标志性大熊猫以建立外交关系的历史，这被称为“熊猫外交”。

paras.en: Cubs born in foreign zoos are typically sent back to China.
paras.zh: 在国外动物园出生的幼崽通常会被送回中国。

paras.en: Meanwhile, unaware of the soft power they wield, Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, lounged about their new habitat on Friday.
paras.zh: 与此同时，萍萍和傅爽并没有意识到自己所拥有的软实力，周五在他们的新栖息地闲逛。

paras.en: The zoo recently renovated its panda facilities and has also ensured a long-term supply of locally grown bamboo for its newest residents.
paras.zh: 该动物园最近翻新了熊猫设施，并确保为其新居民长期供应当地种植的竹子。

paras.en: Three US zoos now house the black-and-white mammals.
paras.zh: 美国的三个动物园现在饲养着黑白哺乳动物。

articles.title: Smog blankets New Delhi as Diwali firecrackers worsen air quality

paras.en: Heavy smog has blanketed New Delhi after firecrackers lit up the Indian capital during Diwali celebrations, worsening the seasonal pollution crisis.
paras.zh: 在排灯节庆祝活动期间，印度首都燃放鞭炮，浓烟笼罩新德里，加剧了季节性污染危机。

paras.en: Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights, was celebrated across India on Sunday. Despite restrictions on fireworks, New Delhi residents celebrated the festival of lights with firecrackers throughout Sunday evening, releasing smoke and fine particulate matter into the atmosphere.
paras.zh: 周日，印度各地庆祝排灯节，即印度教排灯节。尽管烟花爆竹受到限制，新德里居民整个周日晚上都用鞭炮庆祝排灯节，向大气中释放烟雾和细颗粒物。

paras.en: On Monday morning, the Air Quality Index exceeded 350 in several parts of the capital, categorised as “severe” and posing significant health risks, according to the World Health Organization’s (WHO) recommended exposure thresholds.
paras.zh: 周一上午，根据世界卫生组织 (WHO) 建议的暴露阈值，首都多个地区的空气质量指数超过 350，属于“严重”级别，构成重大健康风险。

paras.en: Last month, India’s Supreme Court put in place restrictions to limit Diwali pollution, allowing only approved “green firecrackers” under specified conditions for three-hour windows on Saturday and Sunday. The approved crackers produce fewer emissions but are not pollution-free.
paras.zh: 上个月，印度最高法院制定了限制排灯节污染的限制措施，仅允许在特定条件下在周六和周日的三小时窗口内燃放经批准的“绿色鞭炮”。批准的裂解装置产生的排放量较少，但并非没有污染。

paras.en: On Wednesday, days before Diwali, toxic air pollution in New Delhi surged to more than 30 times the WHO’s recommended daily limit, data from air monitors showed.
paras.zh: 空气监测器的数据显示，周三，排灯节前几天，新德里的有毒空气污染飙升至世界卫生组织建议的每日限值的 30 倍以上。

paras.en: New Delhi, home to 30 million people, persistently ranks among the world’s most polluted capital cities.
paras.zh: 新德里拥有 3000 万人口，一直位居全球污染最严重的首都城市之列。

paras.en: The issue is exacerbated during the winter, when cooler temperatures, low wind speeds and stagnant atmospheric conditions prevent pollutants from dispersing.
paras.zh: 这个问题在冬季会更加严重，因为气温较低、风速较低且大气条件停滞，污染物无法扩散。

paras.en: Vehicles account for 23 percent of New Delhi’s winter pollution, while biomass burning, including farm stubble fires, contributes 20 percent, according to India’s Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.
paras.zh: 根据印度环境、森林和气候变化部的数据，新德里冬季污染中 23% 是由车辆造成的，而包括农场秸秆火灾在内的生物质燃烧则占 20%。

paras.en: The result is a thick haze that can linger over the capital and surrounding areas for days.
paras.zh: 其结果是浓浓的雾霾可能会在首都和周边地区持续数天。

articles.title: Lando Norris wins Sao Palo Grand Prix, but Mercedes seal constructors title

paras.en: Mercedes have secured their ninth Formula One constructors world championship and completed a title double in a wet Sao Paulo Grand Prix won by McLaren’s Lando Norris from pole position for the second year in a row.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯第九次夺得一级方程式车队世界冠军，并在潮湿的圣保罗大奖赛中完成双料冠军，迈凯伦车队的兰多·诺里斯连续第二年从杆位夺得冠军。

paras.en: The title, secured on Sunday, was the first team crown for Mercedes since 2021 and came a week after 20-year-old Italian Kimi Antonelli made headlines as the youngest drivers champion with four races to spare.
paras.zh: 周日获得的冠军是梅赛德斯自 2021 年以来的首个车队冠军，一周前，20 岁的意大利车手基米·安东内利 (Kimi Antonelli) 作为最年轻的车手冠军登上了头条，还剩四场比赛。

paras.en: Red Bull’s Max Verstappen finished second, putting on a masterclass from 21st on the grid due to engine penalties in a race that started and ended in the rain.
paras.zh: 红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘获得第二名，在雨中开始和结束的比赛中，由于发动机受到处罚，他从第 21 名发车，上演了一场大师级的比赛。

paras.en: Teammate Isack Hadjar was third with George Russell fourth for Mercedes and Antonelli fifth with the fastest lap. After leading at the start, both made costly errors on an eventful afternoon.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯车队的队友伊萨克·哈贾尔（Isack Hadjar）排名第三，乔治·拉塞尔（George Russell）排名第四，安东内利（Antonelli）以最快圈速排名第五。起步时领先后，两人在这个多事的下午都犯了代价高昂的错误。

paras.en: Mercedes had needed to score only three points more than Ferrari to clinch the title, and the Italian team never threatened to prolong the fight on a treacherous track with Charles Leclerc eighth after a post-race penalty demoted him one place and Lewis Hamilton ninth in his 400th race.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯只需要比法拉利多得分三分就可以锁定冠军，意大利车队从未威胁要在危险的赛道上延长战斗，查尔斯·勒克莱尔在赛后处罚被降级一位，刘易斯·汉密尔顿在他的第 400 场比赛中排名第九，位列第八。

paras.en: “It was a very tough race, very, very tough,” Norris, the 2025 world champion, said of his 14th career win and 50th podium as well as his team’s first victory since August when he won the Dutch Grand Prix.
paras.zh: “这是一场非常艰难的比赛，非常非常艰难，”2025 年世界冠军诺里斯谈到他职业生涯的第 14 次胜利和第 50 次登上领奖台，以及他的车队自 8 月赢得荷兰大奖赛以来的首场胜利时说道。

paras.en: “A lot of challenges today with the conditions and going onto slicks in the wet is always tough, especially when you are pushing for the lead and trying to catch up a little bit,” added the Briton, who lost out to Antonelli when the start lights went out.
paras.zh: “今天的条件有很多挑战，在湿滑的路面上行驶总是很艰难，尤其是当你努力争取领先并试图追上一点时，”这位英国人补充道，当起跑灯熄灭时，他输给了安东内利。

paras.en: “The main thing today was I kept it cool and didn’t make any mistakes and had the pace when I needed to. Nice to be back on the top step and what a place to do it as well.”
paras.zh: “今天最重要的是我保持冷静，没有犯任何错误，并且在需要的时候保持节奏。很高兴回到巅峰，也是一个可以做到这一点的地方。”

paras.en: Norris took the chequered flag, waved by Brazilian football forward Neymar, 14.602 seconds clear of Driver of the Day Verstappen.
paras.zh: 诺里斯在巴西足球前锋内马尔的挥舞下夺得了方格旗，领先当天车手维斯塔潘 14.602 秒。

paras.en: Mercedes, whose engines also power McLaren, have now equalled Williams’ nine constructors championships.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯的发动机也为迈凯轮提供动力，现在已经追平了威廉姆斯的九个车队冠军头衔。

paras.en: “It was a very strong beginning of the season, and that kind of got us over the line,” team boss Toto Wolff said. “These last few races have been challenging at times. Today it was difficult, but overall, I’m so proud of the organisation.”
paras.zh: “这是一个非常强劲的赛季开局，这让我们越过了界限，”球队老板托托·沃尔夫说。 “过去几场比赛有时充满挑战。今天很困难，但总的来说，我为这个组织感到自豪。”

paras.en: McLaren’s Oscar Piastri was sixth with Racing Bulls’ Liam Lawson seventh after a fine race that saw the New Zealander start third and run in second place for the first five laps.
paras.zh: 迈凯轮车队的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里 (Oscar Piastri) 排名第六，公牛队 (Racing Bulls) 车队的利亚姆·劳森 (Liam Lawson) 排名第七。新西兰人在一场精彩的比赛中从第三位起步，并在前五圈中排名第二。

paras.en: Nico Hulkenberg took the final point for Audi in a race of spins, slippery moments and changeable conditions.
paras.zh: 尼科·霍肯伯格在一场充满旋转、湿滑时刻和多变条件的比赛中为奥迪赢得了最后一分。

paras.en: Verstappen moved further ahead in the driver standings in the race for second place overall, now 17 points clear of Russell, who moved up to third.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘在车手积分榜上进一步领先，争夺第二名，目前领先升至第三名的拉塞尔 17 分。

articles.title: How Israel’s separation wall compares with the Berlin Wall

paras.en: In the occupied West Bank, a barrier of concrete and fencing cuts Palestinians off from their land, their families and nearby towns.
paras.zh: 在被占领的约旦河西岸，混凝土和栅栏组成的屏障将巴勒斯坦人与其土地、家人和附近城镇隔离开来。

paras.en: Israel began building its separation wall in 2002. Planned to stretch 712km (442 miles), it runs deep inside Palestinian territory rather than along the boundary with Israel. In 2004, the International Court of Justice ruled it illegal.
paras.zh: 以色列于 2002 年开始修建隔离墙。隔离墙计划绵延 712 公里（442 英里），深入巴勒斯坦领土内部，而不是沿着与以色列的边界。 2004年，国际法院裁定其非法。

paras.en: Today’s date carries extra weight. Thirty-seven years ago on November 9, 1989, the Berlin Wall fell.
paras.zh: 今天的约会格外重要。三十七年前的1989年11月9日，柏林墙倒塌。

paras.en: Built by East Germany in 1961 to stop its citizens fleeing to the West, it encircled West Berlin for 155km (96 miles), dividing the city and its people for 28 years.
paras.zh: 它由东德于 1961 年建造，旨在阻止其公民逃往西方，它环绕西柏林 155 公里（96 英里），将这座城市及其人民分隔了 28 年。

paras.en: Since 2003, Palestinians have marked the same date as an international day of action against Israel’s wall, which is more than four times as long and still being built. In urban areas, its concrete rises to about 9 metres (30ft), more than twice the height of Berlin’s.
paras.zh: 自 2003 年以来，巴勒斯坦人将这一天定为针对以色列隔离墙的国际行动日，该隔离墙的长度是以色列隔离墙的四倍多，而且仍在修建中。在城市地区，其混凝土高度约为 9 米（30 英尺），是柏林高度的两倍多。

paras.en: But the wall is more than a physical structure. It operates alongside a wider network of checkpoints, roadblocks, gates and permits that restricts Palestinian movement across the occupied territory.
paras.zh: 但墙不仅仅是一个物理结构。它与更广泛的检查站、路障、大门和许可证网络一起运作，限制巴勒斯坦人穿越被占领土的行动。

paras.en: According to the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), about 456km (283 miles), or 64 percent, of the planned route had been built by April.
paras.zh: 据联合国人道主义事务协调办公室 (OCHA) 称，截至 4 月份，计划路线的约 456 公里（283 英里）（即 64%）已建成。

paras.en: About 85 percent of it runs inside the West Bank rather than along the Green Line, the 1949 armistice line separating Israel from the West Bank. That route determines which communities, roads and farmland are cut off from their surroundings.
paras.zh: 大约 85% 的道路在约旦河西岸境内，而不是沿着绿线（1949 年将以色列与约旦河西岸分隔开的停战线）延伸。该路线决定了哪些社区、道路和农田与周围环境隔绝。

paras.en: In some urban areas, the barrier is a concrete wall. Elsewhere, it is made up of fences, patrol roads, ditches and other security infrastructure.
paras.zh: 在一些城市地区，屏障是混凝土墙。在其他地方，它由栅栏、巡逻道路、沟渠和其他安全基础设施组成。

paras.en: For Palestinians, the comparison with Berlin carries a message. “It doesn’t matter how high the barriers will be, they will fall,” a Palestinian activist in Bir Nabala told Al Jazeera. “Like the Berlin Wall fell, the Palestinian wall will fall.”
paras.zh: 对于巴勒斯坦人来说，与柏林的比较传达了一个信息。 “无论障碍有多高，它们都会倒塌，”比尔纳巴拉的一名巴勒斯坦活动人士告诉半岛电视台。 “就像柏林墙倒塌一样，巴勒斯坦墙也会倒塌。”

paras.en: How many people are cut off from their land?
paras.zh: 有多少人与自己的土地隔绝？

paras.en: The wall’s impact reaches far beyond the structure itself. Its route cuts Palestinian communities off from neighbouring towns, workplaces and farmland, disrupting livelihoods and everyday life.
paras.zh: 这堵墙的影响远远超出了结构本身。它的路线切断了巴勒斯坦社区与邻近城镇、工作场所和农田的联系，扰乱了生计和日常生活。

paras.en: More than 14,000 Palestinians live between the wall and the Green Line in an area known as the Seam Zone. To reach basic services, markets and relatives on the other side, they must pass through checkpoints.
paras.zh: 超过 14,000 名巴勒斯坦人居住在隔离墙和绿线之间一个被称为“接缝区”的地区。为了到达另一边的基本服务、市场和亲戚，他们必须通过检查站。

paras.en: Farmers are among the hardest hit. According to OCHA, about 150 Palestinian communities have land in this area. Reaching it depends on permits, prior coordination with Israeli authorities and access through designated agricultural gates.
paras.zh: 农民是受灾最严重的群体之一。据人道协调厅称，该地区约有 150 个巴勒斯坦社区拥有土地。实现这一目标取决于许可、与以色列当局的事先协调以及通过指定农业大门的进入。

paras.en: There are about 62 such gates along the wall, and most stay closed for much of the year. During the 2025 olive harvest, 74 percent opened only on a limited number of days.
paras.zh: 城墙上大约有 62 个这样的门，大多数在一年中的大部分时间里都是关闭的。在 2025 年橄榄收获期间，74% 的橄榄仅在有限的时间内开放。

paras.en: In Qalqiliya, the wall wraps around much of the city, cutting it off from nearby Palestinian communities and the land around it. Journeys to neighbouring towns that were once short can now mean passing through checkpoints or taking long detours.
paras.zh: 在盖勒吉利耶，隔离墙包围了城市的大部分地区，将其与附近的巴勒斯坦社区及其周围的土地隔离开来。前往邻近城镇的旅程曾经很短，现在可能意味着要经过检查站或绕很远的路。

paras.en: The wall restricts more than movement. It reshapes how communities relate to their land and places that are part of their everyday lives.
paras.zh: 墙壁限制的不仅仅是行动。它重塑了社区与土地和日常生活场所的关系。

paras.en: The wall is only one part of a much wider network restricting Palestinian movement across the West Bank.
paras.zh: 隔离墙只是限制巴勒斯坦人穿越西岸行动的更广泛网络的一部分。

paras.en: As of December, OCHA documented 925 checkpoints, road gates, earth mounds and other obstacles across the West Bank and occupied East Jerusalem. They restrict the movement of about 3.4 million Palestinians, often forcing long detours to reach work, school, hospitals and other services.
paras.zh: 截至 12 月，人道协调厅记录了西岸和被占领东耶路撒冷的 925 个检查站、路门、土堆和其他障碍物。它们限制了约 340 万巴勒斯坦人的行动，常常迫使他们绕很远的路才能到达工作地点、学校、医院和其他服务场所。

paras.en: The network includes 89 permanently staffed checkpoints, 218 partial checkpoints, 232 road gates, 167 earth mounds, 114 linear closures and 105 roadblocks.
paras.zh: 该网络包括 89 个常驻检查站、218 个部分检查站、232 个路口、167 个土堆、114 个线性封闭点和 105 个路障。

paras.en: Checkpoints and road gates now make up nearly 60 percent of these obstacles, up from 15 percent two decades ago when temporary blockages, such as earth mounds and roadblocks, were far more common.
paras.zh: 检查站和路闸现在占这些障碍物的近 60%，而二十年前这一比例为 15%，当时土堆和路障等临时堵塞更为常见。

paras.en: Crossing the wall itself requires permits. Of its 13 checkpoints, only three can be used by Palestinians with West Bank IDs and Israeli-issued permits to enter East Jerusalem and Israel. OCHA said these permits are hard to get and many have been revoked or suspended since the Hamas-led attacks on southern Israel and the start of Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza in October 2023.
paras.zh: 越过围墙本身就需要许可证。在其 13 个检查站中，只有 3 个可供持有西岸身份证和以色列颁发的进入东耶路撒冷和以色列许可证的巴勒斯坦人使用。人道协调厅表示，这些许可证很难获得，自 2023 年 10 月哈马斯领导的对以色列南部的袭击以及以色列对加沙的种族灭绝战争开始以来，许多许可证已被撤销或暂停。

paras.en: The wall stretches for hundreds of kilometres, but its impact cannot be measured by distance alone. It is measured in the farmland farmers struggle to reach, the communities cut off from nearby towns and the checkpoints between people and the places they need to go.
paras.zh: 隔离墙绵延数百公里，但其影响无法仅用距离来衡量。它是通过农民努力到达的农田、与附近城镇隔绝的社区以及人们和他们需要去的地方之间的检查站来衡量的。

articles.title: Trying to find true owners, Paris' Musee D'Orsay exhibits art looted by Nazis
articles.author: Eleanor Beardsley

paras.en: Trying to find true owners, Paris' Musee D'Orsay exhibits art looted by Nazis
paras.zh: 巴黎奥赛博物馆展出纳粹掠夺的艺术品，试图寻找真正的主人

paras.en: A new permanent exhibition at Paris' Musee d'Orsay showcases works of art suspected to have been looted by Nazis during the Second World War in France. Experts are trying to find the true owners or their descendants.
paras.zh: 巴黎奥赛博物馆的一个新常设展览展示了疑似在法国第二次世界大战期间被纳粹掠夺的艺术品。专家们正在努力寻找真正的主人或其后代。

paras.en: This year, Paris' Musée d'Orsay opened a permanent exhibition space to display paintings that were most likely stolen from Jewish families during World War II and whose owners have never been found. The room highlights ongoing work to track down those rightful owners. NPR's Eleanor Beardsley visited the museum and has this story.
paras.zh: 今年，巴黎奥赛博物馆开设了一个永久展览空间，展示极有可能在二战期间从犹太家庭被盗的画作，而其主人至今仍下落不明。该房间强调了正在进行的追查这些合法所有者的工作。 NPR 的埃莉诺·比尔兹利 (Eleanor Beardsley) 参观了博物馆并讲述了这个故事。

paras.en: ELEANOR BEARDSLEY, BYLINE: Tourists from around the world flock to the Musée d'Orsay to see its spectacular impressionist collection, but now the museum wants visitors to think more deeply about some of the artwork that is here. It recently opened a small, permanent room off a main gallery. The sign above the entrance reads, to whom do these works belong? The answers aren't easy.
paras.zh: 埃莉诺·比尔兹利连线：来自世界各地的游客涌入奥赛博物馆欣赏其壮观的印象派藏品，但现在博物馆希望游客更深入地思考这里的一些艺术品。它最近在主画廊旁边开设了一个小型的永久性房间。入口上方的牌子上写着：这些作品属于谁？答案并不容易。

paras.en: INES ROTERMUND-REYNARD: Of course, the families aren't there anymore, the people who had these works with them.
paras.zh: INES ROTERMUND-REYNARD：当然，这些家庭已经不在那里了，那些和他们一起工作的人已经不复存在了。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Ines Rotermund-Reynard is the Musée d'Orsay's head provenance researcher. She's responsible for confirming the ownership history of every work in this museum. She points to a large tableau painted by Belgian artist Alfred Stevens in 1891, which shows a girl with her arm around a younger boy, leaning over a balcony looking out on a Normandy beach.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：伊内斯·罗特蒙德·雷纳德 (Ines Rotermund-Reynard) 是奥赛博物馆的首席出处研究员。她负责确认该博物馆每件作品的所有权历史。她指着比利时艺术家阿尔弗雷德·史蒂文斯 (Alfred Stevens) 于 1891 年创作的一幅大型画作，画中一个女孩搂着一个小男孩，靠在阳台上眺望诺曼底海滩。

paras.en: ROTERMUND-REYNARD: And they are looking on the seaside, on the balcony with flowers, so it's a very beautiful subject, if you want. But the story of the painting, it's much less beautiful.
paras.zh: ROTERMUND-REYNARD：他们正在看海边，在开满鲜花的阳台上，所以如果你愿意的话，这是一个非常美丽的主题。但画中的故事，却远没有那么美丽。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: The painting once hung at Hitler's Bavarian Alpine retreat, known as Eagle's Nest. Rotermund-Reynard says it was likely caught up in the large-scale pillage of art by the Nazis that began as soon as they marched into Paris in June 1940.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：这幅画曾挂在希特勒位于巴伐利亚阿尔卑斯山的隐居处，即“鹰巢”。罗特蒙德-雷纳德 (Rotermund-Reynard) 表示，纳粹 1940 年 6 月进军巴黎后，就开始了对艺术品的大规模掠夺，该博物馆很可能陷入其中。

paras.en: ROTERMUND-REYNARD: Cultural looting was very much organized since the beginning. The Nazis knew the huge Jewish collections, and they started from June on to go to the families' places, to the apartments, and to take the work.
