articles.title: Victorian election 2026: Concern and scepticism among Labor MPs as new poll shows party trailing One Nation
articles.author: Benita Kolovos Victorian state correspondent

paras.en: Victorian Labor MPs are both sceptical and seriously concerned about a new poll ahead of the state election showing the party trailing third behind One Nation, with its primary vote at an all-time low of just 18%.
paras.zh: 维州工党议员对州选举前的一项新民意调查表示怀疑和严重担忧，该民意调查显示该党落后于一国党，落后于一国党，其初选得票率仅为 18%，创下历史新低。

paras.en: The DemosAU/PremierNational, first published by the Herald Sun on Monday, showed Labor’s primary vote share has crashed seven points to 18%, putting it in third place behind the Coalition’s 33% and One Nation’s 21%. At the same time, the Greens improved their primary vote to 17%, an increase of three points since September.
paras.zh: 《先驱太阳报》周一首次发布的 DemosAU/PremierNational 报告显示，工党的初选得票率已暴跌 7 个百分点，至 18%，位居第三，落后于联盟党 33% 和一国党 21%。与此同时，绿党的初选得票率提高至 17%，比 9 月份增加了 3 个百分点。

paras.en: It means the Coalition now leads Labor on a two-party preferred basis 56-44, compared with 52-48 in September.
paras.zh: 这意味着联盟党目前在两党优先的基础上以 56 比 44 领先工党，而 9 月份的比例为 52 比 48。

paras.en: George Hasanakos, DemosAU’s head of research, said if the poll were replicated on election night then many contests across the state would be between the Liberals or Nationals and One Nation, which would then result in a “clear Coalition majority”.
paras.zh: DemosAU 研究主管乔治·哈萨纳科斯 (George Hasanakos) 表示，如果在选举之夜重复进行民意调查，那么全州的许多竞争将在自由党或国家党和一国党之间展开，这将导致“联盟党明显占多数”。

paras.en: “If that happens, One Nation has to poll really, really well to have a chance of winning, because Labor and Greens preferences will flow to the Liberals,” he said.
paras.zh: “如果发生这种情况，一国党必须在民意调查中表现得非常非常好才有机会获胜，因为工党和绿党的偏好将流向自由党，”他说。

paras.en: On election night, the Victorian Electoral Commission plans to conduct a two-candidate-preferred count, or 2CP, between the two candidates it expects to finish with the most support after preferences are distributed. The commission is selecting the indicative 2CP for each seat based on polling, analysis of preference flows and results from previous elections. It will not publish the indicative 2CPs before election day to avoid influencing voter behaviour.
paras.zh: 在选举之夜，维多利亚州选举委员会计划对两名候选人进行优先计票（2CP），预计在分配优先权后将获得最多支持的两名候选人。该委员会正在根据民意调查、偏好流分析和之前选举的结果为每个席位选择指示性 2CP。它不会在选举日之前发布指示性 2CP，以避免影响选民的行为。

paras.en: Hasanakos added that he “double, triple, quadruple checked” the result of the “extraordinary” poll, which had 1,562 respondents, an effective sample of 818 and a margin of error of 3.4%.
paras.zh: 哈萨纳科斯补充说，他对这项“非凡”民意调查的结果进行了“双重、三重、四重检查”，该民意调查共有 1,562 名受访者，有效样本为 818 人，误差幅度为 3.4%。

paras.en: “We went to the trouble of a bigger sample here, and I stand by it,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们不辞辛劳地在这里采集了更大的样本，但我坚持这一点，”他说。

paras.en: Ben Carroll repeatedly refused to say whether he was worried about the poll at a press conference in South Melbourne on Monday morning.
paras.zh: 本·卡罗尔周一上午在南墨尔本举行的新闻发布会上多次拒绝透露他是否担心这次民意调查。

paras.en: “What I’m focused on every day is fighting for working people and making sure that every Victorian that goes into the ballot on November 28 knows that under my government you have a government on your side that will fight for you,” he told reporters.
paras.zh: 他告诉记者：“我每天关注的焦点是为工薪阶层而战，并确保每一位参加 11 月 28 日投票的维州人都知道，在我的政府领导下，有一个政府站在你一边，为你而战。”

paras.en: “The alternative is a Liberal-One Nation government that will fight against you – they’re going to shrink the economy, cause a recession and make life difficult for every single Victorian.”
paras.zh: “另一种选择是自由党一国政府将与你作对——他们将收缩经济，导致经济衰退，让每个维多利亚人的生活变得困难。”

paras.en: But the result has sparked serious concerns among the Labor caucus, even though some MPs are sceptical about the 18% figure. Inside Labor’s campaign headquarters, they are treating the result as an “outlier” and point to other public polls that have their primary vote in the 20s.
paras.zh: 但这一结果引发了工党核心小组的严重担忧，尽管一些议员对 18% 的数字持怀疑态度。在工党竞选总部内部，他们将这一结果视为“异常值”，并指出其他民意调查的初选票数为 20 多岁。

paras.en: Several Labor MPs, unauthorised to speak publicly, have told Guardian Australia there are many in the caucus questioning their party’s strategy.
paras.zh: 几位未经授权公开发言的工党议员告诉《澳大利亚卫报》，核心小组中有许多人质疑他们党的策略。

paras.en: This includes a focus in recent days on crime – an issue that is typically a Coalition strength. On Sunday, Carroll announced a $204m plan to enable judges to sentence low- and mid-level youth offenders to a new rehabilitation detention program, while on Monday he announced $70m to recruit 200 more police reservists to reopen stations and build and upgrade more stations.
paras.zh: 这包括最近几天对犯罪的关注——这是一个典型的联盟力量问题。周日，卡罗尔宣布了一项 2.04 亿美元的计划，使法官能够对低级和中级青少年罪犯判处新的改造拘留计划，而周一他宣布投入 7000 万美元，招募 200 名预备役警察，以重新开放警察局并建造和升级更多警察局。

paras.en: “Caucus is really angry and deflated, because this is all happening because of him,” one MP said.
paras.zh: 一名议员表示：“核心小组真的感到愤怒和泄气，因为这一切都是因为他而发生的。”

paras.en: “Even if it’s higher than 18, and we get back into something with a two in front of it, the experiment has been an epic fail, the campaign is in freefall, and it’s about to get a whole lot worse.”
paras.zh: “即使它高于 18，而且我们又回到了前面有 2 的情况，这个实验也是一次史诗般的失败，整个活动就像自由落体一样，而且情况还会变得更糟。”

paras.en: Another MP said the focus on crime was “diabolically stupid strategy” as the government had years to tackle community concern around rising rates.
paras.zh: 另一位议员表示，关注犯罪是“极其愚蠢的策略”，因为政府有多年的时间来解决社区对犯罪率上升的担忧。

paras.en: The opposition leader, Jess Wilson, on Monday said her party had a focus on “getting tough on crime”, including by introducing Aidan’s Law to toughen sentencing for attacks on people who step in to protect others.
paras.zh: 反对党领袖杰西·威尔逊(Jess Wilson)周一表示，她的政党的重点是“严厉打击犯罪”，包括引入艾丹法，以加强对那些介入保护他人的人的袭击的量刑。

paras.en: Carroll immediately matched the commitment to introduce the proposed law, named after 22-year-old Aidan Becker, who was fatally stabbed at Mernda station after stepping in to protect a 14-year-old during an alleged violent robbery.
paras.zh: 卡罗尔立即兑现了引入拟议法律的承诺，该法律以 22 岁的艾丹·贝克尔 (Aidan Becker) 的名字命名。艾丹·贝克尔在一次涉嫌暴力抢劫的事件中介入保护一名 14 岁的青少年，随后在默恩达车站被刺伤身亡。

paras.en: It comes as Pauline Hanson rejected reports by the Age and 60 Minutes on Sunday that her former national campaign director Sean Black continues to secretly work for One Nation in Victoria.
paras.zh: 周日，宝琳·汉森 (Pauline Hanson) 否认了《时代报》和《60 分钟》的报道，称她的前全国竞选总监肖恩·布莱克 (Sean Black) 继续秘密为维多利亚州的一国党 (One Nation) 工作。

paras.en: Black in 2018 was jailed for rape and subsequently lost his appeal against the conviction but was then rehired by One Nation in 2020 as a campaign director after serving his time. Hanson sacked him after political pressure earlier this year.
paras.zh: 布莱克于 2018 年因强奸罪入狱，随后对定罪上诉失败，但刑满后于 2020 年被一国党重新聘为竞选总监。今年早些时候，汉森在政治压力下解雇了他。

paras.en: She told the Australian Financial Review on Monday “the day that I sacked him [Sean Black] that was the day he finished up”.
paras.zh: 她周一告诉《澳大利亚金融评论报》，“我解雇他（肖恩·布莱克）的那一天，就是他结束的那一天”。

articles.title: Stop undermining Jim Chalmers, environment minister urges Labor colleagues
articles.author: Tom McIlroy Political editor

paras.en: The environment minister, Murray Watt, has urged ministers to stop undermining the treasurer, Jim Chalmers, as Labor struggles to sell its budget and looks to cut popular clean energy subsidies to help with the fight against inflation.
paras.zh: 环境部长默里·瓦特 (Murray Watt) 敦促部长们停止破坏财政部长吉姆·查尔默斯 (Jim Chalmers) 的影响，因为工党正在努力推销其预算，并希望削减受欢迎的清洁能源补贴以帮助对抗通货膨胀。

paras.en: Cabinet ministers met again on Monday to discuss potential budget savings to be included in next month’s mid-year update, part of efforts to reducing spending to ease pressure on the economy.
paras.zh: 内阁部长周一再次开会，讨论下个月年中更新中可能包含的预算节省，这是减少支出以缓解经济压力的努力的一部分。

paras.en: Watt was asked about speculation of tension between the treasurer and the prime minister, Anthony Albanese, and whether he’d like to see an end to “undermining and leaking” against Chalmers.
paras.zh: 瓦特被问及有关财政部长和总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯之间紧张关系的猜测，以及他是否希望看到针对查尔默斯的“破坏和泄密”结束。

paras.en: “Yes, I would,” Watt said. “As a member of the government, I take seriously the responsibility to work together to support government policies and also to get our work to support each other in what are very difficult times.
paras.zh: “是的，我愿意，”瓦特说。 “作为政府成员，我认真承担起共同努力支持政府政策的责任，并在非常困难的时期让我们的工作相互支持。

paras.en: “I think that Jim Chalmers is doing an excellent job as a treasurer in what are very difficult economic times; many of the features that are impacting on our economy are sort of well outside any treasurer’s control, and I very much support Jim Chalmers in his efforts.”
paras.zh: “我认为吉姆·查尔默斯在经济困难时期作为财务主管做得非常出色；影响我们经济的许多因素都超出了任何财务主管的控制范围，我非常支持吉姆·查尔默斯的努力。”

paras.en: Watt conceded Chalmers was being undermined from within Labor.
paras.zh: 瓦特承认查默斯正在受到工党内部的削弱。

paras.en: “It’s pretty obvious that there are all sorts of people making all sorts of comments.”
paras.zh: “很明显，各种各样的人都在发表各种各样的评论。”

paras.en: A new round of opinion polls added to Labor’s political pain on Monday, with the Resolve Political Monitor in the Age and Sydney Morning Herald showing Labor’s primary vote falling to 28 percentage points, down from 34.6% at last year’s election.
paras.zh: 周一的新一轮民意调查加剧了工党的政治痛苦，《时代解决政治观察》和《悉尼先驱晨报》显示工党的初选得票率下降至 28 个百分点，低于去年选举时的 34.6%。

paras.en: The Coalition also dropped one point to 22%, while One Nation was steady at 25%.
paras.zh: 联盟党的支持率也下降了 1 个百分点，至 22%，而一国党则稳定在 25%。

paras.en: A Redbridge poll in the Financial Review showed Labor’s primary vote slipped two percentage points to 26%, while the Coalition’s jumped four points to 25%. One Nation was down one point to 28%.
paras.zh: 《金融评论》的雷德布里奇民意调查显示，工党的初选得票率下滑了两个百分点，至 26%，而联盟党的得票率则跃升了四个百分点，至 25%。 One Nation 下降了一个百分点，至 28%。

paras.en: Monday’s meeting of the expenditure review committee of cabinet comes after last week’s interest rate hike from the Reserve Bank. The governor, Michele Bullock, said while it is up to governments to manage their budgets independently of the RBA, public and private spending had caused “excess demand” in the economy.
paras.zh: 继上周储备银行加息之后，周一召开了内阁支出审查委员会会议。行长米歇尔·布洛克表示，虽然政府有责任独立于澳大利亚央行管理预算，但公共和私人支出导致了经济“需求过剩”。

paras.en: Watt accused the Coalition and minor parties of leaving existing spending proposals to linger in parliament, including savings from changes to the private health insurance rebate for over 65s.
paras.zh: 瓦特指责联盟党和小党将现有的支出提案留在议会，其中包括通过改变 65 岁以上的私人医疗保险回扣而节省的开支。

paras.en: “Let’s not forget that for all of their demands that we find more savings, the Coalition currently are blocking the government from saving $10 billion in measures that are before the parliament,” Watt said.
paras.zh: 瓦特说：“我们不要忘记，尽管他们要求我们找到更多储蓄，但联盟党目前正在阻止政府采取议会面前的 100 亿美元储蓄措施。”

paras.en: Albanese has confirmed spending in the public service will be scrutinised as the government looks for savings in the budget update, expected in the middle of December. Last year, departments and agencies were asked to identify potential savings of as much as 5% from their annual budgets, part of the government’s efforts to cut lower-priority spending.
paras.zh: Albanese 已确认，随着政府在预计于 12 月中旬更新的预算中寻求节省开支，公共服务支出将受到审查。去年，各部门和机构被要求从其年度预算中确定多达 5% 的潜在节省，这是政府削减低优先级支出的努力的一部分。

paras.en: Spending on Labor’s $7bn home battery subsidy program and incentives for electric vehicle purchases could be reined in.
paras.zh: 工党 70 亿美元的家用电池补贴计划和电动汽车购买激励措施的支出可能会受到限制。

paras.en: Announced in April 2025, the batteries program was originally designed to cost about $2bn. More than 600,000 systems have been installed, but the program could have means testing rules added.
paras.zh: 该电池计划于 2025 年 4 月宣布，最初设计成本约为 20 亿美元。已经安装了超过 600,000 个系统，但该计划可能会添加经济状况测试规则。

paras.en: Separately, subsidies designed to promote uptake of electric vehicles has cost the budget far more than originally anticipated.
paras.zh: 另外，旨在促进电动汽车普及的补贴所花费的预算远远超过最初的预期。

paras.en: Angus Taylor announced an opposition “red tape razor gang” on Monday, designed to reduce the burden on business from costly regulation.
paras.zh: 安格斯·泰勒周一宣布成立反对派“繁文缛节剃须刀团伙”，旨在减轻昂贵的监管给企业带来的负担。

articles.title: Kraków shooting suspect who killed six has died, say police in Poland
articles.author: Staff and agencies

paras.en: A gunman suspected of killing six people in Kraków has died in hospital, police in Poland said early on Monday.
paras.zh: 波兰警方周一早些时候表示，一名涉嫌在克拉科夫杀害六人的枪手已在医院死亡。

paras.en: The suspect had been wounded in a shootout with police and had been in critical condition in hospital.
paras.zh: 嫌疑人在与警方的枪战中受伤，目前在医院情况危急。

paras.en: “We would like to inform you that the perpetrator of the tragic events died in hospital early this morning,” Malopolska Policja wrote on X.
paras.zh: Malopolska Policja 在 X 上写道：“我们想通知您，悲剧事件的肇事者今天凌晨在医院去世。”

paras.en: Polish prosecutors had opened a terrorism investigation after a 24-year-old man opened fire in a busy market square on Saturday afternoon, killing six including a Briton and injuring 17, in an attack that authorities said was probably inspired by far-right ideologies.
paras.zh: 周六下午，一名 24 岁男子在繁忙的集市广场开枪，造成包括一名英国人在内的 6 人死亡，17 人受伤，波兰检察官已展开恐怖主义调查，当局称这起袭击可能是受到极右意识形态的启发。

paras.en: Karolina Galecka, an interior ministry spokeswoman, told radio TOK FM on Monday: “There were many different emblems on the perpetrator’s clothing that have been partially examined and interpreted.
paras.zh: 内政部发言人卡罗琳娜·加莱卡 (Karolina Galecka) 周一对 TOK FM 电台表示：“肇事者的衣服上有许多不同的标志，这些标志已经过部分检查和解释。

paras.en: “These patches were associated with various motifs that are currently being analysed by specialists,” she added, declining to comment further as the investigation was ongoing.
paras.zh: “这些补丁与专家目前正在分析的各种图案有关，”她补充道，由于调查正在进行，她拒绝进一步置评。

paras.en: Police confirmed on Sunday that three people found dead at the gunman’s home after the attack on Saturday afternoon were his father, 53, mother, 52, and sister, 21.
paras.zh: 警方周日证实，周六下午袭击事件发生后，枪手家中发现三人死亡，分别是他 53 岁的父亲、52 岁的母亲和 21 岁的妹妹。

paras.en: As two days of national mourning began, the national prosecutor’s office said on social media it had launched an investigation into “the killing of six people … using a firearm, and the attempted murder of many others, including police officers, this act constituting a terrorist offence”.
paras.zh: 随着为期两天的全国哀悼开始，国家检察官办公室在社交媒体上表示，已对“使用枪支杀害六人，以及企图谋杀包括警察在内的许多人进行调查，这种行为构成恐怖主义犯罪”。

paras.en: The rare mass shooting has shocked a country that was considered safer than many of its European neighbours, and has deepened concern after several school stabbings in October that left one woman dead and which officials said were linked to extremist content online.
paras.zh: 这起罕见的大规模枪击事件震惊了这个被认为比许多欧洲邻国更安全的国家，并在十月份发生了几起导致一名妇女死亡的学校持刀伤人事件后加深了人们的担忧，官员们称这起事件与网上的极端主义内容有关。

articles.title: Inside the French drug gangs recruiting children to kill

paras.en: Warning: Strong language and descriptions of sexual violence
paras.zh: 警告：粗俗语言和性暴力描述

paras.en: Although she had just bought hashish from a drug dealer, the woman decided to call the police.
paras.zh: 尽管她刚刚从毒贩那里购买了大麻，但该女子还是决定报警。

paras.en: It was because, along with the illegal drugs, she had been handed a note by the young seller during their brief meeting on a Marseille housing estate in 2022.
paras.zh: 这是因为，2022 年，年轻卖家在马赛一处住宅区进行简短会面时，除了非法毒品之外，还给了她一张纸条。

paras.en: "We're being held captive and need help. We are 15-years-old," it read.
paras.zh: “我们被俘虏了，需要帮助。我们今年 15 岁，”上面写道。

paras.en: The teenage dealer, a French court heard earlier this year, was one of two boys being held by a gang which they had both initially approached looking for paid work - albeit illegal.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，法国法庭审理了这名青少年毒贩的案子，他是被一个团伙关押的两名男孩之一，他们最初都是为了寻找有酬工作——尽管是非法的。

paras.en: One boy had been tasked with handling money, the other worked streets around the Frais-Vallon estate. Soon though, bosses had accused them of being responsible for "shortfalls" in takings.
paras.zh: 一个男孩的任务是处理金钱，另一个男孩则在弗赖斯-瓦隆庄园周围的街道上工作。但很快，老板们就指责他们对收入“不足”负有责任。

paras.en: What followed were regular beatings, the court was told, and being forced to dance naked in front of a camera as a form of blackmail. One of the boys was also raped.
paras.zh: 法庭被告知，随之而来的是经常性的殴打，并被迫在镜头前裸体跳舞，作为一种勒索形式。其中一名男孩也被强奸。

paras.en: Hours after the woman was passed the note, the two teenagers had tried to escape from a second-storey window, injuring themselves in the process. One managed to get away, while the other was caught, beaten and stabbed, but survived.
paras.zh: 在这名女子收到纸条几小时后，这两名青少年试图从二楼的窗户逃走，并在过程中受伤。其中一人成功逃脱，另一人被抓、殴打和刺伤，但幸存。

paras.en: Arrests were made. Photos on the phone of one of the boys' alleged torturers showed several other young men in a similarly distressed condition. Six men have since been handed hefty sentences for what happened to the two teenagers.
paras.zh: 进行了逮捕。其中一名被指控施虐男孩的人手机上的照片显示，其他几名年轻男子也处于同样痛苦的境地。此后，六名男子因两名青少年的遭遇而被处以重刑。

paras.en: The boys' story highlights the grip that drug gangs hold over parts of France's second city.
paras.zh: 男孩们的故事凸显了贩毒团伙对法国第二大城市部分地区的控制。

paras.en: While the blend of Mediterranean culture, street art and hip-hop scene has made Marseille a popular tourist destination - beyond the city centre, it is another story.
paras.zh: 虽然地中海文化、街头艺术和嘻哈音乐的融合使马赛成为一个受欢迎的旅游目的地——但在市中心之外，则是另一回事了。

paras.en: After months of trying, a BBC team managed to enter this dangerous world - centred on deprived streets and high-rise housing estates in the port city, which police do not enter lightly.
paras.zh: 经过几个月的尝试，BBC 团队成功进入了这个危险的世界——以这座港口城市的贫困街道和高层住宅区为中心，警察不会轻易进入这些地方。

paras.en: We found an environment where ruthless gangs lure vulnerable young people with promises of easy money, but end up trapping them in a world of drug dealing, brutality and exploitation.
paras.zh: 我们发现，残酷的团伙以轻松赚钱的承诺来引诱脆弱的年轻人，但最终却让他们陷入了毒品交易、残暴和剥削的世界。

paras.en: We saw how gangs use social media to recruit hitmen and spoke to several young men caught up in the violence. From prison, one gang member accused of involvement in several murders explained how his "cold-bloodedness" had helped him rise through the ranks.
paras.zh: 我们看到了帮派如何利用社交媒体招募杀手，并采访了几名陷入暴力的年轻人。一名被指控参与多起谋杀案的帮派成员在监狱中解释了他的“冷血”如何帮助他晋升。

paras.en: The city's most powerful gang, DZ Mafia, emerged victorious from a bloody turf war and is now one of the most feared criminal organisations in France.
paras.zh: 该市最强大的帮派 DZ 黑手党在一场血腥的地盘争夺战中取得了胜利，现在已成为法国最令人畏惧的犯罪组织之一。

paras.en: DZ is the official internet country code for Algeria, where one of the gang's founders, a French-Algerian called Mehdi Laribi, was detained earlier this year under a French arrest warrant.
paras.zh: DZ 是阿尔及利亚的官方互联网国家代码，该团伙的创始人之一、法裔阿尔及利亚人迈赫迪·拉里比 (Mehdi Laribi) 今年早些时候根据法国逮捕令被拘留。

paras.en: The criminal outfit rose to prominence in 2023, when it became the first French gang to capitalise on its notoriety by releasing video statements - using social media to market itself as a brand - says the head of the country's anti-drug trafficking unit, Dimitri Zoulas.
paras.zh: 法国反毒品走私部门负责人迪米特里·祖拉斯 (Dimitri Zoulas) 表示，该犯罪团伙于 2023 年声名鹊起，成为法国第一个通过发布视频声明利用其恶名的团伙，利用社交媒体将自己打造成一个品牌。

paras.en: Its most recent statement came in July, when the mayor of a nearby town had to be placed in police protection, after intelligence suggested he was in danger of being targeted by the group.
paras.zh: 该组织最新的声明是在 7 月份发布的，当时附近一个城镇的市长有可能成为该组织的攻击目标，因此不得不接受警方保护。

paras.en: In an online video, six masked men dressed in black stood behind a table - as one of them read a statement denying DZ Mafia's involvement.
paras.zh: 在一段在线视频中，六名身着黑衣的蒙面男子站在桌子后面，其中一人宣读了一份否认 DZ Mafia 参与的声明。

paras.en: France's expanding illegal drugs market - which has seen a surge in cocaine imports alongside high volumes of cannabis and synthetic drugs - has also helped the gang grow rapidly.
paras.zh: 法国不断扩大的非法毒品市场——可卡因进口量激增，大麻和合成毒品数量也大量增加——也帮助该团伙迅速发展。

paras.en: The number of cocaine users in France is expected soon to reach two million, says Zoulas, up from 600,000 in 2017. Drug smuggling across France generates â¬7bn (Â£5.9bn) a year, involving 200,000 people, he adds.
paras.zh: 祖拉斯表示，法国的可卡因使用者人数预计很快将达到 200 万，而 2017 年为 60 万。他补充说，法国各地的毒品走私每年创收 70 亿欧元（59 亿英镑），涉​​及 20 万人。

paras.en: Many of those distributing the drugs are children and the authorities say the number of minors caught up in trafficking is increasing. During 2025, more than 10,000 children were involved in some way, according to official figures.
paras.zh: 许多贩毒者都是儿童，当局表示，被贩运的未成年人数量正在增加。根据官方数据，2025 年期间，有超过 10,000 名儿童以某种方式参与其中。

paras.en: DZ Mafia is a prime example. To reach more customers, it needs more gang members - more children.
paras.zh: DZ Mafia 就是一个典型的例子。为了吸引更多的顾客，它需要更多的帮派成员——更多的孩子。

paras.en: We have found it is now recruiting young people from across France - not just to sell drugs, but to carry out kidnap, torture and murder.
paras.zh: 我们发现它现在正在从法国各地招募年轻人——不仅仅是为了贩卖毒品，还为了实施绑架、酷刑和谋杀。

paras.en: They are a generation seen as easy to corrupt, but also expendable, by the kingpins who typically control them from prison or overseas.
paras.zh: 他们是容易腐败的一代人，但也被通常在监狱或海外控制他们的主要人物视为可牺牲品。

paras.en: And, as police and judges warn, once these children enter Marseille's underworld, it is very hard to get them out.
paras.zh: 而且，正如警方和法官警告的那样，一旦这些孩子进入马赛的黑社会，就很难将他们救出来。

paras.en: Few know the human cost of Marseille's gangs like mother Karine Brouillard - who lives at the other end of France, almost as far from the Mediterranean coast as you can get.
paras.zh: 很少有人像母亲卡琳·布鲁亚尔 (Karine Brouillard) 那样了解马赛帮派所造成的人员伤亡。她住在法国的另一端，几乎距离地中海海岸最远。

paras.en: Her son, Hugo, first ran away aged 15 - from his home in a village in the Nord department - after an argument with his family. He was picked up by police three days later, almost 1,000km (600 miles) away in Marseille, with money and cannabis on him. He was taken home.
paras.zh: 她的儿子雨果 (Hugo) 15 岁时，在与家人发生争执后，首次从北部省一个村庄的家中离家出走。三天后，他在近 1,000 公里（600 英里）外的马赛被警察抓获，身上带着钱和大麻。他被带回家了。

paras.en: But several years later, in 2023, Hugo planned to return south, telling his parents he had secured a holiday job at a restaurant near Marseille.
paras.zh: 但几年后，即 2023 年，雨果计划返回南方，告诉父母他已在马赛附近的一家餐厅找到了一份假期工作。

paras.en: "He gave regular updates," Karine remembers. "He called me, everything was going well."
paras.zh: “他定期更新，”卡琳回忆道。 “他打电话给我，一切都很顺利。”

paras.en: Three weeks later, a doctor called. Karine says she will never forget his words: "Your son arrived last night. He took a bullet to the head."
paras.zh: 三周后，医生打来电话。卡琳说她永远不会忘记他的话：“你的儿子昨晚到了。他的头部中了一颗子弹。”

paras.en: Police believe Hugo was brought for medical help from a gang-controlled area and suspect he was involved with one.
paras.zh: 警方认为雨果是从帮派控制区被带去寻求医疗帮助的，并怀疑他与其中有牵连。

paras.en: Our best way into Quartier Nord, where DZ Mafia wields power, is with the help of resident Fadella Ouidef, a 41-year-old mother-of-four who gives us a tour.
paras.zh: 我们进入北区（DZ 黑手党掌权的地方）的最佳方式是在当地居民 Fadella Ouidef 的帮助下，她是一位 41 岁的四个孩子的母亲，她带我们参观了这里。

paras.en: Thirty-seven seconds after entering one housing estate, we find ourselves cornered.
paras.zh: 进入一处住宅区三十七秒后，我们发现自己被逼入绝境。

paras.en: Car horns sound the moment Fadella's Peugeot passes a gang checkpoint - the teenagers manning the post immediately spot our camera. "Wait, stop filming," Fadella warns, as a grey 4x4 forces us to the side of the road.
paras.zh: 当法德拉的标致汽车通过帮派检查站时，汽车喇叭响起 - 负责哨所的青少年立即发现了我们的相机。 “等等，停止拍摄，”法德拉警告道，一辆灰色四驱车将我们逼到路边。

paras.en: "I'm making a report for my housing association," she tells the inquisitive driver. He eventually agrees to let us leave if we stop filming.
paras.zh: “我正在为我的住房协会做一份报告，”她告诉好奇的司机。他最终同意如果我们停止拍摄就让我们离开。

paras.en: It is unnerving to see a non-police vehicle move so assertively and a relief to watch it leave.
paras.zh: 看到一辆非警车如此果断地行驶令人不安，看到它离开又让人松了口气。

paras.en: "Lately, the gangs have been very aggressive," explains Fadella. "What we simply try to do is make sure our young people understand what's happening is wrong."
paras.zh: “最近，这些团伙非常具有攻击性，”法德拉解释道。 “我们只是想确保我们的年轻人明白正在发生的事情是错误的。”

paras.en: Fadella speaks to a wider fear among local families: that their children are enticed by huge sums of money to take a criminal path that robs them of their innocence.
paras.zh: 法德拉谈到了当地家庭中更广泛的恐惧：他们的孩子被巨额金钱引诱走上犯罪道路，剥夺了他们的清白。

paras.en: Money is what led one young man to spend his teenage years with DZ Mafia.
paras.zh: 金钱促使一名年轻人在 DZ Mafia 度过了自己的青少年时期。

paras.en: In order for our interviewees to speak freely, or because of safety concerns, we have agreed to protect their identities.
paras.zh: 为了让我们的受访者能够自由发言，或者出于安全考虑，我们同意保护他们的身份。

paras.en: Camil tells us he worked up the gang's ranks to "running security" in one area it controls.
paras.zh: 卡米尔告诉我们，他将该团伙的队伍提升为在其控制的一个地区“负责安全”。

paras.en: The now 20-year-old, who claims to have left the group, is highly suspicious of our presence, but agrees to tell us how the gang recruits young members.
paras.zh: 这位现年 20 岁的男子声称已经离开该组织，他对我们的存在高度怀疑，但同意告诉我们该团伙如何招募年轻成员。

paras.en: "They know how to get inside your head. Whatever you want, they give to you," he says. This can range from nice cars and spacious apartments, to drugs and prostitutes, he explains.
paras.zh: “他们知道如何进入你的大脑。无论你想要什么，他们都会给你，”他说。他解释说，这包括从漂亮的汽车和宽敞的公寓到毒品和妓女。

paras.en: "You feel loyalty because of what they give you. You'll stay until the very end, until either death or prison."
paras.zh: “你会因为他们给你的东西而感到忠诚。你会一直呆到最后，直到死亡或入狱。”

paras.en: Camil also gives a sobering assessment of what happens if the gang identifies a weakness in a recruit: "They'll exploit it. You're their bitch, it's over."
paras.zh: 卡米尔还对如果该团伙发现新兵的弱点会发生什么做出了发人深省的评估：“他们会利用它。你是他们的婊子，一切都结束了。”

paras.en: DZ Mafia member, Adam - not his real name - tells us he was part of a DZ Mafia hit squad when we speak to him in a Snapchat video call.
paras.zh: DZ 黑手党成员 Adam（化名）告诉我们，当我们在 Snapchat 视频通话中与他交谈时，他是 DZ 黑手党打击小组的一员。

paras.en: He is currently in prison awaiting trial, after being implicated in several murders.
paras.zh: 因涉嫌多起谋杀案，他目前正在监狱等待审判。

paras.en: "People noticed my determination, my cold-bloodedness and, without wanting to, I climbed up the ladder of the gang," says Adam. "It became my place, I had to roll with it."
paras.zh: “人们注意到了我的决心、我的冷血，我在不知不觉中爬上了帮派的阶梯，”亚当说。 “它成了我的地盘，我必须顺其自然。”

paras.en: During the chat, he agrees the killings he has been charged with were "quite shocking".
paras.zh: 在聊天中，他承认他被指控的杀戮行为“相当令人震惊”。

paras.en: "Attempts in broad daylight, in traffic jamsâ¦ it can range from going to hit a guy, slap him to taking him in front of his mother and burning him up in a car. I think I have good composure, I handle it fairly well."
paras.zh: “在光天化日之下，在交通堵塞的情况下……可能会打人、扇他耳光，或者把他带到他母亲面前，然后在车里把他烧死。我认为我镇静得很好，处理得还不错。”

paras.en: We challenge Adam on whether he feels regret when carrying out such acts of brutality.
paras.zh: 我们向亚当提出质疑，问他在实施这种残暴行为时是否感到后悔。

paras.en: He says he is "feeling in-part guilty" but claims to have no regrets.
paras.zh: 他说他“感到部分内疚”，但声称并不后悔。

paras.en: "If I hadn't done all of this, there are other people who would have done that in my place, and so on. I am just another brick in the wall," he says.
paras.zh: “如果我没有做这一切，其他人就会代替我做这件事，等等。我只是墙上的另一块砖，”他说。

paras.en: Like so many teenagers from Marseille, he knew large sums of money could be earned quickly in drug trafficking. Now in his twenties, he admits the environment he entered was a "trap".
paras.zh: 和许多来自马赛的青少年一样，他知道通过贩毒可以很快赚到大笔钱。如今二十多岁的他承认自己进入的环境是一个“陷阱”。

paras.en: At a so-called deal point in a social housing estate - sealed off and controlled by DZ Mafia - price lists for cocaine, hashish and marijuana are graffitied on a wall.
paras.zh: 在一个由 DZ 黑手党封锁和控制的社会住房的所谓交易点，墙上涂鸦着可卡因、印度大麻和大麻的价目表。

paras.en: The estate acts as a natural fortress for drug dealers. With one major road in and out, they can control the flow of customers and see if the police are coming.
paras.zh: 该庄园是毒贩的天然堡垒。进出一条主干道，他们可以控制客流，看看警察是否来了。

paras.en: It is not uncommon for the sound of automatic gunfire to fill the night air in these areas.
paras.zh: 在这些地区的夜间空气中，自动枪声并不少见。

paras.en: After months of negotiations, a deal-point manager from a rival gang agrees to meet us where he works.
paras.zh: 经过几个月的谈判，敌对帮派的一名交易点经理同意在他工作的地方与我们会面。

paras.en: We enter the estate early in the morning, the birdsong and children walking to school providing a stark contrast to the industrial-scale criminal operation that takes place here.
paras.zh: 我们一大早进入庄园，鸟鸣声和步行上学的孩子们与这里发生的工业规模犯罪活动形成鲜明对比。

paras.en: "Joe" says he was making â¬3,000 (Â£2,500) a month when he was 13. Now he says that has risen to between â¬5,000 and â¬10,000 a month.
paras.zh: “乔”说，他 13 岁时每个月的收入为 3,000 英镑（2,500 英镑）。现在他说这个数字已经上升到每月 5,000 英镑至 10,000 英镑。

paras.en: He seems to see his life path as pre-ordained, albeit a lucrative one.
paras.zh: 他似乎认为自己的人生道路是注定的，尽管这是一条有利可图的道路。

paras.en: We ask Joe if he thinks about the lives lost because of the violence carried out by his gang, but the 23-year-old has also long made peace with the pain and destruction drug trafficking can cause.
paras.zh: 我们问乔是否考虑过因帮派实施暴力而失去的生命，但这位 23 岁的年轻人也早已坦然面对贩毒可能造成的痛苦和破坏。

paras.en: "It destroys people, but we all make our own choices," he shrugs.
paras.zh: “它毁了人，但我们都会做出自己的选择，”他耸耸肩。

paras.en: The work that Joe's gang and DZ Mafia are doing represents a threat to national security, says Zoulas, of the anti-drug trafficking unit.
paras.zh: 反毒品贩运部门的祖拉斯表示，乔的团伙和 DZ 黑手党所做的工作对国家安全构成了威胁。

paras.en: There are road accidents, as well as family violence, depressions, suicides and more than 700 overdoses each year, he says, "and it distorts the economy".
paras.zh: 他说，每年都会发生交通事故、家庭暴力、抑郁症、自杀和700多起吸毒过量事件，“这扭曲了经济”。

paras.en: "We are heading towards a potential systemic breakdown of the criminal justice system."
paras.zh: “我们正在走向刑事司法系统潜在的系统性崩溃。”

paras.en: Police have had success in Marseille and other cities against drug gangs.
paras.zh: 马赛和其他城市的警方在打击贩毒团伙方面取得了成功。

paras.en: Criminal operations are being frustrated, more kingpins arrested and drugs seized.
paras.zh: 犯罪活动受到挫败，更多的头目被捕，毒品被查获。

paras.en: Since 2024, about 1,000 individuals associated with DZ Mafia have been arrested, and 600 incarcerated, police say.
paras.zh: 警方称，自 2024 年以来，约有 1,000 名与 DZ 黑手党有关联的人被捕，600 人被监禁。

paras.en: But overall, it is a battle that is becoming more arduous, rather than easier.
paras.zh: 但总体而言，这场战斗正在变得更加艰巨，而不是变得容易。

paras.en: As gangs seek to widen their operations, or replace members who have been arrested or killed, social media has become a potent recruitment tool - especially since the Covid pandemic, when many street-drug sales jumped online.
paras.zh: 随着帮派寻求扩大其活动范围，或替换已被捕或被杀的成员，社交媒体已成为一种有效的招募工具——尤其是自新冠疫情大流行以来，许多街头毒品销售在网上激增。

paras.en: On social media, we found countless posts advertising jobs in Marseille for aspiring drivers, couriers and hitmen, often with glamourised AI-generated images.
paras.zh: 在社交媒体上，我们发现无数帖子在马赛为有抱负的司机、快递员和杀手做广告，这些帖子通常带有人工智能生成的迷人图像。

paras.en: Nets are also being cast wider, as it becomes harder to entice young people locally because they know more about what might happen to them.
paras.zh: 网络也正在扩大，因为吸引当地的年轻人变得更加困难，因为他们更了解自己可能会发生什么。

paras.en: The ads can reach teenagers in most corners of France - including Paris, Nantes and Lille - and serve as a powerful pull to Marseille, and the Quartier Nord, police say.
paras.zh: 警方称，这些广告可以覆盖法国大部分地区的青少年，包括巴黎、南特和里尔，并对马赛和北区产生强大的吸引力。

paras.en: Online advertising has also changed the typical profile of someone who would join a gang's ranks, say law enforcement officials.
paras.zh: 执法官员表示，在线广告还改变了加入帮派行列的人的典型形象。

paras.en: Now, it is often someone without a criminal past, but who has exploitable vulnerabilities, like having a difficult family life.
paras.zh: 现在，通常是没有犯罪记录但有可利用弱点的人，例如家庭生活困难。

paras.en: "These people are recruited by unscrupulous sponsors who send them into the lion's den," explains Thibaut Fontaine, the head of France's anti-organised-crime unit.
paras.zh: 法国反有组织犯罪部门负责人蒂博·方丹（Thibaut Fontaine）解释说：“这些人是由不择手段的赞助商招募的，他们将他们送入狮穴。”

paras.en: Their lack of criminal experience, he says, makes them easier to arrest quickly.
paras.zh: 他说，他们缺乏犯罪经验，这使得他们更容易迅速被捕。

paras.en: Karine still has no idea why her son, Hugo, was shot.
paras.zh: 卡琳仍然不知道为什么她的儿子雨果被枪杀。

paras.en: Asked what she would say to gang leaders recruiting children and young men in Marseille, she says: "They destroy families. Little sisters, little brothers, grandparents. But then, I don't think those people have a heart, really."
paras.zh: 当被问及她对马赛招募儿童和年轻人的帮派头目有何看法时，她说：“他们摧毁了家庭。小姐妹、小兄弟、祖父母。但是，我认为这些人真的没有良心。”

paras.en: The restaurant where her son said he was going to work did exist, but staï¬ there told Karine they had never recruited anyone called Hugo.
paras.zh: 她儿子说他要去工作的那家餐厅确实存在，但那里的员工告诉卡琳，他们从未招募过叫雨果的人。

paras.en: The reason for his death almost certainly lies within Marseille's Quartier Nord.
paras.zh: 几乎可以肯定，他的死亡原因就在马赛北区。

paras.en: Additional reporting by Marianne Baisnee, Lea Guedj and Paul Pradier
paras.zh: Marianne Baisnee、Lea Guedj 和 Paul Pradier 的补充报道

articles.title: Jensen Huang: Silicon Valley superstar engulfed by personal scandal

paras.en: Jensen Huang is one of the technology industry's most high-profile figures.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋是科技行业最引人注目的人物之一。

paras.en: He rose to prominence as the business he leads - artificial intelligence (AI) chip giant Nvidia - became one of the world's most valuable companies.
paras.zh: 随着他领导的人工智能 (AI) 芯片巨头英伟达 (Nvidia) 成为全球最有价值的公司之一，他声名鹊起。

paras.en: As the face of the AI boom, Huang also became close to Donald Trump as the president pushed for the US to keep its dominance of the technology over China.
paras.zh: 作为人工智能热潮的代言人，随着唐纳德·特朗普总统推动美国保持对中国的技术主导地位，黄仁勋也与特朗普关系密切。

paras.en: The 63-year-old who was once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech" and referred to as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan is now mired in scandal after an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 这位曾被誉为“科技界泰勒·斯威夫特”、在台湾被称为“黄爸爸”的 63 岁老人，如今因与一名疑似中国间谍有染而深陷丑闻。

paras.en: Born in Taiwan in 1963, Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the West Coast of the US.
paras.zh: 黄1963年出生于台湾，九岁时全家搬到了美国西海岸。

paras.en: He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University.
paras.zh: 他毕业于俄勒冈州立大学电气工程师，随后在斯坦福大学获得同一领域的硕士学位。

paras.en: Huang then worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia.
paras.zh: 黄先生随后在美国芯片公司 AMD 工作，之后与他人共同创立了 Nvidia。

paras.en: He has an estimated fortune of $155bn, according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index.
paras.zh: 根据彭博亿万富翁指数，他的财富估计为 1,550 亿美元。

paras.en: "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine - a biography on Huang, tells the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today.
paras.zh: “黄仁勋是像史蒂夫·乔布斯这样的技术梦想家，”黄仁勋传记《思考机器》一书的作者史蒂芬·威特 (Stephen Witt) 告诉 BBC，并补充说他负责创建我们今天所知的人工智能硬件。

paras.en: Huang has a famously close relationship with Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Huang.
paras.zh: 黄与特朗普的关系是出了名的密切。最近在白宫举行的人工智能峰会上，有 42 名科技高管出席，总统的两侧是埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和黄仁勋。

paras.en: Trump said he had not spoken to the Nvidia boss since news of the investigation emerged.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，自调查消息传出以来，他还没有与英伟达老板交谈过。

paras.en: "I just know he's a fine person, but you never know what's going on," Trump told reporters, adding that he had "done an amazing job for our country".
paras.zh: 特朗普对记者说：“我只知道他是一个好人，但你永远不知道发生了什么。”他还补充说，他“为我们的国家做了一项了不起的工作”。

paras.en: Huang has long found himself at the centre of US-China tensions. Trump has repeatedly said the two nations are in a race for dominance.
paras.zh: 黄长期以来发现自己处于美中紧张局势的中心。特朗普多次表示，两国正在争夺主导地位。

paras.en: Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the fear is that if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities.
paras.zh: 特朗普曾说过“谁赢得人工智能，谁就获胜”，人们担心的是，如果中国在人工智能方面占据上风，它将增强该国的军事和监视能力。

paras.en: The US advantage is in large part because of US companies like Nvidia, working with producers like the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips.
paras.zh: 美国的优势在很大程度上是因为英伟达等美国公司与台积电 (TSMC) 等生产商合作，全球 90% 以上的最先进芯片都由台积电生产。

paras.en: Since 2022 the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security.
paras.zh: 自2022年以来，美国利用各种出口管制措施将尖端技术拒之门外，称这有助于保持美国的竞争优势并保护其国家安全。

paras.en: But it means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Jensen Huang once saying that Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. In recent years Huang has engaged in a flurry of shuttle diplomacy, dashing between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way.
paras.zh: 但这意味着像英伟达这样的公司基本上被排除在全球最赚钱的市场之外，黄仁勋曾表示，英伟达在中国市场的份额已从 95% 左右下降到实际上为零。近年来，黄进行了一系列穿梭外交，穿梭于华盛顿和北京之间，希望找到一条美国认可的重返之路，并在此过程中影响美国对华政策。

paras.en: Sunday's revelations may explain why Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China.
paras.zh: 周日的爆料或许可以解释为什么黄仁勋未能为英伟达带来最大的奖励：特朗普政府允许将除最先进芯片之外的所有芯片出售给中国。

paras.en: Quarter after quarter of late, Nvidia has been locked out of that lucrative market. Despite his ostensible closeness to Trump, Huang has not managed to wrest this concession from the administration.
paras.zh: 最近一个又一个季度，英伟达都被排除在这个利润丰厚的市场之外。尽管黄表面上与特朗普关系密切，但他并没有成功从政府那里夺取这一让步。

paras.en: Huang founded Nvidia with fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993.
paras.zh: 1993 年，黄仁勋与电气工程师同事 Chris Malachowsky 和 ​​Curtis Priem 共同创立了 Nvidia。

paras.en: The company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for computer games.
paras.zh: 该公司最初以处理图形（尤其是电脑游戏）的芯片而闻名。

paras.en: Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates.
paras.zh: 最终，它把重点转向了人工智能，这是它现在占据主导地位的领域。

paras.en: "In 2012 these machine learning neural net researchers started to use it for that purpose and Jensen immediately recongnised that this was going to be a massive industry and the future of computing. He began to pour enormous amounts of resources into building what was essentially the AI hardware market," says Witt.
paras.zh: “2012 年，这些机器学习神经网络研究人员开始将其用于此目的，Jensen 立即认识到这将是一个巨大的行业，也是计算的未来。他开始投入大量资源来构建本质上是人工智能硬件的市场，”Witt 说。

paras.en: "Today when we think of that, we think of these giant data centres - none of that existed. There were no customers for the stuff he was building. In fact his first customer was Open AI at the time they had 30 people - he actually gave it to them, he donated it to them."
paras.zh: “今天，当我们想到这一点时，我们会想到这些巨大的数据中心 - 这些都不存在。他正在构建的东西没有客户。事实上，他的第一个客户是 Open AI，当时他们有 30 名员工 - 他实际上把它给了他们，他把它捐赠给了他们。”

paras.en: Nvidia is now worth some $4.5 trillion, making it one of the most valuable companies ever.
paras.zh: Nvidia 目前价值约 4.5 万亿美元，使其成为有史以来最有价值的公司之一。

paras.en: "The first real neural net of modern times on an Nvidia network was Alex Krizhevsky's Alexnet and they trained that on two Nvidia cards in Alex's bedroom. Now we do the same thing but we do it with 200,000 - 300,000 cards and instead of doing it in a bedroom we do it in a giant barn full of computers called a data centre," adds Witt.
paras.zh: “现代 Nvidia 网络上第一个真正的神经网络是 Alex Krizhevsky 的 Alexnet，他们在 Alex 卧室的两张 Nvidia 卡上对其进行了训练。现在我们做同样的事情，但我们使用 200,000 - 300,000 张卡，而不是在卧室中进行，而是在一个装满计算机（称为数据中心）的巨大谷仓中进行，”Witt 补充道。

paras.en: "So when you think about a data centre buildout, when you hear the AI infrastructure buildout, Jensen runs a tollbooth. All of that goes through him. And it made his company at least temporarily, the most valuable company in the world."
paras.zh: “因此，当你想到数据中心扩建时，当你听到人工智能基础设施扩建时，詹森经营着一个收费站。所有这一切都经过他。这使他的公司至少暂时成为世界上最有价值的公司。”

paras.en: Nvidia's board has announced a probe following reports by the New York Times that Huang had engaged in a romantic relationship with a woman believed by US intelligence to be a Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》报道黄与一名被美国情报部门认为是中国间谍的女子发生恋爱关系后，英伟达董事会宣布展开调查。

paras.en: For now, though, Nvidia's board appears to have little appetite for removing Huang, saying in a statement on Sunday that they have "confidence in Jensen and his leadership team".
paras.zh: 不过，目前英伟达董事会似乎对罢免黄仁勋没什么兴趣，他们在周日的一份声明中表示，他们“对詹森和他的领导团队充满信心”。

paras.en: Sources tell the BBC his removal is unlikely because there is so much money at stake. There is also no clear successor to the 63-year old tech boss.
paras.zh: 消息人士告诉英国广播公司，他不太可能被免职，因为这涉及到太多资金。这位 63 岁的科技老板也没有明确的继任者。

paras.en: Huang met his wife Lori at Oregon State University, where she was also studying electrical engineering and was his lab partner.
paras.zh: 黄在俄勒冈州立大学认识了他的妻子洛丽，她也在俄勒冈州立大学学习电气工程，并且是他的实验室伙伴。

paras.en: They married in 1985, about eight years before he co-founded Nvidia, and have two children, Madison and Spencer.
paras.zh: 他们于 1985 年结婚，大约比他共同创立 Nvidia 早八年，并育有两个孩子：麦迪逊和斯宾塞。

paras.en: He has credited Lori and Madison for making black leather jackets his signature style.
paras.zh: 他称赞洛里和麦迪逊使黑色皮夹克成为他的标志性风格。

paras.en: In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation.
paras.zh: 2007年，夫妇俩创立了黄仁勋和洛瑞基金会。

paras.en: The charitable fund has seen its assets surge in recent years, driven by the soaring value of Nvidia shares, and is estimated to be worth more than $9bn.
paras.zh: 近年来，受英伟达股价飙升的推动，该慈善基金的资产大幅增长，估计价值超过 90 亿美元。

paras.en: Its donations include tens of millions of dollars to engineering programmes at Oregon State and Stanford University.
paras.zh: 其捐赠包括向俄勒冈州立大学和斯坦福大学的工程项目提供数千万美元。

paras.en: "Jensen in my conversations with him and in other conversations has gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man. That's very important to him," says Witt.
paras.zh: “詹森在我和他的谈话以及其他谈话中竭尽全力地表现出自己是一个有家室的男人。这对他来说非常重要，”威特说。

paras.en: "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways. Both of his children work for Nvidia. Spencer and Maddison. The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad."
paras.zh: “他称赞他的妻子，用非常热情的方式谈论她。他的两个孩子斯宾塞和麦迪逊都为英伟达工作。这对任何人的家庭来说都是不好的。但对于一个不遗余力地培养顾家形象并与孩子保持密切关系的人来说，这是非常糟糕的。”

paras.en: Huang for his part released a statement which said, "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry."
paras.zh: 黄先生则发表声明称，“我对我的妻子不忠。我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的行为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”

paras.en: US officials had concluded that Alice Huang had been recruited to spy by China's top intelligence agency, the New York Times reports.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，美国官员得出的结论是，爱丽丝·黄被中国最高情报机构招募从事间谍活动。

paras.en: She was a top executive at Megaspeed, a data centre company based in Singapore. The firm had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, a concern that Nvidia maintains was investigated and debunked.
paras.zh: 她是新加坡数据中心公司 Megaspeed 的高管。该公司被怀疑帮助将英伟达芯片转移到中国，英伟达坚称这一担忧已被调查并揭穿。

paras.en: Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang through a process known as "unmasking".
paras.zh: 据报道，监控显示了爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）与一名美国公民之间的通信，随后通过“揭露”过程被确认为黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）。

paras.en: It remains unclear what information Alice Huang â who is also known as Huang Le â allegedly passed to Beijing, how valuable it was, or when she is believed to have begun gathering intelligence.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚黄丽丽（又名黄乐）据称向北京传递了哪些信息、这些信息有多大价值，或者据信她何时开始收集情报。

paras.en: Alice Huang did not respond to the paper's request for comment.
paras.zh: 黄爱丽没有回应该报的置评请求。

paras.en: When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not.
paras.zh: 当 BBC 询问英伟达是否意识到情报问题时，该公司表示没有。

paras.en: "We trust that if we were the target of a genuine threat, the US government would have notified us," an Nvidia spokesperson told the BBC.
paras.zh: 英伟达发言人告诉 BBC：“我们相信，如果我们成为真正威胁的目标，美国政府就会通知我们。”

paras.en: Additional reporting by Ayeshea Perera in Singapore and Helen Davidson in Sydney
paras.zh: 新加坡 Ayeshea Perera 和悉尼 Helen Davidson 的补充报道

articles.title: Krakow shooting suspect has died in hospital, police say

paras.en: A gunman suspected of killing six people in Krakow has died in hospital, Polish police say.
paras.zh: 波兰警方称，一名涉嫌在克拉科夫杀害六人的枪手在医院死亡。

paras.en: The 24-year-old, who ministers said was apparently inspired by "far-right ideologies", was injured after opening fire in central Krakow, the second largest city in Poland, on Saturday.
paras.zh: 部长们表示，这名 24 岁的男子显然是受到“极右意识形态”的启发，周六在波兰第二大城市克拉科夫市中心开枪受伤。

paras.en: Armed officers raced to the scene and engaged in a gunfight with the suspect, who was shot within three minutes of the attack beginning, preventing a further massacre, officials said.
paras.zh: 官员称，武装警察赶到现场并与嫌疑人发生枪战，嫌疑人在袭击开始后三分钟内被枪杀，避免了进一步的屠杀。

paras.en: Krakow police said the suspected gunman died early on Monday morning.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫警方表示，枪手嫌疑人于周一凌晨死亡。

paras.en: After the shooting, which began shortly before 15:00 local time (14:00 GMT) in Krakow's busy Main Market Square, police identified the attacker as a 24-year-old Polish man but did not confirm his name.
paras.zh: 当地时间 15:00（格林威治标准时间 14:00）前不久，克拉科夫繁忙的主集市广场发生枪击事件，警方确认袭击者是一名 24 岁的波兰男子，但没有确认他的姓名。

paras.en: In the hours after the shooting, a minister has said early investigations indicate he was inspired by "far-right ideologies". The minister also described him as an "ultra-nationalist" without giving further details.
paras.zh: 在枪击事件发生后的几个小时内，一名部长表示，早期调查表明他受到了“极右意识形态”的启发。这位部长还称他为“极端民族主义者”，但没有提供更多细节。

paras.en: Six people - four women and two men - are confirmed to have been killed in the attack.
paras.zh: 已确认六人（四名女性和两名男性）在袭击中丧生。

paras.en: Four victims are Polish, while a British national and an Austrian woman were also killed.
paras.zh: 四名受害者是波兰人，一名英国公民和一名奥地利妇女也被杀。

paras.en: Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk said three bodies - two women and one man - were found at the gunman's house when it was searched after the attack.
paras.zh: 波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克表示，袭击发生后，在枪手家中搜查时发现了三具尸体——两女一男。

paras.en: On Sunday, Polish police confirmed those three victims had been identified as the alleged gunman's 53-year-old father, 52-year-old mother and his sister, who was 21 years old.
paras.zh: 周日，波兰警方证实，这三名受害者已被确认为枪手 53 岁的父亲、52 岁的母亲和他 21 岁的妹妹。

paras.en: Polish media has reported the suspect had a firearms permit and may have obtained the weapons from his family home.
paras.zh: 波兰媒体报道称，嫌疑人持有枪支许可证，并可能从他的家中获得了这些武器。

paras.en: Sixteen people, including five foreigners, two police officers and the attacker, were taken to hospital. The interior ministry later said they were from Austria, Britain, Germany, Portugal and Russia.
paras.zh: 包括五名外国人、两名警察和袭击者在内的十六人被送往医院。内政部后来表示，他们来自奥地利、英国、德国、葡萄牙和俄罗斯。

paras.en: In the wake of the shooting, Poland declared the country would enter two days of national mourning.
paras.zh: 枪击事件发生后，波兰宣布该国将进入为期两天的全国哀悼。

paras.en: After travelling to Krakow, Tusk said: "Until now in Poland we haven't had such drastic cases of terrorism...that's what we have to call this cruel attack on people's lives here in Krakow."
paras.zh: 前往克拉科夫后，图斯克说：“到目前为止，波兰还没有发生过如此严重的恐怖主义案件......这就是我们对克拉科夫人民生活的残酷袭击的称呼。”

paras.en: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he was "shocked and saddened by the appalling shooting in KrakÃ³w".
paras.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆表示，他“对克拉科夫发生的骇人听闻的枪击事件感到震惊和悲伤”。

paras.en: "My thoughts are with the families of those who have lost their lives, everyone injured and all those affected by this senseless violence. The United Kingdom stands in solidarity with the people of Poland," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“我的心与那些丧生者的家人、受伤的人和所有受到这种毫无意义的暴力影响的人同在。英国与波兰人民站在一起。”

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life
paras.zh: Carlisle 推出 EL121 盘式制动器，以提高性能和磨损寿命

paras.en: (MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.
paras.zh: （俄亥俄州梅迪纳，2023 年 9 月 12 日）——Carlisle Brake & Friction 很高兴地宣布推出适用于矿用运输卡车应用的 EL121 盘式制动片。新产品系列将被命名为Extend Life，即EL系列，EL121将是该系列中首款推出的摩擦配方。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔的 EL121 系列摩擦材料使前轴、矿用运输卡车刹车片的使用寿命几乎延长了一倍。使用 OEM 卡钳和转子时，可以增加设备的正常运行时间并降低维护成本。

paras.en: Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).
paras.zh: 自动运输卡车的刹车片温度较高，当使用缓速器和行车制动器时，制动周期的增加会导致刹车片磨损加剧。 EL121 采用高度耐磨的摩擦材料混合物，可延长刹车片的使用寿命，并具有一致且防褪色的制动性能。 EL121 是当今自动矿用运输卡车的理想解决方案（也可用于载人矿用运输卡车，以提高性能和使用寿命）。

paras.en: “We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司摩擦产品产品线总监 Ron Ratell 表示：“我们了解矿山运营商需要让运输卡车继续工作，而不是在车间进行制动维修。我们的最新创新技术可将前轴矿用运输卡车制动片的使用寿命延长一倍，并且是现有 OEM 制动片的理想替代品。这些制动片经过了彻底的实验室测试以及小松 830E-1 卡车的现场测试。”

paras.en: EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.
paras.zh: EL121 摩擦力经过测功机测试以复制应用，并被证明可以提供创新的高能材料来满足市场需求。 EL121 盘式刹车片还采用经过行业验证的机械固定系统，采用背板技术，旨在实现卓越的粘合性和耐用性，甚至能够承受最恶劣的非公路环境中的恶劣条件。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. articles.title: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

paras.en: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification
paras.zh: 卡莱苏州获得卡特彼勒 SER 认证

paras.en: (MEDINA, January 25, 2024) – Carlisle Brake & Friction announced its Suzhou facility has won a Supplier Excellence Recognition (SER) Certification from Caterpillar Inc. The Caterpillar SER is a new supplier management system featuring "Certified" and "Excellent" levels. Caterpillar officially launched the program in 2022. Carlisle's Suzhou manufacturing facility achieved a "Certified" level of recognition and celebrated the achievement alongside the Caterpillar team with a ceremony at the Carlisle Suzhou plant.
paras.zh: （梅迪纳，2024 年 1 月 25 日）——卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司宣布其苏州工厂获得卡特彼勒公司颁发的供应商卓越认可 (SER) 认证。卡特彼勒 SER 是一种新的供应商管理体系，具有“认证”和“优秀”级别。卡特彼勒于 2022 年正式启动该计划。卡莱尔苏州制造工厂获得了“认证”级别的认可，并与卡特彼勒团队在卡莱尔苏州工厂举行了仪式，庆祝这一成就。

paras.en: Of 27,000 suppliers, 250 were among the selected companies awarded by Caterpillar. Carlisle, a leading global supplier of brake, clutch, and transmission friction products, is the only friction products manufacturer worldwide to win the coveted certification.
paras.zh: 在 27,000 家供应商中，有 250 家入选卡特彼勒授予的奖项。 Carlisle 是全球领先的制动器、离合器和变速箱摩擦产品供应商，也是全球唯一一家获得这一令人垂涎的认证的摩擦产品制造商。

paras.en: "We are honored to be recognized by Caterpillar as a Certified level supplier," said Doug Wagner, Global VP of Sales, Carlisle Brake & Friction. "This award recognizes the superior efforts and dedication of the entire Suzhou team that supports our global business."
paras.zh: “我们很荣幸被 Caterpillar 认可为认证级供应商，”Carlisle 制动与摩擦部全球销售副总裁 Doug Wagner 说道。 “该奖项是对支持我们全球业务的整个苏州团队的卓越努力和奉献精神的认可。”

paras.en: Carlisle earned SER Certification in recognition of the company's exemplary commitment to supporting Caterpillar's global growth strategy goals.
paras.zh: Carlisle 获得了 SER 认证，以表彰该公司对支持 Caterpillar 全球增长战略目标的模范承诺。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
