paras.zh: 但直到最近，一组考古学家才发现了几个世纪以来这些相对现代的游客显然没有注意到的东西。洞穴中的一些最早的居民留下的，隐藏在众目睽睽之下，是伊比利亚半岛地中海一侧迄今为止发现的第三大冰河时代雕刻藏品。

paras.en: “At the moment of discovery, I experienced a mixture of excitement at encountering something both unexpected and extraordinary and profound disbelief,” Josep Maria Vergès, an archaeologist at the Catalan Institute of Human Paleoecology and Social Evolution (IPHES), tells Gizmodo’s Gayoung Lee. “It seemed inconceivable that none of the many visitors who had traversed the gallery … had ever noticed the presence of these prehistoric engravings.”
paras.zh: 加泰罗尼亚人类古生态和社会进化研究所 (IPHES) 的考古学家何塞普·玛丽亚·维尔格斯 (Josep Maria Vergès) 告诉 Gizmodo 的 Gayoung Lee，“在发现的那一刻，我感到非常兴奋，因为遇到了一些意想不到的、非同寻常的东西，同时又令人难以置信。” “令人难以置信的是，走过画廊的众多参观者中没有一个人注意到这些史前雕刻的存在。”

paras.en: During a series of excavations in 2019, researchers from IPHES identified some 280 Paleolithic engravings on the cave’s walls. The motifs were wide-ranging, comprising 55 distinct animals—horses, a bear, deer and early types of wild cattle among them—and dozens of abstract patterns, lines and loops. Their research was published this week in the journal Antiquity.
paras.zh: 在 2019 年的一系列发掘中，IPHES 的研究人员在洞穴的墙壁上发现了约 280 个旧石器时代的雕刻。图案范围广泛，包括 55 种不同的动物（其中包括马、熊、鹿和早期类型的野牛）以及数十种抽象图案、线条和循环。他们的研究发表在本周的《古代》杂志上。

paras.en: Paleolithic rock art on the Iberian peninsula is plentiful but unevenly distributed. Prior to the discovery at Cova de la Font Major, rock art identified in Catalonia was “very scarce compared with the abundant record of the neighboring Franco-Cantabrian region,” Vergès explains in a statement.
paras.zh: 伊比利亚半岛的旧石器时代岩画数量丰富，但分布不均。在 Cova de la Font Major 发现之前，在加泰罗尼亚发现的岩画“与邻近的弗朗哥-坎塔布连地区的丰富记录相比非常稀缺”，韦尔热斯在一份声明中解释道。

paras.en: It remains unclear how the markings had never been documented before. They are in a part of the cave that has been open to tourists since 1957. The general consensus was that the walls of the cave were too “irregular both in relief and color” to preserve art, per the article.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚这些标记以前是如何从未被记录下来的。它们位于自 1957 年以来一直向游客开放的洞穴的一部分。文章称，普遍的共识是，洞穴的墙壁“无论是浮雕还是颜色都太不规则”，无法保存艺术品。

paras.en: The researchers speculate that lighting may have had a role to play in the belated discovery. “When you shine a light straight on the engravings, they are really difficult to see. You have to play with light from different directions to see the depressions,” Míriam Salas-Altès, an archaeologist with IPHES and a co-author of the study, tells Nature’s Chris Simms.
paras.zh: 研究人员推测，照明可能在这个迟来的发现中发挥了作用。 “当你用光线直射雕刻时，它们真的很难看到。你必须利用不同方向的光线才能看到凹陷，”IPHES 考古学家、该研究的合著者 Míriam Salas-Altès 告诉 Nature 杂志的 Chris Simms。

paras.en: The drawings appear to be advanced and distinct from the neighboring Franco-Cantabrian style of rock art. Some designs, the researchers posit, may represent the earth or bodies of water, and at least 20 inscriptions could form something like a prehistoric “movie or animation,” Salas-Altès tells Nature. These scenes show animals in repetition, with their limbs and heads changing positions, as though meant to depict running or movement.
paras.zh: 这些图画似乎很先进，与邻近的弗朗哥-坎塔布里亚风格的岩石艺术截然不同。萨拉斯-阿尔特斯告诉《自然》杂志，研究人员推测，一些设计可能代表地球或水体，至少 20 个铭文可以形成类似史前“电影或动画”的东西。这些场景重复地展示了动物，它们的四肢和头部不断变换着位置，仿佛是在描绘奔跑或运动。

paras.en: Using radiocarbon dating on bits of charcoal discovered inside one engraved groove—beside which a small flint bladelet was also recovered—the researchers estimated that the artworks are roughly 26,000 years old.
paras.zh: 通过对在一个雕刻凹槽内发现的木炭碎片（旁边还发现了一个小燧石刀片）进行放射性碳测年，研究人员估计这些艺术品大约有 26,000 年的历史。

paras.en: The researchers found that early humans traversed the sprawling cave system incrementally, visiting different sections over different periods of time. The earliest evidence of prehistoric activity inside dates to roughly 41,000 years ago. One cavernous area, near an entrance, was likely busier during the early Bronze Age, between 4,200 and 2,700 years ago. Here, fragments of a dagger, sword and axe were discovered. Another artery of the cave was occupied during the Neolithic era, up to 7,400 years ago.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，早期人类逐渐穿越了庞大的洞穴系统，在不同时期访问了不同的部分。内部史前活动的最早证据可以追溯到大约 41,000 年前。入口附近的一个洞穴区域在 4,200 至 2,700 年前的青铜时代早期可能比较繁忙。在这里，发现了匕首、剑和斧头的碎片。洞穴的另一条动脉在新石器时代（距今 7,400 年前）就被占据。

paras.en: - Researchers recently discovered that traces of ancient DNA from humans can survive for millennia on cave walls and in rock art, based on findings from 11 sites in Spain and Portugal.
paras.zh: - 研究人员最近根据西班牙和葡萄牙 11 个地点的发现，发现古代人类 DNA 的痕迹可以在洞穴墙壁和岩石艺术中保存数千年。

paras.en: - The DNA likely appears in the rock art because prehistoric artists would apply red ochre paint with their hands or spit it from their mouths on to the cave wall.
paras.zh: - DNA 很可能出现在岩石艺术中，因为史前艺术家会用手涂抹红色赭石颜料或将其从嘴里吐到洞穴墙壁上。

paras.en: Despite identifying these timelines, the researchers have not yet determined how any one group of people may have used the cave—for shelter, rituals or other practices. What is clear, they say, is that Catalonia has a much richer Paleolithic history than previously thought. Following this finding, the researchers say, the region deserves more attention in Ice Age studies.
paras.zh: 尽管确定了这些时间线，研究人员尚未确定任何一组人可能如何使用这个洞穴——进行庇护、仪式或其他活动。他们说，显而易见的是，加泰罗尼亚的旧石器时代历史比以前想象的要丰富得多。研究人员表示，根据这一发现，该地区值得在冰河时代研究中得到更多关注。

paras.en: “Contrary to what was previously thought, northeastern Iberia holds first-rate Paleolithic rock art sites,” Salas-Altès says in the statement. “The Mediterranean art of western Europe is now enriched by a new body of rock art, which allows us to characterize in greater depth a Mediterranean graphic tradition with an identity of its own, distinct from that of the Franco-Cantabrian region.”
paras.zh: “与之前的想法相反，伊比利亚东北部拥有一流的旧石器时代岩石艺术遗址，”萨拉斯-阿尔特斯在声明中说。 “西欧的地中海艺术现在因新的岩石艺术而更加丰富，这使我们能够更深入地描绘地中海图形传统，使其具有自己的特色，与法国-坎塔布连地区的特色不同。”

articles.title: Wandrd’s Magnetic Camera Straps Are My New Favorite Accessory
articles.author: Julian Chokkattu

paras.en: More than a decade ago, Peak Design rethought the humble camera strap. This was a necessary development. When you buy a camera, manufacturers almost always toss in a chintzy, uninspired strap with their logo on it. These cheap straps have cheap mounting systems that make it hard to quickly remove the strap from the camera when you need to, like when you're attaching your camera to a tripod or gimbal and you’d rather not have a dangling strap whacking you in the face.
paras.zh: 十多年前，Peak Design 重新思考了不起眼的相机带。这是一个必要的发展。当你购买相机时，制造商几乎总是会赠送一条印有他们标志的廉价、平庸的背带。这些便宜的背带具有廉价的安装系统，因此在您需要时很难快速从相机上取下背带，例如当您将相机连接到三脚架或万向节时，并且您不想让悬垂的背带打到您的脸上。

paras.en: Peak Design solved this with its Anchor Links system, small circular nubs you leave attached to camera eyelets that make detaching or even swapping straps easy. The quick-connect mechanism is now the de facto industry standard and has inspired countless copycats.
paras.zh: Peak Design 通过其 Anchor Links 系统解决了这个问题，该系统是连接在相机孔眼上的小圆形小块，可以轻松拆卸甚至更换肩带。快速连接机制现已成为事实上的行业标准，并激发了无数模仿者。

paras.en: Now, Wandrd has outdone that design using magnets.
paras.zh: 现在，Wandrd 使用磁铁超越了这种设计。

paras.en: “We're photographers ourselves, so we're constantly ideating, tinkering, thinking of ways that things can be better,” Ryan Cope, Wandrd cofounder, tells WIRED. “A camera strap like this has been at the back of our minds for a while.”
paras.zh: “我们自己就是摄影师，所以我们不断地构思、修补、思考如何让事情变得更好，”Wandrd 联合创始人瑞安·科普 (Ryan Cope) 告诉《连线》杂志。 “像这样的相机背带已经在我们的脑海中浮现了一段时间。”

paras.en: Wandrd—known for its camera bags—launched its Magnetic Camera Strap system on Thursday. It features a circular anchor similar to Peak Design, called “Torus Links.” The anchors attach to your camera’s eyelets and are rated to carry up to 198 pounds—so unless you're bench-pressing your camera, they'll do the job. If the cord does start to wear down over time, you'll first see yellow under the black fabric—a sign you should replace the Torus Link. If it's red, you should stop using the link immediately—a warning system borrowed from Peak Design. (Wandrd offers a two-year warranty.)
paras.zh: 以相机包闻名的 Wandrd 于周四推出了磁性相机带系统。它具有类似于 Peak Design 的圆形锚点，称为“Torus Links”。这些锚固定在相机的孔眼上，额定承重达 198 磅，因此除非您卧推相机，否则它们就可以胜任。如果随着时间的推移，绳索确实开始磨损，您首先会在黑色织物下面看到黄色，这表明您应该更换环面链接。如果它是红色的，你应该立即停止使用该链接——这是一个借鉴自 Peak Design 的警告系统。 （Wandrd 提供两年保修。）

paras.en: Unlike Peak Design's anchors, the Wandrd anchors look like donuts, with a hole in the middle. When you attach the strap, the embedded magnets guide the Torus Link into the strap's CoreLock mechanism, which pinches into the hole to secure the camera body. The magnets make connecting a strap easier, and they keep the strap fastened to the anchor, but you can’t just pull the strap off like you’re pulling a MagSafe accessory on your phone. You’ll need to use the strap’s dual-pinch mechanism to remove it from the Torus Link, a design that’s more secure.
paras.zh: 与 Peak Design 的锚不同，Wandrd 锚看起来像甜甜圈，中间有一个洞。当您连接腕带时，嵌入式磁铁会将 Torus Link 引导至腕带的 CoreLock 机构中，该机构会捏入孔中以固定相机机身。磁铁使连接带子变得更容易，并且它们将带子固定在锚点上，但你不能像拉手机上的 MagSafe 配件那样直接拉掉带子。您需要使用表带的双捏机构将其从环面链接上取下，这种设计更安全。

paras.en: It’s a much faster way to connect and disconnect a strap, and that speed pays off in the field. This week, I had to photograph a product during a press briefing. Usually, I use Peak Design's Leash and, instead of taking off the strap, I bunch it up in my hand when it's not around my neck. It's not that it's hard to remove—it's just an extra step I have to think about. But Wandrd's magnetic system felt faster to unlock mid-shoot when I wanted to lower the camera for an awkward, low-angle shot, and reattaching the strap was practically instantaneous. I did the whole swap one-handed, with the magnets doing most of the work.
paras.zh: 这是一种更快地连接和断开表带的方法，并且这种速度在现场得到了回报。本周，我必须在新闻发布会上拍摄产品照片。通常，我使用 Peak Design 的皮带，当它没有挂在脖子上时，我不会取下带子，而是将它束在手中。这并不是说它很难删除——这只是我必须考虑的一个额外步骤。但当我想要降低相机进行尴尬的低角度拍摄时，Wandrd 的磁性系统感觉解锁速度更快，并且重新连接带子几乎是瞬间的。我用一只手完成了整个交换工作，大部分工作都是由磁铁完成的。

paras.en: “I love magnets, man,” Cope says. “I love the simplicity they create—guiding things into place. You don't always have a place to put your camera down; I like that magnets help guide them and are a lot more secure, and they're also just fun.”
paras.zh: “我喜欢磁铁，伙计，”科普说。 “我喜欢它们创造的简单性——引导物品就位。你并不总是有地方可以放下相机；我喜欢磁铁帮助引导它们并且更安全，而且它们也很有趣。”

paras.en: I have two Torus Links on my camera body, one on the right eyelet and another on the tripod baseplate. But my favorite configuration turns the strap into a single-point sling. The strap has a built-in “Torus Loop” on the buckle—clip one end directly into it to create a closed loop worn across your torso, leaving just a single magnetic connector to snap onto your camera. When you unclip the camera to shoot freely, the strap stays neatly in place across your body instead of sliding off your shoulder.
paras.zh: 我的相机机身上有两个环面连杆，一个位于右孔眼上，另一个位于三脚架底板上。但我最喜欢的配置是将带子变成单点吊带。该肩带的带扣上有一个内置的“环形环”，将一端直接夹入其中，形成一个穿在您躯干上的闭环，只留下一个磁性连接器来卡在您的相机上。当您松开相机自由拍摄时，肩带会整齐地固定在您的身体上，而不是从肩膀上滑落。

paras.en: The nylon felt comfortable across my chest and near my neck—there's no padding, but that's intentional. Cope says Wandrd spent two years developing this custom “liquid nylon” tubular webbing that is softer along the edges, so it won't feel like the strap is cutting into your neck after a long day of wear. The lack of metal throughout the strap system also prevents the strap from scratching up your camera gear.
paras.zh: 尼龙在我的胸部和脖子附近感觉很舒服——没有衬垫，但这是故意的。 Cope 表示，Wandrd 花了两年时间开发这种定制的“液体尼龙”管状织带，其边缘较柔软，因此在长时间佩戴后不会感觉带子割伤了您的脖子。整个表带系统没有金属，也可以防止表带划伤您的相机装备。

paras.en: Best of all, you don't have to replace your strap to use Wandrd's system. If you have a strap you love—maybe a fancy leather strap someone gifted you—Wandrd is selling a DIY kit ($29) that lets you attach its Magnetic CoreLock system to the ends of your preferred strap. Otherwise, the strap kit comes in a 30-mm size ($69), a 15-mm “Lite" ($49), and a wrist strap ($39).
paras.zh: 最重要的是，您无需更换表带即可使用 Wandrd 的系统。如果您有一条喜欢的表带（也许是别人送给您的精美皮革表带），Wandrd 正在销售一款 DIY 套件（29 美元），您可以将其磁性 CoreLock 系统连接到您喜欢的表带的末端。另外，表带套件有 30 毫米尺寸（69 美元）、15 毫米“Lite”尺寸（49 美元）和腕带（39 美元）。

paras.en: I don't know if Wandrd's system will see the same success as Peak Design's Anchor Links, but I don't see myself switching back anytime soon. Magnets are just too dang cool.
paras.zh: 我不知道 Wandrd 的系统是否会取得与 Peak Design 的 Anchor Links 相同的成功，但我不认为自己会很快切换回去。磁铁太酷了。

articles.title: I Used NYT Cooking’s New AI-Powered Recipe Modifier, and It’s Actually Pretty Good
articles.author: Joe Ray

paras.en: In an aside in the New York Times Cooking video I watched recently, where Melissa Clark made her lemony white bean soup with turkey and greens, the food reporter and recipe columnist invited viewers to leave a comment telling her what they do with the kale stems. It highlighted this sweet, funny relationship between a media brand’s personalities and its audience, a warm-casual vibe.
paras.zh: 在我最近观看的《纽约时报》烹饪视频的旁白中，梅丽莎·克拉克用火鸡和蔬菜做了柠檬白豆汤，这位美食记者和食谱专栏作家邀请观众发表评论，告诉她他们如何处理羽衣甘蓝茎。它强调了媒体品牌的个性与其受众之间这种甜蜜、有趣的关系，一种温暖休闲的氛围。

paras.en: Below the article announcing the change on October 23, commenters loudly aired their grievances, threatening to cancel subscriptions, asking who wanted this, and how to turn it off.
paras.zh: 在10月23日宣布改变的文章下方，评论者大声表达了他们的不满，威胁要取消订阅，询问谁想要这个，以及如何关闭它。

paras.en: After four days and 172 almost exclusively angry comments, commenting for the story was turned off.
paras.zh: 经过四天的 172 条几乎全是愤怒的评论后，该报道的评论被关闭了。

paras.en: My writing for WIRED over the past decade has shown me again and again that adding tech to a kitchen product is risky at best. I've repeatedly watched companies try and fail: Bluetooth connections for all the appliances, apps that lean too heavily on crummy recipes, toasters with optical sensors or touchscreens that still couldn't toast particularly well. Just about anything that was part of the "smart kitchen" tended not to be very smart at all.
paras.zh: 过去十年我为《连线》撰写的文章一次又一次地向我表明，在厨房产品中添加科技充其量是有风险的。我多次看到公司尝试和失败：所有设备的蓝牙连接、过于依赖糟糕食谱的应用程序、带有光学传感器或触摸屏的烤面包机仍然无法烤得特别好。几乎所有“智能厨房”的一部分都不是很智能。

paras.en: Developing dependable, delicious recipes is hard, expensive work that can require a whole staff. Yet skimping can hurt the brand. Two notable companies with a deep bench—The New York Times Cooking and America's Test Kitchen—are cooking content makers. Recipes, which is to say delicious, high-quality, tested recipes, are what they do.
paras.zh: 开发可靠、美味的食谱是一项艰巨且昂贵的工作，可能需要全体员工的参与。然而，吝啬可能会损害品牌。 《纽约时报烹饪》和《美国测试厨房》这两家实力雄厚的著名公司都是烹饪内容制作者。菜谱，也就是说美味的、高质量的、经过测试的菜谱，就是他们所做的。

paras.en: Since AI is often a lousy chef, giving it a role in the presentation of NYT's gold mine of content is a big risk.
paras.zh: 由于人工智能通常是一个糟糕的厨师，因此让其在《纽约时报》内容金矿的呈现中发挥作用是一个很大的风险。

paras.en: Earlier this year, the Times allowed AI to help with a recipe-scaling feature (modifying ingredient quantities so "serves 4" turns into "serves 6") and converting from imperial measurements to metric—cups, tablespoons, and Fahrenheit to grams, milliliters, and Celsius. Now, in the iOS-only beta, a "customize this recipe" field appears just above the ingredient list.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，《纽约时报》允许人工智能帮助实现食谱缩放功能（修改配料数量，使“4 份”变成“6 份”），并将英制单位转换为公制单位——杯子、汤匙和华氏度转换为克、毫升和摄氏度。现在，在仅限 iOS 的测试版中，“自定义此配方”字段出现在成分列表的正上方。

paras.en: "We put a lot of effort into trying to tell you when not to do something if it's no longer in the spirit of the recipe," says Camilla Velasquez, the general manager of NYT Cooking.
paras.zh: 纽约时报烹饪公司总经理卡米拉·维拉斯奎兹 (Camilla Velasquez) 表示：“我们花了很多精力试图告诉你何时不要做某件事，如果它不再符合菜谱的精神。”

paras.en: For its recommendations, the LLM looks at the recipe itself, the Times’ ingredient substitution guide, user comments, and then what it calls AI "drawing on our expertise," in that order. Velasquez says the AI should be a helper, not the main act, noting, "You shouldn't be chatting with it."
paras.zh: 对于其建议，法学硕士会按顺序查看食谱本身、《纽约时报》的成分替代指南、用户评论，然后是所谓的“利用我们的专业知识”的人工智能。 Velasquez 表示，人工智能应该是一个助手，而不是主要角色，并指出，“你不应该与它聊天。”

paras.en: She explains that when the Times built the AI functionality, recipe editors helped create the original rule set, then evaluated how it worked at the end.
paras.zh: 她解释说，当《纽约时报》构建人工智能功能时，菜谱编辑帮助创建了原始规则集，然后评估其最终的工作原理。

paras.en: When I ask what this means for the jobs of 60 editors, writers, video journalists, and other employees—the team that creates the recipes people use and curates the vibe readers relate to—Velasquez stresses that NYT Cooking has been "hiring more than ever" and that it has "zero intention of publishing fewer recipes."
paras.zh: 当我问这对 60 名编辑、作家、视频记者和其他员工的工作意味着什么时（这些团队负责创建人们使用的食谱并策划读者所涉及的氛围），Velasquez 强调《纽约时报烹饪》一直在“比以往任何时候都雇用更多的人”，并且“零意图出版更少的食谱”。

paras.en: So far, she says people are mainly using it for ingredient and equipment substitutions, along with adjusting recipes for dietary needs. "Some people use the chatbot to scale, or they'll scale to match an ingredient," giving the example of someone who had only one cup of oil for a recipe that needed more.
paras.zh: 她说，到目前为止，人们主要将其用于成分和设备替代，以及根据饮食需求调整食谱。 “有些人使用聊天机器人来缩放，或者他们会缩放以匹配成分，”举了一个例子，有人只有一杯油来满足需要更多的食谱。

paras.en: As a food writer whose career has taken some substantial turns due to AI recently, I wouldn't say I've been clamoring for this, but I find the Times’ measured approach works pretty well.
paras.zh: 作为一名美食作家，他的职业生涯最近因人工智能而发生了一些重大转变，我不会说我一直在呼吁这样做，但我发现《纽约时报》谨慎的方法非常有效。

paras.en: I started testing it out by making chicken and dumplings using a five-star Alison Roman recipe with more than 6,000 ratings. I asked the AI tool to swap out bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs for boneless, skinless breasts. It thought about it for a moment—"simmering" in AI Cooking patois—and then offered up "Chicken Breast and Dumplings," with the "breast" in the title rendered in the red-orange color that indicates a modification. Just below the title, it said it was "Joseph's version made with AI. Not tested or endorsed by the original recipe's creators." Along with those visible changes, I could also toggle back and forth between my version and the original.
paras.zh: 我开始测试它，使用评分超过 6,000 的五星级 Alison Roman 食谱制作鸡肉和饺子。我要求人工智能工具将带骨、带皮的鸡大腿换成去骨、去皮的鸡胸肉。它想了一会儿——用人工智能烹饪土语来说是“慢炖”——然后提供了“鸡胸肉和饺子”，标题中的“鸡胸肉”用红橙色表示，表明是修改过的。就在标题下方，它说这是“约瑟夫用人工智能制作的版本。未经原始食谱创建者测试或认可。”除了这些可见的更改之外，我还可以在我的版本和原始版本之间来回切换。

paras.en: Once I started cooking, things went smoothly. I'm a recipe follower, not an improviser, and the Times’ recipes are easy to follow. The modifications were too. I was also impressed by how the app flagged that the chicken breast simmering time would be reduced because it cooks faster than thighs, and since they don't render as much fat as skin-on thighs do, it added some butter to the roux. These changes were incorporated into the right places in the recipe.
paras.zh: 一旦我开始做饭，一切就很顺利了。我是一个菜谱追随者，而不是一个即兴创作者，《泰晤士报》的菜谱很容易遵循。修改也是如此。令我印象深刻的是，该应用程序标记鸡胸肉的煮时间会减少，因为它比大腿煮得更快，而且由于它们不会像带皮大腿那样产生那么多脂肪，所以它在面糊中添加了一些黄油。这些更改已合并到配方中的正确位置。

paras.en: It all made sense except for one bit. It suggested the shredded, cooked breast go back into the pot for about another 30 minutes while the sauce thickens and the dumplings cook. I saw this coming and, well, I wasn't going to do that to my dinner. I put a handful of shredded meat in as directed so I could see what happened and reserved the rest. The shredded bits that were in for that extra half hour weren’t bad per se, but their texture was notably less succulent than what I'd reserved and way less than thighs would be.
paras.zh: 除了一点之外，这一切都有意义。建议将切碎的煮熟的鸡胸肉放回锅中再煮约 30 分钟，直到酱汁变稠，饺子煮熟。我预见到了这一点，好吧，我不会在晚餐时这样做。我按照指示放了一把肉丝进去，这样我就可以看到发生了什么，并保留了剩下的。在这额外的半小时里切碎的碎片本身并不坏，但它们的质地明显不如我保留的多汁，而且比大腿要少得多。

paras.en: This was the largest issue I encountered in all of my testing. If I had been the creator of the Times' original recipe, I'm not sure how I'd feel about the option to use a breast instead of thighs, which is not unheard of, but not very common in classic chicken and dumpling recipes. Perhaps it's something that could be fine-tuned or simply not offered as an option.
paras.zh: 这是我在所有测试中遇到的最大问题。如果我是《泰晤士报》原创食谱的创造者，我不确定我对使用鸡胸肉而不是大腿肉的选择有何感受，这并非闻所未闻，但在经典的鸡肉和饺子食谱中并不常见。也许它可以进行微调，或者干脆不作为选项提供。

paras.en: From there, it was fairly smooth sailing. I had it turn a Francis Lam roasted mushroom and broccoli grain bowl into a roasted mushroom, cauliflower, and squash grain bowl. The crucifer crisscross was an easy one-to-one, but I also told it to add a pound of delicata squash. It had me slice the squash into half moons so everything would finish at the same time, then upped the total amount of olive oil. Lam's poetic voice was preserved in both versions of the recipe, telling you to heat the olive oil "until it slips around the pan like water" before adding beaten eggs for festive dish-topping egg ribbons. My buddy Dave had come by for cribbage night, and this made for an enjoyable, healthy, pregame dinner before he went on to skunk me twice.
paras.zh: 从那时起，一切进展顺利。我让它把弗朗西斯·林烤蘑菇和西兰花谷物碗变成了烤蘑菇、花椰菜和南瓜谷物碗。十字花科交叉是一个简单的一对一，但我还告诉它添加一磅熟食南瓜。它让我把南瓜切成半月形，这样所有的东西都能同时完成，然后增加橄榄油的总量。林诗意的声音在两个版本的食谱中都得到了保留，告诉你先加热橄榄油“直到它像水一样在锅里滑落”，然后添加打散的鸡蛋作为节日菜肴顶部的鸡蛋丝带。我的好友戴夫来参加纸牌之夜，这为他提供了一顿愉快、健康的赛前晚餐，然后他又对我进行了两次臭鼬攻击。

paras.en: I'd been curious how it would handle batters, and it capably transformed Yewande Komolafe’s Toasted Sesame and Scallion Waffles into a yeasted version, which, unlike the original, gets an overnight in the fridge, letting the active dry yeast get bubbly and add an appealing tang.
paras.zh: 我一直很好奇它会如何处理面糊，它能够将 Yewande Komolafe 的烤芝麻和葱华夫饼转化为酵母版本，与原来的不同，它可以在冰箱中放置过夜，让活性干酵母起泡并增添诱人的味道。

paras.en: A friend suggested Colu Henry's pasta and chickpea stew. I swapped canned diced tomatoes I had in my pantry for whole, and asked it to "add more vegetables." It gave options in line with the recipe—carrots, celery, onion, zucchini, mushrooms, and extra greens—then put what I chose into the right spots throughout the procedure so everything went in at the right time. It made for a healthy, hearty dinner.
paras.zh: 一位朋友推荐了 Colu Henry 的意大利面和鹰嘴豆炖菜。我把储藏室里的罐装西红柿丁换成了整个西红柿，并要求它“添加更多蔬菜”。它提供了符合食谱的选项——胡萝卜、芹菜、洋葱、西葫芦、蘑菇和额外的蔬菜——然后在整个过程中把我选择的东西放在正确的位置，这样一切就在正确的时间进行。这是一顿​​健康、丰盛的晚餐。

paras.en: Having been to the Portland Fermentation Festival recently and wanting guidance on incorporating a few extra ingredients, particularly garlic, into my sauerkraut, I used the AI to modify Lidey Heuck's original, saying "add carrots, garlic, and kale," which it suggested grating, thin slicing, and mincing, respectively, all in the right-feeling proportions. It also added more salt, since I was making more kraut. The big jar is sitting next to me as I type, and while it's several days from being ready, a sniff test tells me it's on its way to being a good batch.
paras.zh: 最近参加了波特兰发酵节，并希望获得关于在酸菜中加入一些额外成分（尤其是大蒜）的指导，我使用人工智能修改了 Lidey Heuck 的原文，说“添加胡萝卜、大蒜和羽衣甘蓝”，它建议分别磨碎、切成薄片和切碎，所有这些都以正确的比例进行。它还添加了更多的盐，因为我做了更多的泡菜。当我打字时，大罐子就坐在我旁边，虽然距离准备好还有几天，但嗅探测试告诉我，它正在成为一批好批次。

paras.en: Finally, I turned Sue Li's peanut noodles with spicy tofu into peanut udon with tofu, whitefish, and cucumber. I started by asking it to make the original less spicy, add veggies, and "keep the tofu," but add some good-looking rockfish I found at the grocery store. Impressively, since the fish was an add-on, it had me cook it, then set it aside and wipe out the pan (!) before cooking the tofu. Since I swapped udon for the original bucatini, it customized the noodle-cooking guidance, too.
paras.zh: 最后我把苏李的辣豆腐花生面变成了豆腐白鱼黄瓜花生乌冬面。我首先要求它减少原来的辣度，添加蔬菜，并“保留豆腐”，但添加一些我在杂货店找到的好看的石斑鱼。令人印象深刻的是，由于鱼是附加的，它让我先煮它，然后把它放在一边并擦干净锅（！），然后再煮豆腐。由于我将乌冬面换成了原来的布卡蒂尼，它也定制了面条烹饪指南。

paras.en: It seems pretty natural that the Cooking section ran into some resistance when launching this feature. The NYT employs some of the best recipe creators in the business. Using AI to help us make substitutions is helpful, and the way the app integrates those changes into the recipes is impressive, but this tinkering with the original is essentially a subtractive process. How many of us are going to make substitutions and land on something better than Melissa Clark, Yewande Komolafe, or Francis Lam set out to make by design?
paras.zh: 烹饪部分在推出此功能时遇到了一些阻力，这似乎很自然。 《纽约时报》聘请了一些业内最优秀的食谱创作者。使用人工智能帮助我们进行替代是有帮助的，该应用程序将这些更改集成到食谱中的方式令人印象深刻，但这种对原始内容的修改本质上是一个减法过程。我们中有多少人会做出替代，并找到比 Melissa Clark、Yewande Komolafe 或 Francis Lam 设计的更好的东西？

paras.en: Instead, it's saving us a trip to the store, or helping us use something we have on hand, or making it gluten-free, serving as a good and rare example of how you can use technology to make a product incrementally better.
paras.zh: 相反，它节省了我们去商店的时间，或者帮助我们使用手头上的东西，或者使其不含麸质，这是一个很好且罕见的例子，说明如何使用技术来逐步改进产品。

paras.en: It also sounds like the commenters’ concerns have been heard. Velasquez let me know right away when we spoke that people will be able to hide the AI feature in the app if they want. The Times is also keeping the whole thing in iOS-only beta for now, and not saying when it would be available on other platforms.
paras.zh: 听起来评论者的担忧也得到了倾听。当我们交谈时，Velasquez 立即告诉我，如果人们愿意，他们可以在应用程序中隐藏人工智能功能。 《纽约时报》目前也将整个内容保留在仅限 iOS 的测试版中，并没有透露何时会在其他平台上推出。

paras.en: That bond that you can see between the Cooking team and its users is a pretty sweet thing. Deep down, I'm guessing the upset Cooking commenters felt worried they were going to lose some of that human connection. I hope it never goes away.
paras.zh: 您可以看到烹饪团队与其用户之间的这种联系是非常甜蜜的。在内心深处，我猜那些心烦意乱的烹饪评论者担心他们会失去一些人际关系。我希望它永远不会消失。

articles.title: 8 Best Computer Speakers (2026) After Testing 30 Pairs
articles.author: Simon Hill

paras.en: Good computer speakers can make for a quick desktop upgrade. Sound is often overlooked when people buy a PC. Some folks prefer headphones, others stick with those old, battered speakers they inherited, and some rely on the awful built-in speaker in their monitor. With any of the speakers in this list, you can enhance voices in video calls and movies, tease out greater depth in your favorite music, and provide spatial awareness in games. After several months of testing, I've narrowed my selection across various budgets and preferences. Whether you want a soundbar for your computer, a pair of speakers, or a surround sound system, you can find it here.
paras.zh: 好的电脑扬声器可以使桌面快速升级。人们购买电脑时常常会忽视声音。有些人更喜欢耳机，另一些人则坚持使用他们继承的旧的、破旧的扬声器，还有一些人依赖显示器中糟糕的内置扬声器。使用此列表中的任何扬声器，您都可以增强视频通话和电影中的声音，在您喜爱的音乐中梳理出更深入的内容，并在游戏中提供空间感知。经过几个月的测试，我根据不同的预算和偏好缩小了选择范围。无论您想要为计算机配备条形音箱、一对扬声器还是环绕音响系统，您都可以在这里找到。

paras.en: Be sure to check out our many other audio guides, like the Best Soundbars, Best Bluetooth Speakers, Best Wireless Headphones, Best Gaming Headsets, and Best Bookshelf Speakers.
paras.zh: 请务必查看我们的许多其他音频指南，例如最佳条形音箱、最佳蓝牙扬声器、最佳无线耳机、最佳游戏耳机和最佳书架扬声器。

paras.en: Updated November 2026: I added speakers from Creative, a mention for speakers from Pioneer, and updated prices.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月更新：我添加了 Creative 的演讲者、Pioneer 的演讲者以及更新的价格。

paras.en: There are tons of computer speakers on the market, and many of the ones I tested are perfectly fine, but don't deserve a spot above for one reason or another.
paras.zh: 市场上有大量的电脑扬声器，我测试过的许多扬声器都非常好，但由于某种原因不值得在上面占据一席之地。

paras.en: Pioneer DJ DM-40D-BT for $239: Designed as entry-level speakers for bedroom DJs, the Pioneer DJ DM-40D-BTs sport a molded black plastic front with an MDF cabinet, but they feel well-built and solid. There’s a 4-inch fiberglass woofer with a 0.75-inch soft‑dome tweeter, and a class‑D amplifier with DSP (digital signal processing). Input options are RCA, 3.5-mm stereo mini, or Bluetooth 5.0, with a 3.5-mm headphone port in front, a simple volume knob, and a Bluetooth button. On the back of the control speaker, there’s a DJ/Production switch, which dials up the boomy bass. The sound quality is decent for the money, but they’re a bit too big for my desktop. If you need a budget option for music production to pair with a laptop, they might be a good shout, though the IK Multimedia iLoud Micro Monitors above are better if you can find the extra cash.
paras.zh: Pioneer DJ DM-40D-BT 售价 239 美元：Pioneer DJ DM-40D-BT 专为卧室 DJ 设计的入门级扬声器，采用模压黑色塑料正面和 MDF 箱体，但感觉做工精良且坚固。有一个 4 英寸玻璃纤维低音扬声器和一个 0.75 英寸软球顶高音扬声器，以及一个带 DSP（数字信号处理）的 D 类放大器。输入选项包括 RCA、3.5 毫米立体声迷你或蓝牙 5.0，前面有一个 3.5 毫米耳机端口、一个简单的音量旋钮和一个蓝牙按钮。控制扬声器的背面有一个 DJ/制作开关，可以调出强劲的低音。音质对于这个价格来说还算不错，但对于我的台式机来说有点太大了。如果您需要一个预算选项来与笔记本电脑搭配进行音乐制作，它们可能是一个不错的选择，不过如果您能找到额外的现金，上面的 IK Multimedia iLoud 微型显示器会更好。

paras.en: Edifier M60 for $200: Close to matching my top picks in sound quality, but significantly cheaper, the Edifier M60 speakers produce a rich, clear sound that persists when you crank the volume. The bass is decent, considering the lack of a subwoofer, but it can get muddy and a bit rattly. You have three connection options, including USB-C, 3.5 mm, or Bluetooth 5.3. My test music playlist sounded great on these speakers, and only the rumbly bass distracted me in games and movies, though they come with angled stands that point them at your ears and reduce vibrations. The M60 speakers are also the perfect size for most desktops. On the downside, the touch controls are a little annoying (you have to hold down for three seconds to power on/off or change mode), and the Edifier ConneX app for Android (also available on iOS) was a little flaky, though it offered some handy customization options and a six-band equalizer. Overall, these speakers are a solid option if this is your budget.
paras.zh: Edifier M60 售价 200 美元：Edifier M60 扬声器的音质与我的首选产品接近，但价格便宜得多，它可以产生丰富、清晰的声音，当您调高音量时，这种声音仍然存在。考虑到没有低音炮，低音还算不错，但可能会变得浑浊而且有点刺耳。您有三种连接选项，包括 USB-C、3.5 毫米或蓝牙 5.3。我的测试音乐播放列表在这些扬声器上听起来很棒，在游戏和电影中只有隆隆的低音分散了我的注意力，尽管它们配备了有角度的支架，可以将它们指向您的耳朵并减少振动。 M60 扬声器的尺寸也适合大多数台式机。缺点是，触摸控制有点烦人（你必须按住三秒钟才能打开/关闭或更改模式），Android 版 Edifier ConneX 应用程序（也可在 iOS 上使用）有点不稳定，尽管它提供了一些方便的自定义选项和六频段均衡器。总的来说，如果您的预算有限，这些扬声器是一个不错的选择。

paras.en: Creative Pebble Nova for $266: These eye-catching orb-shaped speakers with RGB rings around the base are a statement piece for your desk. They are big, angled at 45 degrees, and you have the choice of a flat base or elevated stands. They light up, produce a pleasant sound that’s rich across the board and with real depth, and can, frankly, get far too loud for your desktop. I was also impressed by the virtual surround sound for gaming. Don’t make the mistake of thinking the Creative App is superfluous, because it’s packed with options, from an equalizer to dialogue enhancement to RGB lighting controls. While I love the stand, it made them too tall for my desk because of my dual monitors. I also found the touch controls a bit finicky, and I advise switching off the power saving mode.
paras.zh: Creative Pebble Nova 售价 266 美元：这些引人​​注目的球形扬声器，底座周围带有 RGB 环，是您办公桌上的亮点。它们很大，呈 45 度角，您可以选择平底或高架支架。它们会发光，产生令人愉悦的声音，声音丰富且具有真正的深度，坦率地说，对于您的桌面来说声音太大了。游戏的虚拟环绕声也给我留下了深刻的印象。不要错误地认为创意应用程序是多余的，因为它充满了选项，从均衡器到对话增强再到 RGB 灯光控制。虽然我喜欢这个支架，但由于我的双显示器，它使它们对于我的办公桌来说太高了。我还发现触摸控制有点挑剔，我建议关闭省电模式。

paras.en: Ruark MR1 MK3 for $599: Perfect for a retro vibe, the styling includes a fabric front, and black finish with a dial on top. With a fluid and expansive soundstage, music sounds great on these speakers, and even without a subwoofer, there’s a decent rumble of bass. I found Ruark’s speakers equally pleasing for watching movies and video calls, as voice clarity is excellent, though I experienced some slight distortion with deep voices during meetings. They are also quite large, maybe too large for some desks.
paras.zh: Ruark MR1 MK3 售价 599 美元：非常适合复古氛围，其款式包括织物正面和黑色饰面，顶部有表盘。凭借流畅而广阔的音场，音乐在这些扬声器上听起来很棒，即使没有低音炮，也能发出不错的低音隆隆声。我发现 Ruark 的扬声器在看电影和视频通话时同样令人愉悦，因为语音清晰度非常好，尽管我在会议期间遇到了一些低沉声音的轻微失真。它们也很大，对于某些桌子来说可能太大了。

paras.en: OXS Thunder Pro for $600: With a compact design, sci-fi styling that includes RGB lighting, and no separate subwoofer, I was unsure what to expect from this soundbar. The Thunder Pro is 24 inches long and just 3 inches tall, so slotted into place perfectly under my monitor. It comes with a wired control dial, a remote control, and extra feet in the box to angle it. I was immediately impressed when the bass of Dead Prez’s “Hip-Hop” kicked in, bouncing the passive radiators up and down. The sound is expansive, the bass is far better than it has any right to be without a large subwoofer, and the highs are surprisingly crisp. This soundbar is Dolby Atmos-certified and has three distinct gaming modes. The first-person shooter mode offered excellent spatial sound, allowing me to hear the footsteps and grunts of a cloaked Elite in Halo Infinite just in time to avoid being impaled. Connectivity is comprehensive with USB-A and USB-C, 3.5-mm aux, Bluetooth 5.0, two HDMI ports (one eARC), a mic-in port, and a headphone jack. All that’s missing is the option to hook up a subwoofer. The wired control unit lights up, acts as a volume dial and power button, and has EQ and mode buttons on the back. While the OXS Thunder Pro impressed, you will get better sound, especially for music, if you buy separate speakers and a subwoofer.
paras.zh: OXS Thunder Pro 售价 600 美元：设计紧凑，科幻风格，包括 RGB 灯光，没有独立的低音炮，我不确定这款条形音箱会带来什么。 Thunder Pro 长 24 英寸，高仅 3 英寸，因此可以完美地安装在我的显示器下方。它配有一个有线控制旋钮、一个遥控器和盒子里额外的脚来调整它的角度。当 Dead Prez 的“Hip-Hop”的低音响起，让无源辐射器上下弹跳时，我立即印象深刻。声音广阔，低音远胜于没有大型低音炮的情况，而高音则令人惊讶地清脆。该条形音箱经过杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos) 认证，并具有三种不同的游戏模式。第一人称射击模式提供了出色的空间音效，让我能够听到《光环：无限》中隐身精英的脚步声和咕噜声，及时避免被刺穿。连接性非常全面，包括 USB-A 和 USB-C、3.5 毫米辅助接口、蓝牙 5.0、两个 HDMI 端口（一个 eARC）、一个麦克风输入端口和一个耳机插孔。所缺少的只是连接低音炮的选项。有线控制单元亮起，充当音量旋钮和电源按钮，背面有均衡器和模式按钮。虽然 OXS Thunder Pro 给人留下了深刻的印象，但如果您购买单独的扬声器和低音炮，您将获得更好的声音，尤其是音乐。

paras.en: Razer Nommo V2 Pro for $438: Stick to one brand for all your gaming gear, and it’s easier to achieve harmony. Plus, you only need one app to configure everything. If Razer is your jam, the Nommo V2 Pro is a 2.1 system with tempting bells and whistles. These stylish cylindrical speakers fire light out the back and tilt up towards your ears. The chunky subwoofer is wireless, which could be handy if you prefer to keep the space under your desk free. The wireless control puck acts as a volume dial, and you can press it to mute, play, or skip. You can expect booming bass and rich mids, but there’s a little crispness lacking in the highs, particularly when you crank the volume up. The sound profile is well-suited to action movies and games, with a deep bass rumble that you feel in the pit of your stomach. Connectivity is limited to USB or Bluetooth 5.3. I had some setup issues with the wireless control puck, but after a few attempts, the new firmware was installed successfully. I still found it a bit flaky and didn’t like having to hold it down to turn the speakers on. (They switch off automatically unless you deactivate the power-saving setting.) While Razer Chroma RGB now supports more than 300 games, offers various effects, and an ambient awareness mode that reacts to your screen, there are only two lighting zones (one for each speaker). Unfortunately, the Razer Synapse software is the only way to get at some settings, and it feels bloated and sometimes hogs system resources.
paras.zh: Razer Nommo V2 Pro 售价 438 美元：坚持使用同一个品牌的所有游戏装备，更容易实现和谐。另外，您只需要一个应用程序即可配置所有内容。如果 Razer 是您的最爱，Nommo V2 Pro 是一款带有诱人花哨功能的 2.1 系统。这些时尚的圆柱形扬声器从背面发出光线，并向您的耳朵倾斜。厚实的低音炮是无线的，如果您希望保持办公桌下方的空间空闲，这可能会很方便。无线控制圆盘充当音量旋钮，您可以按下它来静音、播放或跳过。您可以期待强劲的低音和丰富的中音，但高音缺乏一点清脆感，尤其是当您调高音量时。声音配置非常适合动作电影和游戏，具有深沉的低音隆隆声，让您在胃中感受到。连接仅限于 USB 或蓝牙 5.3。我在无线控制盘上遇到了一些设置问题，但经过几次尝试，新固件安装成功。我仍然发现它有点不稳定，并且不喜欢必须按住它才能打开扬声器。 （除非您停用省电设置，否则它们会自动关闭。）而 Razer Chroma RGB 现在支持 超过 300 个游戏，提供各种效果，以及对屏幕做出反应的环境感知模式，只有两个照明区域（每个扬声器一个）。不幸的是，Razer Synapse 软件是获取某些设置的唯一方法，而且感觉很臃肿，有时还会占用系统资源。

paras.en: Logitech G560 Lightsync for $250: Folks who prefer Logitech gear should consider the G560 Lightsync. This 2.1 system comprises a huge subwoofer and two speakers with an attractive curved loop design. The speakers project RGB lighting onto the wall behind them. Sound-wise, the bass is dominant and the soundstage lacks definition, but you can play around with the equalizer or use the presets Logitech provides. For movies and gaming, the G560 does better, with DTS:X Ultra virtual surround sound to emulate larger systems. There’s a good thump of bass for explosions, and they provide a decent positional sense in games. These speakers connect via USB, but there’s also a 3.5-mm aux port and support for Bluetooth 4.1. Sadly, for lighting fans, you only get four zones of LEDs here, but there are lots of presets and colors to choose from, and you can have them react to the onscreen action. While these speakers don’t grab me, with the bass bossing the show, they are decent value, particularly as the price has dropped significantly since they were first released.
paras.zh: 罗技 G560 Lightsync 售价 250 美元：喜欢罗技装备的人们应该考虑 G560 Lightsync。该 2.1 系统包括一个巨大的低音炮和两个采用迷人的弧形环设计的扬声器。扬声器将 RGB 灯光投射到后面的墙上。声音方面，低音占主导地位，声场缺乏清晰度，但您可以使用均衡器或使用罗技提供的预设。对于电影和游戏，G560 表现更好，具有 DTS:X Ultra 虚拟环绕声来模拟更大的系统。爆炸时有很好的低音重击，并且它们在游戏中提供了不错的位置感。这些扬声器通过 USB 连接，但还有一个 3.5 毫米辅助端口并支持蓝牙 4.1。遗憾的是，对于灯光爱好者来说，这里只有四个 LED 区域，但有很多预设和颜色可供选择，并且可以让它们对屏幕上的操作做出反应。虽然这些扬声器并没有吸引我的注意力，但它们的低音占主导地位，但它们的价值还不错，特别是自它们首次发布以来价格已大幅下降。

paras.en: SteelSeries Arena 7 for $380: The SteelSeries Arena 7 boasts great sound and real versatility. This 2.1 system is the sweet spot in the SteelSeries Arena lineup, as it adds a chunky subwoofer and RGB lighting over the Arena 3, but is still relatively affordable. Simply plug in the USB and attach the pear-shaped speakers to the subwoofer. The adjustable speakers look interesting, with RGB lighting around the base and back, and a mode button and volume dial on the right speaker (headphone port behind it). This system produces a soundstage with clarity and precision, but can sound too bassy and flat, though you can tweak it in the SteelSeries GG software. The spatial sound for games is immersive and accurate enough to help you pinpoint footsteps or the whomp of an approaching helicopter. With USB, Bluetooth 4.2, optical in and out, and 3.5-mm aux, your connectivity bases are covered. You can also sync the Prism RGB lighting with the rest of your setup, have it react to music, or just pick a color. On the downside, the speakers are quite tall, and the subwoofer is bulky and sometimes overpowers the sound.
paras.zh: SteelSeries Arena 7 售价 380 美元：SteelSeries Arena 7 拥有出色的音质和真正的多功能性。这个 2.1 系统是 SteelSeries Arena 系列中的最佳点，因为它在 Arena 3 的基础上增加了厚实的低音炮和 RGB 照明，但仍然相对便宜。只需插入 USB 并将梨形扬声器连接到低音炮即可。可调节扬声器看起来很有趣，底座和背面周围有 RGB 灯光，右侧扬声器上有模式按钮和音量旋钮（耳机端口位于其后面）。该系统产生的声场清晰且精确，但听起来可能过于低音和平淡，尽管您可以在 SteelSeries GG 软件中对其进行调整。游戏的空间音效足够身临其境且准确，可以帮助您精确定位脚步声或正在接近的直升机的轰鸣声。借助 USB、蓝牙 4.2、光纤输入和输出以及 3.5 毫米辅助接口，满足您的连接需求。您还可以将 Prism RGB 灯光与您的其他设置同步，让它对音乐做出反应，或者只是选择一种颜色。缺点是扬声器相当高，低音炮体积庞大，有时会压倒声音。

paras.en: Majority DX10 Desktop Speakers for £13: They lack bass and general clarity, but these USB-powered speakers are the cheapest I’ve tried. These 10-watt, 2.5-inch, full-range speakers are angled up toward your ears and have a simple power and volume dial. There’s also a 3.5 mm headphone port. Only available in the UK, they could be enough if your budget is very tight.
paras.zh: 大多数 DX10 桌面扬声器售价 13 英镑：它们缺乏低音和一般清晰度，但这些 USB 供电的扬声器是我尝试过的最便宜的。这些 10 瓦、2.5 英寸全频扬声器朝向您的耳朵倾斜，并具有简单的功率和音量旋钮。还有一个 3.5 毫米耳机端口。仅在英国提供，如果您的预算非常紧张，它们可能就足够了。

paras.en: Edifier G2000 Pro for $212: A spruced-up version of the G2000 above, the Pro is an upgrade to 64-watt power, 3-inch full-range drivers, and virtual 7.1 surround sound. Edifier also made these speakers translucent and added garish RGB lighting effects courtesy of LED strips in each speaker. They do sound a bit better, though still lacking in bass, and some folks will love the sci-fi light show, but there isn’t enough extra to justify the significant jump in price.
paras.zh: Edifier G2000 Pro 售价 212 美元：Pro 是上述 G2000 的升级版本，升级至 64 瓦功率、3 英寸全频驱动器和虚拟 7.1 环绕声。 Edifier 还使这些扬声器变得半透明，并通过每个扬声器中的 LED 灯条添加了华丽的 RGB 灯光效果。它们听起来确实好一点，尽管仍然缺乏低音，而且有些人会喜欢科幻灯光秀，但没有足够的额外费用来证明价格大幅上涨的合理性。

paras.en: Creative Pebble X Plus for $123: If our budget pick isn’t quite doing it for you, Creative’s Pebble X Plus adds a cube-shaped subwoofer under your desk. The larger speakers, with RGB lighting, are also more powerful, and the sub provides punchy bass. They sound reasonably good for the money. Connectivity is also beefed up compared to the V3 above, with headphone and microphone ports and Bluetooth 5.3, but all of this invariably comes at a higher cost.
paras.zh: Creative Pebble X Plus 售价 123 美元：如果我们的预算选择不太适合您，Creative 的 Pebble X Plus 在您的办公桌下添加了一个立方体形状的低音炮。带有 RGB 灯光的更大扬声器也更强大，低音炮提供强劲的低音。它们听起来相当物有所值。与上面的 V3 相比，连接性也得到了加强，配备了耳机和麦克风端口以及蓝牙 5.3，但所有这一切都以更高的成本为代价。

paras.en: Onkyo Creator GX-10DB for $250: Capable of producing a warm and rich sound, Onkyo’s speakers are the perfect size for your desktop and come with angled stands (though they are plastic). The connectivity options are solid, with USB-C, optical, and stereo RCA inputs, and support for Bluetooth 5.3. These speakers get a little louder than our top pick, though you’ll need to pair a subwoofer if you’re into bass (there is a subwoofer-out port). Sadly, the volume knob on the back of the right speaker is tricky to reach, the slim remote control has a weird layout, and the source LED on the front is always on. But what I struggled with most was the automatic power-off (Onkyo says this “feature” is an eco-regulation in Europe) that turns off the speakers if they aren’t used for 15 minutes. If you have more space and crave more power, I also tested the Onkyo Creator Series GX-30ARC ($350), which goes far louder and adds a decent thump of bass.
paras.zh: Onkyo Creator GX-10DB 售价 250 美元：Onkyo 扬声器能够产生温暖而丰富的声音，其尺寸非常适合您的桌面，并配有倾斜支架（尽管它们是塑料的）。连接选项非常可靠，具有 USB-C、光纤和立体声 RCA 输入，并支持蓝牙 5.3。这些扬声器的声音比我们的首选扬声器大一点，但如果您喜欢低音，则需要配对低音炮（有一个低音炮输出端口）。遗憾的是，右侧扬声器背面的音量旋钮很难触及，纤薄的遥控器布局怪异，前面的 LED 源始终亮着。但最令我困扰的是自动关闭电源（安桥称此“功能”是欧洲的一项生态法规），如果 15 分钟不使用扬声器，它就会关闭扬声器。如果您有更多的空间并渴望更大的功率，我还测试了 Onkyo Creator 系列 GX-30ARC（350 美元），它的声音更大，并增加了不错的低音。

paras.en: Creative Sound Blaster GS5 for $95: While it doesn’t quite have the power of the OXS Thunder Lite above, this soundbar is cheaper and matches it on connectivity, even adding cool RGB lighting to the underside. It also has a remote and decent software for making EQ and lighting adjustments. The sound lacks clarity, and the bass is limited, but this is a solid, small soundbar for the money and works well as a desktop device.
paras.zh: Creative Sound Blaster GS5 售价 95 美元：虽然它没有上面的 OXS Thunder Lite 那样强大，但这款条形音箱更便宜，并且在连接性方面与之匹配，甚至在底部添加了炫酷的 RGB 灯光。它还具有一个远程且不错的软件，用于进行均衡器和灯光调整。声音缺乏清晰度，低音有限，但这是一款坚固的小型条形音箱，物有所值，并且可以作为桌面设备使用。

paras.en: Logitech Z407 for $110: A complete 2.1 system at this price is no mean feat. These speakers connect via USB, 3.5-mm aux, or Bluetooth, and there’s a wireless remote volume dial. Construction is cheap, and the sound lacks definition, but there’s a good thump of bass from the subwoofer, and mids and highs are reasonably crisp, provided you don’t turn the volume up too high. WIRED senior reviews editor Julian Chokkattu says he used a variation of the Logitech Z-series for nearly a decade and only recently donated them to someone else.
paras.zh: 罗技 Z407 售价 110 美元：以这个价格购买完整的 2.1 系统绝非易事。这些扬声器通过 USB、3.5 毫米辅助接口或蓝牙进行连接，并配有无线遥控音量旋钮。结构很便宜，声音缺乏清晰度，但低音炮发出的低音很好，中音和高音相当清脆，只要你不把音量调得太高。 《连线》高级评论编辑朱利安·乔卡图 (Julian Chokkattu) 表示，他使用罗技 Z 系列的变体近十年，直到最近才将其捐赠给其他人。

paras.en: Razer Nommo V2 X for $150: The sound quality of Razer’s entry-level speakers is solid for music and good for movies and games (there's THX Spatial support), though lacking in bass. These no-frills speakers look great but lack a subwoofer, RGB lighting, and a remote. They offer USB and Bluetooth connectivity and can be customized in Razer’s Synapse software.
paras.zh: Razer Nommo V2 X 售价 150 美元：Razer 入门级扬声器的音质对于音乐来说很稳定，对于电影和游戏也有好处（有 THX Spatial 支持），但低音有所欠缺。这些简洁的扬声器看起来很棒，但缺少低音炮、RGB 灯光和遥控器。它们提供 USB 和蓝牙连接，并且可以在 Razer Synapse 软件中进行定制。

paras.en: These are the computer speakers that had deal-breaking flaws for me.
paras.zh: 这些电脑扬声器对我来说存在破坏性的缺陷。

paras.en: OXS Thunder Duo X for $550: These powerful speakers get plenty loud and come with a wireless neck speaker for surround sound, but they are very large (way too big for my desk) and, frankly, kinda garish when they light up. The sound quality is decent and I liked the surround sound for gaming, but the neck speaker is not comfortable, especially for long gaming sessions (much will depend on your office chair). You can also get these speakers with a subwoofer.
paras.zh: OXS Thunder Duo X 售价 550 美元：这些功能强大的扬声器声音很大，并配有无线颈部扬声器，可提供环绕声，但它们非常大（对于我的办公桌来说太大了），坦白说，当它们亮起时有点花哨。音质不错，我喜欢游戏时的环绕声，但颈部扬声器不太舒服，尤其是长时间游戏时（很大程度上取决于您的办公椅）。您还可以购买带有低音炮的扬声器。

paras.en: OXS Thunder Lite for $150: This compact soundbar lacks the bells and whistles of its bigger sibling above, but is far more affordable. It can get plenty loud, supports virtual surround sound, and comes with a small remote. Unfortunately, separation was poor, so it was tough to tell where sounds were coming from in games, and it is severely lacking in bass for a soundbar with thunder in its name. Connectivity includes USB-C, 3.5-mm aux, optical, or HDMI, and it supports Bluetooth 5.0.
paras.zh: OXS Thunder Lite 售价 150 美元：这款紧凑型条形音箱缺乏上面较大兄弟产品的附加功能，但价格便宜得多。它声音很大，支持虚拟环绕声，并配有一个小遥控器。不幸的是，分离度很差，所以很难分辨游戏中的声音来自哪里，而且对于一个以雷霆为名的条形音箱来说，它的低音严重缺乏。连接包括 USB-C、3.5 毫米辅助、光纤或 HDMI，并且支持蓝牙 5.0。

paras.en: Edifier QR65 for $314: Delivering classy looks with supercool lighting effects and a seriously big, powerful sound, these speakers are excellent for music, movies, or games. They also come with two angled stands to point them at your ears. They have USB, RCA, and Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity and USB ports for charging your gadgets. Controls are decent, with a physical button on the right speaker for power and cycling through modes. The problem is that they are huge and won’t fit on most desktops, including mine.
paras.zh: Edifier QR65 售价 314 美元：这些扬声器具有优雅的外观、超酷的灯光效果和大而有力的声音，非常适合音乐、电影或游戏。它们还配有两个倾斜的支架，可将它们指向您的耳朵。它们具有 USB、RCA 和蓝牙 5.3 连接以及用于为您的小工具充电的 USB 端口。控件很不错，右侧扬声器上有一个物理按钮，用于电源和循环模式。问题是它们太大了，不适合大多数桌面，包括我的。

paras.en: Creative Stage V2 for $150: This affordable soundbar offers excellent connectivity with HDMI ARC, optical, USB, 3.5-mm aux, and Bluetooth 5.0. But it’s not especially powerful, can sound muddy and flat, and has a short cable (no good for sit-stand desks). The subwoofer lends some decent bass, there’s a remote control, and I like the Clear Dialog option to sharpen voices, but you can do better.
paras.zh: Creative Stage V2 售价 150 美元：这款价格实惠的条形音箱提供与 HDMI ARC、光纤、USB、3.5 毫米 aux 和蓝牙 5.0 的出色连接。但它的功能不是特别强大，听起来浑浊且平淡，并且电缆很短（不适合坐立式办公桌）。低音炮提供了一些不错的低音，有一个遥控器，我喜欢“清晰对话”选项来锐化声音，但你可以做得更好。

paras.en: House of Marley Get Together Duo for $170: Sporting an attractive and eco-friendly blend of bamboo and fabric, the Get Together Duo from House of Marley is affordable. They connect via Bluetooth 5.0, RCA, or 3.5-mm aux. There’s no subwoofer, the midrange is dominant, and they are lacking something at the high end. The battery-powered right speaker can also double as a portable speaker, and you can use these as bookshelf speakers, but as computer speakers, they are just OK.
paras.zh: House of Marley Get Together Duo 售价 170 美元：House of Marley 的 Get Together Duo 采用有吸引力且环保的竹子和织物混合而成，价格实惠。它们通过蓝牙 5.0、RCA 或 3.5 毫米辅助连接。没有低音炮，中音占主导地位，而高端则有所欠缺。电池供电的右侧扬声器还可以兼作便携式扬声器，您可以将它们用作书架扬声器，但作为电脑扬声器，它们也还可以。

paras.en: SteelSeries Arena 3 for $150: Sporting a nice pear-shaped design with tiltable speakers and subtle branding, the entry-level Arena 3 from SteelSeries can get loud. But they lack bass, lose detail in the highs, and sound a bit fuzzy for music. Even for SteelSeries fans, there isn’t much reason to choose these over some of our picks above. They don’t have lighting, USB, or any other extras.
paras.zh: SteelSeries Arena 3 售价 150 美元：SteelSeries 的入门级 Arena 3 采用精美的梨形设计，配有可倾斜扬声器和微妙的品牌标识，声音响亮。但它们缺乏低音，丢失高音细节，并且听起来对音乐来说有点模糊。即使对于 SteelSeries 粉丝来说，也没有太多理由选择这些而不是我们上面的一些选择。他们没有照明、USB 或任何其他附加设施。

paras.en: Logitech Z906 5.1 Surround Sound Speaker System for $450: This 5.1 system is THX-certified and comes with a huge subwoofer, five speakers, and a central control unit. The design feels dated, maybe even a bit ugly, and you need to run cables around your room. The surround sound effect is solid, and you can even convert stereo with the 3D mode, but overall, it’s a bass-heavy system.
paras.zh: 罗技 Z906 5.1 环绕声扬声器系统，售价 450 美元：这款 5.1 系统经过 THX 认证，配有一个巨大的低音炮、五个扬声器和一个中央控制单元。该设计感觉过时，甚至可能有点难看，而且您需要在房间周围布设电缆。环绕声效果很扎实，甚至可以用 3D 模式转换立体声，但总的来说，它是一个重低音的系统。

paras.en: Budget is a deciding factor for most folks, but even cheap desktop speakers offer far better sound than your monitor. Headphones are a great alternative, but not everyone wants to wear headphones all the time. You can spend as much as you like on audio gear, but I have focused on reasonably affordable desktop systems here, starting from as low as $35 and not exceeding $700.
paras.zh: 对于大多数人来说，预算是一个决定因素，但即使是便宜的桌面扬声器也能提供比显示器更好的声音。耳机是一个很好的选择，但并不是每个人都想一直戴着耳机。您可以在音频设备上花多少钱，但我在这里重点关注价格合理的桌面系统，起价低至 35 美元，不超过 700 美元。

paras.en: What Should I Look for in Computer Speakers?
paras.zh: 我应该在电脑扬声器中寻找什么？

paras.en: It depends. There’s plenty to weigh when shopping for a set of computer speakers, so it’s vital to start by deciding what’s most important to you. For example, I work and play on the same desktop PC, so I need speakers that perform well for video calls, long gaming sessions, listening to music, and watching movies. I also have a standing desk, and my monitor setup doesn’t leave much room, so I prefer compact all-rounders with long cables.
paras.zh: 这取决于。购买一套电脑扬声器时需要权衡很多因素，因此首先决定什么对您最重要至关重要。例如，我在同一台台式电脑上工作和娱乐，因此我需要性能良好的扬声器来进行视频通话、长时间游戏、听音乐和看电影。我还有一张站立式办公桌，而且我的显示器设置没有留下太多空间，所以我更喜欢带有长电缆的紧凑型全能设备。

paras.en: Sound quality: The top consideration for most folks, you want the best sound quality you can afford. A good set of speakers will offer a balance of clear vocals, rich treble, and rumbling bass. If you crave bass you feel in the pit of your stomach, a subwoofer is essential, though it might not be a good idea for folks who have downstairs neighbors. For accurate positional sound, you might want to look at a surround sound system with multiple speakers.
paras.zh: 音质：对于大多数人来说，最重要的考虑因素是您想要您能负担得起的最佳音质。一套好的扬声器将提供清晰的人声、丰富的高音和隆隆的低音之间的平衡。如果您渴望低音，那么低音炮是必不可少的，尽管对于楼下有邻居的人来说这可能不是一个好主意。为了获得准确的定位声音，您可能需要考虑具有多个扬声器的环绕音响系统。

paras.en: Design: Consider the finish. Your speakers will be on show, so you’ll want to pick something that fits your decor.
paras.zh: 设计：考虑饰面。您的扬声器将展出，因此您需要选择适合您的装饰的扬声器。

paras.en: Brand: Gamers with devices from an existing brand might lean toward the same brand of speakers because they can be configured in the same software. This is particularly important with speakers that have built-in lights, so you can sync up your entire setup.
paras.zh: 品牌：拥有现有品牌设备的游戏玩家可能会倾向于使用同一品牌的扬声器，因为它们可以在同一软件中进行配置。这对于具有内置灯的扬声器尤其重要，因此您可以同步整个设置。

paras.en: Extras: Some people will consider these superfluous, but if you want a remote control for kicking back or RGB lighting to bring a splash of color to your desk, these are extra perks on higher-end speakers. Snag speakers with a decent range of connectivity, and you can always repurpose them later. Most speakers come with all the cables you need, but it’s worth checking before you buy. I have listed what you will find in the box with all the computer speakers I recommend.
paras.zh: 附加功能：有些人会认为这些是多余的，但如果您想要一个遥控器来控制回响或 RGB 灯光为您的办公桌带来一抹色彩，这些都是高端扬声器的额外福利。具有良好连接范围的扬声器，您以后随时可以重新调整它们的用途。大多数扬声器都配有您需要的所有电缆，但在购买前值得检查。我列出了我推荐的所有电脑扬声器的包装盒中的物品。

paras.en: Where Should I Position My Desktop Speakers?
paras.zh: 我应该将桌面扬声器放置在哪里？

paras.en: You ideally want the speakers to be angled slightly up (around 15 degrees) and pointed at your ears. Since you know the exact spot you’ll be in when listening, you can tweak the position of your speakers for the best results. Don’t just chuck them on the desk and leave it at that. Try moving and angling them until you find that sweet spot.
paras.zh: 理想情况下，您希望扬声器稍微向上倾斜（大约 15 度）并指向您的耳朵。由于您知道聆听时所在的确切位置，因此您可以调整扬声器的位置以获得最佳效果。不要只是把它们扔在桌子上然后就放在那里。尝试移动它们并调整它们的角度，直到找到最佳位置。

paras.en: Speaker stands can maximize sound quality by helping to reduce vibrations from your desktop that can muddy the sound. Angled speaker stands are also a good way to direct the sound toward your ears. Some manufacturers, such as Edifier and Onkyo, include stands; IK Multimedia and Razer include adjustable bases or fold-out feet; Audioengine sells stands separately. You will also find a wide choice of third-party stands online.
paras.zh: 扬声器支架可以帮助减少桌面振动，从而最大限度地提高音质。倾斜的扬声器支架也是将声音引导至耳朵的好方法。一些制造商，例如 Edifier 和 Onkyo，都配有支架； IK Multimedia 和 Razer 包括可调节底座或折叠脚； Audioengine 单独销售支架。您还可以在网上找到多种第三方展位。

paras.en: If space is limited, a compact set of speakers will work best. The trade-off is power and volume, as small speakers generally don’t produce as big or high-quality a sound as large speakers. If you opt for a subwoofer, you will want a suitable space under your desk. For surround sound systems, you must run cables and find suitable spots for speakers behind you. If you have a wide monitor on a mount, a compact soundbar beneath it could be the best fit. Check the dimensions carefully and measure the space on your desk before you buy.
paras.zh: 如果空间有限，一组紧凑的扬声器效果最佳。权衡是功率和音量，因为小型扬声器通常无法产生与大型扬声器一样大或高质量的声音。如果您选择低音炮，您需要在桌子下方有一个合适的空间。对于环绕声系统，您必须铺设电缆并为身后的扬声器找到合适的位置。如果您的安装座上有宽显示器，那么其下方的紧凑型条形音箱可能是最合适的选择。购买前请仔细检查尺寸并测量桌子上的空间。

paras.en: What’s the Best Way to Connect My Speakers to My Computer?
paras.zh: 将扬声器连接到计算机的最佳方式是什么？

paras.en: Speakers can come with a multitude of ports and connectivity options. USB connections usually sound best because they output the digital signal for the digital-to-analog converter (DAC) in the speakers, which is likely to be better unless you have a good sound card. But the best way to be sure is to try both and see which sounds better. If you want to be able to connect a phone or laptop wirelessly, then Bluetooth is paramount. Most speakers have a 3.5-mm aux input, and some have an output for headphones. Just make sure your preferred speakers support the connectivity you want. You should also make sure that you have the necessary free ports on your PC or laptop, though you can always add more with a USB hub.
paras.zh: 扬声器可以配备多种端口和连接选项。 USB 连接通常听起来效果最好，因为它们为扬声器中的数模转换器 (DAC) 输出数字信号，除非您有好的声卡，否则这可能会更好。但最好的确定方法是两种都尝试一下，看看哪种听起来更好。如果您希望能够无线连接手机或笔记本电脑，那么蓝牙至关重要。大多数扬声器都具有 3.5 毫米辅助输入，有些还具有耳机输出。只需确保您的首选扬声器支持您想要的连接即可。您还应该确保您的 PC 或笔记本电脑上有必要的可用端口，但您始终可以使用 USB 集线器添加更多端口。

paras.en: Every set of speakers in this guide was tested for at least a week, sometimes longer. I don’t use headphones, so they were all used for video calls throughout my work day, listening to music and podcasts, and for movies and games in the evening. While I played several games, watched many movies or shows, and listened to lots of music and podcasts, I ran through a specific list of test content with every speaker system to make it easier to compare them.
paras.zh: 本指南中的每组扬声器都经过至少一周的测试，有时甚至更长。我不使用耳机，所以我整个工作日都用它们进行视频通话、听音乐和播客，以及晚上看电影和玩游戏。当我玩了几个游戏、观看了许多电影或节目、听了很多音乐和播客时，我对每个扬声器系统都运行了特定的测试内容列表，以便更容易对它们进行比较。

paras.en: My test content included the game Halo Infinite, the movie Dune, and a music playlist including “Hip-Hop” (Dead Prez), “The National Anthem” (Radiohead), “All Along the Watchtower” (Jimi Hendrix), “Hey” (Pixies), “Sabotage” (Beastie Boys), “A Day in the Life” (the Beatles), “Nothing Compares 2 U” (Sinéad O'Connor), and “Only God Knows” (Young Fathers).
paras.zh: 我的测试内容包括游戏《光环无限》、电影《沙丘》以及音乐播放列表，其中包括“Hip-Hop”（Dead Prez）、“国歌”（Radiohead）、“All Below the Watchtower”（Jimi Hendrix）、“Hey”（Pixies）、“Sabotage”（Beastie Boys）、“A Day in the Life”（披头士乐队）、“Nothing Compares 2 U”（Sinéad）奥康纳）和“只有上帝知道”（年轻的父亲）。

articles.title: On This Day, Nov. 8: Americans elect Abraham Lincoln to second term

paras.en: Nov. 8 (UPI) -- On this date in history:
paras.zh: 11 月 8 日（UPI）——历史上的这一天：

paras.en: In 1864, amid the U.S. Civil War, Abraham Lincoln was elected to his second term as president. He was assassinated five months later.
paras.zh: 1864年，在美国内战期间，亚伯拉罕·林肯当选第二任总统。五个月后他被暗杀。

paras.en: In 1889, Montana was admitted to the union as the 41st state.
paras.zh: 1889年，蒙大拿州加入联邦，成为第41个州。

paras.en: In 1895, physicist Wilhelm Conrad Roentgen discovered X-rays.
paras.zh: 1895年，物理学家威廉·康拉德·伦琴发现了X射线。

paras.en: In 1923, Adolf Hitler led a failed attempt to overthrow the German government in what has become known as the Beer Hall Putsch. Hitler was quickly arrested and charged with treason.
paras.zh: 1923 年，阿道夫·希特勒领导了一场推翻德国政府的失败尝试，即后来的啤酒馆政变。希特勒很快被捕并被指控犯有叛国罪。

paras.en: In 1932, voters elected Franklin D. Roosevelt as the 32nd president of the United States, defeating incumbent President Herbert Hoover.
paras.zh: 1932年，选民选举富兰克林·罗斯福成为美国第32任总统，击败了现任总统赫伯特·胡佛。

paras.en: In 1933, U.S. President Franklin Roosevelt set up the Civil Works Administration as an emergency Depression agency to provide jobs for the unemployed.
paras.zh: 1933年，美国总统富兰克林·罗斯福设立了土木工程管理局，作为大萧条时期的紧急机构，为失业者提供就业机会。

paras.en: In 1942, as World War II raged on, more than 400,000 Allied soldiers invaded North Africa.
paras.zh: 1942年，第二次世界大战愈演愈烈，超过40万盟军士兵入侵北非。

paras.en: In 1960, John F. Kennedy won the U.S. presidential election, defeating Richard Nixon. Kennedy was the 35th president.
paras.zh: 1960年，约翰·F·肯尼迪击败理查德·尼克松，赢得美国总统大选。肯尼迪是第 35 任总统。

paras.en: In 1965, the United Kingdom formally abolishes the death penalty as Royal Assent is given to the Murder (Abolition of Death Penalty) Act 1965.
paras.zh: 1965年，英国正式废除死刑，并获得御准《1965年谋杀（废除死刑）法》。

paras.en: In 1973, the right ear of John Paul Getty III, who had been kidnapped four months earlier, was delivered, along with a ransom note, to a daily newspaper. The ransom was reluctantly paid, with Getty III found alive at a gas station in southern Italy.
paras.zh: 1973 年，四个月前被绑架的约翰·保罗·盖蒂三世的右耳连同一张赎金信被交给一家日报。赎金被勉强支付，盖蒂三世在意大利南部的一个加油站被发现还活着。

paras.en: In 1974, Ted Bundy attempted and failed to abduct 18-year-old Carol DaRonch in the parking lot of a Utah mall. Her testimony resulted in his conviction for kidnapping, landing him in jail until his escape in 1977. He later killed more than 30 people and was executed in 1989.
paras.zh: 1974 年，泰德·邦迪 (Ted Bundy) 试图在犹他州一家购物中心的停车场绑架 18 岁的卡罗尔·达朗奇 (Carol DaRonch)，但未能成功。她的证词导致他被判绑架罪，并入狱，直到 1977 年越狱。后来他杀害了 30 多人，并于 1989 年被处决。

paras.en: In 1985, a judge overturned Rubin "Hurricane" Carter's conviction for a 1966 triple killing in a Patterson, N.J., bar, freeing the former boxer after 19 years in prison.
paras.zh: 1985 年，法官推翻了鲁宾·“飓风”·卡特 1966 年在新泽西州帕特森一家酒吧犯下三重杀人罪的定罪，这位前拳击手在入狱 19 年后获释。

paras.en: In 1988, U.S. Vice President George H.W. Bush was elected as the 41st president of the United States.
paras.zh: 1988年，美国副总统乔治·H·W·布什 (George H.W.布什当选为美国第41任总统。

paras.en: In 1994, in a stunning upset, Republican candidates swept the general election, regaining control of both chambers of the U.S. Congress. It marked the first time in 40 years the Republicans controlled both the House of Representatives and the Senate.
paras.zh: 1994年，共和党候选人在大选中大获全胜，重新获得了美国国会参众两院的控制权，令人震惊。这标志着共和党40年来首次同时控制众议院和参议院。

paras.en: In 2005, French Prime Minister Dominique de Villepin declared a state of emergency in a bid to quell the nation's worst rioting in decades.
paras.zh: 2005年，法国总理多米尼克·德维尔潘宣布进入紧急状态，以平息该国数十年来最严重的骚乱。

paras.en: In 2011, remains of U.S. soldiers were mishandled and body parts were lost at Dover Air Force Base in Delaware, a scathing Washington report concluded. Three senior officials at the base were disciplined following an 18-month investigation.
paras.zh: 华盛顿一份措辞严厉的报告得出结论，2011年，特拉华州多佛空军基地的美国士兵遗骸被处理不当，身体部位丢失。经过 18 个月的调查后，该基地的三名高级官员受到纪律处分。

paras.en: In 2013, Super Typhoon Haiyan, one of the most powerful typhoons ever recorded, smashed into the Philippines, causing death and destruction on island after island. The death toll rose into the thousands, with hundreds of people injured and missing and tens of thousands displaced. On Jan. 3, 2014, government officials said at least 6,166 people had been killed and 28,626 injured.
paras.zh: 2013年，有史以来最强台风之一的超强台风海燕袭击了菲律宾，造成一个又一个岛屿的死亡和破坏。死亡人数上升至数千人，数百人受伤和失踪，数万人流离失所。 2014 年 1 月 3 日，政府官员称至少 6,166 人死亡、28,626 人受伤。

paras.en: In 2016, voters elected businessman Republican Donald Trump to be president over Democrat Hillary Clinton. He became the first U.S. president with no prior military or government experience.
paras.zh: 2016年，选民选举商人共和党人唐纳德·特朗普击败民主党人希拉里·克林顿成为总统。他成为第一位没有军事或政府经验的美国总统。

paras.en: In 2018, the deadliest and most destructive wildfire in California history to date, the Camp Fire, broke out in Northern California's Butte County. The blaze would go on to kill 85 people and cause more than $16 billion in damage.
paras.zh: 2018年，加州历史上迄今为止最致命、最具破坏性的野火——坎普大火（Camp Fire）在北加州巴特县爆发。大火导致 85 人死亡，造成超过 160 亿美元的损失。

paras.en: In 2023, the European Space Agency released the first images from its Euclid space telescope, which was designed to observe deep space in the hopes of unlocking the mysteries of the universe.
paras.zh: 2023年，欧洲航天局发布了其欧几里得太空望远镜的第一批图像，该望远镜旨在观测深空，以期解开宇宙之谜。

paras.en: In 2024, the eight bells of Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris rang out for the first time since a fire damaged the roof and spire of the historic church five years earlier. The historic building officially reopened a month later.
paras.zh: 2024年，巴黎圣母院的八钟钟声自五年前一场火灾烧毁这座历史悠久的教堂的屋顶和尖塔以来首次敲响。一个月后，这座历史建筑正式重新开放。

articles.title: Saudi Aramco building damaged in Houthi attack on Riyadh

paras.en: Nov. 8 (UPI) -- A building belonging to Saudi Arabia's state-run energy energy company Aramco sustained damage Sunday in an attack in Riyadh, the Ministry of Energy said.
paras.zh: 11月8日（合众社）——沙特阿拉伯能源部表示，周日，沙特阿拉伯国营能源公司阿美石油公司的一栋建筑在利雅得的一次袭击中遭到破坏。

paras.en: The ministry described the incident as "an attempted attack" in a statement posted to X.
paras.zh: 该部在发布给 X 的一份声明中将这一事件描述为“一次未遂袭击”。

paras.en: "The incident resulted in falling shrapnel that caused minor damage to the building, with no injuries or fatalities reported, thankfully," the ministry said.
paras.zh: 该部表示：“这起事件导致弹片坠落，对建筑物造成轻微损坏，幸运的是没有人员伤亡的报告。”

paras.en: Video verified by CNN showed the building with damage to several floors, including blown-out windows.
paras.zh: 美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）核实的视频显示，该建筑的几层楼都遭到损坏，其中窗户被炸毁。

paras.en: A New York Times reporter in Riyadh described one floor of the building as severely damaged.
paras.zh: 利雅得的《纽约时报》记者称，该建筑的一层受到严重损坏。

paras.en: The Saudi Civil Defense issued an early-warning alert ahead of the attack on the King Abdullah Financial District.
paras.zh: 沙特民防部门在阿卜杜拉国王金融区遭受袭击之前发布了预警警报。

paras.en: The Houthi rebels in Yemen claimed responsibility, saying it was one of multiple attacks on Aramco sites. They also said they targeted Saudi ground forces in Yemen.
paras.zh: 也门胡塞叛乱分子声称对此事负责，称这是针对沙特阿美石油公司工地的多起袭击之一。他们还表示，他们的目标是沙特驻也门的地面部队。

paras.en: Saudi has supported the Yemeni government in its 12-year-long civil war with the Houthis, who are backed by Iran.
paras.zh: 沙特支持也门政府与胡塞武装进行长达12年的内战，胡塞武装得到伊朗的支持。

articles.title: Trains collide in Egypt, killing at least 7

paras.en: Nov. 8 (UPI) -- Two trains collided in Egypt on Sunday, killing at least seven people and injuring dozens, health officials said.
paras.zh: 11 月 8 日（UPI）——卫生官员称，周日两列火车在埃及相撞，造成至少 7 人死亡、数十人受伤。

paras.en: The Egyptian National Railways Authority said the crash site was between the Kafr Ammar and Al-Raqqa stations about 35 miles south of Cairo. The collision happened when a train traveling southwest from Giza to the Fayoum oasis struck the rear of another train traveling from Cairo to Aswan.
paras.zh: 埃及国家铁路局表示，坠机地点位于开罗以南约 35 英里的卡夫阿马尔车站和拉卡车站之间。事故发生时，一列从吉萨向西南开往法尤姆绿洲的火车与另一列从开罗开往阿斯旺的火车尾部相撞。

paras.en: The collision killed seven people and injured 112 others, the Egyptian Minister of Health and Population said. Injuries ranged from minor bruises and abrasions to more serious bone fractures, lacerations, and bruising to the chest and ribs.
paras.zh: 埃及卫生和人口部长表示，此次碰撞造成 7 人死亡、112 人受伤。受伤范围从轻微的瘀伤和擦伤到更严重的骨折、撕裂以及胸部和肋骨的瘀伤。

paras.en: The ministry said ambulances transported the injured to multiple area hospitals. Of those hospitalized, 45 were discharged.
paras.zh: 卫生部表示，救护车已将伤者送往多个地区医院。住院患者中，45 人已出院。

paras.en: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi said he directed government agencies to provide care to those injured and to investigate the circumstances of the crash.
paras.zh: 埃及总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西表示，他指示政府机构为伤者提供护理，并调查坠机情况。

paras.en: "I am following the aftermath of the train collision with great concern and extend my deepest condolences to the families of those who lost their lives, along with my sincere wishes for a speedy recovery for the injured," he said in a statement on X.
paras.zh: 他在 X 日的一份声明中表示：“我非常关注火车相撞事件的后果，并向遇难者家属表示最深切的哀悼，并衷心祝愿伤者早日康复。”

paras.en: The Egyptian Red Crescent society said it directed team members from four governorates to the site to support the injured and their families.
paras.zh: 埃及红新月会表示，已指示四个省份的工作人员前往现场，为伤者及其家人提供支持。

articles.title: Alanis Morissette Shares She Identifies as Pansexual
articles.author: Ashley Iasimone

paras.en: Alanis Morissette identifies as pansexual, she revealed in a podcast appearance earlier this week. The hitmaker — who just dropped her first holiday album, Good Weather for Immaculate Conception, featuring new single “To an Empath at Christmas Time” — visited the Handsome Podcast as the podcast trio’s first in-person guest for an episode that was uploaded on Nov. 3.
paras.zh: 艾拉妮丝·莫莉塞特 (Alanis Morissette) 在本周早些时候的播客节目中透露，她是一名泛性恋者。这位热门音乐制作人刚刚推出了她的第一张假日专辑《Good Weather for Immaculate Conception》，其中收录了新单曲“To an Empath at Christmas Time”。她作为播客三人组的第一位现场嘉宾访问了 Handsome Podcast，并观看了 11 月 3 日上传的一集节目。

paras.en: “I’m sorry for the men that hurt you, but I’m not sorry for the songs that came from it. Those are pretty amazing,” comedian Fortune Feimster, who co-hosts the show with Tig Notaro and Mae Martin, said at one point toward the end of the episode, adding, “Did it make you want to be a lesbian at any point?”
paras.zh: “我为那些伤害你的男人感到抱歉，但我并不为其中的歌曲感到抱歉。那些真是太棒了，”与蒂格·诺塔罗和梅·马丁共同主持该节目的喜剧演员福琼·费姆斯特在剧集接近尾声时说道，并补充道，“这是否让你在任何时候都想成为一名女同性恋？”

paras.en: “I’m pansexual, so yeah,” Morissette shared in reply. “I get everything.”
paras.zh: “我是泛性恋，所以是的，”莫莉塞特回答道。 “我得到了一切。”

paras.en: GLAAD defines someone who identifies as pansexual as “a person who has the capacity to form enduring physical, romantic, and/ or emotional attractions to any person, regardless of gender identity.” The term is different than the term bisexual, which means that a person is attracted to people of more than one gender (whereas pansexual means gender is not a determining factor in attraction).
paras.zh: GLAAD 将泛性恋定义为“有能力对任何人形成持久的身体、浪漫和/或情感吸引力的人，无论性别认同如何。”该术语与双性恋一词不同，双性恋意味着一个人会被多种性别的人所吸引（而泛性恋则意味着性别不是吸引力的决定因素）。

paras.en: Notaro then asked, “Wait, you’re not really pansexual, are you?” to which Morissette confirmed, “I am.”
paras.zh: 诺塔罗接着问道：“等等，你并不是真正的泛性恋者，是吗？”莫莉塞特确认道：“我是。”

paras.en: Joking that they should’ve launched the episode with this tidbit, Notaro said, “How did I not know this?”
paras.zh: 诺塔罗开玩笑说他们应该用这个花絮来启动这一集，他说：“我怎么不知道这一点？”

paras.en: “You know, I like to leave it for the epilogue,” quipped Morissette. “I like to confuse people on the way out. Is it confusing?”
paras.zh: “你知道，我喜欢把它留到尾声，”莫里塞特打趣道。 “我喜欢在出去的时候迷惑别人。这让人迷惑吗？”

paras.en: Morissette, who’s got three Billboard 200 No. 1 albums under her belt and whose top hit “Ironic” soared to No. 4 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1996, is married to husband Mario Treadway, aka the artist Souleye. The couple wed in 2010 and are parents to three children.
paras.zh: Morissette 拥有三张 Billboard 200 排名第一的专辑，其热门单曲《Ironic》于 1996 年在 Billboard Hot 100 中飙升至第四位，她的丈夫 Mario Treadway（又名艺术家 Souleye）已结婚。这对夫妇于 2010 年结婚，是三个孩子的父母。

paras.en: Her 14-track holiday album, Good Weather for Immaculate Conception, arrived on Friday (Nov. 6). The set was led by her recording of “Beautiful Star of Bethlehem,” featuring Brandi Carlile and Steve Martin; Morissette gets snowed-in in a music video for second single “To an Empath at Christmas Time,” released on Saturday.
paras.zh: 她的 14 首歌曲假日专辑《Good Weather for Immaculate Conception》已于周五（11 月 6 日）上市。该系列以她录制的“美丽的伯利恒之星”为主导，与布兰迪·卡莱尔和史蒂夫·马丁合作；莫莉塞特在周六发布的第二首单曲《圣诞节时的同理心》的音乐视频中大放异彩。

paras.en: “The lights are green and red and shimmering white/ These days are super dark and even quieter nights/ All this time to sense what all year felt not right/ Nothing to distract us from this heavy ride,” she sings on the opening of the midtempo “Empath.”
paras.zh: “灯光是绿色、红色和闪烁的白色/这些天非常黑暗，甚至是更安静的夜晚/一直以来都在感受这一整年感觉不对劲的地方/没有什么可以分散我们对这段沉重旅程的注意力，”她在中速“Empath”的开头唱道。

paras.en: On the song’s chorus, Morissette says, “You don’t have to smile big for us/ Nor have a joyous time/ You won’t have to hold your breath until New Year time/ Your precious sensitivity has felt like curse and crime/ But you’re not alone with your SOS inside/ To an empath at Christmas time.”
paras.zh: 在这首歌的副歌部分，莫莉塞特说：“你不必为我们大笑/也不必享受欢乐时光/你不必屏住呼吸直到新年/你宝贵的敏感感觉就像诅咒和犯罪/但你并不孤单，心里有你的求救信号/在圣诞节期间有同理心。”

paras.en: Watch her full conversation on the Handsome Podcast below.
paras.zh: 在下面的帅气播客中观看她的完整对话。

paras.en: What TV Network Features the NFL Madrid Game 2026?
paras.zh: 哪个电视网络转播 2026 年 NFL 马德里比赛？

paras.en: The Bengals-Falcons game broadcasts on NFL Network, while the NFL game is available to livestream on ESPN Unlimited.
paras.zh: 孟加拉虎队与猎鹰队的比赛在 NFL Network 上直播，而 NFL 比赛则可在 ESPN Unlimited 上进行直播。

paras.en: Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances During the NFL Madrid Game 2026?
paras.zh: 哪些名人将亮相 2026 年 NFL 马德里比赛？

paras.en: NFL games are known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance. Artists have been known to appear at games in the past, include Spanish NFL fans Bizarrap, Daddy Yankee, Madrid’s Mayor José Luis Martínez Almeida, former-Real Madrid goalie Iker Casillas and others.
paras.zh: NFL 比赛以名人出镜而闻名，因此很可能会有许多著名男女演员和唱片艺术家出席。过去曾有艺术家出现在比赛中，其中包括西班牙 NFL 球迷 Bizarrap、Daddy Yankee、马德里市长何塞·路易斯·马丁内斯·阿尔梅达、前皇家马德里守门员伊克尔·卡西利亚斯等。

paras.en: Colombian singer and Latin Grammy Awards-nominee Manuel Turizo performs at halftime, which starts around 11 a.m. ET/8 a.m. PT (5 p.m. CEST).
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚歌手、拉丁格莱美奖提名者曼努埃尔·图里佐 (Manuel Turizo) 在中场休息时进行表演，中场休息时间大约在东部时间上午 11 点/太平洋时间上午 8 点（欧洲中部夏令时间下午 5 点）开始。

paras.en: Plus, Spanish classical guitarist Pablo Sáinz-Villegas is also scheduled to perform the National Anthem of Spain, “La Marcha Granadera,” while Taylor Momsen, lead singer of The Pretty Reckless, is set to perform the American National Anthem, “The Star-Spangled Banner.”
paras.zh: 此外，西班牙古典吉他手巴勃罗·萨因斯-维勒加斯也将演奏西班牙国歌《La Marcha Granadera》，而The Pretty Reckless的主唱泰勒·莫森将演奏美国国歌《星条旗永不落》。
