paras.zh: 但未参与这项新研究的北卡罗来纳州立大学罗利分校古生物学家玛丽·史怀哲 (Mary Schweitzer) 表示，她认为这些发现并不完全符合这些标准。

paras.en: The heme biomarkers, for example, don’t appear to be localized to the round structures alone, as would be expected in fossilized blood cells, but come from analysis of the entire bone. The proposed red blood cells also differ in size and shape compared with red blood cells from living birds and reptiles, she says.
paras.zh: 例如，血红素生物标志物似乎并不像在化石血细胞中所预期的那样仅局限于圆形结构，而是来自对整个骨骼的分析。她说，与活鸟类和爬行动物的红细胞相比，拟议的红细胞在大小和形状上也有所不同。

paras.en: Schweitzer is no stranger to skepticism over the discovery of ephemeral tissues in fossils. In 2005, she and her colleagues reported the first recovery of flexible, soft-tissue blood vessels from the 68-million-year-old fossilized leg bone of a Tyrannosaurus rex. It was a landmark study that sparked debate, including over how it would even be possible to preserve such tissues through deep time, as well as the most surefire way to detect them in the present.
paras.zh: 施韦策对化石中短暂组织的发现并不陌生。 2005年，她和她的同事首次从6800万年前的霸王龙腿骨化石中发现了灵活的软组织血管。这是一项具有里程碑意义的研究，引发了争论，包括如何在很长时间内保存这些组织，以及目前检测它们的最可靠的方法。

paras.en: “I am not convinced” that the research team has definitively identified heme compounds, Schweitzer says. “I do applaud them for bringing a plethora of methods to the study. Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence, and that does require state-of-the-art technology.”
paras.zh: 施韦策说，“我不相信”研究小组已经确定了血红素化合物。 “我确实赞赏他们为这项研究带来了多种方法。非凡的主张需要非凡的证据，而这确实需要最先进的技术。”

paras.en: No one really knows what a dinosaur’s red blood cell shape would be, let alone how the process of fossilization might distort the original shape of the structures, or allow heme-related molecules to escape their cellular confines over time, Grice says.
paras.zh: 格赖斯说，没有人真正知道恐龙的红细胞形状是什么，更不用说石化过程如何扭曲结构的原始形状，或者随着时间的推移让血红素相关分子逃离细胞的限制。

paras.en: And, she says, her team’s interpretation of the evidence doesn’t just rely on the observations of those structures. “[It] rests on the convergence of anatomy, morphology, mineralogy, elemental analysis and molecular chemistry,” she says. “That combination is critical.”
paras.zh: 而且，她说，她的团队对证据的解释不仅仅依赖于对这些结构的观察。 “[它]依赖于解剖学、形态学、矿物学、元素分析和分子化学的融合，”她说。 “这种组合至关重要。”

paras.en: As for whether other fossils might have molecular traces that have been preserved by hausmannite, “we simply don’t know yet,” Grice says. “But this type of preservation may not be quite as rare as we currently think.”
paras.zh: 至于其他化石是否可能具有黑锰矿所保存的分子痕迹，“我们还不知道，”格赖斯说。 “但这种类型的保存可能并不像我们目前想象的那么罕见。”

articles.title: Scientists Identified a Biological Signature of Tinnitus, And It's in Your Blood
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: For the millions worldwide with tinnitus, silence never comes.
paras.zh: 对于全世界数以百万计的耳鸣患者来说，安静永远不会到来。

paras.en: The condition, estimated to affect 15 percent of people globally, produces the perception of persistent ringing and other phantom sounds.
paras.zh: 据估计，这种情况影响了全球 15% 的人，会产生持续的铃声和其他幻觉声音。

paras.en: We've never known for sure what causes tinnitus, and we've also never had a reliable objective biomarker or test for it.
paras.zh: 我们从未确切知道耳鸣的原因，也从未有过可靠的客观生物标志物或测试。

paras.en: Until now, the only way doctors could diagnose the condition was if you told them you heard sounds that weren't there.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，医生诊断这种情况的唯一方法是告诉他们你听到了不存在的声音。

paras.en: In a new study published in Otolaryngology – Head and Neck Surgery, scientists report what could be the strongest evidence yet of a biomarker candidate for tinnitus.
paras.zh: 在《耳鼻喉科 - 头颈外科》杂志上发表的一项新研究中，科学家们报告了迄今为止关于耳鸣候选生物标志物的最有力证据。

paras.en: "We now have proof-of-concept that an ear protein may play a central role in the development and management of tinnitus," says otolaryngologist Kourosh Parham from the University of Connecticut.
paras.zh: 康涅狄格大学耳鼻喉科医生库罗什·帕勒姆 (Kourosh Parham) 表示：“我们现在已经有了概念验证，即耳蛋白可能在耳鸣的发生和治疗中发挥着核心作用。”

paras.en: In an experiment with 82 adults – half of whom experienced tinnitus – blood tests revealed that a protein called prestin appears to be linked to the condition.
paras.zh: 在一项对 82 名成年人进行的实验中（其中一半患有耳鸣），血液测试显示一种名为 prestin 的蛋白质似乎与这种情况有关。

paras.en: The research, building upon an earlier study by some of the same team, found that people with tinnitus showed blood concentrations of prestin that were about 50 percent higher than participants without the condition.
paras.zh: 这项研究以同一团队的一些成员的早期研究为基础，发现患有耳鸣的人血液中 prestin 的浓度比没有耳鸣的参与者高出约 50%。

paras.en: Prestin is a motor protein found in the membranes of outer hair cells that line the cochlea. It helps to amplify sounds and is crucial for sensitive hearing.
paras.zh: Prestin 是一种运动蛋白，存在于耳蜗外毛细胞膜中。它有助于放大声音，对灵敏的听力至关重要。

paras.en: But previous research has linked prestin to hearing damage, raising the possibility that changes in this protein could affect the healthy functioning of the inner ear, potentially contributing to the phantom sounds experienced by people with tinnitus.
paras.zh: 但之前的研究已将 prestin 与听力损伤联系起来，这增加了这种蛋白质的变化可能影响内耳健康功能的可能性，可能导致耳鸣患者经历幻音。

paras.en: Studies have shown that prestin levels are influenced by noise exposure, age, and hearing loss, and experimental models of hearing damage show that prestin levels are altered by trauma, suggesting the protein could be a biomarker for cochlear injury.
paras.zh: 研究表明，prestin 水平受到噪音暴露、年龄和听力损失的影响，听力损伤的实验模型表明，prestin 水平会因创伤而改变，这表明该蛋白质可能是耳蜗损伤的生物标志物。

paras.en: "Now, measuring prestin gives us a clinical indication of how bad the tinnitus is," Parham says.
paras.zh: “现在，测量 prestin 可以为我们提供耳鸣严重程度的临床指示，”帕勒姆说。

paras.en: For several years, it's been known that an overdose of aspirin can induce hearing problems by disrupting cochlear functions, and prestin is one of the proteins affected.
paras.zh: 多年来，人们都知道过量服用阿司匹林会破坏耳蜗功能，从而引发听力问题，而 prestin 就是受影响的蛋白质之一。

paras.en: Now, we're getting more evidence of its association to tinnitus, but there's still a lot we don't know.
paras.zh: 现在，我们得到了更多证据证明其与耳鸣的关联，但仍有很多我们不知道的地方。

paras.en: This was only a small observational study, and the findings for now don't prove that high prestin levels trigger tinnitus.
paras.zh: 这只是一项小型观察性研究，目前的研究结果并不能证明高 prestin 水平会引发耳鸣。

paras.en: All we know is they're somehow linked to the condition, but as the researchers acknowledge, it's likely that other factors could also contribute to tinnitus.
paras.zh: 我们所知道的是它们与这种情况有某种联系，但正如研究人员承认的那样，其他因素也可能导致耳鸣。

paras.en: It's also worth noting that while the study showed that high prestin levels were linked to tinnitus, a separate diagnostic accuracy analysis suggested that the biomarker can't yet reliably be used as a tool to diagnose tinnitus, at least based on the sample of participants studied here.
paras.zh: 还值得注意的是，虽然该研究表明高 prestin 水平与耳鸣有关，但一项单独的诊断准确性分析表明，该生物标志物尚不能可靠地用作诊断耳鸣的工具，至少基于此处研究的参与者样本。

paras.en: As the researchers point out, it's possible that might be because some of the participants here had a form of non-cochlear tinnitus, caused by something other than prestin abnormalities.
paras.zh: 正如研究人员指出的，这可能是因为这里的一些参与者患有某种形式的非耳蜗性耳鸣，这是由 prestin 异常以外的其他原因引起的。

paras.en: Future research might be able to clear that up. For now, we've got a strong clue that prestin is involved in the condition, and it's a research lead that could help us get towards a diagnostic system for clinical settings, and maybe even in terms of one day treating tinnitus too.
paras.zh: 未来的研究或许能够澄清这一点。目前，我们已经掌握了强有力的线索，表明 prestin 与这种情况有关，这是一项研究先导，可以帮助我们建立临床诊断系统，甚至可能有一天可以治疗耳鸣。

paras.en: "Our work now says there is promise in using prestin as a biomarker for tinnitus," Parham says. "This is our first step to developing drugs to help manage tinnitus."
paras.zh: “我们现在的工作表明，使用 prestin 作为耳鸣的生物标志物是有希望的，”帕勒姆说。 “这是我们开发药物来帮助控制耳鸣的第一步。”

paras.en: The findings are reported in Otolaryngology – Head and Neck Surgery.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《耳鼻喉科-头颈外科》杂志上。

articles.title: A Massive Brain-Scan Study Just Complicated a Popular Theory About Emotional Control
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: After a breakup, a friend might remind you that you've made it through difficult times before. Their advice makes sense, and you want to believe you'll feel happy again. You might still return home from that conversation feeling just as upset.
paras.zh: 分手后，朋友可能会提醒你，你以前已经度过了困难时期。他们的建议很有道理，你要相信自己会再次感到快乐。谈话结束回家后，你可能仍会感到同样的不安。

paras.en: Looking at a situation differently can sometimes bring relief. Scientists call the attempt to change our feelings by reinterpreting events cognitive reappraisal.
paras.zh: 以不同的方式看待情况有时可以带来缓解。科学家将通过重新解释事件来改变我们的感受的尝试称为认知重评。

paras.en: But does seeing the brain make that effort also reveal how well it works?
paras.zh: 但是，看到大脑所做的努力是否也能揭示它的运作情况？

paras.en: A study published in Nature investigated that question across 40 datasets involving up to 2,175 participants. Activity in brain regions associated with emotional control did not show the expected relationships with how successfully people used this strategy.
paras.zh: 《自然》杂志上发表的一项研究通过 40 个数据集（涉及多达 2,175 名参与者）调查了这个问题。与情绪控制相关的大脑区域的活动并没有显示出与人们如何成功地使用这种策略的预期关系。

paras.en: Those regions had repeatedly stood out in earlier experiments. When people try to reinterpret upsetting situations, parts of the brain behind the forehead, called the prefrontal cortex, become engaged. These areas also contribute to reasoning and holding information in mind.
paras.zh: 这些区域在早期的实验中多次脱颖而出。当人们试图重新解释令人沮丧的情况时，前额后面的大脑部分（称为前额叶皮层）就会开始工作。这些区域也有助于推理和牢记信息。

paras.en: Researchers therefore expected connections between activity in these regions and people's ability to regulate emotions. The new study highlights a distinction between observing someone's brain as they use a strategy and comparing how much different people benefit from it.
paras.zh: 因此，研究人员预计这些区域的活动与人们调节情绪的能力之间存在联系。 The new study highlights a distinction between observing someone's brain as they use a strategy and comparing how much different people benefit from it.

paras.en: "Some of the brain regions involved in regulating emotions are not necessarily the same regions whose activity tells us how good someone is at it," psychologist Maurizio Sicorello of Germany's Central Institute of Mental Health told ScienceAlert.
paras.zh: 德国中央心理健康研究所的心理学家毛里齐奥·西科雷洛（Maurizio Sicorello）告诉《ScienceAlert》：“一些涉及调节情绪的大脑区域不一定是那些活动告诉我们一个人在这方面有多擅长的区域。”

paras.en: To investigate, the team combined analysis results from 32 research groups following a standardized plan registered in advance. Bringing together so many participants allowed them to detect weak relationships that smaller studies could miss.
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，该团队按照预先注册的标准化计划，综合了 32 个研究小组的分析结果。将如此多的参与者聚集在一起，让他们能够发现小型研究可能会错过的薄弱关系。

paras.en: In the experiments, participants typically viewed upsetting pictures inside a scanner. They simply watched some pictures and tried to reinterpret others to feel less distressed.
paras.zh: 在实验中，参与者通常会在扫描仪内查看令人不安的图片。他们只是看了一些照片，并试图重新解释其他照片，以减轻痛苦。

paras.en: Functional magnetic resonance imaging, or fMRI, tracked changes in blood oxygenation associated with brain activity. Researchers could then identify how regional responses changed during reappraisal and compare those changes with how much relief participants reported.
paras.zh: 功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）追踪与大脑活动相关的血氧变化。然后，研究人员可以确定区域反应在重新评估期间如何变化，并将这些变化与参与者报告的救援量进行比较。

paras.en: The team also examined questionnaires about how often people used reappraisal in everyday life. A third measure tracked reductions in activity in a brain structure involved in emotional responses, the amygdala.
paras.zh: 研究小组还研究了有关人们在日常生活中重新评估的频率的调查问卷。第三项测量追踪了与情绪反应有关的大脑结构——杏仁核的活动减少。

paras.en: The expectation was that these measures would support one another. People who used reappraisal more often might experience greater relief during experiments, accompanied by corresponding differences in brain responses.
paras.zh: 人们期望这些措施能够相互支持。经常进行重新评估的人可能会在实验过程中感受到更大的缓解，并伴随着大脑反应的相应差异。

paras.en: The results did not produce that picture. Questionnaire scores showed no significant relationship with either relief during the tasks or reduced amygdala activity. People who reported more relief did tend to show larger reductions in amygdala activity, but the connection was very weak.
paras.zh: 结果并没有产生那张照片。问卷分数显示与任务期间的缓解或杏仁核活动减少没有显着关系。报告缓解更多的人确实倾向于表现出杏仁核活动的更大程度的减少，但这种联系非常微弱。

paras.en: The researchers calculated that a study would need 1,105 participants for an 80 percent chance of detecting a relationship that small. Small experiments could easily miss it.
paras.zh: 研究人员计算出，一项研究需要 1,105 名参与者才能有 80% 的机会发现如此小的关系。小实验很容易错过它。

paras.en: None of the three measures showed the expected connection with activity in established prefrontal emotion regulation networks. Those networks were engaged both when people experienced negative emotions and when they tried to change them.
paras.zh: 这三项指标均未显示出与已建立的前额叶情绪调节网络活动的预期联系。当人们经历负面情绪和试图改变负面情绪时，这些网络就会参与进来。

paras.en: Sicorello explained the distinction through the example of comforting a friend after a breakup. The friend's prefrontal cortex would probably participate as they considered another perspective. Finding comfort, however, could depend on how that perspective connects with their experience.
paras.zh: Sicorello 通过安慰分手后的朋友的例子解释了这种区别。当他们考虑另一个观点时，朋友的前额叶皮层可能会参与其中。然而，能否找到安慰可能取决于这种观点与他们的经历如何联系起来。

paras.en: Remembering a previous recovery might offer reassurance. Rediscovering their own interests might offer hope. Whether those possibilities feel meaningful at that moment is a separate question.
paras.zh: 记住以前的恢复情况可能会让人安心。重新发现自己的兴趣可能会带来希望。这些可能性在那一刻是否有意义是一个单独的问题。

paras.en: "Simply engaging the brain regions involved in reappraisal does not necessarily mean that the reappraisal is personally meaningful or emotionally effective," Sicorello said.
paras.zh: “仅仅调动参与重新评估的大脑区域并不一定意味着重新评估对个人有意义或在情感上有效，”西科雷洛说。

paras.en: The findings have implications for research seeking to assess emotional difficulties through brain scans. Activity in a particular region alone provides an insufficient basis for judging someone's ability to manage emotions. Studying communication between regions and situations connected to personal experiences could offer more information.
paras.zh: 这些发现对于寻求通过脑部扫描评估情绪困难的研究具有重要意义。仅凭特定区域的活动不足以判断某人管理情绪的能力。研究与个人经历相关的地区和情况之间的交流可以提供更多信息。

paras.en: The analysis did not test whether therapy improves emotional skills. Sicorello explained that existing evidence of treatment benefits remains relevant, while the brain processes responsible for those benefits still need clarification.
paras.zh: 该分析没有测试治疗是否可以改善情绪技能。 Sicorello 解释说，现有的治疗益处证据仍然具有相关性，而负责这些益处的大脑过程仍然需要澄清。

paras.en: The datasets covered non-clinical adult samples, so the findings may not extend to other populations, including people with more severe mental health symptoms.
paras.zh: 这些数据集涵盖了非临床成人样本，因此研究结果可能不会扩展到其他人群，包括患有更严重心理健康症状的人。

paras.en: Reinterpreting a picture in a scanner also cannot fully capture coping with a breakup in someone's own life. Moving closer to those personal experiences could be an important next step.
paras.zh: 重新解读扫描仪中的图片也无法完全反映某人在生活中应对分手的情况。更接近这些个人经历​​可能是下一步重要的一步。

paras.en: The research has been published in Nature.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《自然》杂志上。

articles.title: Finally! Physicists Create an Exotic Quantum State of Matter That Works at Room Temperature
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: The laws of physics at the quantum level can break free from the standard confines of solids, liquids, and gases, and researchers just observed an exotic quantum state of matter – a particular way of particles organizing and behaving themselves.
paras.zh: 量子层面的物理定律可以摆脱固体、液体和气体的标准限制，研究人员刚刚观察到一种奇异的物质量子态——一种粒子组织和行为的特殊方式。

paras.en: What's more, it was engineered at room temperature, without the extreme cooling that quantum states usually require.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，它是在室温下设计的，没有量子态通常需要的极端冷却。

paras.en: The results of the experiments, carried out by an international team of researchers, have been published in Science Advances. They point the way to more practical uses of quantum technology in advanced computing systems and sensors.
paras.zh: 由国际研究小组进行的实验结果已发表在《科学进展》上。他们为量子技术在先进计算系统和传感器中更实际的应用指明了道路。

paras.en: Part liquid and part solid, the quantum state was created using a tiny light-trapping structure called a microcavity.
paras.zh: 部分液体和部分固体的量子态是使用一种称为微腔的微小光捕获结构创建的。

paras.en: As a quantum testbed, the setup has a lot going for it: It's relatively inexpensive, controllable via voltages, and doesn't need a cryogenic fridge.
paras.zh: 作为一个量子测试平台，该装置有很多优点：它相对便宜，可通过电压控制，并且不需要低温冰箱。

paras.en: "Our liquid-crystal microcavities can operate even at temperatures approaching 60 °C (140 °F)," says physicist Wiktor Piecek from the Military University of Technology in Poland.
paras.zh: 波兰军事科技大学的物理学家 Wiktor Piecek 表示：“我们的液晶微腔甚至可以在接近 60 °C (140 °F) 的温度下运行。”

paras.en: The technical term for this quantum state is a supersolid in an exciton-polariton Bose-Einstein condensate, which probably needs some breaking down for those of us who aren't quantum physicists.
paras.zh: 这种量子态的技术术语是激子极化玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的超固体，对于我们这些不是量子物理学家的人来说，它可能需要一些分解。

paras.en: Two of the states that exist in the quantum realm are superfluids (a liquid that can flow without resistance) and supersolids (superfluids but with a regular, repeating crystal structure rather than a loose, fluid one). That's the supersolid part.
paras.zh: 量子领域中存在的两种状态是超流体（一种可以无阻力流动的液体）和超固体（超流体，但具有规则的重复晶体结构，而不是松散的流体结构）。这就是超固体部分。

paras.en: The exciton-polariton is a hybrid quasiparticle (multiple particles acting as one), combining both light and matter. And finally, a Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) is where multiple particles or quasiparticles become a single quantum entity.
paras.zh: 激子极化子是一种混合准粒子（多个粒子作为一个粒子），结合了光和物质。最后，玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）是多个粒子或准粒子变成单个量子实体的地方。

paras.en: To produce this quantum state, the researchers combined a liquid crystal (which can be controlled by voltage) and an organic semiconductor (which interacts strongly with light). Laser pulses were then used to supply energy for the quantum reaction.
paras.zh: 为了产生这种量子态，研究人员将液晶（可以通过电压控制）和有机半导体（与光相互作用强烈）结合起来。然后使用激光脉冲为量子反应提供能量。

paras.en: However, the behavior the scientists were looking for was relatively short-lived – the materials degraded over time, as the semiconductor reacted with the liquid crystal.
paras.zh: 然而，科学家们所寻找的行为相对短暂——随着半导体与液晶发生反应，材料会随着时间的推移而降解。

paras.en: "We had to plan the entire sequence of experiments in advance," says physicist Marcin Muszyński, from the City College of New York. "Repeating a measurement meant fabricating an entirely new sample."
paras.zh: “我们必须提前计划整个实验序列，”纽约城市学院的物理学家 Marcin Muszyński 说。 “重复测量意味着制造一个全新的样品。”

paras.en: Further validation of what the researchers were looking at came with each successive laser pulse. The condensate reformed each time, with its stripes – the solid, crystal-like part of the supersolid – lining up in slightly different places with every refresh.
paras.zh: 每个连续的激光脉冲都进一步验证了研究人员的观察结果。凝结物每次都会重新形成，其条纹（超固体的固体、晶体状部分）每次刷新时都会排列在略有不同的位置。

paras.en: That might not sound like much, but it's evidence of the inherent nature of this quantum state, rather than anything influenced by the external microcavity.
paras.zh: 这听起来可能不多，但它证明了这种量子态的固有性质，而不是受外部微腔影响的任何东西。

paras.en: "This is a textbook example of spontaneous symmetry breaking," says physicist Guillaume Malpuech, from the French National Centre for Scientific Research (CNRS).
paras.zh: 法国国家科学研究中心 (CNRS) 的物理学家纪尧姆·马尔普埃赫 (Guillaume Malpuech) 表示：“这是自发对称性破缺的教科书示例。”

paras.en: "Theory predicted that the supersolid could choose among several equivalent states, and that is exactly what we observed."
paras.zh: “理论预测超固体可以在几种等效状态之间进行选择，这正是我们所观察到的。”

paras.en: While the individual particles produced by the researchers only lasted for fractions of a second, it was enough to get the observations they needed. Multiple samples were tested with the same results, which were also backed up by computer simulation models.
paras.zh: 虽然研究人员产生的单个粒子只持续了几分之一秒，但足以获得他们所需的观察结果。对多个样品进行了测试，得到了相同的结果，这些结果也得到了计算机模拟模型的支持。

paras.en: Routes for developing the experiments further might involve working on ways to get the core reactions to last for longer, and interrogating in more detail the quantum vortices that appeared – flaws in the stripe patterns that indicated superfluid behavior.
paras.zh: 进一步发展实验的路线可能涉及研究如何让核心反应持续更长时间，并更详细地询问出现的量子涡旋——表明超流体行为的条纹图案中的缺陷。

paras.en: Ultimately, it means an easier method for studying quantum behavior in superfluids and supersolids, without the added expense and complexity of extreme cooling – particularly when it comes to the spin-orbit coupling shown here (the linking of light polarization and motion that created the supersolid arrangement).
paras.zh: 最终，这意味着一种更简单的方法来研究超流体和超固体中的量子行为，而无需增加极端冷却的费用和复杂性，特别是当涉及到此处所示的自旋轨道耦合时（光偏振和运动的连接创造了超固体排列）。

paras.en: Almost any quantum effect involving light, including those related to computer chips and advanced sensors, could benefit further down the line.
paras.zh: 几乎所有涉及光的量子效应，包括与计算机芯片和先进传感器相关的量子效应，都可能进一步受益。

paras.en: "Our work opens new perspectives for quantum fluids of light physics in the presence of spin-orbit coupling and beyond," write the researchers in their published paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在发表的论文中写道：“我们的工作为自旋轨道耦合及其他情况下的光物理量子流体开辟了新的视角。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Science Advances.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《科学进展》上。

articles.title: A nuclear blast could save Earth from an asteroid, but there's a catch

paras.en: A nuclear blast could save Earth from an asteroid, but there's a catch
paras.zh: 核爆炸可以将地球从小行星手中拯救出来，但有一个问题

paras.en: - A nuclear explosion might save Earth from a deadly asteroid, but new research suggests that hitting the wrong side could make the difference between success and disaster. Scientists found that an asteroid's irregular shape can dramatically affect how it responds to an X-ray blast, with deflection effectiveness varying nearly fivefold depending on the angle.
paras.zh: - 核爆炸可能会将地球从致命的小行星手中拯救出来，但新的研究表明，击中错误的一侧可能会导致成功与灾难。科学家发现，小行星的不规则形状会极大地影响它对 X 射线爆炸的反应，根据角度的不同，偏转效果会变化近五倍。

paras.en: A nuclear explosion could potentially protect Earth from an incoming asteroid by releasing powerful X-rays that heat its surface and push it onto a safer trajectory. However, new research suggests that the success of such a mission could depend heavily on which side of the asteroid receives the blast.
paras.zh: 核爆炸可能会释放强大的 X 射线，加热地球表面并将其推向更安全的轨道，从而保护地球免受小行星撞击。然而，新的研究表明，此类任务的成功可能在很大程度上取决于小行星的哪一侧受到爆炸。

paras.en: Unlike the smooth, round objects often used in computer simulations, real asteroids have uneven surfaces and irregular shapes. Those differences can dramatically influence how an asteroid moves when exposed to intense radiation.
paras.zh: 与计算机模拟中经常使用的光滑圆形物体不同，真实的小行星具有不平坦的表面和不规则的形状。这些差异会极大地影响小行星在受到强烈辐射时的移动方式。

paras.en: A new study published in Icarus found that changing the direction of an X-ray burst could produce vastly different results, even when targeting the same asteroid. In one simulation, the asteroid's speed changed by 3.9 millimeters per second when irradiated from one direction, compared with only 0.8 millimeters per second from another. That represents a nearly fivefold difference in deflection velocity, the change in the asteroid's forward speed caused by the burst.
paras.zh: 发表在《伊卡洛斯》上的一项新研究发现，改变 X 射线爆发的方向可能会产生截然不同的结果，即使瞄准的是同一个小行星。在一项模拟中，当从一个方向受到辐射时，小行星的速度每秒改变 3.9 毫米，而从另一个方向辐射时，速度仅每秒改变 0.8 毫米。这代表了偏转速度的近五倍差异，即爆发引起的小行星前进速度的变化。

paras.en: "We expected aim to matter," said Nathan Moore, a physicist at Sandia National Laboratories who led the research. "What surprised us was how much."
paras.zh: “我们预计目标很重要，”领导这项研究的桑迪亚国家实验室物理学家内森摩尔说。 “令我们惊讶的是有多少。”

paras.en: The effects on an asteroid's rotation could be even more dramatic. For another simulated asteroid, the change in how quickly it spun varied by a factor of 17 depending on the direction of the X-rays.
paras.zh: 对小行星自转的影响可能更加显着。对于另一颗模拟小行星，其自转速度的变化取决于 X 射线的方向，变化幅度为 17 倍。

paras.en: These findings suggest that understanding an asteroid's shape and carefully selecting where to direct a nuclear blast could be essential to protecting Earth from a future impact.
paras.zh: 这些发现表明，了解小行星的形状并仔细选择核爆炸的地点对于保护地球免受未来的影响至关重要。

paras.en: The research received funding through Sandia's Laboratory Directed Research and Development program.
paras.zh: 该研究通过桑迪亚实验室指导的研究和开发计划获得了资助。

paras.en: A New Way to Simulate Asteroid Deflection
paras.zh: 模拟小行星偏转的新方法

paras.en: To investigate how different asteroid shapes respond to nuclear blasts, Moore and his colleagues developed what they describe as the most accurate asteroid deflection model yet.
paras.zh: 为了研究不同的小行星形状如何响应核爆炸，摩尔和他的同事开发了他们所说的迄今为止最准确的小行星偏转模型。

paras.en: Earlier computer models faced a major limitation. Researchers typically had to choose between representing an asteroid's complex shape and performing highly detailed calculations of the physical forces involved. Combining both approaches demanded more computing power than was practical.
paras.zh: 早期的计算机模型面临着重大限制。研究人员通常必须在表示小行星的复杂形状和对所涉及的物理力进行高度详细的计算之间做出选择。结合这两种方法需要比实际更多的计算能力。

paras.en: The new system overcomes that obstacle, allowing scientists to study realistic asteroid shapes while maintaining the precision needed to calculate their response to an X-ray burst. The result is the most detailed simulation of asteroid deflection produced so far.
paras.zh: 新系统克服了这一障碍，使科学家能够研究真实的小行星形状，同时保持计算其对 X 射线爆发的响应所需的精度。结果是迄今为止最详细的小行星偏转模拟。

paras.en: "Our new algorithm is over 1,600 times faster, which was critical to this breakthrough," Moore said. "With the old models, computers just couldn't handle it."
paras.zh: “我们的新算法速度快了 1,600 多倍，这对于这一突破至关重要，”摩尔说。 “对于旧模型，计算机无法处理它。”

paras.en: Moore's interest in improving these calculations grew out of an earlier experiment using Sandia's Z machine. That experiment provided the first demonstration that X-rays could deflect a small piece of asteroid material.
paras.zh: 摩尔对改进这些计算的兴趣源于早期使用桑迪亚 Z 机器进行的实验。该实验首次证明 X 射线可以偏转一小块小行星物质。

paras.en: The next challenge was determining how the same physical process might affect an entire asteroid.
paras.zh: 下一个挑战是确定相同的物理过程如何影响整个小行星。

paras.en: "I started wondering how to scale up the calculation to more accurately predict deflection of a full-scale asteroid."
paras.zh: “我开始想知道如何扩大计算规模，以更准确地预测全尺寸小行星的偏转。”

paras.en: A major problem was the widespread practice of treating asteroids as spheres. Although this simplifies the mathematics, it overlooks the irregular shapes of real asteroids, which can have ridges, depressions, and uneven surfaces.
paras.zh: 一个主要问题是将小行星视为球体的广泛做法。尽管这简化了数学，但它忽略了真实小行星的不规则形状，这些小行星可能具有脊、凹陷和不平坦的表面。

paras.en: "You can make estimates that way, but asteroids come in all kinds of odd, lumpy shapes," he said. "That's when I latched onto some work one of my colleagues was doing related to outgassing of objects in space. I think we had an aha moment when we realized we could do this. No more spheres. We would be able to model deflection for any asteroid."
paras.zh: “你可以用这种方式进行估计，但小行星有各种奇怪的、块状的形状，”他说。 “就在那时，我开始关注我的一位同事正在做的一些与太空中物体​​脱气相关的工作。我想当我们意识到我们可以做到这一点时，我们顿时恍然大悟。不再需要球体了。我们将能够对任何小行星的偏转进行建模。”

paras.en: The solution involved bringing together two sophisticated simulation systems already used at Sandia for very different types of physical problems.
paras.zh: 该解决方案涉及将桑迪亚已经用于解决不同类型物理问题的两个复杂的模拟系统结合在一起。

paras.en: "The ALEGRA code is normally used to model fast, high-energy experiments, like magnetically imploding wires on the Z machine, while SPARTA, a direct simulation Monte Carlo code, is usually used to model comparatively weak, slowly evolving forces, like the drag on a satellite from the solar wind," Moore explained.
paras.zh: “ALEGRA 代码通常用于对快速、高能实验进行建模，例如 Z 机器上的磁爆线，而 SPARTA（一种直接模拟蒙特卡罗代码）通常用于对相对较弱、缓慢演变的力进行建模，例如太阳风对卫星的阻力，”摩尔解释道。

paras.en: "The key innovation here was figuring out how to combine the two simulation approaches."
paras.zh: “这里的关键创新是弄清楚如何结合两种模拟方法。”

paras.en: Predicting What Happens After a Nuclear Blast
paras.zh: 预测核爆炸后会发生什么

paras.en: The new computer model allows researchers to reconstruct an asteroid using detailed 3D images captured during spacecraft flybys. They can then simulate a nuclear X-ray burst while adjusting the explosion's strength, its distance from the asteroid, and the direction from which the radiation arrives.
paras.zh: 新的计算机模型允许研究人员使用航天器飞越期间捕获的详细 3D 图像来重建小行星。然后，他们可以模拟核 X 射线爆发，同时调整爆炸的强度、与小行星的距离以及辐射到达的方向。

paras.en: The software calculates how much material would vaporize across different parts of the asteroid's surface and displays the results as a heat map. Using that information, it estimates the resulting push, changes in the asteroid's rotation, and the extent of surface damage.
paras.zh: 该软件计算小行星表面不同部分会蒸发多少物质，并将结果显示为热图。利用这些信息，它可以估计由此产生的推力、小行星自转的变化以及表面损坏的程度。

paras.en: These calculations are important because a successful planetary defense mission would ideally change an asteroid's trajectory without breaking it into multiple dangerous fragments. Redirecting one large object could be preferable to creating several pieces that might still threaten Earth.
paras.zh: 这些计算很重要，因为成功的行星防御任务理想情况下会改变小行星的轨道，而不会将其分成多个危险的碎片。改变一个大物体的方向可能比制造几个可能仍然威胁地球的碎片更好。

paras.en: However, the simulations cannot yet predict every possible consequence of a nuclear blast.
paras.zh: 然而，模拟尚无法预测核爆炸的所有可能后果。

paras.en: "Right now, our computer model only considers breakup of rocks on the surface. We can't predict breakup of the entire asteroid body accurately yet," Moore said.
paras.zh: “目前，我们的计算机模型只考虑表面岩石的破裂。我们还无法准确预测整个小行星体的破裂，”摩尔说。

paras.en: Developing that capability will require additional research, investment, and more advanced computational tools. An intense X-ray burst can trigger numerous physical effects, some of which influence one another. Accounting for all those interactions makes it exceptionally difficult to predict exactly how an asteroid would behave during a real deflection attempt.
paras.zh: 开发这种能力需要额外的研究、投资和更先进的计算工具。强烈的 X 射线爆发会引发多种物理效应，其中一些效应会相互影响。考虑到所有这些相互作用，使得准确预测小行星在真正的偏转尝试期间将如何表现变得异常困难。

paras.en: Choosing the Right Blast Could Save Earth
paras.zh: 选择正确的爆炸可以拯救地球

paras.en: Despite these remaining challenges, the findings offer valuable guidance for future planetary defense efforts. The research shows that the direction of a nuclear blast is not simply a minor detail. It can substantially change how effectively an asteroid is redirected.
paras.zh: 尽管仍存在这些挑战，但研究结果为未来的行星防御工作提供了宝贵的指导。研究表明，核爆炸的方向不仅仅是一个小细节。它可以极大地改变小行星重定向的效率。

paras.en: "Our study shows how important it is to aim carefully," Moore said. "Pick the right side and you win. Guess wrong and it could be a bad day."
paras.zh: “我们的研究表明，仔细瞄准是多么重要，”摩尔说。 “选择正确的一方，你就赢了。猜错了，这可能是糟糕的一天。”

paras.en: The new simulation tools could eventually help mission planners identify the most effective way to deflect a threatening asteroid. In principle, researchers could enter detailed information about its shape, then calculate the ideal explosive strength, distance, and direction needed to move it away from Earth.
paras.zh: 新的模拟工具最终可以帮助任务规划者确定偏转威胁小行星的最有效方法。原则上，研究人员可以输入有关其形状的详细信息，然后计算将其移离地球所需的理想爆炸强度、距离和方向。

paras.en: Turning those calculations into a real mission would still be extremely difficult.
paras.zh: 将这些计算转化为真正的任务仍然非常困难。

paras.en: For one thing, the software requires reasonably accurate information about the asteroid's shape from every direction. If an asteroid were discovered on a collision course with Earth, there might not be enough time to gather the necessary observations.
paras.zh: 一方面，该软件需要从各个方向获得有关小行星形状的相当准确的信息。如果在与地球相撞的过程中发现小行星，可能没有足够的时间来收集必要的观测结果。

paras.en: Another challenge would be delivering and positioning a nuclear device at precisely the right location relative to an asteroid traveling through space. Even if scientists could identify the ideal blast configuration, executing it would require extraordinary precision.
paras.zh: 另一个挑战是将核装置精确地运送和定位在相对于穿越太空的小行星的正确位置。即使科学家能够确定理想的爆炸配置，执行它也需要极高的精度。

paras.en: Nevertheless, the improved simulations could eliminate much of the uncertainty surrounding one possible method of asteroid defense. By better understanding how nuclear X-rays interact with the complex surfaces of real asteroids, scientists are moving closer to predicting which strategies would work best.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，改进的模拟可以消除围绕一种可能的小行星防御方法的大部分不确定性。通过更好地了解核 X 射线如何与真实小行星的复杂表面相互作用，科学家们正在更接近于预测哪种策略最有效。

paras.en: For Moore, that progress is an encouraging step toward ensuring humanity has a better chance of preventing a catastrophic asteroid impact.
paras.zh: 对于摩尔来说，这一进展是令人鼓舞的一步，有助于确保人类有更好的机会防止灾难性的小行星撞击。

paras.en: Materials provided by Sandia National Laboratories. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由桑迪亚国家实验室提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Nathan W. Moore, Michael A. Gallis, D. Gregory Tipton, Zakari S. Eckert, Timothy P. Koehler, Kevin N. Long, Joel T. Clemmer, Kyle R. Cochrane, Brian C. Franke, Mekiel Olguin. Efficient computation of vapor ejecta over asteroid geometries during pulsed energy deflection. Icarus, 2026; 117364 DOI: 10.1016/j.icarus.2026.117364
paras.zh: - Nathan W. Moore、Michael A. Gallis、D. Gregory Tipton、Zakari S. Eckert、Timothy P. Koehler、Kevin N. Long、Joel T. Clemmer、Kyle R. Cochrane、Brian C. Franke、Mekiel Olguin。有效计算脉冲能量偏转期间小行星几何形状上的蒸气喷射物。伊卡洛斯，2026； 117364 DOI：10.1016/j.icarus.2026.117364

articles.title: MIT scientists turn immune cells into cancer killers inside the body

paras.en: MIT scientists turn immune cells into cancer killers inside the body
paras.zh: 麻省理工学院的科学家将免疫细胞转化为体内的癌症杀手

paras.en: - MIT scientists have developed nanoparticles that reprogram immune cells directly inside the body to attack cancer and harmful immune cells, eliminating tumors and reversing liver damage in mouse experiments. The breakthrough could make powerful immune therapies dramatically simpler and less expensive while opening new possibilities for treating cancer and autoimmune diseases.
paras.zh: - 麻省理工学院的科学家们开发出了纳米粒子，可以直接在体内重新编程免疫细胞，以攻击癌症和有害的免疫细胞，在小鼠实验中消除肿瘤并逆转肝脏损伤。这一突破可以使强大的免疫疗法变得更加简单和便宜，同时为治疗癌症和自身免疫性疾病开辟新的可能性。

paras.en: MIT researchers have developed a new technique that allows them to transform immune cells into cancer fighters directly inside the body, potentially making advanced treatments for cancer and autoimmune diseases much easier to produce and administer.
paras.zh: 麻省理工学院的研究人员开发了一种新技术，使他们能够将免疫细胞直接转化为体内的抗癌药物，从而可能使癌症和自身免疫性疾病的先进治疗方法更容易生产和管理。

paras.en: The method focuses on natural killer (NK) cells, a type of immune cell that can be engineered to recognize and destroy harmful cells. These include cancerous T cells and T cells that mistakenly attack healthy tissue, contributing to conditions such as lymphoma and autoimmune hepatitis.
paras.zh: 该方法的重点是自然杀伤（NK）细胞，这是一种可以被改造来识别和消灭有害细胞的免疫细胞。其中包括癌性 T 细胞和错误攻击健康组织的 T 细胞，导致淋巴瘤和自身免疫性肝炎等疾病。

paras.en: Rather than extracting immune cells from a patient and modifying them in a laboratory, the researchers use tiny particles made of fatty molecules to deliver genetic instructions directly to NK cells. These instructions, carried by messenger RNA, tell the cells to produce specialized proteins that help them identify and eliminate diseased T cells.
paras.zh: 研究人员不是从患者身上提取免疫细胞并在实验室中对其进行修改，而是使用由脂肪分子制成的微小颗粒将遗传指令直接传递给 NK 细胞。这些由信使 RNA 携带的指令告诉细胞产生特殊的蛋白质，帮助它们识别和消除患病的 T 细胞。

paras.en: The resulting cells, known as CAR NK cells, could eventually be used against several different diseases. By carrying out the engineering process inside the body, the new approach could eliminate much of the time, expense, and complexity involved in manufacturing personalized immune cell therapies.
paras.zh: 由此产生的细胞被称为 CAR NK 细胞，最终可用于对抗几种不同的疾病。通过在体内进行工程过程，新方法可以消除制造个性化免疫细胞疗法所需的大量时间、费用和复杂性。

paras.en: "The manufacturing challenges with CAR NK cells are significant. The idea here is you can deliver a nanoparticle that will modify your own NK cells with a CAR construct and teach them to attack tumor cells," says Daniel Anderson, a professor in MIT's Department of Chemical Engineering and a member of MIT's Koch Institute for Integrative Cancer Research and Institute for Medical Engineering and Science.
paras.zh: 麻省理工学院化学工程系教授、麻省理工学院科赫综合癌症研究所和医学工程与科学研究所成员 Daniel Anderson 说：“CAR NK 细胞的制造挑战是巨大的。这里的想法是，你可以提供一种纳米颗粒，用 CAR 结构修饰你自己的 NK 细胞，并教它们攻击肿瘤细胞。”

paras.en: Anderson is the senior author of the research, published in Nature Biotechnology. The lead authors are MIT postdoctoral researcher Yuang Chen and graduate students Julia Monkovic and Haseeb Mughal. Robert Langer, MIT's David H. Koch Institute Professor, also contributed to the study.
paras.zh: 安德森是该研究的资深作者，发表在《自然生物技术》杂志上。主要作者是麻省理工学院博士后研究员 Yuang Chen 以及研究生 Julia Monkovic 和 Haseeb Mughal。麻省理工学院大卫·H·科赫研究所教授罗伯特·兰格也对这项研究做出了贡献。

paras.en: Why Current Cancer Immunotherapies Are So Complex
paras.zh: 为什么当前的癌症免疫疗法如此复杂

paras.en: Immune cell engineering has already transformed treatment options for certain cancers. During the past decade, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved seven cancer therapies that use genetically modified T cells, known as chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cells.
paras.zh: 免疫细胞工程已经改变了某些癌症的治疗选择。在过去的十年中，美国食品和药物管理局批准了七种使用转基因 T 细胞（称为嵌合抗原受体 (CAR) T 细胞）的癌症疗法。

paras.en: These treatments work by equipping T cells with specially designed receptors that recognize particular markers, or antigens, on other cells. When an engineered T cell encounters its designated target, such as a protein associated with cancer, it becomes activated and attacks the cell carrying that marker.
paras.zh: 这些治疗方法是通过为 T 细胞配备专门设计的受体来发挥作用，这些受体可以识别其他细胞上的特定标记或抗原。当工程化 T 细胞遇到其指定靶标（例如与癌症相关的蛋白质）时，它就会被激活并攻击携带该标记的细胞。

paras.en: CAR T cell therapies have been especially effective against blood cancers arising from B cells. These include certain forms of leukemia and lymphoma, as well as multiple myeloma.
paras.zh: CAR T 细胞疗法对 B 细胞引起的血癌特别有效。这些包括某些形式的白血病和淋巴瘤，以及多发性骨髓瘤。

paras.en: However, preparing these treatments involves several complicated steps. Doctors first collect blood from the patient and send it to a specialized facility. There, technicians separate the T cells, genetically modify them to produce the desired receptors, and grow enough engineered cells for treatment. The finished cells must then be transported back to the hospital and infused into the patient.
paras.zh: 然而，准备这些治疗方法涉及几个复杂的步骤。医生首先从患者身上采集血液并将其送往专门的设施。在那里，技术人员分离 T 细胞，对它们进行基因改造以产生所需的受体，并培养足够的工程细胞用于治疗。然后，完成的细胞必须运回医院并输注到患者体内。

paras.en: Natural Killer Cells Offer a Different Way to Fight Cancer
paras.zh: 自然杀伤细胞提供了一种不同的抗癌方法

paras.en: Scientists have recently been exploring whether natural killer cells could be engineered in a similar way. One important advantage is their potential to treat cancers and autoimmune conditions involving abnormal T cells.
paras.zh: 科学家最近一直在探索是否可以以类似的方式改造自然杀伤细胞。一项重要优势是它们具有治疗癌症和涉及异常 T 细胞的自身免疫性疾病的潜力。

paras.en: Trying to use CAR T cells against diseased T cells creates a major problem. Because both the engineered cells and their intended targets are T cells, the modified cells may recognize and destroy one another. This unintended attack can undermine the treatment.
paras.zh: 尝试使用 CAR T 细胞对抗患病 T 细胞会产生一个主要问题。由于工程细胞及其预期目标都是 T 细胞，因此修饰后的细胞可能会相互识别并破坏。这种意外的攻击可能会破坏治疗。

paras.en: Natural killer cells avoid this complication because they are a different type of immune cell. They can be programmed to attack harmful T cells without triggering the same problem of engineered T cells killing each other.
paras.zh: 自然杀伤细胞可以避免这种并发症，因为它们是不同类型的免疫细胞。它们可以被编程来攻击有害的 T 细胞，而不会引发工程化 T 细胞互相残杀的相同问题。

paras.en: "NK cells can treat these T cell malignancies -- not only T cell cancer, but also T cell autoimmune diseases," Chen says.
paras.zh: “NK 细胞可以治疗这些 T 细胞恶性肿瘤——不仅是 T 细胞癌症，还可以治疗 T 细胞自身免疫性疾病，”Chen 说。

paras.en: Producing CAR NK cells outside the body, however, still requires much of the specialized equipment, labor, and processing associated with CAR T cell manufacturing. To overcome these limitations, the MIT team investigated whether NK cells could instead be engineered "in vivo," meaning directly inside the body.
paras.zh: 然而，在体外生产 CAR NK 细胞仍然需要大量与 CAR T 细胞制造相关的专用设备、劳动力和加工。为了克服这些限制，麻省理工学院的研究小组研究了是否可以“体内”改造 NK 细胞，即直接在体内进行改造。

paras.en: "If a patient can just get an infusion of nanoparticles, it would dramatically simplify the process and reduce costs," Anderson says.
paras.zh: 安德森说：“如果患者只需注射纳米颗粒，就可以大大简化流程并降低成本。”

paras.en: Although researchers are actively developing CAR NK cell therapies for cancer and autoimmune disorders, none have received FDA approval.
paras.zh: 尽管研究人员正在积极开发针对癌症和自身免疫性疾病的 CAR NK 细胞疗法，但尚未获得 FDA 批准。

paras.en: How mRNA Nanoparticles Reprogram Immune Cells
paras.zh: mRNA 纳米颗粒如何重新编程免疫细胞

paras.en: The MIT team designed lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) capable of transporting messenger RNA into natural killer cells. The mRNA carries instructions for producing a chimeric antigen receptor that directs the modified immune cell toward a specific target.
paras.zh: 麻省理工学院的团队设计了能够将信使 RNA 转运到自然杀伤细胞中的脂质纳米颗粒 (LNP)。 mRNA 携带产生嵌合抗原受体的指令，该受体将修饰的免疫细胞引导至特定目标。

paras.en: The technology can be adapted to recognize different proteins depending on the disease being treated. For example, the researchers can provide instructions for a receptor that recognizes CD19, a protein found on B cells, or CD3, a protein present on T cells, including those responsible for autoimmune attacks.
paras.zh: 该技术可以根据所治疗的疾病来识别不同的蛋白质。例如，研究人员可以为识别 CD19（B 细胞上的一种蛋白质）或 CD3（T 细胞上存在的蛋白质，包括那些负责自身免疫攻击的蛋白质）的受体提供指令。

paras.en: To help the nanoparticles reach the correct immune cells, the scientists covered their surfaces with antibody fragments. These fragments recognize and attach to receptors on NK cells, helping deliver the genetic instructions where they are needed.
paras.zh: 为了帮助纳米粒子到达正确的免疫细胞，科学家们在其表面覆盖了抗体片段。这些片段识别并附着在 NK 细胞上的受体上，帮助将遗传指令传递到需要的地方。

paras.en: Once inside an NK cell, the mRNA directs the production of the new receptor, giving the immune cell the ability to recognize and attack its intended target.
paras.zh: 一旦进入 NK 细胞，mRNA 就会指导新受体的产生，使免疫细胞能够识别和攻击其预定目标。

paras.en: The researchers then tested whether this approach could efficiently reprogram NK cells and whether the resulting cells could combat cancer and autoimmune disease in mice.
paras.zh: 研究人员随后测试了这种方法是否可以有效地重新编程 NK 细胞，以及所得细胞是否可以对抗小鼠的癌症和自身免疫性疾病。

paras.en: Reprogrammed Immune Cells Eliminate Tumors in Mice
paras.zh: 重新编程的免疫细胞消除了小鼠的肿瘤

paras.en: The initial experiments produced encouraging results. After injecting the nanoparticles into mice, the researchers successfully modified approximately 80 percent of the NK cells they were targeting.
paras.zh: 最初的实验产生了令人鼓舞的结果。将纳米粒子注射到小鼠体内后，研究人员成功修饰了大约 80% 的目标 NK 细胞。

paras.en: They next investigated whether these engineered cells could attack tumors. In mice with an aggressive form of melanoma, three of the five animals treated with nanoparticles designed to direct NK cells against the cancer experienced complete remission.
paras.zh: 他们接下来研究了这些工程细胞是否可以攻击肿瘤。在患有侵袭性黑色素瘤的小鼠中，用旨在引导 NK 细胞对抗癌症的纳米粒子治疗的五只动物中，有三只获得了完全缓解。

paras.en: The researchers also tested the technique against T cell lymphoma using humanized mice. These animals receive transfusions of human blood cells, temporarily giving them immune systems that share certain characteristics with those of humans.
paras.zh: 研究人员还使用人源化小鼠测试了针对 T 细胞淋巴瘤的技术。这些动物接受人类血细胞的输注，暂时赋予它们与人类具有某些共同特征的免疫系统。

paras.en: In this model, the treatment produced substantial tumor destruction. After five injections of the nanoparticles, the tumors were completely eliminated.
paras.zh: 在该模型中，治疗产生了显着的肿瘤破坏。注射五次纳米粒子后，肿瘤被完全消除。

paras.en: Importantly, these results were comparable to those achieved with CAR NK cells produced through the more traditional method of collecting NK cells, modifying them outside the body, and then returning them to the animals.
paras.zh: 重要的是，这些结果与通过更传统的方法收集 NK 细胞、在体外对其进行修饰，然后将其返回动物体内而产生的 CAR NK 细胞所获得的结果相当。

paras.en: This suggests that generating CAR NK cells directly inside the body could offer similar cancer-fighting capabilities while avoiding the complicated manufacturing process required by conventional cell therapies.
paras.zh: 这表明直接在体内生成 CAR NK 细胞可以提供类似的抗癌能力，同时避免传统细胞疗法所需的复杂制造过程。

paras.en: A Single Injection Reverses Autoimmune Liver Damage
paras.zh: 单次注射可逆转自身免疫性肝损伤

paras.en: The researchers also wanted to determine whether their technology could help treat autoimmune diseases, in which the immune system mistakenly damages healthy tissues.
paras.zh: 研究人员还想确定他们的技术是否可以帮助治疗自身免疫性疾病，即免疫系统错误地损害健康组织。

paras.en: They focused on autoimmune hepatitis, a condition in which abnormal T cells attack hepatocytes, the main functional cells of the liver. By designing nanoparticles that instruct NK cells to recognize these harmful T cells, the scientists tested whether they could interrupt the autoimmune response.
paras.zh: 他们专注于自身免疫性肝炎，这是一种异常 T 细胞攻击肝细胞（肝脏的主要功能细胞）的疾病。通过设计指导 NK 细胞识别这些有害 T 细胞的纳米颗粒，科学家们测试了它们是否可以中断自身免疫反应。

paras.en: The treatment successfully eliminated the autoreactive T cells in mice with the disease. Even more encouragingly, the animals' damaged liver tissue healed after the harmful immune cells were removed.
paras.zh: 该治疗成功消除了患有该疾病的小鼠体内的自身反应性 T 细胞。更令人鼓舞的是，在有害的免疫细胞被去除后，动物受损的肝组织得到了愈合。

paras.en: These improvements occurred after just one nanoparticle injection, demonstrating the potential of the approach beyond cancer treatment.
paras.zh: 这些改进仅在注射一次纳米颗粒后就发生了，证明了该方法在癌症治疗之外的潜力。

paras.en: "This study is an excellent example of the power of nano delivery systems and their ability to potentially treat cancer and other diseases," Langer says.
paras.zh: 兰格说：“这项研究是纳米输送系统的力量及其潜在治疗癌症和其他疾病的能力的一个很好的例子。”

paras.en: A New Direction for Cancer and Autoimmune Treatments
paras.zh: 癌症和自身免疫治疗的新方向

paras.en: The researchers believe that reprogramming natural killer cells inside the body could eventually provide new treatment options for a much wider range of conditions.
paras.zh: 研究人员相信，对体内自然杀伤细胞进行重新编程最终可以为更广泛的疾病提供新的治疗选择。

paras.en: Among the diseases they hope to target are multiple sclerosis and rheumatoid arthritis, both of which can involve harmful immune responses driven by dysfunctional T cells.
paras.zh: 他们希望针对的疾病包括多发性硬化症和类风湿性关节炎，这两种疾病都可能涉及由功能失调的 T 细胞驱动的有害免疫反应。

paras.en: Although the findings are promising, the experiments were conducted in mice, and further research will be necessary to determine whether the technique is safe and effective in humans.
paras.zh: 尽管这些发现很有希望，但实验是在小鼠身上进行的，还需要进一步的研究来确定该技术对人类是否安全有效。

paras.en: If successful, the technology could make engineered immune cell treatments considerably more accessible by replacing a lengthy laboratory manufacturing process with the direct delivery of genetic instructions through nanoparticles.
paras.zh: 如果成功，该技术可以通过纳米粒子直接传递遗传指令来取代冗长的实验室制造过程，从而使工程免疫细胞治疗变得更加容易。

paras.en: The research received funding from Sanofi, the Marble Center for Cancer Nanomedicine, and a Koch Institute Support (core) Grant from the National Cancer Institute.
paras.zh: 该研究获得了赛诺菲、Marble 癌症纳米医学中心的资助，以及国家癌症研究所的科赫研究所支持（核心）资助。

articles.title: A 24-hour fast triggers a surprising repair response in the gut

paras.en: A 24-hour fast triggers a surprising repair response in the gut
paras.zh: 24 小时禁食会引发肠道惊人的修复反应

paras.en: - University of Texas M. D. Anderson Cancer Center
paras.zh: - 德克萨斯大学MD安德森癌症中心

paras.en: - Scientists have discovered that fasting for just 24 hours increases a beneficial gut bacterium that helps the intestines regenerate after radiation damage. The preclinical findings could pave the way for new treatments that protect healthy tissue during cancer therapy, potentially without requiring patients to fast.
paras.zh: - 科学家发现，仅禁食 24 小时就能增加有益肠道细菌的数量，从而帮助肠道在辐射损伤后再生。临床前研究结果可能为在癌症治疗期间保护健康组织的新疗法铺平道路，并且可能不需要患者禁食。

paras.en: A 24-hour fast may help prepare the intestines to recover from radiation damage, but scientists have discovered that a particular gut bacterium plays a crucial role in making this possible. New preclinical research from The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center reveals how fasting and beneficial microbes work together to activate the body's natural tissue repair mechanisms.
paras.zh: 24 小时禁食可能有助于肠道做好从辐射损伤中恢复的准备，但科学家发现，一种特定的肠道细菌在实现这一目标方面发挥着至关重要的作用。德克萨斯大学 MD 安德森癌症中心的新临床前研究揭示了禁食和有益微生物如何共同作用来激活人体的自然组织修复机制。

paras.en: The findings could eventually lead to new ways to protect healthy tissue during cancer treatment. By improving the intestine's ability to recover from radiation exposure, researchers hope to reduce serious side effects and potentially make radiation therapy safer and more effective.
paras.zh: 这些发现最终可能会带来在癌症治疗期间保护健康组织的新方法。通过提高肠道从辐射暴露中恢复的能力，研究人员希望减少严重的副作用，并有可能使放射治疗更安全、更有效。

paras.en: Published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, the study was co-led by Helen Piwnica-Worms, Ph.D., professor of Experimental Radiation Oncology, and Kunal Rai, Ph.D., professor of Genomic Medicine.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上，由实验放射肿瘤学教授 Helen Piwnica-Worms 博士和基因组医学教授 Kunal Rai 博士共同领导。

paras.en: "Fasting helps prepare intestinal cells to respond more quickly and effectively after injury, almost like training the cells with an emergency preparedness plan," Piwnica-Worms said. "This study helps explain how that plan is organized and identifies a key bacterium involved in coordinating the response."
paras.zh: Piwnica-Worms 说：“禁食有助于肠道细胞在受伤后更快、更有效地做出反应，就像用应急准备计划训练细胞一样。” “这项研究有助于解释该计划是如何组织的，并确定了参与协调反应的关键细菌。”

paras.en: Why Radiation Therapy Can Damage the Intestines
paras.zh: 为什么放射治疗会损害肠道

paras.en: Radiation therapy is widely used to treat cancers in the abdomen, including pancreatic, colorectal, and gynecologic cancers. Although radiation can destroy cancer cells, it can also harm nearby healthy tissue. The small intestine is particularly vulnerable because its delicate lining is highly sensitive to radiation exposure.
paras.zh: 放射治疗广泛用于治疗腹部癌症，包括胰腺癌、结直肠癌和妇科癌症。虽然辐射可以破坏癌细胞，但它也会损害附近的健康组织。小肠特别脆弱，因为其脆弱的内壁对辐射高度敏感。

paras.en: When this protective lining becomes damaged, patients may experience nausea, diarrhea, and infections. Severe injuries can cause life-threatening complications. These risks can also restrict the amount of radiation doctors can safely administer, potentially limiting treatment options.
paras.zh: 当这种保护层受损时，患者可能会出现恶心、腹泻和感染。严重受伤可能会导致危及生命的并发症。这些风险还可能限制医生可以安全施用的放射量，从而可能限制治疗选择。

paras.en: Previous preclinical research from the Piwnica-Worms Laboratory showed that fasting before radiation exposure helped the intestines recover afterward. However, researchers had not fully determined why going without food produced this protective effect.
paras.zh: 皮尼卡蠕虫实验室之前的临床前研究表明，辐射暴露前禁食有助于肠道在辐射后恢复。然而，研究人员尚未完全确定为什么不吃食物会产生这种保护作用。

paras.en: The latest study provides an important piece of that puzzle by identifying a specific gut bacterium and explaining how it helps intestinal cells prepare for injury.
paras.zh: 最新的研究通过识别一种特定的肠道细菌并解释它如何帮助肠道细胞为损伤做好准备，为这个难题提供了重要的一部分。

paras.en: Researchers found that 24 hours of fasting increased the abundance of a beneficial bacterium called Akkermansia muciniphila, also known as AKK, in the small intestine. This microbe produces a substance called propionate, which helps trigger changes inside intestinal cells that make them better prepared to regenerate following radiation damage.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，24 小时禁食会增加小肠中一种名为 Akkermansia muciniphila（也称为 AKK）的有益细菌的丰度。这种微生物产生一种叫做丙酸盐的物质，它有助于触发肠道细胞内部的变化，使它们更好地准备好在辐射损伤后再生。

paras.en: Propionate works alongside other metabolic changes caused by fasting to modify proteins known as histones. These proteins serve as structures around which DNA is packaged inside cells. Small chemical markers added to histones can influence which genes become active without changing the underlying DNA sequence.
paras.zh: 丙酸与禁食引起的其他代谢变化一起作用，以修饰称为组蛋白的蛋白质。这些蛋白质作为 DNA 在细胞内包装的结构。添加到组蛋白中的小化学标记可以影响哪些基因变得活跃，而不改变潜在的 DNA 序列。

paras.en: These modifications make portions of DNA more accessible, allowing cells to activate genes involved in tissue regeneration. During fasting, a population of intestinal cells carrying these repair programs becomes more abundant.
paras.zh: 这些修饰使部分 DNA 更容易接近，从而使细胞能够激活参与组织再生的基因。在禁食期间，携带这些修复程序的肠道细胞群变得更加丰富。

paras.en: In effect, fasting helps prepare these cells with the biological instructions they will need if an injury occurs. When the intestines are subsequently exposed to radiation, the prepared cells can expand and help rebuild the damaged intestinal lining.
paras.zh: 实际上，禁食有助于这些细胞准备好发生损伤时所需的生物指令。当肠道随后暴露于辐射时，准备好的细胞可以扩张并帮助重建受损的肠内壁。

paras.en: One Gut Bacterium Proves Essential for Recovery
paras.zh: 一种肠道细菌被证明对康复至关重要

paras.en: To determine how important AKK was to this process, the researchers selectively removed the bacterium. Without it, fasting no longer produced the same regenerative benefits.
paras.zh: 为了确定 AKK 在此过程中的重要性，研究人员选择性地去除了这种细菌。没有它，禁食就不再产生同样的再生益处。

paras.en: Even more revealing, the protective response returned only when the bacterium was restored in combination with fasting. This demonstrated that neither component alone was sufficient to reproduce the full effect observed in the study.
paras.zh: 更能说明问题的是，只有当细菌在禁食的情况下恢复时，保护性反应才会恢复。这表明单独使用任何一种成分都不足以重现研究中观察到的全部效果。

paras.en: The results suggest that fasting does more than temporarily change the gut's metabolism. Together with AKK, it alters the activity of intestinal cells before radiation exposure, placing them in a state that supports more efficient recovery after damage occurs.
paras.zh: 结果表明，禁食不仅仅只是暂时改变肠道的新陈代谢。它与 AKK 一起，在辐射暴露前改变肠道细胞的活性，使它们处于一种支持损伤发生后更有效恢复的状态。

paras.en: By uncovering this connection between nutrition, gut bacteria, and cellular regeneration, the researchers have identified a potential new way to strengthen the body's response to tissue injury. The discovery could be especially valuable for protecting healthy organs during cancer treatment.
paras.zh: 通过揭示营养、肠道细菌和细胞再生之间的联系，研究人员找到了一种潜在的新方法来增强身体对组织损伤的反应。这一发现对于在癌症治疗期间保护健康器官特别有价值。

paras.en: Could Gut Bacteria Make Cancer Treatment Safer?
paras.zh: 肠道细菌能让癌症治疗更安全吗？

paras.en: Although the results are promising, the research remains preclinical. Additional studies will be needed to determine whether the same protective mechanism operates in humans and whether it can safely improve outcomes for patients receiving radiation therapy.
paras.zh: 尽管结果令人鼓舞，但该研究仍处于临床前阶段。还需要进行更多研究来确定相同的保护机制是否适用于人类，以及它是否可以安全地改善接受放射治疗的患者的治疗结果。

paras.en: One possibility is that the newly discovered pathway could be used to help other healthy tissues recover from cancer treatment. Researchers are particularly interested in tissues with rapidly dividing cells, including bone marrow, which can also suffer treatment-related damage.
paras.zh: 一种可能性是，新发现的途径可用于帮助其他健康组织从癌症治疗中恢复。研究人员对细胞快速分裂的组织特别感兴趣，包括骨髓，这些组织也可能遭受与治疗相关的损伤。

paras.en: If further investigations support the findings, clinical trials could eventually explore whether activating this repair mechanism benefits patients undergoing abdominal radiation therapy.
paras.zh: 如果进一步的研究支持这些发现，临床试验最终可以探索激活这种修复机制是否有益于接受腹部放射治疗的患者。

paras.en: Importantly, the discovery may also provide ways to achieve these effects without requiring patients to fast. Treatments involving beneficial bacteria or the molecules they produce could potentially stimulate similar repair processes while avoiding the practical difficulties of food restriction during cancer care.
paras.zh: 重要的是，这一发现还可能提供无需患者禁食即可实现这些效果的方法。涉及有益细菌或其产生的分子的治疗可能会刺激类似的修复过程，同时避免癌症治疗期间限制食物的实际困难。

paras.en: "Fasting is not always practical for cancer patients, and this work supports several other potential ways to enhance recovery after treatment," Rai said. "Whether through dietary interventions, targeted microbes or their metabolites, the goal is to help repair healthy tissue more effectively while patients receive the cancer therapies they need."
paras.zh: “禁食对于癌症患者来说并不总是可行，这项工作支持了其他几种促进治疗后恢复的潜在方法，”拉伊说。 “无论是通过饮食干预、靶向微生物或其代谢物，目标都是在患者接受所需的癌症治疗的同时帮助更有效地修复健康组织。”

paras.en: The research was funded by the National Cancer Institute (NCI) within the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and the Cancer Prevention and Research Institute of Texas (CPRIT).
paras.zh: 该研究由美国国立卫生研究院 (NIH) 下属的国家癌症研究所 (NCI) 和德克萨斯州癌症预防与研究所 (CPRIT) 资助。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Texas M. D. Anderson Cancer Center. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.

articles.title: Who is King Ghidorah? The cosmic connections of Godzilla Minus Zero's foe
articles.author: Robert Lea

paras.en: Godzilla goes toe-to-toe with long-time foe King Ghidorah in Godzilla Minus Zero, which opened in theaters on Friday (Nov. 6). Though the three-headed golden Kaiju might seem like a natural native of Monster Island, King Ghidorah actually emerged from the depths of space.
paras.zh: 《哥斯拉减零》于周五（11 月 6 日）在影院上映，哥斯拉将与宿敌王基多拉正面交锋。虽然三头黄金怪兽看起来像是怪物岛的天然居民，但王者基多拉实际上是从太空深处出现的。

paras.en: However, it isn't just the origins of King Ghidorah — also known as Monster Zero in the Godzilla movie Invasion of Astro-Monster (1965) — that are this beast's only cosmic connection. One of the largest structures in the universe, the King Ghidorah Supercluster, was named in honor of Godzilla's primary antagonist.
paras.zh: 然而，王者基多拉（在哥斯拉电影《天文怪兽入侵》（1965 年）中也被称为“零号怪兽”）的起源不仅仅是这只野兽与宇宙的唯一联系。宇宙中最大的结构之一，王者基多拉超级星团，是以哥斯拉的主要对手的名字命名的。

paras.en: King Ghidorah is a three-headed, twin-tailed golden dragon from the stars, first introduced in the fifth Godzilla movie, Ghidorah, the Three-Headed Monster (1964).
paras.zh: 王者基多拉是一条来自星空的三头双尾金龙，首次出现在第五部哥斯拉电影《三头怪兽基多拉》（1964 年）中。

paras.en: In this first appearance, part of the Shōwa era (1964–1975) of Godzilla history, Ghidorah ravaged Venus, wiping out its population 5,000 years before arriving on Earth encased within a highly magnetic meteorite. Ghidorah was bested this first time by Godzilla, Rodan, and Mothra.
paras.zh: 在哥斯拉历史昭和时代（1964-1975）的第一次出现中，基多拉蹂躏了金星，在到达地球前 5000 年消灭了金星上的人口，并被包裹在一颗高磁性陨石中。基多拉第一次被哥斯拉、拉顿和魔斯拉击败。

paras.en: Undeterred, Ghidorah returned for a rematch just a year later in Invasion of Astro Monster (1965), after being discovered supposedly terrorizing the inhabitants of Planet X, a world found beyond Jupiter. In this movie, it is revealed that Ghidorah is less a king and more a pawn, under the control of calculating Xiliens as part of a plan to subjugate Earth. This will become a theme.
paras.zh: 基多拉并没有被吓倒，仅仅一年后，基多拉就在《天文怪物入侵》（1965 年）中回归，在被发现恐吓 X 行星（木星之外的世界）的居民后，他再次参加了比赛。在这部电影中，基多拉与其说是国王，不如说是棋子，在计算西连的控制下，作为征服地球计划的一部分。这将成为一个主题。

paras.en: Freed from that control, Ghidorah returns to deep space, once again falling under the thrall of an alien race in 1968's Destroy All Monsters.
paras.zh: 摆脱了这种控制后，基多拉返回外太空，在 1968 年的《消灭所有怪物》中再次沦为外星种族的奴隶。

paras.en: This movie sees Ghidorah hold its own against a who's who of kaiju, eventually succumbing to the combined might of Godzilla, Minilla, Mothra, Rodan, Manda, Gorosaurus, Anguirus, Kumonga, Baragon, and Varan.
paras.zh: 在这部电影中，基多拉与怪兽名人录抗衡，最终屈服于哥斯拉、米尼拉、摩斯拉、罗顿、曼达、戈龙、安吉鲁斯、库蒙加、巴拉贡和瓦兰的联合力量。

paras.en: Even with three gravity-beam-blasting heads, that is hardly fair!
paras.zh: 即使有三个重力束爆破头，这也不太公平！

paras.en: Ghidorah returned with some backup for a final time in the Shōwa era in 1975's Godzilla vs. Gigan. This time, Ghidorah and his tag-team partner Gigan (who resembled a giant one-eyed space chicken) were under the control of cockroach-like Nebulans. Getting mind-controlled three times is just embarrassing!
paras.zh: 基多拉在 1975 年的《哥斯拉大战基刚》中，在昭和时代最后一次带着一些替补回归。这一次，基多拉和他的双打搭档吉甘（类似一只巨大的独眼太空鸡）受到了像蟑螂一样的星云的控制。被精神控制三次，简直丢脸！

paras.en: Fortunately, the Shōwa era drew to a close in 1975 before Ghidorah was forced into servitude for a fourth time.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，昭和时代在 1975 年结束，基多拉第四次被迫为奴。

paras.en: Ghidorah returned in the rebooted Godzilla timeline of the Heisei era (1991–1998) in 1991's Godzilla Vs. King Ghidorah, but its cosmic origins are gone. The Heisei Ghidorah begins life as three genetically engineered creatures called Dorats in the future before being morphed into a three-headed form via nuclear exposure.
paras.zh: 基多拉在 1991 年的《哥斯拉大战》中回归平成时代（1991-1998）重启的哥斯拉时间线。王者基多拉，但其宇宙起源已不复存在。平成基多拉最初是三个被称为未来多拉特的基因工程生物，然后通过核暴露变成了三头形态。

paras.en: Ghidorah was given a spiritual origin in the Millennium era's Godzilla, Mothra, and King Ghidorah: Giant Monsters All-Out Attack (2001), actually serving as a protagonist, helping Mothra in halting Godzilla's rampage.
paras.zh: 基多拉在千禧年的《哥斯拉、魔斯拉与王者基多拉巨兽全面进击》中被赋予了精神起源，实际上作为主角，帮助魔斯拉制止了哥斯拉的暴行。

paras.en: Ghidorah is once again an extraterrestrial in Universal Pictures' MonsterVerse movie Godzilla: King of the Monsters (2019), being described as having "fallen from the stars" in ancient times before rising to challenge Godzilla.
paras.zh: 环球影业出品的怪兽宇宙电影《哥斯拉：怪兽之王》（2019）中，基多拉再次成为外星人，被描述为在远古时代“从星星上坠落”，然后崛起挑战哥斯拉。

paras.en: Now King Ghidorah is back once again in Godzilla Minus Zero, maintaining his extraterrestrial origin story and once again challenging Godzilla to an epic kaiju battle.
paras.zh: 如今，王者基多拉再次回归《哥斯拉负零》，延续了他的外星起源故事，并再次向哥斯拉发起了一场史诗般的怪兽大战。

paras.en: Those are some of the fictional versions of this golden beast, but what does it look like in reality?
paras.zh: 这些是这只金色野兽的一些虚构版本，但它在现实中是什么样子呢？

paras.en: Arguably the most impressive feat of King Ghidorah has been to make itself such an important part of pop culture that astronomers took note.
paras.zh: 可以说，王者基多拉最令人印象深刻的壮举就是使自己成为流行文化的重要组成部分，以至于天文学家注意到了这一点。

paras.en: The King Ghidorah supercluster is a collection of galaxies located around 6.7 billion light-years from Earth. Covering an area of the sky equivalent to 19 full moons, as seen from our vantage point, this cosmic Kaiju was discovered in late 2022 by Japanese astronomers using data from the Subaru Telescope.
paras.zh: 王者基多拉超星系团是距离地球约 67 亿光年的星系集合。从我们的有利位置看，这颗宇宙怪兽的天空面积相当于 19 个满月，日本天文学家利用斯巴鲁望远镜的数据于 2022 年底发现了它。

paras.en: The King Ghidorah supercluster is comprised of at least 19 individual associated galaxy clusters. It stretches out for an incredible 1.3 billion light-years, meaning the entire Milky Way could fit across it around 12,300 times. That makes it the largest supercluster ever discovered.
paras.zh: 王者基多拉超星系团由至少 19 个独立的相关星系团组成。它绵延令人难以置信的 13 亿光年，这意味着整个银河系可以穿过它约 12,300 倍。这使其成为迄今为止发现的最大的超星系团。

paras.en: To put into context just how monstrous the King Ghidorah supercluster is, consider the fact that it has a mass equivalent to 10,000,000,000,000,000 suns, 10 times as massive as the Milky Way's home supercluster, Laniakea.
paras.zh: 为了说明王者基多拉超星系团有多么可怕，请考虑一下这样一个事实：它的质量相当于 10,000,000,000,000,000 个太阳，是银河系家乡超星系团拉尼亚凯亚质量的 10 倍。

paras.en: Even Godzilla may think twice before attempting to tussle with that particular King Ghidorah!
paras.zh: 即使是哥斯拉在尝试与特定的国王基多拉战斗之前也会三思而后行！

paras.en: See King Ghidorah in action in Godzilla Minus Zero, which is showing in theaters in the US and UK from November 6. You can see the preceding movie, Godzilla Minus One, on Netflix.
paras.zh: 在《哥斯拉减零》中观看王者基多拉的表演，该片将于 11 月 6 日起在美国和英国影院上映。您可以在 Netflix 上观看前一部电影《哥斯拉减一》。

paras.en: Robert Lea is a science journalist in the U.K. whose articles have been published in Physics World, New Scientist, Astronomy Magazine, All About Space, Newsweek and ZME Science. He also writes about science communication for Elsevier and the European Journal of Physics. Rob holds a bachelor of science degree in physics and astronomy from the U.K.’s Open University. Follow him on Twitter @sciencef1rst.
paras.zh: 罗伯特·李 (Robert Lea) 是一位英国科学记者，其文章发表在《物理世界》、《新科学家》、《天文学杂志》、《All About Space》、《新闻周刊》和《ZME Science》上。他还为爱思唯尔和《欧洲物理学杂志》撰写有关科学传播的文章。 Rob 拥有英国开放大学物理和天文学理学学士学位。在 Twitter 上关注他@sciencef1rst。

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 8, 2005: Europe launches Venus Express, its first mission to Venus
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. The spacecraft was called Venus Express.
paras.zh: 2005年11月8日，欧洲发射了首次金星任务。这艘宇宙飞船被称为“金星快车”。

paras.en: Venus is a hothouse planet, one where the atmospheric pressure can easily crush an unprotected spacecraft. Even from orbit, Venus Express had to survive harsh radiation. But the spacecraft lasted for more than nine years.
paras.zh: 金星是一颗温室行星，大气压力很容易压碎未受保护的航天器。即使在轨道上，金星快车也必须承受严酷的辐射。但航天器持续了九年多。

paras.en: During that time, Venus Express saw a weird vortex swirling around Venus's south pole. It also saw possible signs of active volcanoes. Venus Express also discovered that the planet generates its own auroras. These auroras happen when particles from the sun hit charged particles in the atmosphere.
paras.zh: 在那段时间，金星快车号看到金星南极周围有一个奇怪的漩涡旋转。它还看到了可能存在活火山的迹象。金星快车还发现这颗行星会产生自己的极光。当太阳粒子撞击大气中的带电粒子时，就会发生这些极光。

paras.en: Late in the Venus Express mission, controllers told the spacecraft to dip down into Venus's clouds — even though the spacecraft wasn't designed to do this. It performed well, but eventually it stopped listening to commands. The spacecraft burned up in the atmosphere in January 2015.
paras.zh: 在金星快车任务后期，控制人员告诉航天器深入金星云层——尽管航天器的设计初衷并不是这样做。它表现得很好，但最终它不再听命令了。 2015年1月，该航天器在大气层中燃烧。

paras.en: Venus Express established ESA as the third world organization to successfully send a probe to study Venus, following the United States and Soviet Union. (Japan's JAXA became the fourth five years later.)
paras.zh: 金星快车成立欧空局，成为继美国和苏联之后第三个成功发射探测器研究金星的世界组织。 （五年后，日本 JAXA 成为第四家。）

paras.en: "By studying Venus, scientists learn how Earth-like planets change over time," reads a summary of the planet's exploration prepared by The Planetary Society. "Orbital studies [like Venus Express] hint that Venus may have hosted habitable oceans before becoming inhospitable."
paras.zh: “通过研究金星，科学家们了解类地行星如何随时间变化，”行星协会编写的金星探索总结中写道。 “轨道研究（如金星快车）暗示，金星在变得不适宜居住之前可能曾经拥有适宜居住的海洋。”

paras.en: "By studying Venus, we can learn how Earth-like planets evolve and what shapes planets throughout the galaxy into temperate, lush worlds instead of sweltering hothouses. Venus also helps scientists model Earth’s climate, and may serve as a cautionary tale on how dramatically a planet’s climate can change," wrote the Society.
paras.zh: 该学会写道：“通过研究金星，我们可以了解类地行星如何演化，以及是什么将整个银河系的行星塑造成温和、茂盛的世界，而不是闷热的温室。金星还帮助科学家模拟地球的气候，并可能作为一个关于行星气候如何剧烈变化的警示故事。”

paras.en: ESA returned to Venus in 2018 when BepiColombo, its joint mission with JAXA, used the planet's gravity to redirect its path toward the planet Mercury.
paras.zh: 欧空局于 2018 年返回金星，当时其与 JAXA 的联合任务 BepiColombo 利用金星的引力改变其前往水星的路径。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: Legendary sci-fi magazine 'Starlog' returns as a yearly release, just in time for its 50th anniversary
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: "Starlog" was one of the greatest sci-fi and fantasy magazines ever, and after a 17-year absence, it's being resurrected.
paras.zh: 《Starlog》是有史以来最伟大的科幻奇幻杂志之一，在消失 17 年后，它又重新焕发活力。

paras.en: The legendary sci-fi mag went dark back in 2009 as part of the wave of popular publications folding due to years of declining readership and subscriptions. But as of Nov. 13, this geek favorite periodical returns as an annual print edition, and it's available for pre-order now.
paras.zh: 这本传奇的科幻杂志早在 2009 年就停刊了，这是由于读者数和订阅量多年来不断下降而导致的流行出版物倒闭浪潮的一部分。但从 11 月 13 日起，这本极客最喜爱的期刊以年度印刷版的形式回归，并且现在可以预订。

paras.en: It’s another indication of digital fatigue in the world, and fans of a certain age will recall the pleasure of poring over each colorful issue packed with in-depth interviews, behind-the-scenes photos, TV guides, classic movie retrospectives, book reviews, con news, and VFX features.
paras.zh: 这是世界数字疲劳的另一个迹象，一定年龄的粉丝会回忆起仔细阅读每一期丰富多彩的内容的乐趣，其中充满了深度采访、幕后照片、电视指南、经典电影回顾、书评、骗局新闻和视觉特效功能。

paras.en: "Starlog" launched in 1976, in the pre-"Star Wars" days, under the leadership of editor-in-chief Terry O’Quinn. It first arrived with artist Jack Thurston's beautiful painted "Star Trek" cover, featuring William Shatner as Captain James T. Kirk and Leonard Nimoy’s Spock, set against the U.S.S. Enterprise near a shimmering black hole.
paras.zh: 《Starlog》于 1976 年在《星球大战》上映之前由主编特里·奥奎因 (Terry O’Quinn) 创办。它首先以艺术家杰克·瑟斯顿 (Jack Thurston) 精美的彩绘《星际迷航》封面亮相，其中威廉·沙特纳 (William Shatner) 饰演詹姆斯·T·柯克 (James T. Kirk) 船长，伦纳德·尼莫伊 (Leonard Nimoy) 饰演的斯波克 (Spock)，背景是美国。企业号靠近一个闪闪发光的黑洞。

paras.en: The magazine continued to inform the science fiction community about upcoming sci-fi TV shows and blockbuster Hollywood films for over three decades; I fondly recall reading each informative and entertaining monthly issue cover-to-cover.
paras.zh: 三十多年来，该杂志不断向科幻界介绍即将上映的科幻电视节目和好莱坞大片；我清楚地记得从头到尾阅读每一期信息丰富且有趣的月刊。

paras.en: Just in time to honor its 50th anniversary this year, "Starlog" blasts back into the sci-fi universe with Issue #375 showcasing cover artwork created by Armenian artist Gabriel Yeganyan. Its geek culture legacy, covering iconic franchises like "Star Wars," "Star Trek," and "Alien," will now live on thanks to Fangoria Holdings and io9 co-founder Annalee Newitz, editor-in-chief.
paras.zh: 今年恰逢其成立 50 周年，《Starlog》以第 375 期的形式重返科幻宇宙，展示了亚美尼亚艺术家 Gabriel Yeganyan 创作的封面艺术作品。得益于 Fangoria Holdings 和 io9 联合创始人兼主编 Annalee Newitz，其极客文化遗产（涵盖《星球大战》、《星际迷航》和《异形》等标志性系列）如今将得以延续。

paras.en: "During its original 33-year run, 'Starlog' documented science fiction as it evolved across film, television, books, technology, and culture," said 'Fangoria's Tara Ansley.
paras.zh: “在最初的 33 年运营中，《Starlog》记录了科幻小说在电影、电视、书籍、技术和文化中的演变，”Fangoria 的塔拉·安斯利 (Tara Ansley) 说道。

paras.en: "Fifty years after the magazine first launched, the line between science fiction and the real world has become increasingly difficult to separate. That makes this an especially interesting time to bring 'Starlog' back. Technology may change, but the most compelling questions have always been about people: how we live, what we create, and what kind of future we want to build."
paras.zh: “杂志创刊五十年后，科幻小说与现实世界之间的界限变得越来越难以区分。这使得《Starlog》回归成为一个特别有趣的时刻。技术可能会发生变化，但最引人注目的问题始终是关于人的：我们如何生活，我们创造什么，以及我们想要建设什么样的未来。”

paras.en: "Starlog" reloads for its first annual edition after a long hiatus on Nov. 13. You can pre-order the first issue (Issue 375 in continuity) on the Starlog website.
paras.zh: 《Starlog》在长时间中断后于 11 月 13 日重新推出第一期年度版。您可以在 Starlog 网站上预订第一期（连续第 375 期）。

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。

articles.title: Flexell Space and Satoro Agree to Collaborate on In-Orbit Demonstration of Next-Generation Space Solar Cells
articles.author: Flexell Space

paras.en: – Two demonstration missions planned aboard SpaceX Falcon 9, one each in 2027 and 2028
paras.zh: – 计划在 SpaceX Falcon 9 上执行两次演示任务，分别于 2027 年和 2028 年执行一次

paras.en: – Satoro to provide “Satellite-as-a-service” solution; Flexell Space to supply solar cells and test modules
paras.zh: – Sataro 提供“卫星即服务”解决方案； Flexell Space 供应太阳能电池和测试模块

paras.en: Uiwang-si, Korea – Flexell Space, a space energy company led by CEO Taehun Ahn, announced that it has signed an agreement with Singapore-based CubeSat specialist Satoro, led by CEO Mark Lu, for the in-orbit demonstration and validation (IOD/IOV) of next-generation space solar cells.
paras.zh: 韩国义王市 - 由首席执行官 Taehun Ahn 领导的空间能源公司 Flexell Space 宣布，它已与由首席执行官 Mark Lu 领导的新加坡 CubeSat 专家 Satoro 签署协议，以进行下一代空间太阳能电池的在轨演示和验证 (IOD/IOV)。

paras.en: The agreement aims to verify the performance and reliability of Flexell Space’s solar cells in the actual space environment. The companies plan to conduct two demonstration missions, one in 2027 and another in 2028. Each demonstration satellite is scheduled to launch aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket.
paras.zh: 该协议旨在验证Flexell Space太阳能电池在实际太空环境中的性能和可靠性。两家公司计划执行两次演示任务，一次在 2027 年，另一次在 2028 年。每颗演示卫星都计划搭载 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭发射。

paras.en: Flexell Space previously conducted two space demonstration missions through launches aboard Korea’s KSLV-II, in November 2025 and October 2026. Building on this experience, the agreement with Satoro will expand opportunities for in-orbit validation of its next-generation space solar cells and support the continued accumulation of operational data needed for commercialization.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 此前曾于 2025 年 11 月和 2026 年 10 月通过韩国 KSLV-II 发射进行了两次太空演示任务。基于这一经验，与 Satoro 的协议将扩大其下一代空间太阳能电池在轨验证的机会，并支持持续积累商业化所需的操作数据。

paras.en: Under the agreement, Satoro will manufacture the satellites for the demonstration missions, while Flexell Space will supply the solar cells and test modules to be integrated into them. The companies will coordinate technical requirements for the CubeSat platforms and demonstration payloads, working together to evaluate the solar cells’ operating characteristics and performance in orbit.
paras.zh: 根据协议，Satoro 将制造用于演示任务的卫星，而 Flexell Space 将提供太阳能电池和集成到卫星中的测试模块。两家公司将协调立方体卫星平台和演示有效载荷的技术要求，共同评估太阳能电池的运行特性和在轨性能。

paras.en: Through these missions, Flexell Space plans to compare and validate ground-test results against in-orbit operational data and assess the solar cells’ power output characteristics and performance changes over time. Data collected from both missions will support further design improvements and reliability validation, strengthening the technical foundation for evaluations by global customers and future commercial supply.
paras.zh: 通过这些任务，Flexell Space 计划将地面测试结果与在轨运行数据进行比较和验证，并评估太阳能电池的功率输出特性和性能随时间的变化。从这两个任务收集的数据将支持进一步的设计改进和可靠性验证，加强全球客户评估和未来商业供应的技术基础。

paras.en: The collaboration brings together Satoro’s expertise in CubeSat manufacturing and demonstration missions with Flexell Space’s capabilities in next-generation solar cell development. Flexell Space is developing solar cell technologies based on CIGS (copper indium gallium selenide) and perovskites, with a focus on commercializing low-cost, large-area, ultralight power solutions for satellites and a wide range of space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 此次合作将 Sataro 在 CubeSat 制造和演示任务方面的专业知识与 Flexell Space 在下一代太阳能电池开发方面的能力结合在一起。 Flexell Space 正在开发基于 CIGS（铜铟镓硒）和钙钛矿的太阳能电池技术，重点是将用于卫星和各种空间基础设施的低成本、大面积、超轻电源解决方案商业化。

paras.en: “Commercializing space solar cells requires both ground-based performance validation and data collected in orbit,” said Taehun Ahn, CEO of Flexell Space. “With two demonstration opportunities secured for 2027 and 2028, we will systematically verify the performance and reliability of our next-generation solar cells and build the technical evidence required by global customers.”
paras.zh: Flexell Space 首席执行官 Taehun Ahn 表示：“太空太阳能电池的商业化需要地面性能验证和在轨道上收集的数据。” “通过在 2027 年和 2028 年获得两次演示机会，我们将系统地验证下一代太阳能电池的性能和可靠性，并建立全球客户所需的技术证据。”

paras.en: He added, “Our collaboration with Satoro establishes a clear path from development to in-orbit demonstration and will accelerate our preparations for future commercial supply.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“我们与 Sataro 的合作建立了从开发到在轨演示的清晰路径，并将加速我们为未来商业供应做准备。”

paras.en: “We are pleased to work with Flexell Space on the demonstration of its next-generation space solar cells,” said Mark Lu, CEO of Satoro. “Drawing on Satoro’s CubeSat platforms and mission integration capabilities, we will work closely with Flexell Space to help secure the in-orbit data needed to validate its technology.”
paras.zh: “我们很高兴与 Flexell Space 合作展示其下一代太空太阳能电池，”Satoro 首席执行官 Mark Lu 表示。 “利用 Satoro 的 CubeSat 平台和任务集成能力，我们将与 Flexell Space 密切合作，帮助确保验证其技术所需的在轨数据的安全。”

paras.en: He added, “We look forward to these two demonstration missions advancing the commercial potential of new space power technologies and laying the groundwork for continued technical collaboration between our companies.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“我们期待这两项示范任务能够提升新太空动力技术的商业潜力，并为我们公司之间的持续技术合作奠定基础。”

paras.en: Flexell Space is a space energy company that originated as an internal venture at Hanwha Systems and develops next-generation space solar cells and power solutions. The company focuses on low-cost, large-area, ultralight products based on CIGS and perovskite solar cell technologies, with an emphasis on the durability, radiation tolerance, and long-term operational reliability required for space applications. Through collaboration with global satellite manufacturers and space agencies, Flexell Space is advancing the commercialization of solar cell technologies for satellites and space infrastructure.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 是一家空间能源公司，最初是韩华系统公司的内部合资企业，致力于开发下一代空间太阳能电池和电源解决方案。该公司专注于基于 CIGS 和钙钛矿太阳能电池技术的低成本、大面积、超轻产品，重点关注空间应用所需的耐用性、耐辐射性和长期运行可靠性。通过与全球卫星制造商和航天机构合作，Flexell Space 正在推进卫星和空间基础设施太阳能电池技术的商业化。

paras.en: Satoro is a Singapore-based “Satellite-as-a-service” solutions company providing integrated services spanning satellite manufacturing, payload integration, launch coordination, and in-orbit operations, demonstration, and validation (IOD/IOV). Since 2021, the company has successfully deployed 11 satellites into orbit across eight launches, achieving a 100% launch success rate. Drawing on this experience and technical expertise, Satoro supports global customers in validating and commercializing their space technologies.
paras.zh: Satero 是一家总部位于新加坡的“卫星即服务”解决方案公司，提供涵盖卫星制造、有效载荷集成、发射协调以及在轨运行、演示和验证 (IOD/IOV) 的综合服务。 2021年以来，公司共发射8次，成功将11颗卫星送入轨道，发射成功率100%。凭借这些经验和技术专长，Satoro 支持全球客户验证其空间技术并将其商业化。

articles.title: Advice for optimizing the space industry with Laura Crabtree
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, Mike Gruss speaks with Laura Crabtree, the CEO of Epsilon3, who is also a former SpaceX astronaut trainer. They talk about ways that space companies can organize themselves to increase speed, especially to remove roadblocks around testing and certification.
paras.zh: 在本集中，迈克·格鲁斯 (Mike Gruss) 与 Epsilon3 首席执行官劳拉·克拉布特里 (Laura Crabtree) 进行了交谈，劳拉·克拉布特里也是前 SpaceX 宇航员培训师。他们讨论了航天公司如何组织起来提高速度，特别是消除测试和认证方面的障碍。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对喜欢谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

paras.en: Watch a new episode every Thursday on SpaceNews.com and on our YouTube, Spotify and Apple channels.
paras.zh: 每周四在 SpaceNews.com 以及我们的 YouTube、Spotify 和 Apple 频道上观看新剧集。

paras.en: Be the first to know when new episodes drop! Enter your email, and we’ll make sure you get exclusive access to each episode as soon as it goes live!
paras.zh: 成为第一个知道新剧集何时发布的人！输入您的电子邮件，我们将确保您在每集上线后立即获得独家访问权限！
